questions.title: Bones
questions.passage_html: Bones also protect the organs in our bodies. The skull protects the brain and forms the shape of the face. The spinal cord, a pathway for messages between the brain and the body, is protected by the backbone, or spinal column. The ribs form a cage that shelters heart and lungs, and the pelvis helps protect the bladder, part of the intestines, and in women, the reproductive organs. Bones are made up of a framework of a protein called collagen, with a mineral called calcium phosphate that makes the framework hard and strong. Bones store calcium and release some into the bloodstream when it's needed by other parts of the body. The amounts of certain vitamins and minerals that you eat, especially vitamin D and calcium, directly affect how much calcium is stored in the bones. Joints are where bones meet. They make the skeleton flexible — without them, movement would be impossible. Joints allow our bodies to move in many ways. Some joints open and close like a hinge (such as knees and elbows), whereas others allow for more complicated movement — a shoulder or hip joint, for example, allows for backward, forward, sideways, and rotating movement. Joints are classified by their range of movement: Immovable, or fibrous, joints don't move. The dome of the skull, for example, is made of bony plates, which move slightly during birth and then fuse together as the skull finishes growing. Between the edges of these plates are links, or joints, of fibrous tissue. Fibrous joints also hold the teeth in the jawbone. Partially movable, or cartilaginous, joints move a little. They are linked by cartilage, as in the spine. Each of the vertebrae in the spine moves in relation to the one above and below it, and together these movements give the spine its flexibility. Freely movable, or synovial (pronounced: sih-NO-vee-ul), joints move in many directions. The joints of the body — such as those found at the hip, shoulders, elbows, knees, wrists, and ankles — are freely movable. They are filled with synovial fluid, which acts as a lubricant to help the joints move easily. kinds of freely movable joints play a big part in voluntary movement: Hinge joints allow movement in one direction, as seen in the knees and elbows. Pivot joints allow a rotating or twisting motion, like that of the head moving from side to side. Ball-and-socket joints allow the greatest freedom movement. The hips and shoulders have this type of joint, in which the round end of a long bone fits into the hollow of another bone.
questions.analysis_html:
1、the

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格位于 “The ribs form a cage that shelters ______ heart and lungs” 结构中。本句在讨论人体的解剖学结构（肋骨保护着心脏和肺部）。因为人体器官“心脏（heart）”和“肺（lungs）”在此属于世人共知的特定人体器官，在单句内部的限定逻辑下，必须使用定冠词进行特指。因此选用 the（定冠词，特指人体的这些器官）。

2、two

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格位于 “Joints are where ______ bones meet” 结构中。这里是在给“关节（Joints）”下定义。根据医学基础常识与单句内部的定义逻辑，一个关节必然是由“两块”或两块以上的骨头相连相遇的地方。在选项给出的数量及指代词中，只有 two（两块） 满足关节形成的生理定义。

3、main

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作定语修饰名词 joints，本句框架为 “The ______ joints of the body — such as those found at the hip, shoulders, elbows... — are freely movable.”（身体的……关节——例如臀部、肩膀、手肘等处的关节——是自由活动的）。作者在此通过 such as 列举了人体最主要、最核心的几个大关节。根据单句内部的分类逻辑，此处是在概述人体“主要的”关节类型，故选用形容词 main（主要的） 最具概括性（whole 和 entire 意为“整个/全部”，与后面的具体列举逻辑不符）。

4、Three

考点：上下文语境

解析： 空格位于句首，用来总领下文：“______ kinds of freely movable joints play a big part in voluntary movement...”。紧接着后文用冒号（或分述句）清晰地一一列举了这几种关节：第一种是 Hinge joints（铰链关节），第二种是 Pivot joints（枢轴关节），第三种是 Ball-and-socket joints（球窝关节）。后文这清晰的三点列举构成了决定性的上下文线索，彻底锁死了此处需要填入数量词 Three（三种）。

5、of

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于 “Ball-and-socket joints allow the greatest freedom ______ movement” 结构中。本句在形容球窝关节的物理特性，即它能赋予关节最大的“运动自由度”。在英语习惯用法中，表达“……的自由 / 做某事的自由”，freedom 后面习惯使用的是由介词构成的固定搭配 “freedom of...”（如 freedom of movement 运动自由，freedom of speech 言论自由）。

They are linked by cartilage, as in the spine.

Each of the vertebrae in the spine moves in relation to the one above and below it, and together these movements give the spine its flexibility.

脊柱中的每一块椎骨都相对于其上方和下方的椎骨运动，这些运动共同赋予了脊柱灵活性。

Freely movable, or synovial, joints move in many directions.

自由活动关节（或称滑膜关节）可以向多个方向活动。

The main joints of the body — such as those found at the hip, shoulders, elbows, knees, wrists, and ankles — are freely movable.

身体的主要关节——例如髋关节、肩关节、肘关节、膝关节、腕关节和踝关节——都是自由活动关节。

They are filled with synovial fluid, which acts as a lubricant to help the joints move easily.

它们充满了滑液，滑液起到润滑剂的作用，帮助关节轻松活动。

Three kinds of freely movable joints play a big part in voluntary movement: Hinge joints allow movement in one direction, as seen in the knees and elbows.

三种自由活动关节在随意运动中起着重要作用：铰链关节允许单向运动，如膝盖和肘部所示。

Pivot joints allow a rotating or twisting motion, like that of the head moving from side to side.

枢轴关节允许旋转或扭转运动，例如头部从一侧向另一侧移动。

Ball-and-socket joints allow the greatest freedom of movement.

球窝关节允许最大程度的活动自由。

The hips and shoulders have this type of joint, in which the round end of a long bone fits into the hollow of another bone.

髋关节和肩关节属于这种类型，其中长骨的圆端嵌入另一块骨的凹陷中

blanks.explanation: 空格位于 “Joints are where ______ bones meet” 结构中。这里是在给“关节（Joints）”下定义。根据医学基础常识与单句内部的定义逻辑，一个关节必然是由“两块”或两块以上的骨头相连相遇的地方。在选项给出的数量及指代词中，只有 two（两块） 满足关节形成的生理定义。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 空格作定语修饰名词 joints，本句框架为 “The ______ joints of the body — such as those found at the hip, shoulders, elbows... — are freely movable.”（身体的……关节——例如臀部、肩膀、手肘等处的关节——是自由活动的）。作者在此通过 such as 列举了人体最主要、最核心的几个大关节。根据单句内部的分类逻辑，此处是在概述人体“主要的”关节类型，故选用形容词 main（主要的） 最具概括性（whole 和 entire 意为“整个/全部”，与后面的具体列举逻辑不符）。

questions.title: Population Change
questions.passage_html: Populations can change through three processes: fertility, mortality and migration. Fertility the number of children that women and differs from fecundity (a woman's childbearing potential). Mortality is the study of the causes, consequences and measurement of processes affecting death in a population. Demographers most commonly study mortality using the Life Table, a statistical which provides information about the mortality conditions (most notably the life expectancy) in the population. Migration refers to the movement of persons from an origin place to a destination place across some pre-defined political boundary. Migration researchers do not designate movements as migrations, they are somewhat permanent. Thus demographers do not consider tourists and travelers to be migrating. While demographers who study migration typically do so through census data on place of , indirect sources of data including tax forms and labor force surveys are also important. Demography is today widely taught in many universities across the world, students with initial training in social sciences, statistics or health studies.
questions.analysis_html:
1、involves

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作谓语动词,主语是 Fertility(生育力/生育率),宾语是"女性拥有的孩子数量"。根据单句内部的语义辨析,生育率的具体概念就是去"包含/涉及"女性实际生育子女的数量。因此选用动词 involves(涉及/包含)最符合句意。

2、have

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格位于定语从句中,表达"女性所生育/拥有的孩子数量"。在日常英语的单句逻辑下,表达"生孩子/有孩子"直接选用最基础的及物动词 have(生育/拥有) 即可。

3、device

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格作同位语,用来概括前文的 Life Table(生命表)。前文提到它是一个 "statistical ______(统计学的......)",能提供人口死亡率和预期寿命的数据。结合科学研究的上下文语境,生命表在统计学里属于一种分析数据的手段、工具或机制,因此选用名词 device(在此处引申为"手段/工具") 最为精准。

4、unless

考点:逻辑衔接

解析: 空格用来连接主句与条件分句。前半句提到"研究者不会把人们的移动定义为移民",后半句是"这些移动具有一定的永久性"。前后构成了清晰的条件限制逻辑,即"【除非】移动具有永久性,否则不算是移民",故选用连词 unless(除非) 满足逻辑衔接。

5、residence

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "place of ______" 结构中。本句讨论的是官方人口普查数据。在人口学和官方统计领域,表达法定的"居住地 / 住所",其雷打不动的标准固定搭配为 "place of residence"。

6、attracting

考点:非谓语形式

解析: 空格前的句子主干 Demography is today widely taught... 已经完整,此处不能再出现谓语动词。空格后带有宾语 students,说明需要填入一个非谓语形式。因为主语"人口学(Demography)"与"吸引(attract)"之间是主动关系,所以选用现在分词形式 attracting(作伴随或结果状语)。
questions.translation_html:
Populations can change through three processes: fertility, mortality and migration.

人口可以通过三个过程发生变化：生育、死亡和迁移。

Fertility involves the number of children that women have and differs from fecundity (a woman's childbearing potential).

生育率涉及女性实际生育的子女数量，并不同于生育能力，即女性的潜在生育能力。

Mortality is the study of the causes, consequences and measurement of processes affecting death in a population.

死亡率研究的是影响人口死亡过程的原因、后果和测量方式。

Demographers most commonly study mortality using the Life Table, a statistical device which provides information about the mortality conditions (most notably the life expectancy) in the population.

人口学家最常用生命表来研究死亡率，生命表是一种统计工具，提供人口死亡状况的信息，最显著的是预期寿命。

Migration refers to the movement of persons from an origin place to a destination place across some pre-defined political boundary.

迁移指人们从原居地跨越某个预先界定的政治边界，移动到目的地。

Migration researchers do not designate movements as migrations, unless they are somewhat permanent.

迁移研究者不会把所有移动都称为迁移，除非这些移动具有一定的永久性。

Thus demographers do not consider tourists and travelers to be migrating.

因此，人口学家并不把游客和旅行者视为迁移者。

While demographers who study migration typically do so through census data on place of residence, indirect sources of data including tax forms and labor force surveys are also important.

研究迁移的人口学家通常通过居住地的人口普查数据进行研究，但税表和劳动力调查等间接数据来源也很重要。

Demography is today widely taught in many universities across the world, attracting students with initial training in social sciences, statistics or health studies.

如今，人口学在世界各地许多大学广泛开设，吸引了拥有社会科学、统计学或健康研究基础训练的学生。

questions.title: Origin of Music
questions.passage_html: Music is an important part of our lives. We connect and interact with it daily and use it as a way of projecting our self-identities to the people around us. The music we enjoy ― whether it's country or classical, rock n' roll or rap ― who we are. But where did music, at its core, first come from?It's a puzzling question that may not have a definitive answer. One researcher, however, has proposed that the key to understanding the origin of music is nestled snugly in the loving bond between mother and child. In a lecture at the University of Melbourne, Richard Parncutt, an Australian-born professor of systematic musicology, endorsed the idea that music originally spawned from 'motherese' ― the playful voices mothers when speaking to infants and toddlers. As the theory goes, increased human brain sizes caused by evolutionary changes occurring between one and 2,000,000 years ago resulted in earlier births, more fragile infants and a need for stronger relationships between mothers and their newborn babies. According to Parncutt, who is based at the University of Graz in Austria, 'motherese' arose as a way to strengthen this maternal bond and to help an infant's survival.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 reflects

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,主语为 The music we enjoy(我们喜欢的音乐),宾语从句为 who we are(我们是谁)。根据句意,这里需要表达“反映”这一含义,即我们喜欢的音乐能够“反映”出我们是谁。在单句内部,主宾之间的逻辑对应关系可以直接锁定动词 reflects。

2、 leading

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定形容词。必须结合后文对这位研究者的详细介绍:他在墨尔本大学做讲座,并且是格拉茨大学系统音乐学的教授(Richard Parncutt, a professor of systematic musicology)。这些跨句的背景身份介绍,表明他是一位在学术界处于“领先地位的、主要的(leading)”研究者。

3、 adopt

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,这是一个由关系代词引导的定语从句,用来修饰前面的 voices(声音、语调)。mothers adopt when speaking to infants 意为“母亲在和婴幼儿说话时所‘采用’的语调”。adopt 与 voices 构成动宾搭配,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

4、 critical

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个形容词来修饰名词 need(需求)。前文提到由于进化原因导致婴儿早产且更加脆弱(more fragile infants),因此母亲与新生儿之间建立更强纽带的需求自然变得至关重要。a critical need 意为“至关重要的需求”,通过句内的因果逻辑即可直接确定。

5、 ensure

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,不定式短语为 to help ______ an infant's survival(帮助......婴儿的生存)。根据词义辨析,ensure 意为“确保、保证”,常用于确保某件事情的发生或实现;而 assure 侧重于向某人保证,insure 侧重于经济上的保险。因此,为了表达“确保婴儿存活”,在单句内部即可锁定动词 ensure。

questions.title: Shakespeare
questions.passage_html: There has been a great variety of critical approach to Shakespeare's work since his death. During the 17th 18th centuries, Shakespeare was both admired and condemned. Since then, much of the adverse criticism considered relevant, although certain issues to interest critics throughout the years. For instance, charges against his moral propriety were made by Samuel Johnson in the 18th century and by George Bernard Shaw in the 20th. Early criticism was directed at questions of form. Shakespeare was for mixing comedy and tragedy and failing to observe the unities of time and place by the rules of classical drama. Dryden and Johnson were among the critics claiming that he had the language with false wit, puns, and ambiguity. some of his early plays might justly be charged with a frivolous use of such devices, 20th-century criticism has tended to praise their use in later plays as adding depth and resonance of meaning.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 and

考点：并列结构

解析：句子这里需要表达“和、以及”这一含义。空格连接的是 17th(17世纪)与 18th centuries(18世纪),两者属于时间上的并列关系,共同修饰后文的 centuries,使用并列连词 and 最符合逻辑。

has not been

考点：时态语态

解析： 空格作本句的谓语动词。主语是 much of the adverse criticism（大部分负面批评意见），时间状语为 “Since then”（自那时以来）。

核心考点在于：Since + 过去时间点 构成了标准的现在完成时标志。

结合语意流，虽然当年的负面批评在今天“【已经不被】”认为是相关的（has not been considered relevant），但它的时态必须严格锁死在现在完成时。故选用 has not been（现在完成时的否定形式） 满足时态语态要求。

3、have continued

考点：时态语态

解析： 空格位于 although 引导的让步状语从句中作谓语动词。主语是复数名词 certain issues（某些议题），时间状语是 “throughout the years”（这些年以来/历年来）。

同样地，throughout the years 表达一个从过去一直延续到当下的时间区间，属于现在完成时的标准时间标志。

由于主语 issues 是复数，对应的助动词必须使用 have。因此，选用 have continued（现在完成时复数形式） 满足时态语态中主谓一致与时间线索的完全匹配。

4、 primarily

考点：上下文语境

解析：句子这里需要表达“主要地、首要地”这一含义。后文紧接着详细列举了对戏剧形式层面的具体指责(如混合了喜剧与悲剧、未能遵守古典戏剧关于时空的规则),这表明早期的批评焦点“主要”集中在这些形式问题上,该词能够准确与后文的详细列举形成呼应。

5、 criticized

考点：上下文语境

解析：句子这里需要表达“受到批评”这一含义。后文提到他“混合了喜剧和悲剧”以及“未能遵守(failing to observe)”古典戏剧的规则,在古典主义的文学背景下,没有遵守规则属于违规行为,因此他是“被指责或批评”,该词符合贬义的上下文语境。

6、 prescribed

考点：单句理解

解析：句子这里需要表达“规定、对......做出规范”这一含义。古典戏剧规则(rules of classical drama)对时间、地点和行动的一致性(即三一律)有着严格的硬性要求,规定创作者必须严格遵守,该词在文学和法律语境下常用来表达“规则所作出的强制规定”,符合句意。

7、 corrupted

考点：上下文语境

解析：句子这里需要表达“败坏、污染”这一含义。空格后的宾语是 the language(语言),后文指出他使用了“低俗的俏皮话、双关语和模棱两可的话(false wit, puns, and ambiguity)”,批评家们认为这些不规范的语言现象污染了语言的纯洁性,该词能够准确地表达批评家眼中的负面影响。

8、 While

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：句子这里需要表达“尽管、虽然”这一含义。前半句提到“他早期的一些剧作确实可以被指责轻率地使用了这些修辞手法”,后半句则转折指出“20世纪的批评则倾向于赞赏这些手法在后期剧作中的应用”,前后两个时代对相同手法的看法形成了鲜明的对比和让步,使用 While 引导让步状语从句最符合逻辑衔接。

There has been a great variety of critical approach to Shakespeare's work since his death.

自莎士比亚去世以来,人们对他作品的评论方法一直多种多样。

During the 17th and 18th centuries, Shakespeare was both admired and condemned.

在17和18世纪期间,莎士比亚既受到赞赏,也受到谴责。

Since then, much of the adverse criticism has not been considered relevant, although certain issues have continue to interest critics throughout the years.

从那时起,尽管某些议题在这些年里继续吸引着批评家的兴趣,但许多负面批评已被认为不具有相关性。

For instance, charges against his moral propriety were made by Samuel Johnson in the 18th century and by George Bernard Shaw in the 20th.

例如,在18世纪,萨缪尔·约翰逊对他的道德适当性提出了指责,而在20世纪,乔治·伯纳德·肖也提出了同样的指责。

Early criticism was directed primarily at questions of form.

早期的批评主要针对形式问题。

Shakespeare was criticized for mixing comedy and tragedy and failing to observe the unities of time and place prescribed by the rules of classical drama.

莎士比亚因混合喜剧与悲剧,以及未能遵守古典戏剧规则所规定的时间与地点一致性而受到批评。

Dryden and Johnson were among the critics claiming that he had corrupted the language with false wit, puns, and ambiguity.

德莱顿和约翰逊等批评家声称,他用虚假的机智、双关语和模棱两可的话语败坏了语言。

While some of his early plays might justly be charged with a frivolous use of such devices, 20th-century criticism has tended to praise their use in later plays as adding depth and resonance of meaning.

虽然他早期的一些剧作确实可以被指责轻率地使用了这些修辞手法,但20世纪的批评则倾向于赞赏这些手法在后期剧作中的应用,认为它们增加了意义的深度和共鸣。

blanks.label: 并列结构
blanks.explanation: 句子这里需要表达“和、以及”这一含义。空格连接的是 17th(17世纪)与 18th centuries(18世纪),两者属于时间上的并列关系,共同修饰后文的 centuries,使用并列连词 and 最符合逻辑。

blanks.label: 时态语态
blanks.explanation:
空格作本句的谓语动词。主语是 much of the adverse criticism（大部分负面批评意见），时间状语为 “Since then”（自那时以来）。
核心考点在于：Since + 过去时间点 构成了标准的现在完成时标志。
结合语意流，虽然当年的负面批评在今天“【已经不被】”认为是相关的（has not been considered relevant），但它的时态必须严格锁死在现在完成时。故选用 has not been（现在完成时的否定形式） 满足时态语态要求。

blanks.label: 时态语态
blanks.explanation:
空格位于 although 引导的让步状语从句中作谓语动词。主语是复数名词 certain issues（某些议题），时间状语是 “throughout the years”（这些年以来/历年来）。
同样地，throughout the years 表达一个从过去一直延续到当下的时间区间，属于现在完成时的标准时间标志。
由于主语 issues 是复数，对应的助动词必须使用 have。因此，选用 have continued（现在完成时复数形式） 满足时态语态中主谓一致与时间线索的完全匹配。

blanks.explanation: 句子这里需要表达“主要地、首要地”这一含义。后文紧接着详细列举了对戏剧形式层面的具体指责(如混合了喜剧与悲剧、未能遵守古典戏剧关于时空的规则),这表明早期的批评焦点“主要”集中在这些形式问题上,该词能够准确与后文的详细列举形成呼应。

blanks.explanation: 句子这里需要表达“受到批评”这一含义。后文提到他“混合了喜剧和悲剧”以及“未能遵守(failing to observe)”古典戏剧的规则,在古典主义的文学背景下,没有遵守规则属于违规行为,因此他是“被指责或批评”,该词符合贬义的上下文语境。

questions.title: Dinosaurs
questions.passage_html: What killed off the dinosaurs?The end of the Cretaceous Period saw one of the most dramatic mass extinctions the Earth has ever seen. The fossil record shows that throughout their 160-million-year , dinosaurs took on a huge variety of forms as the environment changed and new species evolved that were suited to these new conditions. Others that failed to adapt extinct. But then 66 million years ago, over a relatively short time, dinosaurs disappeared (except for birds). Many other animals also died out, including pterosaurs, large marine reptiles, and other sea creatures such as ammonites. the number of dinosaur species was already declining, this suggests a sudden catastrophic event sealed their fate, causing unfavorable changes to the environment more quickly than dinosaurs and other creatures could adapt. The exact nature of this catastrophic event is still to scientific debate. The catastrophe could have been an asteroid impact, volcanic eruptions or the effect of both, together with more changes in the Earth's climate over millions of years. Whatever the causes, the huge extinction that ended the age of the dinosaur left gaps in the ecosystem that were subsequently filled by mammals and birds, allowing them to evolve rapidly.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 existence

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格前的名词所有格形式 their(指代前文的 dinosaurs)和名词 year 共同修饰空格处,此处需要一个名词来表达“存在、生存”这一含义。160-million-year existence 意为“160万年的生存历程”,该词在单句内能准确补足恐龙在地球上生存的时间跨度。

2、 went

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。go extinct 构成固定搭配,意思是“灭绝、消亡”。由于整篇文章是在讨论过去已经发生并结束的历史事件,因此在单句中动词应使用一般过去时形式 went。

3、 completely

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定消失的程度。需要参考后文紧接着的括号内容 except for birds(除了鸟类以外),以及后一句 Many other animals also died out(许多其他动物也灭绝了),这些跨句的线索共同表明,非鸟类恐龙在当时已经“完全”消失了。

4、 Although

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：该空需要平衡前后两句话的逻辑。前半句提到“恐龙物种的数量在当时其实已经处于下降趋势”,后半句则指明“这表明是一场突如其来的灾难性事件决定了它们的命运”。“数量本在减少”与“突然被灾难终结”之间存在让步与转折关系,使用 Although 引导让步状语从句最符合逻辑衔接。

5、 open

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。be open to debate 构成固定搭配,意思是“尚无定论、仍有争议”。在单句语境中,该结构用来表示这场灾难性事件的具体性质在科学界依然是一个“开放式的、有待讨论”的课题。

6、 gradual

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定气候变化的特征。必须结合整篇文章的主题以及本句后半部分的修饰语 over millions of years(横跨数百万年)这一跨句与跨特征的线索,数百万年的演变过程必然属于“渐进的、缓慢的”变化,从而与前文 sudden(突然的)事件形成对比。

What killed off the dinosaurs?

是什么导致恐龙灭绝?

The end of the Cretaceous Period saw one of the most dramatic mass extinctions the Earth has ever seen.

白垩纪末期发生了地球有史以来最剧烈的大规模灭绝事件之一。

The fossil record shows that throughout their 160-million-year existence, dinosaurs took on a huge variety of forms as the environment changed and new species evolved that were suited to these new conditions.

化石记录表明,在长达 1.6 亿年的生存历程中,随着环境变化以及适应新环境的新物种演化,恐龙呈现出多种多样的形态。

Others that failed to adapt went extinct.

其他未能适应的物种则灭绝了。

But then 66 million years ago, over a relatively short time, dinosaurs disappeared completely (except for birds).

但随后在 6600 万年前,恐龙在相对较短的时间内完全消失了,鸟类除外。

Many other animals also died out, including pterosaurs, large marine reptiles, and other sea creatures such as ammonites.

许多其他动物也灭绝了,包括翼龙、大型海洋爬行动物以及菊石等海洋生物。

Although the number of dinosaur species was already declining, this suggests a sudden catastrophic event sealed their fate, causing unfavorable changes to the environment more quickly than dinosaurs and other creatures could adapt.

尽管恐龙物种数量已经在减少,但这表明某个突发的灾难性事件决定了它们的命运,使环境发生不利变化,而这种变化快到恐龙和其他生物无法适应。

The exact nature of this catastrophic event is still open to scientific debate.

这一灾难性事件的确切性质仍有待科学讨论。

The catastrophe could have been an asteroid impact, volcanic eruptions or the effect of both, together with more gradual changes in the Earth's climate over millions of years.

这场灾难可能是小行星撞击、火山爆发,或两者共同作用的结果,同时也伴随着地球气候在数百万年间更缓慢的变化。

Whatever the causes, the huge extinction that ended the age of the dinosaur left gaps in the ecosystem that were subsequently filled by mammals and birds, allowing them to evolve rapidly.

无论原因是什么,这场终结恐龙时代的大灭绝都在生态系统中留下了空缺,而这些空缺随后被哺乳动物和鸟类填补,使它们得以快速演化。

questions.title: York
questions.passage_html: York was once a rich and populous city. Many houses the narrow streets in the district, creating crowded living conditions. Records also show details about daily life, including meals served every day. Religious festivals are in St. Mary’s Church, which remain an important part of York’s traditions.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 blocked

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说许多房屋______狭窄的街道,造成拥挤的居住条件。blocked(堵塞/阻挡)符合语义,房屋建在街道两旁使街道变窄或受阻。ploughed(犁地/费力穿过)不符合;tallied(计数/吻合)不符合;endowed(捐赠/赋予)不符合。

2、 the number of

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。根据语境,记录显示的是每天所供应的餐食的“具体数量”,the number of 意为“......的数量”,后接可数名词复数 meals。而 an amount of 通常用于修饰不可数名词,a lot 缺少介词 of,a few of 则不符合记录详细数据的语境。

3、 held

考点：时态语态

解析：这个答案考查的是被动语态。主语 Religious festivals(宗教节日)与动词 hold(举办)之间是被动关系,表示节日“被举办”,因此使用助动词 are 配合过去分词 held 构成一般现在时的被动语态。

York was once a rich and populous city.

questions.title: UK Universities
questions.passage_html: The research, commissioned by HEDQF, asked 1,000 students from UK universities for their views on the quality of their university campus and sheds new light on how students make decisions as they go through the application process. When asked what the most important factors were when deciding where to study, 76% of students campus facilities as either 'quite' or 'very' important, with only 8% saying it was 'not very' or 'not at all' important in their choice. This was the fourth most important factor after course, location and reputation. Estate quality increases in importance once a student has chosen a university, with 86% of students saying that it is 'quite' or 'very' important in their first year of studies. However, the importance students to estates decreases to 79% for third years students. The research also highlighted how factors such as demographics, region and type of university have an impact on how students view the university buildings. Students in Russell Group universities are much more likely to describe their buildings as 'inspiring', closely followed by students in newer universities such as Lincoln, Gloucestershire and Ravensbourne College. This pattern was repeated when students were asked to rate the overall quality and design of estate, with Russell Group students, and students from newer universities, more likely to rate the estates as excellent. data shows capital expenditure on estates has been the highest amongst the Russell Group universities during 2001-2011. When asked where they would invest money in their universities, the top three areas in order of were: smaller class sizes, bursaries for poorer students and new buildings and facilities. When their expenditure options were restricted to estates-only items, the repair and of existing buildings came out top with 77%, which suggests that new buildings should not be at the of the rest of the estate, and may even highlight the deficiencies of tired and outmoded facilities.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 ranked

考点：固定搭配

解析：在单句语境中,从句缺少谓语动词。空格后面的名词短语之后紧跟着介词 as,这直接提示了此处考查的是 rank... as... 这一固定搭配,意为“将......列为、把......归类为”。整句话意为“76%的学生将校园设施‘列为’相当重要或非常重要”,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 ranked。

2、 attach

考点：固定搭配

解析：attach importance to something 构成固定搭配,意思是“对......赋予重要性、认为......具有重要意义”。在单句语境中,该空处于省略了关系代词的定语从句中,用于修饰先行词 importance,后面接了介词 to。整句话意为“然而,学生对校园资产所‘赋予’的重要性的比例在三年级学生中下降到了79%”,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 attach。

3、 attended

考点：定语从句

解析：该空处于省略了关系代词的定语从句中,用来修饰前面的先行词 type of university(大学的类型)。判定依赖“先行词 + 关系词 + 从句结构”,完整结构恢复后为 ...type of university (which/that) students attended...(学生们所就读的大学类型)。在选项中,只有 attended(就读、出席)能够与大学构成合理的动宾修饰和修饰关系。

4、 Existing

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的形容词用来修饰名词 data(数据)。后文提到了“数据显示,在2001-2011年期间,罗素大学集团的资本支出是最高的”,这属于引用客观存在的历史统计数据。在选项中,只有 Existing(现有的、现存的)最符合描述客观历史数据的语境。

5、 preference

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处于短语 in order of...(按照......的顺序)之中,介词 of 后面必须接名词形式。在选项中,prefer 是动词,preferential 是形容词,只有 preference(偏好、倾向)是符合语法和语义的名词,意为“按照偏好顺序”,在单句内部即可通过词性与词义辨析直接锁定。

6、 maintenance

考点：并列结构

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的名词与前面的 repair(修理、翻新)由连词 and 紧密并列,共同修饰后文的 existing buildings(现有建筑物)。根据排比和并列原则,空格处必须填入一个与房屋修理性质相同、词性相同的名词。maintenance(维护、保养)与 repair 构成完美并列。

7、 expense

考点：固定搭配

解析：at the expense of something 构成固定搭配,意思是“以......为代价、损害......的利益”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“这表明新建筑不应该‘以牺牲’其余校园资产‘为代价’”,在单句内部即可直接锁定名词 expense。
questions.translation_html:
The research, commissioned by HEDQF, asked 1,000 students from UK universities for their views on the quality of their university campus and sheds new light on how students make decisions as they go through the application process.

这项由高等教育设计质量论坛(HEDQF)委托开展的研究,调查了1000名英国大学学生对各自大学校园质量的看法,并对学生在申请过程中如何做出决定提供了新的见解。

When asked what the most important factors were when deciding where to study, 76% of students ranked campus facilities as either 'quite' or 'very' important, with only 8% saying it was 'not very' or 'not at all' important in their choice.

当被问及在决定去哪里学习时最重要的因素是什么时,76%的学生将校园设施列为“相当”或“非常”重要,只有8%的人表示这在他们的选择中“不太”或“一点也不”重要。

This was the fourth most important factor after course, location and reputation.

这是继课程、地理位置和声誉之后第四个最重要的因素。

Estate quality increases in importance once a student has chosen a university, with 86% of students saying that it is 'quite' or 'very' important in their first year of studies.

一旦学生选择了一所大学,校园资产质量的重要性就会增加,86%的学生表示这在他们大学第一年的学习中是“相当”或“非常”重要的。

However, the importance students attach to estates decreases to 79% for third years students.

然而,学生对校园资产所赋予的重要性的比例在三年级学生中下降到了79%。

The research also highlighted how factors such as demographics, region and type of university attended have an impact on how students view the university buildings.

该研究还强调了诸如人口统计特征、地区和所就读的大学类型等因素,是如何对学生看待大学建筑的方式产生影响的。

Students in Russell Group universities are much more likely to describe their buildings as 'inspiring', closely followed by students in newer universities such as Lincoln, Gloucestershire and Ravensbourne College.

罗素大学集团的学生更有可能将他们的建筑描述为“具有启发性的”,紧随其后的是林肯大学、格洛斯特郡大学和雷文斯本学院等较新大学的学生。

This pattern was repeated when students were asked to rate the overall quality and design of estate, with Russell Group students, and students from newer universities, more likely to rate the estates as excellent.

当学生被要求对校园资产的整体质量和设计进行评分时,这种模式再次出现,罗素集团的学生以及来自较新大学的学生更有可能将校园资产评为优秀。

Existing data shows capital expenditure on estates has been the highest amongst the Russell Group universities during 2001-2011.

现有的数据显示,在2001-2011年期间,罗素大学集团在校园资产上的资本支出是最高的。

When asked where they would invest money in their universities, the top three areas in order of preference were: smaller class sizes, bursaries for poorer students and new buildings and facilities.

当被问及他们会把钱投资在大学的哪些地方时,按偏好顺序排列的前三个领域分别是:更小班级的规模、给贫困学生的助学金以及新建筑和设施。

When their expenditure options were restricted to estates-only items, the repair and maintenance of existing buildings came out top with 77%, which suggests that new buildings should not be at the expense of the rest of the estate, and may even highlight the deficiencies of tired and outmoded facilities.

当他们的支出选择被限制在仅限校园资产的项目时,现有建筑的维修和维护以77%得票率高居榜首,这表明新建筑不应该以牺牲其余校园资产为代价,甚至可能突显出陈旧和过时设施的不足。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,从句缺少谓语动词。空格后面的名词短语之后紧跟着介词 as,这直接提示了此处考查的是 rank... as... 这一固定搭配,意为“将......列为、把......归类为”。整句话意为“76%的学生将校园设施‘列为’相当重要或非常重要”,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 ranked。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: attach importance to something 构成固定搭配,意思是“对......赋予重要性、认为......具有重要意义”。在单句语境中,该空处于省略了关系代词的定语从句中,用于修饰先行词 importance,后面接了介词 to。整句话意为“然而,学生对校园资产所‘赋予’的重要性的比例在三年级学生中下降到了79%”,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 attach。

blanks.label: 定语从句
blanks.explanation: 该空处于省略了关系代词的定语从句中,用来修饰前面的先行词 type of university(大学的类型)。判定依赖“先行词 + 关系词 + 从句结构”,完整结构恢复后为 ...type of university (which/that) students attended...(学生们所就读的大学类型)。在选项中,只有 attended(就读、出席)能够与大学构成合理的动宾修饰和修饰关系。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处的形容词用来修饰名词 data(数据)。后文提到了“数据显示,在2001-2011年期间,罗素大学集团的资本支出是最高的”,这属于引用客观存在的历史统计数据。在选项中,只有 Existing(现有的、现存的)最符合描述客观历史数据的语境。

blanks.explanation: at the expense of something 构成固定搭配,意思是“以......为代价、损害......的利益”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“这表明新建筑不应该‘以牺牲’其余校园资产‘为代价’”,在单句内部即可直接锁定名词 expense。

questions.title: Fieldwork
questions.passage_html: The main purpose of fieldwork is to students a chance to what they have learned in the classroom to real-life situations. By doing so, they gain experience that cannot be from books alone.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 offer

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。offer sb. sth. 构成固定搭配,意思是“给某人提供某物/机会”。

2、 apply

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。apply A to B 构成固定搭配,意思是“把 A 应用到 B 中”。

3、 obtained

考点：时态语态

解析：析:句中已有 be 动词,因此空格处需要过去分词构成被动结构,obtained 符合句子的语态要求。
questions.translation_html:
The main purpose of fieldwork is to offer students a chance to apply what they have learned in the classroom to real-life situations.

实地考察的主要目的是给学生一个机会,把他们在课堂上学到的知识应用到真实生活情境中。

By doing so, they gain experience that cannot be obtained from books alone.

通过这样做,他们能够获得仅靠书本无法获得的经验。

blanks.explanation: 析:句中已有 be 动词,因此空格处需要过去分词构成被动结构,obtained 符合句子的语态要求。

questions.title: Shakespeare and English
questions.passage_html: Shakespeare's creativity and use of words transformed the English language. Many people of that time put expectations on the growth of English literature. However, some critics predicted a future for English, worrying that such innovations might not last.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 inventive

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词与名词 creativity 通过连词 and 组合在一起共同修饰 use of words。结合后文提到他的这些遣词造句极大重塑并转化了英语语言的上下文可知,莎士比亚对词汇的使用是极具“创造性的/发明性的(inventive)”。

2、 high

考点：单句理解

解析：put high expectations on 为常见搭配,意为“对......抱有很高期望”。句中指当时许多人对英国文学的发展抱有很高期望。wide(宽的)、much(许多,通常不与 expectations 构成 put much expectations on)、more(更多的)均不符合习惯搭配。

3、daunting

考点：上下文语境

形容词作定语修饰名词 future。结合后文“担忧这种语言文字层面的离经叛道创新可能无法持久”这一负面的批评可知,当时的保守批评家们为英语预测了一个非常“令人担忧的/严峻的(daunting)”前途。
questions.translation_html:
Shakespeare's creativity and inventive use of words transformed the English language.

莎士比亚的创造力和对词汇的创造性使用改变了英语语言。

Many people of that time put high expectations on the growth of English literature.

当时的许多人都对英国文学的发展寄予了厚望。

However, some critics predicted a daunting future for English, worrying that such innovations might not last.

然而,一些批评家预测了英语令人担忧的未来,担心这种创新可能不会持久。

questions.title: Elizabeth
questions.passage_html: Portraiture played an important role in the Elizabethan era. Queen Elizabeth's portraits conveyed the regal image of a powerful monarch―the steadfast, ageless force England. Owning paintings of the Queen was viewed as a status symbol. Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester, displayed over 50 paintings at his Castle in Kenilworth, Warwickshire―a bold reminder guests that he was the man closest to the Queen. Although Elizabethan artists drew inspiration from the European Renaissance, was Elizabeth herself who was the national preoccupation. Invoking her image in paintings and literature had the effect of elevating them to a higher level. Today, we like to think of art as an expression of feelings and beliefs. But in Elizabethan England, flattery was the order of the day―a time when most artists needed wealthy sponsors .
questions.analysis_html:
1、behind

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格修饰 "the steadfast, ageless force ______ England"(英格兰......那股坚定、永恒的力量)。根据历史政治语境,女王伊丽莎白一世是整个英格兰国家运筹帷幄的掌控者。在英语语境中,表达某人是支撑某一国家或政权运作的"幕后推手/核心支柱",习惯用介词 behind(在......后方/作为......的后盾)。

2、to

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格位于 "a bold reminder ______ guests that..." 结构中。罗伯特·达德利在城堡里展示了50多幅女王的画作,这是对来访客人们的一个强有力的"提醒"。在单句内部的语义指向逻辑下,表达"给某人的提醒 / 对某人的警示",介词选用 to(对/给) 最符合指向性。

3、it

考点:固定搭配

解析: 分析本句的框架:______ was Elizabeth herself who was...。这是一个标准且固定的"It is/was... that/who..."强调句型,用来强调正是伊丽莎白本人成为了举国关注的焦点。强调句型的引导词雷打不动,只能选用 it(即 It was... who...)。

4、to survive

考点:非谓语形式

解析: 空格位于句尾:"...a time when most artists needed wealthy sponsors ______."。本句的主干 most artists needed wealthy sponsors(大多数艺术家需要富有的赞助人)已经结构完整。空格处需要填入一个非谓语形式来作目的状语,表达艺术家需要赞助人的"目的是为了生存"。因此选用动词不定式 to survive(为了生存)。
questions.translation_html:
Portraiture played an important role in the Elizabethan era.

肖像画在伊丽莎白时代扮演着重要角色。

Queen Elizabeth's portraits conveyed the regal image of a powerful monarch―the steadfast, ageless force behind England.

伊丽莎白女王的肖像画传达了一位强大君主的高贵形象——她是英国背后坚定而不朽的力量。

Owning paintings of the Queen was viewed as a status symbol.

拥有女王的画作被视为一种身份的象征。

Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester, displayed over 50 paintings at his Castle in Kenilworth, Warwickshire―a bold reminder to guests that he was the man closest to the Queen.

莱斯特伯爵罗伯特·达德利在他位于沃里克郡凯尼尔沃思的城堡中展出了50多幅画作——以此大胆地向宾客提醒，他就是最接近女王的人。

Although Elizabethan artists drew inspiration from the European Renaissance, it was Elizabeth herself who was the national preoccupation.

尽管伊丽莎白时代的艺术家从欧洲文艺复兴中汲取灵感，但正是伊丽莎白本人成为了整个国家关注的焦点。

Invoking her image in paintings and literature had the effect of elevating them to a higher level.

在绘画和文学中引用她的形象，具有将这些作品提升到更高层次的效果。

Today, we like to think of art as an expression of feelings and beliefs.

今天，我们倾向于将艺术视为情感和信念的表达。

But in Elizabethan England, flattery was the order of the day―a time when most artists needed wealthy sponsors to survive.

但在伊丽莎白时代的英格兰，奉承是当时的风尚——那是一个大多数艺术家需要富有的赞助人才能生存的时代。

blanks.label: 上下文语境
blanks.explanation: 空格修饰 "the steadfast, ageless force ______ England"(英格兰......那股坚定、永恒的力量)。根据历史政治语境,女王伊丽莎白一世是整个英格兰国家运筹帷幄的掌控者。在英语语境中,表达某人是支撑某一国家或政权运作的"幕后推手/核心支柱",习惯用介词 behind(在......后方/作为......的后盾)。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "a bold reminder ______ guests that..." 结构中。罗伯特·达德利在城堡里展示了50多幅女王的画作,这是对来访客人们的一个强有力的"提醒"。在单句内部的语义指向逻辑下,表达"给某人的提醒 / 对某人的警示",介词选用 to(对/给) 最符合指向性。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 分析本句的框架:______ was Elizabeth herself who was...。这是一个标准且固定的"It is/was... that/who..."强调句型,用来强调正是伊丽莎白本人成为了举国关注的焦点。强调句型的引导词雷打不动,只能选用 it(即 It was... who...)。

blanks.label: 非谓语形式
blanks.explanation: 空格位于句尾:"...a time when most artists needed wealthy sponsors ______."。本句的主干 most artists needed wealthy sponsors(大多数艺术家需要富有的赞助人)已经结构完整。空格处需要填入一个非谓语形式来作目的状语,表达艺术家需要赞助人的"目的是为了生存"。因此选用动词不定式 to survive(为了生存)。

questions.title: Brain Bus
questions.passage_html: Why does the smell of cut grass remind you of summer? How can you measure your nerve endings with a paper fastener? And how can you create the sound of church bells with just a serving spoon and a piece of string ...? These questions and more will be revealed by University of Manchester scientists when they take to the road on their 'Brain Bus'. The bus is taking hands on to test the senses to the suburbs, to show young and old alike how the brain works and how science can answer some of life's most captivating questions. Organizer Dr Stuart Allan, lecturer at the Faculty of Life Sciences, explains: "Three-year-olds and upwards can understand the senses and it's an area that is to all ages. "It takes effort to get out of bed on a Saturday morning and go to the Museum. We are bringing science to your doorstep and going further afield this year in the hope of finding new and different . "We want people to see that science is interesting as well as important in our lives, and to people who may not consider it possible to go to University."
questions.analysis_html:
1、fascinating

考点:并列结构

解析: 空格作定语修饰名词 questions。本句的框架为 "These ______ questions and more...",指代前文提出的三个非常有趣且吸引人的生活小谜题。同时,在后文的并列语境中,作者再次使用了 captivating(迷人的/吸引人的) 来形容这批科学问题。根据并列结构语调一致与语义呼应的原则,此处选用同义的形容词 fascinating(迷人的/极有吸引力的)。

2、activities

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作及物动词 taking 的宾语。根据单句内部的动作和目的逻辑,"Brain Bus" 这辆科普大巴正在把各种用于测试感官、亲自动手操作的"项目/活动"带到郊区,以此向老少大众展示大脑是如何工作的。因此选用名词 activities(活动) 最符合科学路演的业务特征。

3、intriguing

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作表语。主语是 it(指代 the senses 感官),后接定语修饰 to all ages(对所有年龄段的人而言)。根据迪尔Allan博士的发言逻辑,感官科学是上至三岁小孩、下至老人都觉得"很有趣、引人入胜的"领域。在单句内部的词义辨析中,选用形容词 intriguing(引人入胜的/有趣的) 最为精准。

4、audiences

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格位于 "in the hope of finding new and different ______" 结构中。结合上文的语境线索,科普大巴主动作出努力,"把科学送到人们的家门口,并且今年走得更远(going further afield)",这样做的核心目的就是为了寻找和吸引更多全新的"受众/观众"。因此选用名词 audiences(受众/听众) 完美呼应上文。

5、encourage

考点:并列结构

解析: 空格与前面的动词短语 see that science is interesting... 属于由连词 and 连接的并列行为逻辑。我们想要让人们看到科学的趣味性,从而去"鼓励(encourage)"那些以前认为自己不可能上大学的人勇敢考大学。encourage sb to do sth 构成标准的正向鼓励行为并列。
questions.translation_html:
Why does the smell of cut grass remind you of summer? How can you measure your nerve endings with a paper fastener? And how can you create the sound of church bells with just a serving spoon and a piece of string ...?

为什么割过的青草的气味会让你想起夏天？如何用一个工字钉测量你的神经末梢？又如何仅凭一把上菜勺和一根细绳就能制造出教堂钟声……？

These fascinating questions and more will be revealed by University of Manchester scientists when they take to the road on their 'Brain Bus'.

这些引人入胜的问题以及更多内容，将由曼彻斯特大学的科学家们在他们驾着“大脑巴士”上路时为您揭晓。

The bus is taking hands-on activities to test the senses to the suburbs, to show young and old alike how the brain works and how science can answer some of life's most captivating questions.

这辆巴士将把亲身体验的活动带到郊区来测试人们的感官，向老少展示大脑是如何工作的，以及科学如何回答生活中一些最令人着迷的问题。

Organizer Dr Stuart Allan, lecturer at the Faculty of Life Sciences, explains: "Three-year-olds and upwards can understand the senses and it's an area that is intriguing to all ages.

活动组织者、生命科学学院的讲师斯图尔特·艾伦博士解释说：“三岁及以上的孩子都能理解感官，这是一个对所有年龄层都充满魅力的领域。

It takes effort to get out of bed on a Saturday morning and go to the Museum. We are bringing science to your doorstep and going further afield this year in the hope of finding new and different audiences.

周六早上起床去博物馆确实需要费一番功夫。今年，我们把科学带到您家门口，并走向更远的地方，希望能找到新的、不同的受众。

We want people to see that science is interesting as well as important in our lives, and to encourage people who may not consider it possible to go to University."

我们希望人们看到科学在我们的生活中既有趣又重要，并鼓励那些可能认为自己没有机会上大学的人。”

blanks.label: 并列结构
blanks.explanation: 空格作定语修饰名词 questions。本句的框架为 "These ______ questions and more...",指代前文提出的三个非常有趣且吸引人的生活小谜题。同时,在后文的并列语境中,作者再次使用了 captivating(迷人的/吸引人的) 来形容这批科学问题。根据并列结构语调一致与语义呼应的原则,此处选用同义的形容词 fascinating(迷人的/极有吸引力的)。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 空格作及物动词 taking 的宾语。根据单句内部的动作和目的逻辑,"Brain Bus" 这辆科普大巴正在把各种用于测试感官、亲自动手操作的"项目/活动"带到郊区,以此向老少大众展示大脑是如何工作的。因此选用名词 activities(活动) 最符合科学路演的业务特征。

blanks.label: 单句理解

blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "in the hope of finding new and different ______" 结构中。结合上文的语境线索,科普大巴主动作出努力,"把科学送到人们的家门口,并且今年走得更远(going further afield)",这样做的核心目的就是为了寻找和吸引更多全新的"受众/观众"。因此选用名词 audiences(受众/听众) 完美呼应上文。

blanks.label: 并列结构
blanks.explanation: 空格与前面的动词短语 see that science is interesting... 属于由连词 and 连接的并列行为逻辑。我们想要让人们看到科学的趣味性,从而去"鼓励(encourage)"那些以前认为自己不可能上大学的人勇敢考大学。encourage sb to do sth 构成标准的正向鼓励行为并列。

questions.title: Circular Time
questions.passage_html: Each of us is born into and raised in a particular"time world"-- an environment with its own to which we entrain ourselves. Certain cultures have related to time as a phenomenon, in which there is no pressure or future anxiety. The whole of existence goes around: the cycle of the , of planting and harvesting, the daily return of the sun, of birth and death. In circular time there is no pressing to achieve and create newness, or to insatiably produce more than is needed to simply survive. Additionally, there is no fear of death. Such societies have successfully integrated the past and future into a peaceful sense of the present. They also honored the wisdom of elders who held the knowledge of the past-- upon which the future was clearly linked.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 phenomenon

考点：单句理解

解析：句子说我们出生并成长于一个特定的“时间世界”——一个有其自身______的环境,我们会与之同步。phenomenon(现象)指该环境中存在的各种时间相关现象,符合本句内部逻辑。description(描述)、deposition(沉积/证词)、superstition(迷信)均无法与“时间世界”及“同步”形成合理语义关系。

2、 seasons

考点：上下文语境

解析：后文列举了种植与收获、太阳的每日回归、生与死的循环,这些都是与“季节”相关的周期性现象。seasons 与 circular time 的逻辑一致。days(日子)、arrangement(安排)、periods(时期)不如 seasons 准确贴合后文举例。

3、 need

考点：上下文语境

解析：the cycle of the ______, of planting and harvesting 中,need 与 planting and harvesting 构成“需求—满足”的逻辑链条,即“需求的循环”,指人类基本的生存需求不断出现并被满足。issue(议题)、point(要点)、cause(原因)均不符合。

4、 present

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说“没有紧迫的 ______ 去实现和创造新事物”。present 作名词意为“当下、现在”,no pressing present 指没有紧迫的“当下”需要去不断追求新东西,符合循环时间观中没有未来焦虑的特点。preparation(准备)、presentation(展示)、presence(在场)均不符合语义。

Each of us is born into and raised in a particular "time world" -- an environment with its own phenomenon to which we entrain ourselves.

我们每个人都出生并成长于一个特定的“时间世界”——一个有其自身现象的环境,我们会与之同步。

Certain cultures have related to time as a seasons phenomenon, in which there is no pressure or future anxiety.

某些文化将时间视为一种季节现象,在这种现象中没有压力或对未来的焦虑。

The whole of existence goes around: the cycle of the need, of planting and harvesting, the daily return of the sun, of birth and death.

整个存在是循环往复的:需求的循环、种植与收获的循环、太阳的每日回归、生与死的循环。

In circular time there is no pressing present to achieve and create newness, or to insatiably produce more than is needed to simply survive.

在循环时间里,没有紧迫的当下去实现和创造新事物,也没有去贪得无厌地生产超出仅仅生存所需的东西。

Additionally, there is no fear of death. Such societies have successfully integrated the past and future into a peaceful sense of the present.

此外,对死亡也没有恐惧。这样的社会成功地将过去和未来融入到对当下的宁静感中。

They also honored the wisdom of elders who held the knowledge of the past-- upon which the future was clearly linked.

他们还尊重长者的智慧,长者掌握着过去的知识——而未来显然是与之相连的。

questions.passage_html: A large-scale study was by Facebook to analyze how people interact with online. The research showed of communication and the influence of social networks on relationships and community- building.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 made

考点：固定搭配

解析：make a study 固定搭配,意为“进行一项研究”。在单句语境中,过去分词形式被用来充当后置定语修饰名词 study。

2、 each other

考点：固定搭配

解析：interact with each other 构成固定搭配,意为“互相互动/相互交流”。在单句语境中,指代脸书通过这项大规模研究来分析人们在网络上是如何彼此互动的。

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作 showed 的宾语。根据单句关于社交网络数据统计的词义辨析可知,研究展示了人们在网络上的沟通“模式/习惯(patterns)”以及社交网络对人际关系的影响。

questions.title: Invention and Innovation
questions.passage_html: For our purposes the words 'invention' and 'innovation' can be used interchangeably. More , however, the term 'invention' refers to the discovery of new products or processes, while 'innovation' refers to the commercialization (bringing to the market) of new products or processes. , we can distinguish between product innovations and process innovations. Product innovations result the production of a new product, such as the change from a three- wheel car to a four-wheel car, or the change from LP records to CDs. Process innovations increase the of the methods of production of existing products, for example the invention of the assembly-line technique. The inventions and innovations that form industrial revolutions are those that open new doors and create new ways of doing things, not simply those that fill gaps in existing ways of doing things (Mokyr, 1997). The core of the First Industrial Revolution in the eighteenth century was a succession of technological changes that brought about material advances in three basic areas: (1) the substitution of mechanical devices (such as machines) for human labour; (2) the substitution of inanimate sources of power (such as steam) for animate sources of power (such as horse power); and (3) the substitution of mineral raw materials for vegetable or animal substances, and in general the use of new and more raw materials.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 specifically

考点：单句理解

解析：句子为 “More specifically, however, the term 'invention' refers to...”,此处的语境是在对前 一句进行更精确的说明,副词 specifically(具体地说)恰好符合逻辑衔接。它修饰整句话,用于引出更详细的定义。

2、 Furthermore

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：此处用于补充说明,“我们还可以区分产品创新和过程创新”,逻辑关系是“递进”,因此使用。

3、 in

考点：固定搭配

解析：固定表达 result in,意为“导致,结果是”。此处“Product innovations result in the production of a new product”意思是“产品创新导致了新产品的产生”。

4、 efficiency

考点：固定搭配

解析：句意为“工艺创新提高了现有产品生产方法的效率”,名词 efficiency(效率)正好与 production methods 搭配,构成固定搭配 “increase the efficiency of”。

5、 abundant

考点：单句理解

解析：此处描述工业革命时期新原材料的特征,应为“新的、更丰富的原材料”,即 abundant(丰富的),与前面的“use of new and more ... raw materials”逻辑一致。
questions.translation_html:
For our purposes the words 'invention' and 'innovation' can be used interchangeably.

就我们的讨论而言,invention 和 innovation 这两个词可以互换使用。

More specifically, however, the term 'invention' refers to the discovery of new products or processes, while 'innovation' refers to the commercialization (bringing to the market) of new products or processes.

不过更具体地说,invention 指的是新产品或新工艺的发现,而 innovation 指的是新产品或新工艺的商业化,也就是将其推向市场。

Furthermore, we can distinguish between product innovations and process innovations.

此外,我们可以区分产品创新和工艺创新。

Product innovations result in the production of a new product, such as the change from a three-wheel car to a four-wheel car, or the change from LP records to CDs.

产品创新会带来新产品的生产,例如从三轮汽车到四轮汽车的变化,或从黑胶唱片到 CD 的变化。

Process innovations increase the efficiency of the methods of production of existing products, for example the invention of the assembly-line technique.

工艺创新会提高现有产品生产方法的效率,例如流水线技术的发明。

The inventions and innovations that form industrial revolutions are those that open new doors and create new ways of doing things, not simply those that fill gaps in existing ways of doing things (Mokyr, 1997).

构成工业革命的发明和创新,是那些打开新可能、创造新做事方式的变化,而不只是填补现有方式中的空白(Mokyr, 1997)。

The core of the First Industrial Revolution in the eighteenth century was a succession of technological changes that brought about material advances in three basic areas: (1) the substitution of mechanical devices (such as machines) for human labour; (2) the substitution of inanimate sources of power (such as steam) for animate sources of power (such as horse power); and (3) the substitution of mineral raw materials for vegetable or animal substances, and in general the use of new and more abundant raw materials.

十八世纪第一次工业革命的核心,是一系列技术变化,它们在三个基本方面带来了物质进步:(1)用机械装置(如机器)取代人力;(2)用无生命动力来源(如蒸汽)取代有生命动力来源(如马力);(3)用矿物原材料取代植物或动物物质,并总体上使用新的、更丰富的原材料。

questions.title: Apartment Renting
questions.passage_html: My name is Tonia. My roommate and I are looking for a nice apartment near my college’s campus. We are very quiet and study a lot. I study history, and my roommate studies French. We are very interested renting your apartment. We can the rent on time because we do a part-time work, too. Some of our friends live in the same building and have recommended your place to us. They mentioned that you are a kind and responsible landlord, and we hope to the same positive experience. I would an appointment to view the apartment in person. application form is ready, and we are prepared to proceed with the process quickly. We look to hearing from you soon. Best regards, Tonia
questions.analysis_html:
1、 in

考点：固定搭配

解析：形容词 interested 与介词 in 构成固定搭配 be interested in(对......感兴趣),表示对租房有兴趣。

2、 pay

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 pay 意为“支付”,与宾语 the rent(租金)搭配。我们在做兼职,所以能够按时支付租金。

考点：单句理解

解析：have an experience(有......的经历)是地道的搭配,此处指希望像朋友一样获得积极的租房体验。

考点：固定搭配

解析：短语 would like to do sth. 是“想要做某事”的固定句式,此处指想要预约看房。

考点：单句理解

解析：此处需要形容词性物主代词修饰名词 application form(申请表),指“我们的”申请表已经准备好。

考点：固定搭配

解析：短语 look forward to(期待)是考查的重点,后面通常接名词或动名词形式,此处为固定用法。

questions.title: Illness
questions.passage_html: He spent a night, struggling with his health. It was for him to continue with his duties as usual. Despite his determination and eagerness to teach, he was not permitted to class due to his health condition. He was to attend and fulfill his responsibilities, but his illness prevented him from doing so.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 painful

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看前半句无法直接锁定形容词。必须结合本句后半句的跨句线索——“与他的健康状况作斗争(struggling with his health)”。既然整晚都在与疾病痛苦地抗争,那么这个夜晚必然是“痛苦的(painful)”。选项中的其他词汇均与后文的疾病抗争相矛盾。

2、 difficult

考点：单句理解

解析：形式主语结构 It was... for him to continue with his duties as usual(对他来说,像往常一样继续履行职责是......的)。结合前文他糟糕的健康状况,一个正在饱受病痛折磨的人想要像平常一样坚持工作,从词义和常识来看必然是“困难的(difficult)”。

3、 attend

考点：固定搭配

questions.title: Gamification
questions.passage_html: Gamification refers to the integration of game- like elements into non- game environments, particularly in the workplace, to drive engagement and . It involves using mechanics such as points, badges, leaderboards, and challenges to make tasks more engaging, rewarding, and fun. The primary goal of gamification is to inspire employees to perform better, work more collaboratively, and meet their objectives while feeling for their efforts. To be effective, gamification needs to be thoughtfully . It should align with company goals and be tailored to the needs of employees. Overuse or poorly designed gamification systems can backfire, leading to stress or disengagement. Successful gamification strategies tap into intrinsic motivation, offering employees meaningful rewards, fostering a sense of achievement, and encouraging healthy . The key is to ensure the game elements enhance the workplace experience rather than distract from it. Kevin Werbach, a professor at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, is a leading expert on gamification. Through his research and teaching, Werbach has explored how businesses can apply these game mechanics to increase employee motivation and .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 motivation

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 motivation 与前方的名词 engagement 借由并列连词 and 紧密连接。单句在阐述将游戏元素融入工作场所的核心目的:是为了驱动员工的“参与度”与“【积极性/动力(motivation)】”。前后两个名词在职场心理学和管理学语境下构成了完美的步调一致与递进。

2、 acknowledged

考点：并列结构

解析：过去分词 acknowledged 与前方的并列成分 more engaging、rewarding、fun 处于同一逻辑线索中。通读单句:游戏化旨在激励员工表现得更好,并在他们的努力付出之后,能够感到自己的工作被“【认可/承认(acknowledged)】”。这与被忽略(ignored)或被冷落(neglected)形成了鲜明的反义对照。

3、 implemented

考点：单句理解

解析：过去分词充当主句的表语。结合后方句子的语义警告——“过度使用或设计糟糕的游戏化系统会产生反作用”,本句在字面逻辑上给出正面建议:为了产生效果,游戏化必须被深思熟虑地“【执行/实施(implemented)】”。在四个选项中,只有 implemented 最符合管理系统在企业落地实施的生存逻辑。

4、 competition

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 competition 与前方的并列名词短语 meaningful rewards(有意义的奖励)和 a sense of achievement(成就感)共同构成了 and 连接的递进并列。成功的游戏化不仅要带给员工个人的成就,还要在职场团队中鼓励一种健康的“【竞争(competition)】”,前后语意积极且融洽。

5、 performance

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 performance 位于句末,与前方的名词短语 employee motivation 共同充当动词 increase 的并列宾语。从全篇探讨企业管理绩效的上下文来看,专家研究的核心在于如何通过游戏机制提高员工的积极性与“工作【表现/绩效(performance)】”。

questions.title: The Literary Paradox
questions.passage_html: The normal novel is dying. People nowadays prefer to engage in other forms of entertainment, such as music, rather reading books during their leisure time. However, , a survey conducted by a certain organisation or website reveals that the number of potential online writers, particularly in the genre of novels, is continuously increasing. This contradiction highlights the fact that despite the decline in reading books, global literacy rates are at an all-time high. This signals a shift in how people consume and engage with literature. While novels may be popularity as a medium, the rise of online writers and the overall improvement in literacy rates underscore the enduring importance and value of written communication. It also challenges the notion that literature is dying and suggests that it is merely evolving to adapt to the preferences and habits of modern readers. In conclusion, the novel, like any other art form, may transform in response to changing times but is far from fading .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 than

考点：固定搭配

解析：rather than 构成固定搭配,意为“而不是、而非”。在单句语境中,前面出现了 rather,后面接了分词短语 reading books,整个结构用于对比现代人的休闲选择。整句话意为“现在人们更喜欢参与其他娱乐形式(如音乐),‘而不是’在闲暇时间阅读书本”,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

2、 ironically

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的副词用作全句的状语,用来揭示前后两句话之间的逻辑矛盾。前一句话提到“普通的传统小说正在走向消亡,人们不再喜欢看书”;本句则指出“一项调查显示,潜在的在线作家(尤其是小说类)数量却在持续增加”。这种“读者变少,但想写小说的人却变多”的现象显然是具有讽刺意味的。因此,选择 ironically(具有讽刺意味的是、讽刺的是)最符合上下文的逻辑转折。

3、 losing

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的动词现在分词形式与后面的 popularity(流行度、名气)构成动宾搭配。根据全文第一句给出的核心基调“普通的传统小说正在走向消亡(The normal novel is dying)”,那么此时小说作为一种媒介,其流行度必然是在“流失、失去”。在选项中,maintaining 是保持,regaining 是重新获得,而 loosing 是 loose(变松/释放)的错误拼写形式,只有 losing(失去)符合单句内部的语义。

4、 away

考点：固定搭配

解析：fade away 构成固定搭配,意思是“逐渐消逝、淡出、衰亡”。在单句语境中,作为全文的总结发言,整句话意为“小说就像任何其他艺术形式一样,可能会随着时代的变迁而发生蜕变,但绝不会‘消亡’”,在单句内部即可直接锁定副词 away。

However, ironically , a survey conducted by a certain organisation or website reveals that the number of potential online writers, particularly in the genre of novels, is continuously increasing.

This contradiction highlights the fact that despite the decline in reading books, global literacy rates are at an all-time high.

这一矛盾突显了一个事实,即尽管阅读书本的人数在减少,但全球的识字率却处于历史最高水平。

This signals a shift in how people consume and engage with literature.

这标志着人们消费文学和接触文学的方式发生了转变。

While novels may be losing popularity as a medium, the rise of online writers and the overall improvement in literacy rates underscore the enduring importance and value of written communication.

It also challenges the notion that literature is dying and suggests that it is merely evolving to adapt to the preferences and habits of modern readers.

它还挑战了“文学正在走向死亡”的观念,并表明文学只是在不断演变,以适应现代读者的喜好和习惯。

In conclusion, the novel, like any other art form, may transform in response to changing times but is far from fading away .

questions.title: Lute
questions.passage_html: The lute, a plucked string instrument, a central role in European music from the late Middle Ages through the Baroque period. Its pear-shaped body and fretted neck it a versatile instrument for both solo and ensemble performances. Unlike the modern guitar, the lute typically has paired strings, which a richer, more resonant tone. During the Renaissance, the lute was highly valued by both professional musicians and amateur players. Its popularity gradually declined in the 18th century, as keyboard instruments became more fashionable. , the lute remains an important subject of study for those interested in early music performance practices, and it frequently used in historically informed concerts today.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 played

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 play 在此充当句子的谓语。根据上下文提到的时间背景“from the late Middle Ages through the Baroque period”(从中世纪晚期到巴洛克时期),动作发生于过去,故使用一般过去时 played。

2、 made

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 make 在此构成 make + it + adj. 的结构,意为“使之成为......”。梨形的琴身和品位琴颈“【使】”它成为一种多功能的乐器。

3、 produce

考点：主谓一致

解析：动词 produce 与先行词 strings(复数)保持主谓一致。双弦的设计能够“【产生】”更丰富、共鸣更强的音色。

4、 Nevertheless

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：副词 Nevertheless(然而 / 尽管如此)在此处起到转折作用。前文提到鲁特琴在18世纪逐渐衰落,此处转折说明“【尽管如此】”,它在现代对于早期音乐研究依然重要。

5、 is

考点：时态语态

解析：系动词 is 在此使用一般现在时,描述的是“今天”(today)的客观事实。即它在现今的音乐演出中“【是】”被频繁使用的。

questions.title: Housing
questions.passage_html: Housing is a key component of individual and family. In addition to being a place where family and friends can gather, housing is important for a sense of security and . One aspect of security is the wealth in the homes of owner occupiers. The wealth of households as the wealth (or equity) in the homes of owner occupiers increases through paying off housing loans, or as property values rise. questions.title: Choice of Subjects
questions.passage_html: The lack of interest among adolescents in school science courses is a complex issue, but two are particularly critical. Contemporary students live in a culture that increasingly emphasizes self-reflection and autonomy, and the range of subjects they are with is far broader than in the past. Adolescence is a key period for the formation of identity, and ample evidence shows that the way subject choices contribute to one's sense of self ―particularly in how they reflect personal —is crucial for young people. Specifically, science curricula need to more clearly demonstrate the career pathways that science can offer―both within scientific fields and in science- related professions―and articulate these careers are valuable, meaningful, and rewarding.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 factors

考点：上下文语境

解析：句子这里需要表达“因素”这一含义。前文提到青少年对学校科学课程缺乏兴趣是一个复杂的问题(complex issue),紧接着用 but 进行转折,引出有两个原因特别关键,该词能够准确描述这两个关键的“因素”,并与上下文语境保持一致。

2、 confronted

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。be confronted with 构成固定搭配,意思是“面对、面临”。文中指的是当代学生所“面临”的学科范围比过去要广泛得多。

3、 values

考点：上下文语境

解析：句子这里需要表达“价值观”这一含义。前文提到青春期是身份认同(formation of identity)形成的关键时期,学科选择能够反映出年轻人的个人“价值观”,这对他们至关重要,该词能够准确补充句意。

4、 why

考点：单句理解

解析：这个答案考查的是宾语从句的引导词。空格处引导一个名词性从句作 articulate(清晰表达)的宾语,用来解释这些职业“为什么”是有价值、有意义和值得追求的原因,why 在从句中作原因状语,符合句意逻辑。

questions.title: Pop Art
questions.passage_html: Pop art was a cultural that began in the mid-20th century, to everyday life as a source of inspiration. American artists often used subjects from their surroundings, such as beer bottles, clothing, comic strips, and advertisements, to create bold and striking artworks. In the United Kingdom, however, pop art drew heavily from found in magazines, archives and mass media culture. Together, these approaches made pop art one of the most accessible and influential movements in modern art.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 movement

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说波普艺术是一种文化______,始于20世纪中期。movement(运动)符合艺术史术语,后文也再次出现 movements in modern art。invention(发明)、judgement(判断)、measurement(测量)均不符合。

2、 turning

考点：非谓语形式

解析：句中 began in the mid-20th century, ______ to everyday life,逗号后需要非谓语动词作伴随状语,主语 pop art 与 turn to 之间为主动关系,故用现在分词 turning。turned(过去分词)表被动或已完成,与主动伴随不符;has turned(现在完成)和 turn(原形)不能作伴随状语。

3、 familiar

考点：上下文语境

解析：后文列举了啤酒瓶、服装、连环漫画、广告等日常物品,这些都是美国人“熟悉的”题材。familiar(熟悉的)与 their surroundings(他们的周围环境)形成逻辑呼应。similar(相似的)、popular(流行的)、regular(规律的)均不如 familiar 贴合“从身边熟悉事物取材”的语境。

4、 imagery

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说英国波普艺术大量借鉴杂志中的______,以及档案和大众媒体文化。imagery(图像/意象)符合波普艺术从大众媒体中取材的特点。comments(评论)、articles(文章)、titles(标题)均与视觉艺术的主要灵感来源不符。

5、 as well as

考点：逻辑衔接 / 并列结构

解析：句中 drew heavily from imagery found in magazines, ______ archives and mass media culture,需要连接两个并列的名词成分。as well as(以及)表示并列。for example(例如)表举例,unless(除非)表条件,therefore(因此)表因果,均不符合并列逻辑。
questions.translation_html:
Pop art was a cultural movement that began in the mid-20th century, turning to everyday life as a source of inspiration.

波普艺术是一种始于20世纪中期的文化运动,以日常生活作为灵感来源。

American artists often used familiar subjects from their surroundings, such as beer bottles, clothing, comic strips, and advertisements, to create bold and striking artworks.

美国艺术家常常使用他们周围熟悉的题材,例如啤酒瓶、服装、连环漫画和广告,来创作大胆而引人注目的艺术作品。

In the United Kingdom, however, pop art drew heavily from imagery found in magazines, as well as archives and mass media culture.

然而在英国,波普艺术大量借鉴了杂志中的图像,以及档案和大众媒体文化。

Together, these approaches made pop art one of the most accessible and influential movements in modern art.

这些方式共同使波普艺术成为现代艺术中最平易近人且最具影响力的运动之一。

questions.passage_html: In terms of your own communication skills, it is important to give just as much of your attention to a message you are receiving as to one you are giving. Listening,, as well as being a method for gathering information,your interest in what the other person is concerned with. This in itself can have a positive effect on your relationship with them and, if you are their manager, their motivation. Asking questionsclarification of the detail of the message can also convey that you have understood the message and that you want to respond to it
questions.analysis_html:
1、 for example

考点：状语从句

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的短语用作插入语,用来表明前后文的逻辑关系。第一句提出了一个总领性的观点:“在沟通技巧方面,给予接收到的信息与给予发出的信息同等的注意力是非常重要的(即倾听和表达同等重要)”。第二句则紧接着指出“倾听”所具备的作用,这显然是在对前文“接收到的信息”进行具体的举例说明,因此选择表示“例如”的 for example 最符合单句内部的逻辑。

2、 can convey

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,该句的主语是动名词 Listening,中间插入了 as well as being... 这一介词短语,空格处需要填入整个句子的谓语动词。因为全篇都是在阐述沟通技巧的客观规律和潜在益处,所以需要使用带有情态动词的一般现在时。can convey 意为“能够传达、可以传达”,在句中充当完整的谓语成分,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

3、 for

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。ask for something 构成固定搭配,意为“请求、寻求某物”。在单句语境中,中间插入了名词 clarification(澄清、阐明),整个短语意为“为了对信息的细节进行澄清而提出疑问(寻求澄清)”,在单句内部即可直接锁定介词 for。

4、 appropriately

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的副词用来修饰动词 respond(回应)。根据前半句“提出疑问可以传达出你已经理解了信息”,那么接下来顺理成章的逻辑就是“并且你希望对其做出‘恰当的、合适的’回应”。在选项中,professionally(专业地)、occasionally(偶尔地)、proportionally(成比例地)均不如 appropriately(恰当地)更符合职场或日常人际沟通的通用原则。

就你自身的沟通技巧而言，给予你正在接收的信息与给予你正在发出的信息同等程度的关注，这一点非常重要。

例如，倾听不仅是一种收集信息的方法，还能够传达出你对对方所关心之事的兴趣。

This in itself can have a positive effect on your relationship with them and, if you are their manager, their motivation.

这本身就能对你与他们的关系产生积极影响，而且如果你是他们的管理者，还会对他们的积极性产生积极影响。

Asking questions for clarification of the detail of the message can also convey that you have understood the message and that you want to respond to it appropriately.

questions.title: Sleepwalking
questions.passage_html: Sleepwalking is a disorder that occurs during sleep, in which a person may get up and walk around. It usually happens attimes of the night, especially during the deeper stages of sleep. People who sleepwalk are not aware of their actions and often do not rememberthey have done when they wake up. Sleepwalking is more common in children than in adults, and many children grow out of it over time. Sleepwalking is not the only type of unusual sleep behavior.include sleep talking, nightmares, and night terrors.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 certain

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。at certain times 构成固定搭配,意为“在某些特定的时间”。在单句语境中,后文紧接着提到“尤其是在深度睡眠阶段(especially during the deeper stages of sleep)”,这进一步印证了梦游并不是随机在任何时间发生,而是在“特定”的睡眠阶段发生,在单句内部即可直接锁定 certain。

2、 what

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要填入一个连接代词来引导 remember 后面的宾语从句。从句中的动词短语 have done(做)缺少宾语,因此必须使用在从句中充当宾语的连接代词 what,表示“他们醒来时往往不记得他们‘所做的事情’”。而 where(在哪里)、when(在何时)、how(如何)都是副词,不能在从句中作宾语。

3、 Others

考点：单句理解

解析： 首先，观察空格后的谓语动词 include（包括）使用的是原形，这直接证明该句的主语必须是一个复数概念。

其次，结合前文的语义流：前句提到 “Sleepwalking is not the only type of unusual sleep behavior（梦游症并不是唯一的一种异常睡眠行为）”；本句顺承该语境，需要表达“【其他的一些异常睡眠行为】还包括说梦话、梦魇和夜惊”。

在单句内部的代词辨析与数格一致要求下：

Another（另一个）后接单数谓语动词（如果是 Another，谓语应为 includes），故排除；

Other 是形容词，不能单独作主语，故排除；

Others 是代词，代表 Other unusual sleep behaviors（其他异常睡眠行为），既属于复数概念完美匹配复数谓语动词 include，又符合泛指“其他”的代词语义。

Sleepwalking is a disorder that occurs during sleep, in which a person may get up and walk around.

梦游是一种发生在睡眠过程中的障碍，患者在睡眠中可能会起身走动。

It usually happens at certain times of the night, especially during the deeper stages of sleep.

它通常发生在夜间的某些特定时刻，尤其是在深度睡眠阶段。

People who sleepwalk are not aware of their actions and often do not remember what they have done when they wake up.

梦游者对自己的行为没有意识，并且在醒来后往往不记得自己做了什么。

Sleepwalking is more common in children than in adults, and many children grow out of it over time.

梦游在儿童中比在成人中更为常见，并且许多儿童会随着年龄增长而自然痊愈。

Sleepwalking is not the only type of unusual sleep behavior.

梦游并不是唯一一种异常的睡眠行为。

Others include sleep talking, nightmares, and night terrors.

其他还包括梦话、噩梦和夜惊。

questions.title: Charity Group
questions.passage_html: Landing a position with the acclaimed charity group, often referred to as the providers, was a dream come true for Sarah. Although the organization could only offer a stipend, she eagerly the terms. She believed that working alongside such selfless individuals was far more than chasing a high corporate salary. Over the years, this dedicated group has continued to provide essential healthcare to impoverished communities worldwide, relying heavily on passionate workers who value purpose over financial gain.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 angel

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“referred to as the ______ providers”。angel providers 是常见搭配,意为“天使般的提供者/慈善提供者”,与后文“acclaimed charity group”（备受赞誉的慈善组织）相呼应。其他选项中,lawful（合法的）、mercy（仁慈,但 the mercy providers 搭配不自然）、optional（可选的）均不符合“慈善组织”的语境。因此填 angel。

2、 meager

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“only offer a ______ stipend”。meager 意为“微薄的/少量的”,修饰 stipend（津贴）,表示该组织只能提供微薄的津贴。前文提到“charity group”（慈善组织）,后文“high corporate salary”（高额企业薪水）形成对比,进一步印证了津贴是“微薄的”。large（大量的）与 only 语义矛盾；steady（稳定的）和 thick（厚的）不符合“微薄”的语义。因此填 meager。

3、 accepted

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“she eagerly ______ the terms”。accepted 意为“接受”,句意是“她热切地接受了这些条款”。前文说尽管津贴微薄,她仍然“热切地接受”,体现了她对这份工作的热情。claimed（声称/认领）、disclosed（披露）、despised（鄙视/轻视）均不符合“热切接受”的语义。因此填 accepted。

4、 rewarding

考点： 并列结构

解析： 空格位于“far more ______ than chasing a high corporate salary”。rewarding 意为“有回报的/有价值的”,与高薪企业工作形成对比,强调与无私奉献的人共事更有价值。句意是“与这些无私奉献的人共事远比追求高薪企业工作更有价值”。其他选项中,interesting（有趣的）程度较弱,且与“chasing a high salary”对比不如 rewarding 贴切；disgusting（令人厌恶的）和 repelling（令人排斥的）语义相反。因此填 rewarding。
questions.translation_html:
Landing a position with the acclaimed charity group, often referred to as the angel providers, was a dream come true for Sarah.

在备受赞誉的慈善组织——通常被称为“天使般提供者”——获得一个职位,对莎拉来说是梦想成真。

Although the organization could only offer a meager stipend, she eagerly accepted the terms.

尽管该组织只能提供微薄的津贴,她还是热切地接受了这些条款。

She believed that working alongside such selfless individuals was far more rewarding than chasing a high corporate salary.

她相信,与这些无私奉献的人共事远比追求高额的企业薪水更有价值。

Over the years, this dedicated group has continued to provide essential healthcare to impoverished communities worldwide, relying heavily on passionate workers who value purpose over financial gain.

多年来,这个敬业的团体持续为世界各地的贫困社区提供基本的医疗保健,主要依靠那些重视使命而非经济收益的热情工作者。

questions.title: Pop Mega-stars
questions.passage_html:
A music student at the University of Salford who wrote a song in two weeks is celebrating being featured on a compilation album produced by Metropolis Studios.

Pop mega-stars including Adele, Michael Jackson and Sir Elton John have all recorded music at the world-famous Metropolis Studios. Last year, the recording studios set compiling an album called 'Lost Songs', which features songs from relatively unknown musicians. First-year student Zak Taylor Fray decided to submit his song demo to be included in Volume Two of the Lost Songs album which was released this year, after he saw successful Volume One had been. Zak 24, said: 'I found this competition when simply the internet for songwriting competitions one day, and was lucky that there was still to enter. It amazes me that people who have worked with huge pop stars thought my song was good and worth something.'
questions.analysis_html:
1、 after

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,主句提到一名萨尔福德大学的音乐学生在两周内写了一首歌并正在庆祝(is celebrating),空格后为动名词短语 being featured on a compilation album(被收入一张合辑中)。根据前后逻辑,只有在自己的歌曲“被收入合辑之后”才会开展庆祝活动,因此使用介词 after 顺接先后发生的动作,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

2、 about

考点：固定搭配

解析：set about doing something 为固定搭配,意为“开始做/着手做某事”。句中指录音室着手制作一张名为《Lost Songs》的合辑。set by(放在旁边)、set on(决定/攻击,后接名词)、set up(建立/安排,后接名词)均不符合此处“开始做某事”的语义。

3、 how

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词 saw 后面需要接一个宾语。此处由引导词 how 引出一个宾语从句,整体在句中充当名词性成分。由于从句中的中心词是形容词 successful,在选项中只有副词 how 能够修饰形容词并引出程度,构成名词性从句结构。

4、 searching

考点：状语从句

解析：在单句语境中,时间连词 when 后面接一个现在分词短语充当时间状语。when searching the internet 属于 when he was searching... 的省略结构,用来描述他是在某天“浏览/搜索互联网”时发现这个比赛的,在单句内部通过省略句的语法特征即可确定。

5、 time

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。there is still time to do something 构成固定搭配,意思是“仍然有时间做某事”。在单句语境中,虽然 chance 和 opportunity 也有机会的意思,但当后面接不定式表示“还有做某事的机会/时间”时,固定句型通常使用 time,表示当时依然赶得及报名参赛,在单句内部即可直接锁定。
questions.translation_html:
A music student at the University of Salford who wrote a song in two weeks is celebrating after being featured on a compilation album produced by Metropolis Studios.

索尔福德大学的一名音乐学生在两周内创作了一首歌曲,在被收录进 Metropolis Studios 制作的合辑后正在庆祝。

Pop mega-stars including Adele, Michael Jackson and Sir Elton John have all recorded music at the world-famous Metropolis Studios.

包括 Adele、Michael Jackson 和 Elton John 爵士在内的流行巨星都曾在世界著名的 Metropolis Studios 录制音乐。

Last year, the recording studios set about compiling an album called 'Lost Songs', which features songs from relatively unknown musicians.

去年,这家录音室着手制作了一张名为《Lost Songs》的合辑,其中收录了相对不知名的音乐人的作品。

First-year student Zak Taylor Fray decided to submit his song demo to be included in Volume Two of the Lost Songs album which was released this year, after he saw how successful Volume One had been.

一年级学生 Zak Taylor Fray 在看到第一张专辑取得了巨大成功之后,决定提交自己的歌曲样带,希望能够被收录进今年发行的《Lost Songs》第二辑。

Zak 24, said: “I found this competition when simply searching the internet for songwriting competitions one day, and was lucky that there was still time to enter.”

24岁的 Zak 表示:“有一天我只是在网上搜索歌曲创作比赛时偶然发现了这个比赛,很幸运当时还来得及报名参加。”

“It amazes me that people who have worked with huge pop stars thought my song was good and worth something.”

“让我感到惊讶的是,那些曾与顶级流行歌星合作过的人竟然认为我的歌曲很好,并且有一定价值。”

questions.title: Managing Performance
questions.passage_html: Managing performance is about getting people into action so that they achieve planned and agreed results. It focuses on what has to be done, how it should be done and what to be achieved. But it is equally concerned with people - helping them to learn - and providing them with the support they need to do well, now and in the future. The framework for performance management is provided by the performance agreement, is the outcome of performance planning. The agreement provides the basis for managing performance throughout the year and for improvement and development activities. It is used as a reference point reviewing performance and the achievement of improvement and development plans.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 is

考点：单句理解

解析：It focuses on what has to be done, how it should be done and what is to be achieved. 它专注于必须做什么、应该怎么做以及要实现什么。

2、 developing

考点：并列结构

解析：在单句语境中,动名词与后方的 helping 构成直接的并列语义结构,共同作介词 with 的宾语。根据绩效管理的双重属性可知,它不仅关注工作成果,还同样关注“培养/发展(developing)”人才,帮助他们持续学习。

3、 which

考点：定语从句

解析：在单句语境中,关系代词引导一个非限制性定语从句并在从句中充当主语。由于先行词为前面的单数名词短语 the performance agreement(绩效协议),且从句中缺主语,故强制填入关系代词 which。

4、 guiding

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动名词作介词 for 的宾语。根据管理学对员工技能提升的词义辨析可知,绩效协议能够作为一整年的执行纲领,用来“指导/引领(guiding)”后续的所有企业改进和员工培训活动。

5、 when

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,连词引导一个时间状语省略从句(when reviewing 相当于 when managers are reviewing)。纯靠语义逻辑可知,绩效协议在管理中是作为一个参考基准点,以便在“当......的时候(when)”去评估绩效和发展计划。
questions.translation_html:
Managing performance is about getting people into action so that they achieve planned and agreed results.

绩效管理是指让人们行动起来,以便他们实现计划和商定的结果。

It focuses on what has to be done, how it should be done and what is to be achieved.

它专注于必须做什么、应该怎么做以及要实现什么。

But it is equally concerned with developing people - helping them to learn - and providing them with the support they need to do well, now and in the future.

但它同样关注培养人才——帮助他们学习——并为他们提供现在和未来做好工作所需的支持。

The framework for performance management is provided by the performance agreement, which is the outcome of performance planning.

绩效管理的框架由绩效协议提供,这是绩效计划的结果。

The agreement provides the basis for managing performance throughout the year and for guiding improvement and development activities.

该协议为全年的绩效管理以及指导改进和发展活动提供了基础。

It is used as a reference point when reviewing performance and the achievement of improvement and development plans.

在审查绩效以及改进和发展计划的达成情况时,它被用作一个参考点。

questions.title: Brains or Brawn
questions.passage_html: While workers worry about whether robots will take their jobs, teachers are wondering how to use education to insulate the next generation from such a fate. This before. When the last wave of automation swept the developed world at the start of the 20th century, policymakers decided education was the answer. If machines were going to substitute for brawn, they , more people would need to use their brains. The US invested in education, with good results. Workers reaped the benefits through better jobs and higher wages. Economists Andrew McAfee and Erik Brynjolfsson summed it up like this: 'The industrial revolution a race between technology and education ― and, for most of the 20th century, humans won that race.'
questions.analysis_html:
1、 has worked

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,后文紧接着提到“当20世纪初上一波自动化浪潮席卷发达国家时,决策者决定用教育来应对......美国大力投资教育并取得了良好的效果”。后文这一长串历史事实证明,这种做法在过去“确实奏效过”。根据这一特定时间背景和事实,此处表示“这在以前是行之有效的”,故选择现在完成时 has worked 顺接后面的历史例证。

2、 reasoned

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,这是由 if 引导的条件状语从句中所嵌入的插入语。前半句提到“如果机器将要取代体力”,后半句提到“更多的人就需要动脑筋”。前后这两者之间存在明显的逻辑推导关系,表明这是决策者们的“推理、推论”。因此,在选项中只有 reasoned(推断、思考、讲理)最符合这种逻辑分析的语境。

3、 heavily

考点：单句理解

解析：这个答案考查的是单句理解。invest heavily in something 构成搭配,意思是“在某方面大量投资、重金投入”。在单句语境中,主语为 The US(美国),后文提到获得了“良好的效果(with good results)”,由此可以推断出当时美国在教育上的投入力度非常大,在单句内部即可直接锁定副词 heavily。

4、 started

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。start a race 构成固定搭配,意思是“开启了一场比赛/角逐”。在单句语境中,经济学家们总结道,工业革命“开启了”技术与教育之间的赛跑,而人类在20世纪的大部分时间里赢得了这场赛跑,在单句内部通过动宾的语义搭配即可直接锁定。

While workers worry about whether robots will take their jobs, teachers are wondering how to use education to insulate the next generation from such a fate.

当工人们担心机器人是否会取代自己的工作时,教师们则在思考如何利用教育让下一代免于这样的命运。

This has worked before.

这种方法以前曾经奏效过。

When the last wave of automation swept the developed world at the start of the 20th century, policymakers decided education was the answer.

20世纪初,当上一轮自动化浪潮席卷发达国家时,政策制定者认为教育才是解决方案。

If machines were going to substitute for brawn, they reasoned, more people would need to use their brains.

他们认为,如果机器将取代体力劳动,那么就会有更多人需要依靠脑力工作。

The US invested heavily in education, with good results.

美国在教育上进行了大量投资,并取得了良好的效果。

Workers reaped the benefits through better jobs and higher wages.

工人们通过更好的工作和更高的工资获得了收益。

Economists Andrew McAfee and Erik Brynjolfsson summed it up like this: “The industrial revolution started a race between technology and education ― and, for most of the 20th century, humans won that race.”

经济学家 Andrew McAfee 和 Erik Brynjolfsson 总结道:“工业革命开启了一场技术与教育之间的竞赛,而在20世纪的大部分时间里,人类赢得了这场竞赛。”

questions.title: Home Appliances
questions.passage_html: In the developed world, home appliances have greatly reduced the need for physical labour. people need to be involved in tasks that once left them little time to do much else. For example, the word processor and email have, to a great , replaced the dedicated secretarial staff that briefly flourished with the rise of the typewriter. At time all copies were made with manual scribes, carefully duplicating what they read. Then we had carbon paper. Then photocopiers. Then printers. Then the requirement for physical copy reduced. An entire stream of labour appeared and disappeared as technology advanced. We freed ourselves of one kind of work; we just replaced it another.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 Fewer

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,比较级代词作主语。结合前句提到的“家用电器大大减少了对体力劳动的需求”这一上下文逻辑线索可知,与过去相比,如今“更少的人(Fewer)”需要被卷入到那些曾让他们精疲力竭的家务繁杂劳动中。

2、 extent

考点：固定搭配

解析：to a great extent 固定搭配,意为“在很大程度上”。在单句语境中,用来指出文字处理器和电子邮件在很大程度上取代了传统的专职秘书。

3、 one

考点：固定搭配

解析：at one time 固定搭配,意为“曾经、一度”。在单句语境中,用来引出对过去纯靠手工抄写员一笔一划复制文本的历史回顾。

4、 with

考点：固定搭配

解析：replace A with B 固定搭配,意为“用B取代A、以B代替A”。在单句语境中,在被动语态变形后(we just replaced it with another),意为我们只是用另一种工作取代了它。
questions.translation_html:
In the developed world, home appliances have greatly reduced the need for physical labour.

在发达国家,家用电器大大减少了对体力劳动的需求。

Fewer people need to be involved in tasks that once left them little time to do much else.

更少的人需要参与到那些曾经让他们几乎没有时间做其他事情的任务中。

For example, the word processor and email have, to a great extent, replaced the dedicated secretarial staff that briefly flourished with the rise of the typewriter.

例如,文字处理器和电子邮件在很大程度上取代了曾随着打字机的兴起而短暂繁荣的专职秘书人员。

At one time all copies were made with manual scribes, carefully duplicating what they read. Then we had carbon paper. Then photocopiers. Then printers. Then the requirement for physical copy reduced.

曾经所有的副本都是由手工抄写员制作的,他们仔细地复制他们读到的内容。后来我们有了复写纸。接着是复印机。再后来是打印机。然后对纸质副本的需求减少了。

An entire stream of labour appeared and disappeared as technology advanced.

随着技术的进步,一整股劳动力流出现并消失了。

We freed ourselves of one kind of work; we just replaced it with another.

我们把自己从一种工作中解放出来;我们只是用另一种工作取代了它。

questions.title: Amount of Sleep
questions.passage_html: The amount of sleep you need depends on many , especially your age. Newborns sleep between 16 and 18 hours a day and preschool children should sleep between 10 and 12 hours. Older children and teens need at least nine hours to be well rested. For most adults, seven to eight hours a night appears to the best amount of sleep. However, for some people" enough sleep" may be as few as five hours or as many as 10 hours of sleep. As you get older, your sleeping change. Older adults tend to sleep more lightly and awaken more frequently in the night than younger adults. This can have many causes including medical conditions and medications used to treat them. But there's no evidence that older adults need less sleep than younger adults. Getting enough sleep is to your health because it boosts your system, which makes your body better able to fight disease. Sleep is necessary for your nervous system to work properly. Too little sleep makes you drowsy and unable to concentrate. It also impairs memory and physical performance. So how many hours of sleep are enough for You? Experts say that if you feel drowsy during the day - even during boring activities - you are not getting enough sleep. Also, quality of sleep is just as important as quantity. People whose sleep is frequently interrupted or cut short are not getting quality sleep. If you experience frequent daytime sleepiness, even after increasing the amount of quality sleep you get, talk to your doctor. He or she may be able to the cause of sleep problems and offer advice on how to get a better night's sleep.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 factors

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作介词 on 的宾语。根据单句关于影响睡眠长短原因的词义辨析可知,一个具体需要多少睡眠取决于许多不同的外部和内部“因素(factors)”,尤其是年龄。

2、 patterns

考点：固定搭配

解析：sleeping patterns 构成生理医学与行为心理学中绝对定型的金牌核心搭配,意为“睡眠模式、睡眠习惯”。在单句语境中,指代随着年龄的增长,人类的睡眠习惯与周期会自发地发生改变。

3、 important

考点：固定搭配

解析：be important to意为“对......极其重要”。在单句语境中,指代获得充足的休息对于人体健康而言至关重要。

4、 immune

考点：固定搭配

解析：immune system 构成人体解剖学、临床医学领域里不可动摇的绝对硬性定型术语搭配,意为“免疫系统”。在单句语境中,指代良好的睡眠能够增强免疫系统,从而大幅度提高身体的抗病和自愈能力。

5、 identify

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词原形紧跟在不定式符号 to 后面充当目的状语。纯靠本句关于医生临床诊断职能的词义辨析可知,当患者常年饱受睡眠障碍折磨时,医生能够精确地帮你“找出/识别出(identify)”病根。

The amount of sleep you need depends on many factors, especially your age.

你需要的睡眠量取决于许多因素,尤其是你的年龄。

Newborns sleep between 16 and 18 hours a day and preschool children should sleep between 10 and 12 hours.

新生儿每天睡16到18个小时,学龄前儿童应该睡10到12个小时。

年龄大一点的儿童和青少年至少需要九个小时才能得到充分的休息。

对大多数成年人来说,每晚七到八个小时似乎是最好的睡眠量。

与年轻人相比,老年人往往睡得更轻,夜间醒来的频率更高。

这可能有许多原因,包括医疗状况和用于治疗这些状况的药物。

但没有证据表明老年人比年轻人需要更少的睡眠。

睡眠太少会让你昏昏欲睡,无法集中注意力。

它还会损害记忆力和身体表现。

So how many hours of sleep are enough for You?

那么多少小时的睡眠对你来说才足够呢?

Experts say that if you feel drowsy during the day - even during boring activities - you are not getting enough sleep.

专家说,如果你在白天感到昏昏欲睡——即使是在无聊的活动中——你也没有获得足够的睡眠。

Also, quality of sleep is just as important as quantity.

此外,睡眠质量和睡眠数量一样重要。

People whose sleep is frequently interrupted or cut short are not getting quality sleep.

睡眠经常被打断或缩短的人没有获得高质量的睡眠。

If you experience frequent daytime sleepiness, even after increasing the amount of quality sleep you get, talk to your doctor.

如果你在增加了高质量睡眠量之后仍然经常在白天感到困倦,请去看医生。

He or she may be able to identify the cause of sleep problems and offer advice on how to get a better night's sleep.

他或她可能能够找出睡眠问题的原因,并就如何获得更好的夜间睡眠提供建议。

questions.title: Origin of Species
questions.passage_html:
In The Origin of Species, Darwin provided abundant evidence that life on Earth has evolved over time, and he proposed natural selection as the primary mechanism for that change. He observed that individuals in their inherited traits and that selection acts on such differences, leading to change.

Although Darwin realized that variation in heritable traits is a prerequisite for , he did not know precisely how organisms pass heritable traits to their offspring. Just a years after Darwin published The Origin of Species, Gregor Mendel wrote a groundbreaking paper on inheritance in pea plants. that paper, Mendel proposed a model of inheritance in which organisms transmit discrete heritable units (now called genes) to their offspring. Darwin did not know about genes, Mendel’s paper set the stage understanding the genetic differences on which evolution is based.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 differ

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,that 引导的宾语从句中缺少谓语动词。因为该句在叙述达尔文过去的发现和观察,属于历史事实,所以需要使用一般过去时。主语是复数名词 individuals,故选择动词的过去式形式 differred。

2、 evolutionary

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个形容词来修饰名词 change(改变)。根据前半句“自然选择作用于这些可遗传特征的差异(selection acts on such differences)”,这种由自然选择推动的长期特征改变,正是“演化/进化”的定义,因此 evolutionary(演化的、进化的)最符合单句内部的语义逻辑。

3、 evolution

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定名词。前半句提到“尽管达尔文意识到可遗传特征的变异是......的前提条件”,必须结合前文第一句“生命在地球上随着时间而演化(has evolved over time)”以及本段最后一句“演化赖以发生的基础(on which evolution is based)”。上下文都在紧密围绕“演化”这一核心概念展开,因此选择 evolution 最符合语境。

4、 few

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。a few 加可数名词复数,意为“几个、一些”。在单句语境中,空格后面是可数名词复数 years,表示在达尔文发表《物种起源》“几年”之后,在单句内部即可直接锁定固定搭配 a few。

5、 In

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的介词与后面的名词短语 that paper(那篇论文)搭配,在句中充当状语。根据句意,“在那篇论文中,孟德尔提出了一个遗传模型......”,表示在某一著作或文献的内容之中,英语中习惯使用介词 in,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

6、 Although

考点：状语从句

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个连词来引导让步状语从句。前半句提到“达尔文当时并不知道基因的存在”,后半句提到“孟德尔的论文为理解演化所基于的遗传差异奠定了基础”,前后两部分构成让步和转折关系。在选项中,Despite 和 Because of 是介词短语不能接句子,However 是副词不能引导从句,因此只有连词 Although 能够引导让步状语从句。

7、 for

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。set the stage for something 构成固定搭配,意思是“为......做好准备、为......奠定基础”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“孟德尔的论文为理解演化赖以发生的遗传差异奠定了基础”,在单句内部即可直接锁定介词 for。
questions.translation_html:
