在《物种起源》中,达尔文提供了丰富的证据,证明地球上的生命随着时间的推移而演化,并提出自然选择是这种改变的主要机制。

He observed that individuals differed in their inherited traits and that selection acts on such differences, leading to evolutionary change.

他观察到,个体在可遗传特征上存在差异,而自然选择作用于这些差异,从而导致了演化上的改变。

Although Darwin realized that variation in heritable traits is a prerequisite for evolution, he did not know precisely how organisms pass heritable traits to their offspring.

尽管达尔文意识到可遗传特征的变异是演化的前提条件,但他当时并不知道生物究竟是如何将可遗传特征传递给后代的。

Just a few years after Darwin published The Origin of Species, Gregor Mendel wrote a groundbreaking paper on inheritance in pea plants.

就在达尔文发表《物种起源》几年后,格雷戈尔·孟德尔写了一篇关于豌豆植物遗传的开创性论文。

In that paper, Mendel proposed a model of inheritance in which organisms transmit discrete heritable units (now called genes) to their offspring.

在那篇论文中,孟德尔提出了一个遗传模型,认为生物将离散的遗传单位(现在称为基因)传递给后代。

Although Darwin did not know about genes, Mendel’s paper set the stage for understanding the genetic differences on which evolution is based.

尽管达尔文对基因一无所知,但孟德尔的论文为理解演化所基于的遗传差异奠定了基础。

blanks.label: 时态语态
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,that 引导的宾语从句中缺少谓语动词。因为该句在叙述达尔文过去的发现和观察,属于历史事实,所以需要使用一般过去时。主语是复数名词 individuals,故选择动词的过去式形式 differred。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处需要一个形容词来修饰名词 change(改变)。根据前半句“自然选择作用于这些可遗传特征的差异(selection acts on such differences)”,这种由自然选择推动的长期特征改变,正是“演化/进化”的定义,因此 evolutionary(演化的、进化的)最符合单句内部的语义逻辑。

blanks.label: 上下文语境
blanks.explanation: 单看这一句无法直接确定名词。前半句提到“尽管达尔文意识到可遗传特征的变异是......的前提条件”,必须结合前文第一句“生命在地球上随着时间而演化(has evolved over time)”以及本段最后一句“演化赖以发生的基础(on which evolution is based)”。上下文都在紧密围绕“演化”这一核心概念展开,因此选择 evolution 最符合语境。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 这个答案考查的是固定搭配。a few 加可数名词复数,意为“几个、一些”。在单句语境中,空格后面是可数名词复数 years,表示在达尔文发表《物种起源》“几年”之后,在单句内部即可直接锁定固定搭配 a few。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处的介词与后面的名词短语 that paper(那篇论文)搭配,在句中充当状语。根据句意,“在那篇论文中,孟德尔提出了一个遗传模型......”,表示在某一著作或文献的内容之中,英语中习惯使用介词 in,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处需要一个连词来引导让步状语从句。前半句提到“达尔文当时并不知道基因的存在”,后半句提到“孟德尔的论文为理解演化所基于的遗传差异奠定了基础”,前后两部分构成让步和转折关系。在选项中,Despite 和 Because of 是介词短语不能接句子,However 是副词不能引导从句,因此只有连词 Although 能够引导让步状语从句。

questions.title: Trinity Sport and Fitness
questions.passage_html: Whether you want to exercise and stay , train professionally with like-minded people, or indulge your competitive streak, Trinity Sport and Fitness . We've got a dedicated support development team on campus to support every student part in sports. You might want to participate in sports competitions volunteer with a local sports class or simply play for with our social sport program. Trinity fitness members of our public-facing sports facility will also you to discounts when you are booking a sports facility and fitness class. You will also get an opportunity to from tailored personal training, free activities events, and lots more.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 healthy

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。exercise and stay healthy 构成英语中的高频习语和常见搭配,意为“锻炼身体并保持健康”。在单句语境中,虽然 stay 后面可以接形容词,但根据生活常识与运动房的语境,人们运动锻炼的最直接目的就是为了“保持健康(healthy)”,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

2、 has it covered

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。have something covered 意为“把某事包办了、一切都在掌控之中/考虑得面面俱到”,这里的 it 指代前面提到的各种运动需求。在单句语境中,主语为圣三一体育与健身中心(Trinity Sport and Fitness),整句话意为“无论你是想保持健康还是参加竞技,圣三一健身中心都能为你打理好一切”,在单句内部即可锁定 has it covered。

3、 taking

考点：非谓语形式

解析：在单句语境中,主句部分已经具备了完整的谓语结构(We've got a dedicated support development team... to support every student),空格处需要填入非谓语动词来修饰名词 student。由于学生(student)与动词短语 take part in(参加)之间是主动关系,因此使用现在分词形式 taking 充当后置定语。

4、 fun

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。play for fun 构成固定搭配,意为“为了好玩、为了娱乐而玩(不带竞技压力)”。在单句语境中,前半句提到了“参加体育比赛、在本地体育课当志愿者”,后面用连词 or 进行了并列与对比,表示“或者‘仅仅为了娱乐’而加入我们的社交体育项目”,在单句内部通过语义即可直接锁定。

5、 entitle

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。entitle someone to something 构成固定搭配,意思是“使某人享有......的权利、给予某人......的资格”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“成为我们面向公众的体育设施的会员,还将‘赋予你’在预订场地和健身课程时享受折扣的权利”,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 entitle。

6、 benefit

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。benefit from something 构成固定搭配,意思是“从......中获益、得益于......”。在单句语境中,后面接了介词 from,整句话意为“你还将有机会从量身定制的私人训练和免费活动中‘获益’”,在单句内部通过动词与介词的搭配即可直接锁定。

我们在校园里拥有一支专门的支持发展团队,为每一位参加体育运动的学生提供支持。

成为我们面向公众的体育设施的圣三一健身会员,还将使你在预订体育设施和健身课程时享有折扣。

You will also get an opportunity to benefit from tailored personal training, free activities events, and lots more.

你还将有机会从量身定制的私人训练、免费的活动项目以及更多服务中获益。

questions.title: Two Types of Genes
questions.passage_html: Recently, research into embryonic development has given us an even better insight into how major structural changes might occur in a given population of organisms. We now understand that there are two major types of genes: developmental and 'housekeeping' genes. Developmental genes are those that are expressed during embryonic development, and their proteins the symmetry, skeletal development, organ placement, and overall form of the developing animal. , 'housekeeping' genes are expressed during the animal's daily life to generate proteins which keep the cells, tissues, and organs in the body functioning properly. you might suspect, mutations in developmental genes can have radical consequences for body form and function, whereas mutations in 'housekeeping' genes tend to the health and reproductive success of the post-embryonic animal.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 control

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当由关系代词引导的定语从句的谓语。根据生物学胚胎发育常识的词义辨析可知,发育基因所产生的蛋白质的核心功能,是“控制/决定(control)”发育中动物的对称性、骨骼发育以及器官位置。

2、 In contrast

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,短语置于句首引出两类事物的强烈对比。前文详细描述了在胚胎期表达的“发育基因”,本句开始转而引出日常表达的“管家基因(housekeeping genes)”,两类基因的功能截然相反,故选用 In contrast 表示“相反/与此形成鲜明对比”。

3、 As

考点：固定搭配

解析：As you might suspect 常用搭配,意为“正如你可能猜想的那样”。其中连词 as 意为“正如”。

4、 affect

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词原形紧跟在 tend to 后面作谓语。根据遗传学突变后果的词义辨析可知,发育基因突变后果往往是灾难性的,而日常管家基因的突变则倾向于“影响(affect)”出生后动物的健康和繁殖成功率。
questions.translation_html:
Recently, research into embryonic development has given us an even better insight into how major structural changes might occur in a given population of organisms.

最近,对胚胎发育的研究使我们对给定的生物种群中如何发生重大结构变化有了更好的了解。

We now understand that there are two major types of genes: developmental and 'housekeeping' genes.

我们现在明白,有两种主要类型的基因:发育基因和“管家”基因。

Developmental genes are those that are expressed during embryonic development, and their proteins control the symmetry, skeletal development, organ placement, and overall form of the developing animal.

发育基因是那些在胚胎发育期间表达的基因,它们的蛋白质控制着发育中动物的对称性、骨骼发育、器官放置和整体形态。

In contrast, 'housekeeping' genes are expressed during the animal's daily life to generate proteins which keep the cells, tissues, and organs in the body functioning properly.

相反,“管家”基因在动物的日常生活中表达,以产生使体内的细胞、组织和器官保持正常功能的蛋白质。

As you might suspect, mutations in developmental genes can have radical consequences for body form and function, whereas mutations in 'housekeeping' genes tend to affect the health and reproductive success of the post-embryonic animal.

正如你可能怀疑的那样,发育基因的突变可能会对身体形态和功能产生根本性的后果,而“管家”基因的突变则往往会影响胚胎后动物的健康和繁殖成功。

questions.title: The Growth of the Internet
questions.passage_html: The exponential growth of the internet was , in the 1990s, as revolutionizing the production and of information. Some people saw the internet as a means of access to knowledge. For people with African development, it seemed to offer the possibility of over the technology gap that Africa from advanced industrialized countries.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 heralded

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 heralded 在单句中作为被动语态谓语的核心部分。本句讨论20世纪90年代互联网的指数级增长。在语法结构上,它被 as 引导的短语修饰,字面逻辑表示互联网的增长在当年“被【预示/宣告/称颂(heralded)】”为一场革命。

2、 dissemination

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 dissemination 与前方的名词 production 借由并列连词 and 紧密咬合,共同受后方定语短语 of information 的修饰。从信息科学的并列逻辑来看,互联网改变了信息的“生产(production)”与“【传播/散布(dissemination)】”,前后语意工整、对仗严密。

3、 democratizing

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动名词作介词 of 的宾语。结合后方名词短语 access to knowledge(获取知识的途径)可知,互联网让知识不再被少数人垄断,而是让所有人都能平等获取。在四个选项中,只有 democratizing(使民主化、使大众化)最能精准表达这种“打破门槛、人人平等获取”的字面逻辑。

4、 concerned

考点：固定搭配

解析：在单句语境中,过去分词 concerned 与前方的名词 people 以及后方的介词 with 远程咬合,锁定了英语中极其高频的经典习惯固定搭配 be concerned with...(关心...... / 与......有关,此处用作后置定语 people concerned with...)。它在句中精准表达了“那些【关心】非洲发展的人”。

5、 leapfrogging

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动名词作介词 of 的宾语。这句话在讨论互联网给非洲带来的跨越式发展可能。结合后文的 technology gap(技术鸿沟)以及方向介词 over(越过)可知,互联网让非洲有可能直接“【跳跃/跨越(leapfrogging)】”这一鸿沟。

6、 separates

考点：固定搭配

解析：在由 that 引导的定语从句中,动词 separates 充当从句谓语,并与后方的介词 from(from advanced industrialized countries)形成了强烈的块状远程咬合,共同锁定了英语中定型的经典习惯固定搭配 separate A from B(将 A 与 B 隔开)。它在单句中用来描述“将非洲与先进工业化国家【隔开】的技术鸿沟”。
questions.translation_html:
The exponential growth of the internet was heralded, in the 1990s, as revolutionizing the production and dissemination of information.

在20世纪90年代,互联网的指数级增长被宣告为一场彻底变革信息生产和传播的革命。

Some people saw the internet as a means of democratizing access to knowledge.

一些人将互联网视为一种使获取知识的途径民主化(大众化)的手段。

For people concerned with African development, it seemed to offer the possibility of leapfrogging over the technology gap that separates Africa from advanced industrialized countries.

对于关心非洲发展的人来说,它似乎提供了跨越将非洲与先进工业化国家隔开的技术鸿沟的可能性。

blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,过去分词 concerned 与前方的名词 people 以及后方的介词 with 远程咬合,锁定了英语中极其高频的经典习惯固定搭配 be concerned with...(关心...... / 与......有关,此处用作后置定语 people concerned with...)。它在句中精准表达了“那些【关心】非洲发展的人”。

blanks.explanation: 在由 that 引导的定语从句中,动词 separates 充当从句谓语,并与后方的介词 from(from advanced industrialized countries)形成了强烈的块状远程咬合,共同锁定了英语中定型的经典习惯固定搭配 separate A from B(将 A 与 B 隔开)。它在单句中用来描述“将非洲与先进工业化国家【隔开】的技术鸿沟”。

questions.title: Speech of Alchemy
questions.passage_html: To learn the speech of alchemy, an early form of chemistry in which people attempted to turn metals into gold, it helps to think back to a time when there was no science: no atomic number or weight, no periodic chart, no list of elements. To the alchemists the was not made of leptons, bosons, gluons, and quarks. Instead it was made of substances, and one substance-say, walnut oil-could be just as as another-say, silver-even though modern would say one is heterogeneous and the other homogeneous. Without knowledge of atomic structures, how would it be to tell elements from compounds?
questions.analysis_html:
1、 universe

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个名词来作主语。根据前半句“对于炼金术士来说......(To the alchemists the...)”以及后半句“不是由轻子、玻色子、胶子和夸克组成的”,这里的微观粒子在现代科学中是构成“宇宙、万物”的基本粒子。在选项中,cosmos(宇宙)和 universe(宇宙、世界)语义相近,但 universe 更常用于描述客观物质世界的组成,且与后文“由物质组成(made of substances)”完美契合,指代古人眼中的整个物质世界。

2、 pure

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接锁定形容词。前半句提到“核桃油这种物质可以和银一样......”,后面紧跟着一个让步状语从句“尽管现代科学家会说一种是多相的,另一种是单相的”。现代科学认为银是纯净物(元素),而核桃油是复杂的混合物。但在古人看来,它们都是没有任何杂质的完整物质。因此,此处填入 pure(纯净的),用以对比古今对“纯净”概念的认知差异。

3、 scientists

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个名词来作从句的主语。后文提到了“heterogeneous(多相的、异质的)和 homogeneous(单相的、同质的)”,这些都是高度专业化的“现代科学”术语。因此,会说出这些术语的主体必然是 modern scientists(现代科学家),在单句内部即可直接锁定。

4、 possible

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。句型 how would it be possible to do something? 构成英语中的经典反问句式,意为“又怎么可能做到某事呢?”。其中 it 是形式主语,真正的主语是后面的动词不定式。整句话意为“在没有原子结构知识的情况下,又怎么可能将元素与化合物区分开来呢?”,在单句内部即可直接锁定形容词 possible。

To learn the speech of alchemy, an early form of chemistry in which people attempted to turn metals into gold, it helps to think back to a time when there was no science: no atomic number or weight, no periodic chart, no list of elements.

要学会炼金术(一种早期的化学形式,人们试图将普通金属变成黄金)的语言,有助于回顾一个没有科学的时代:没有原子序数或原子量,没有元素周期表,也没有元素清单。

To the alchemists the universe was not made of leptons, bosons, gluons, and quarks.

对于炼金术士来说,宇宙并不是由轻子、玻色子、胶子和夸克组成的。

Instead it was made of substances, and one substance-say, walnut oil-could be just as pure as another-say, silver-even though modern scientists would say one is heterogeneous and the other homogeneous.

相反,它是由物质组成的,而且一种物质(比如核桃油)可以和另一种物质(比如银)一样纯净,尽管现代科学家会说一种是多相混合物,而另一种是单相纯净物。

Without knowledge of atomic structures, how would it be possible to tell elements from compounds?

在没有原子结构知识的情况下,又怎么可能将元素与化合物区分开来呢?

questions.title: Interior Design
questions.passage_html: Interior design is a professionally conducted, practice-based process of planning and realization of interior spaces and the elements within. Interior design is to the function and operation of the aesthetics and its . The work of an interior designer draws upon many other , such as environmental psychology, architecture, product design and aesthetics, in relation to a wide range of building spaces including hotels, corporate and public spaces, schools, hospitals, private residences, shopping malls, restaurants, theaters and airport terminals. As modern spaces grow more interconnected, interior design is an part of creating environments that serve both practical and emotional needs. With shifts in lifestyle and technology, the core focus of interior design has altered dramatically in recent years — in fact it has significantly from what it was a decade ago.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 related

考点：固定搭配

解析：is related to 为固定搭配,意为“与......相关”。is compared to(被比作)、is concentrated on(集中于)、is corresponded to(与......通信/符合,用法罕见且不搭配)均不符合。

2、 sustainability

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说室内设计与美学及其______的功能和运作相关。sustainability(可持续性)符合室内设计领域的专业关注点。capability(能力)、environment(环境)、deniability(否认能力)均不符合。

3、 disciplines

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说室内设计师的工作借鉴许多其他______,后文列举了环境心理学、建筑学、产品设计和美学等学科。disciplines(学科)符合。course(课程)、principals(校长/原则,拼写应为 principles)、functions(功能)均不符合。

4、 integral

考点：固定搭配

解析：an integral part of 为固定搭配,意为“......的一个组成部分/不可或缺的部分”。infiltrated(渗透的)、impertinent(无礼的/不相关的)、indigenous(本土的)均不符合。

5、 altered

考点：上下文语境

解析：前文说核心焦点近年来发生了巨大变化(altered dramatically),本句进一步强调事实上与十年前相比已经______。altered(改变)与上文重复,起到强调作用。petrified(吓呆/石化)、moderated(缓和)、faltered(犹豫/蹒跚)均不符合语义。
questions.translation_html:
Interior design is a professionally conducted, practice-based process of planning and realization of interior spaces and the elements within.

室内设计是一个以专业方式进行、基于实践的规划和实现室内空间及其内部元素的过程。

Interior design is related to the function and operation of the aesthetics and its sustainability.

室内设计与美学及其可持续性的功能和运作相关。

The work of an interior designer draws upon many other disciplines, such as environmental psychology, architecture, product design and aesthetics, in relation to a wide range of building spaces including hotels, corporate and public spaces, schools, hospitals, private residences, shopping malls, restaurants, theaters and airport terminals.

室内设计师的工作借鉴了许多其他学科,如环境心理学、建筑学、产品设计和美学,涉及广泛的建筑空间,包括酒店、企业和公共空间、学校、医院、私人住宅、购物中心、餐厅、剧院和机场航站楼。

As modern spaces grow more interconnected, interior design is an integral part of creating environments that serve both practical and emotional needs.

随着现代空间变得更加互联,室内设计是创造既满足实用需求又满足情感需求的环境的一个组成部分。

With shifts in lifestyle and technology, the core focus of interior design has altered dramatically in recent years — in fact it has altered significantly from what it was a decade ago.

随着生活方式和技术的转变,室内设计的核心焦点近年来发生了巨大变化——事实上,它与十年前相比已经有了显著改变。

questions.title: Daniel Harris
questions.passage_html: Daniel Harris, a scholar of consumption and style, has observed that until photography did finally illustration as the "primary means of clothing" in the 1950s, glamour inhered in the face of the drawing, which was by necessity schematic and generalized, than in the sketch's , posture, and gestures, especially in the strangely dainty positions of the hands. Glamour once resided so emphatically in the stance of the model that the faces in the illustrations cannot really be said to have at all, but angles or tilts. The chin raised upwards in a haughty look; the eyes lowered in an attitude of introspection; the head cocked at an inquisitive or coquettish angle: or the profile presented in sharp outline, emanating power of the severity like an emperor's bust on a Roman coin.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 supplant

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要填入一个动词来描述“摄影(photography)”与“插画(illustration)”之间的历史关系。根据后文提到的时空背景(in the 1950s),摄影最终取代了插画成为主要手段。在选项中,surmount(克服)、deplete(耗尽)、use(使用)均不符合语境,只有 supplant(取代、替代)最符合单句内部的语义逻辑。

2、 advertising

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句,四种形容词或动名词在语法上似乎都能说得通。但必须结合整篇文章谈论的“消费与时尚风格(consumption and style)”以及“展示服装(clothing)”的宏观语境。在服装行业中,展示服装的最核心目的就是为了“做广告、宣传(advertising)”,因此锁定 advertising 这一符合商业与时尚语境的词汇。

3、 less

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。not so much... as... 或 less... than... 构成英语中的经典比较结构,意为“与其说是......不如说是......”。在单句语境中,空格后面出现了比较连词 than,整句话意为“魅力‘与其说’存在于画出来的面部上,‘不如说’存在于素描的姿态和手势中”,在单句内部即可直接锁定 less 形成 less... than... 搭配。

4、 attitude

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处填入的名词与后面的 posture(姿势)和 gestures(手势)构成并列和递进关系,用来描述模特身上散发魅力的载体。在选项中,altitude(高度)、magnitude(巨大/重要性)、analogue(类似物)均无法与姿势并列,只有 attitude 在此处意为“姿态、神态(身体的某种特定姿势)”,最符合单句内部的排比语义。

5、 expressions

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,前半句提到“魅力曾如此鲜明地存在于模特的站姿中,以至于......”。后面用转折和对比说明,插画中的脸部根本不能说有什么具体的“表情”,而仅仅是各种角度或倾斜。在选项中,只有 expressions(表情)能够与后文的“角度或倾斜(angles or tilts)”构成完美的逻辑对比。

6、 embossed

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配与专业语境。emboss something on a coin 构成固定搭配,意为“在硬币上浮雕/压印图形”。在单句语境中,后文提到了“罗马硬币(a Roman coin)”,古罗马硬币上统治者的半身像都是通过浮雕工艺压印上去的,在单句内部即可直接锁定具有“使凸出、浮雕”含义的动词 embossed。
questions.translation_html:
Daniel Harris, a scholar of consumption and style, has observed that until photography did finally supplant illustration as the "primary means of advertising clothing" in the 1950s, glamour inhered less in the face of the drawing, which was by necessity schematic and generalized, than in the sketch's attitude, posture, and gestures, especially in the strangely dainty positions of the hands.

消费与风格学者丹尼尔·哈里斯观察到，在20世纪50年代摄影最终取代插画成为“服装广告的主要手段”之前，魅力与其说存在于画作的面部（这些面部必然是简略而概括的），不如说存在于素描的姿态、体态和手势之中，尤其是那些奇特地娇柔的手部位置。

Glamour once resided so emphatically in the stance of the model that the faces in the illustrations cannot really be said to have expressions at all, but angles or tilts.

魅力曾如此鲜明地存在于模特的站姿之中，以至于插画中的面部根本不能说有什么表情，而只有角度或倾斜。

The chin raised upwards in a haughty look; the eyes lowered in an attitude of introspection; the head cocked at an inquisitive or coquettish angle: or the profile presented in sharp outline, emanating power of the severity like an emperor's bust embossed on a Roman coin.

下巴高傲地向上抬起；眼睛以自省的神态低垂着；头偏向好奇或卖俏的角度；或者以锐利的轮廓呈现侧面，散发出威严的力量，如同罗马硬币上浮雕的皇帝半身像。

questions.title: Bones
questions.passage_html: Bones are extremely strong. One of their functions is to protect organs. For example, the skull protects the brain; ribs protect heart and lungs. There are types of joints, including fixed joints, slightly moveable joints, and freely moving joints.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 main

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处填入的形容词用来修饰 functions(功能)。骨骼有很多功能,而“保护器官”是其最核心、最基本的功能之一。虽然 main(主要的)和 major(主要的)在很多时候可以互换,但在描述事物“最根本、最基础的核心功能”时,习惯上更常使用 main function 这一固定表达。

2、 the

考点：单句理解

解析：这个答案考查的是定冠词的特指用法。在英语中,谈论人体特有的解剖学器官(如脑、心脏、肺等)时,通常需要使用定冠词 the 来表示独一无二的身体器官。前半句的“the skull protects the brain”已经给出了完美的句式示范,因此后半句并列的器官也应当使用相同的结构,即“ribs protect the heart and lungs”。

3、 three

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看前半句无法直接锁定数字。但必须结合后文紧接着的跨句线索——后文用 including(包括)列举了具体类型:“固定关节(fixed joints)、微动关节(slightly moveable joints)以及活动关节(freely moving joints)”。后文清清楚楚地并列列举了三种类型,因此前面对应的数量必然是 three(三种)。
questions.translation_html:
Bones are extremely strong.

骨骼极其强壮。

One of their main functions is to protect organs.

它们的主要功能之一就是保护器官。

For example, the skull protects the brain; ribs protect the heart and lungs.

例如,颅骨保护大脑;肋骨保护心脏和肺部。

There are three types of joints, including fixed joints, slightly moveable joints, and freely moving joints.

关节共有三种类型,包括固定关节、微动关节和活动关节。

blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处填入的形容词用来修饰 functions(功能)。骨骼有很多功能,而“保护器官”是其最核心、最基本的功能之一。虽然 main(主要的)和 major(主要的)在很多时候可以互换,但在描述事物“最根本、最基础的核心功能”时,习惯上更常使用 main function 这一固定表达。

questions.title: Cultural Studies
questions.passage_html: Cultural studies is a new way of engaging in the study of culture. In the past, many academic subjects including anthropology, history, literary studies, human geography and sociology have brought their own disciplinary concerns to the study of culture. , in recent decades there has been a interest in the study of culture that has crossed disciplinary . The activities and cultural studies have emerged as an intriguing and exciting area of intellectual inquiry which has already shed important new light on the character of human cultures and which to continue to do so. While there is a little doubt that cultural studies are coming to as an important and distinctive field of study, it does seem to encompass a potentially enormous area. This is because the term 'culture' has a complex history and range of usages, which have provided a legitimate of inquiry for several academic disciplines.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 However

考点：状语从句

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要一个逻辑连词来衔接前后两句话。前半句提到“在过去,许多传统学科(如人类学、历史学等)都将各自的学科关注点带入了文化研究之中(各行其是)”,后半句提到“近几十年来,出现了一种跨越学科界限的、对文化研究的全新兴趣”。前后两句在时间(In the past vs. in recent decades)和研究范式上构成了鲜明的对比和转折,因此只能选择表示转折关系的 However(然而)。

2、 renewed

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。a renewed interest 构成英语中的固定搭配,意为“人们重新产生的兴趣、再次兴起的关注”。在单句语境中,用来修饰名词 interest,表示文化研究在近代“重新”焕发了生机并吸引了学者们的目光,在单句内部即可直接锁定过去分词形容词化的 renewed。

3、 boundaries

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。cross disciplinary boundaries 构成固定搭配,意思是“跨越学科边界、跨越学科界限”。在单句语境中,前文提到这种新兴趣是跨学科的(crossed...),在选项中,discriminations(歧视/辨别)、similarities(相似性)、differentiations(分化/差异)均无法与学科构成合理的学科交叉语境,只有 boundaries 最符合。

4、 resulting

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的形容词用来修饰 activities(活动)。前文提到“人们重新燃起了跨越学科边界的文化研究兴趣”,正是因为有了这种全新的跨学科研究动力和趋势,才“导致/产生了”后面的一系列学术活动。因此,选择 resulting(由此产生的、作为结果的)作为前因后果的逻辑连接最为精准。

5、 promises

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,该空处于由 which 引导的定语从句中,与前面的 has already shed(已经阐明了......)由连词 and 并列。由于前半句使用的是现在时态,且后面紧跟了动词不定式 to continue to do so(承诺将继续这样做),表明这种强大的潜力一直延续到现在并指向未来。定语从句的主语 which 指代单数概念的 area,因此谓语动词使用一般现在时单数形式 promises。

6、 be widely recognized

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句,四种短语在语法上都可行。但必须结合后文的跨句线索——后文提到它已经成为“一个重要且独特的全新研究领域(an important and distinctive field of study)”。既然已经形成了独立的、有代表性的重要领域,说明文化研究在学术界已经“被广泛认可”,因此选择 be widely recognized 最符合语境。

7、 focus

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。provide a focus of inquiry 构成固定搭配,意思是“提供研究焦点、成为探究的核心焦点”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“这是因为‘文化’这个词有着复杂的历史和广泛的用法,这些用法为好几个学科都提供了合法的‘研究焦点’”,在单句内部即可直接锁定 focus。
questions.translation_html:
Cultural studies is a new way of engaging in the study of culture.

文化研究是一种参与文化探讨的全新方式。

In the past, many academic subjects including anthropology, history, literary studies, human geography and sociology have brought their own disciplinary concerns to the study of culture.

在过去,许多学术学科,包括人类学、历史学、文学研究、人文地理学和社会学,都将各自的学科关注点带入了文化研究之中。

However, in recent decades there has been a renewed interest in the study of culture that has crossed disciplinary boundaries.

然而,近几十年来,人们对文化研究重新产生了浓厚的兴趣,并且这种兴趣已经跨越了学科的边界。

The resulting activities and cultural studies have emerged as an intriguing and exciting area of intellectual inquiry which has already shed important new light on the character of human cultures and which promises to continue to do so.

由此产生的学术活动和文化研究已发展成为一个引人入胜且令人兴奋的知识探究领域,它不仅对人类文化的特质阐明了重要的新见解,而且有望继续阐明下去。

While there is a little doubt that cultural studies are coming to be widely recognized as an important and distinctive field of study, it does seem to encompass a potentially enormous area.

虽然毫无疑问文化研究正逐渐被广泛认可为一个重要且独特的学术领域,但它似乎确实涵盖了一个潜在的巨大范围。

This is because the term 'culture' has a complex history and range of usages, which have provided a legitimate focus of inquiry for several academic disciplines.

这是因为“文化”一词具有复杂的历史和广泛的用法,这些历史和用法为好几个学术学科都提供了一个合理合法的研究焦点。

questions.title: Laptop
questions.passage_html: UMN's ALCs features large tables that seat nine students and can accommodate laptop computers for work. Typically, students bring their own computers to class and use the building's ubiquitous wireless capability. The classrooms are designed to hands-on activities and problems that require students to interact with each other to reach a solution. Students can display their work on large LCD screens mounted around the room to promote small- and large-group discussions. Each table is allotted three gooseneck microphones so that students can make themselves heard without shouting during group discussions. Additionally, students can press a button on their table console to light a lamp to indicate when they need help or wish to speak. To facilitate brainstorming and group reporting, the room is also lined with erasable marker-boards.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 circular

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句,四个形容词在语法上都可以修饰 tables(桌子)。但必须结合本句内部的后文线索——“这些大桌子可以坐九名学生(seat nine students)”。根据常识和教室空间布局逻辑,要让九个人同时围坐在一起并进行协作,只有圆形桌最为合理。后文提到“每个桌子分配了三个鹅颈麦克风”,也暗含了围坐的圆形结构。

2、 collaborative

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接锁定。必须结合后文全篇的核心线索——第三句明确提到“这些教室旨在促进动手操作,以及需要学生‘相互互动’才能达成解决方案的问题(require students to interact with each other)”,第四句也提到了“为了促进小组和大组讨论”。这些后文线索全部指向了“团队协作”。因此,选择 collaborative(协作的、合作的)最符合上下文语境。

3、 facilitate

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的动词主语是 The classrooms(这些教室),宾语是 hands-on activities and problems(动手实践活动和问题)。教室的设计初衷显然是为了“促进、使便利”这些教学活动的开展。在选项中,spoil(毁坏)、fabricate(捏造/制造)、stabilize(稳定)均不符合语境,只有 facilitate(促进、推动)最符合单句内部的词义辨析。

4、 signal

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的名词用作定语来修饰后面的 lamp(灯)。后文用 to 引导的目的状语给出了明确的提示:“用来指示他们何时需要帮助或希望发言(to indicate when they need help...)”。这种用来传达某种特定信息或请求的灯,在词义上必然是“信号灯”。因此选择 signal 最符合单句内部的语义。

UMN's ALCs features large circular tables that seat nine students and can accommodate laptop computers for collaborative work.

明尼苏达大学(UMN)的活动学习教室(ALCs)其特点是配有大型圆形桌,每张桌子可容纳九名学生,并能放置笔记本电脑以进行协作式工作。

Typically, students bring their own computers to class and use the building's ubiquitous wireless capability.

通常,学生们会带自己的电脑来上课,并利用大楼里无处不在的无线网络功能。

The classrooms are designed to facilitate hands-on activities and problems that require students to interact with each other to reach a solution.

这些教室旨在促进动手实践活动,并解决需要学生相互互动才能达成解决方案的问题。

Students can display their work on large LCD screens mounted around the room to promote small- and large-group discussions.

学生们可以将他们的作品展示在安装在房间周围的大型LCD屏幕上,以促进小组和大组的讨论。

Each table is allotted three gooseneck microphones so that students can make themselves heard without shouting during group discussions.

每张桌子分配了三个鹅颈麦克风,这样学生们在小组讨论时就不用大喊大叫也能让别人听到自己的声音。

此外,学生们还可以按下桌上控制台的一个按钮来点亮一盏信号灯,以表示他们何时需要帮助或希望发言。

To facilitate brainstorming and group reporting, the room is also lined with erasable marker-boards.

为了促进集思广益和小组报告,房间周围还贴满了可擦拭的标记白板。

questions.title: Noble Gas
questions.passage_html: The six gases: helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon and radon have a myriad of modern uses. When they were first discovered, their strangely stand-offish properties were a mystery. Uniquely stable, they to participate in no chemical reactions. But by understanding the stability of the noble gases, physicists discovered the key to chemical bonding . Dmitri Mendeleev added the noble gases to his periodic table in 1902, where he arranged the elements in rows and columns to their atomic weight. Mendeleev was able to see repeating (or periodic) patterns in their properties. The noble gases appeared in the periodic table, occurring in every eighth position, at least amongst the lighter elements.
questions.analysis_html:
1、seemed

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格后接动词不定式 to participate。在四个选项中,只有 seemed(似乎)可以与后面构成 "seem to do something"(似乎做某事)的固定短语搭配,用以描述稀有气体在被发现初期"似乎不参与任何化学反应"的特征。

2、itself

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于名词短语 chemical bonding(化学键)的后方。在英语中,为了表达"某事物本身",习惯在名词后直接紧跟反身代词,构成 [名词] + itself 的固定强调搭配。此处意为"化学键本身"。

3、according

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格与后文的介词 to 强绑定。在英语中,表达"根据...... / 依照......",习惯使用的是固定短语搭配 "according to..."。此处指门捷列夫"根据它们的原子量"来排列元素。

4、regularly

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格在句中作状语,用以修饰动词 appeared(出现)。后文指出这些气体"每隔八个位置就会出现一次(occurring in every eighth position)"。这种周期性、规律性的出现,在单句内部对应的修饰语必然是副词 regularly(规律地/定期地)。
questions.translation_html:
The six gases: helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon and radon have a myriad of modern uses.

氦、氖、氩、氪、氙和氡这六种气体在现代有大量用途。

When they were first discovered, their strangely stand-offish properties were a mystery.

它们最初被发现时，那种奇特的不活泼性质曾是一个谜。

Uniquely stable, they seemed to participate in no chemical reactions.

由于异常稳定，它们似乎不参与任何化学反应。

But by understanding the stability of the noble gases, physicists discovered the key to chemical bonding itself.

但通过理解稀有气体的稳定性，物理学家发现了化学键本身的关键。

Dmitri Mendeleev added the noble gases to his periodic table in 1902, where he arranged the elements in rows and columns according to their atomic weight.

德米特里·门捷列夫于1902年将稀有气体加入元素周期表，并按原子量把元素排列成行和列。

Mendeleev was able to see repeating (or periodic) patterns in their properties.

门捷列夫能够看到这些元素性质中重复出现的，即周期性的规律。

The noble gases appeared regularly in the periodic table, occurring in every eighth position, at least amongst the lighter elements.

稀有气体在周期表中规律地出现，至少在较轻的元素中，每隔第八个位置就会出现一次。

questions.title: Mechanical Engineering
questions.passage_html:
Mechanical engineering was at the heart of Taylor's theorizing, providing the context for its development, the world view by which it was sustained and, finally, the justification for its widespread application. Scientific management aimed to analyse and control the activities of people engineers analysed and controlled machines. Central Taylor's system was

the desire and standardize production techniques in the interests of economy, efficiency and mutual prosperity. His primary point of interest was the individual worker individual goals and motivated by incentive payments. Taylor's view of human motivation was somewhat simplistic and his apprehension of the significance of groups was limited and generally negative.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 in the same way that

考点：固定搭配

解析：在单句语境中,空格处需要填入一个连词词组来引导方式状语从句。in the same way that... 构成固定搭配,意为“以与......相同的方式”。整句话意为“科学管理旨在分析和控制人的活动,‘正如’工程师分析和控制机器‘那样’”,在单句内部即可直接锁定该句型。

2、 to

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。central to something 构成固定搭配,意思是“对......至关重要、居于......的中心地位”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“泰勒体系的核心‘在于’精简和标准化生产技术”,在单句内部即可直接锁定介词 to。

3、 to rationalize

考点：非谓语形式

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。the desire to do something 构成固定搭配,意为“做某事的欲望/愿望”,其中动词不定式作后置定语修饰名词 desire。在单句语境中,表示“精简和标准化生产技术的愿望”,在单句内部即可直接锁定 to rationalize。

4、 pursuing

考点：非谓语形式

解析：在单句语境中,前半句已经具备了完整的谓语结构(His primary point of interest was the individual worker)。空格处需要填入非谓语动词来修饰名词 worker(工人)。由于工人与动词 pursue(追求)之间是主动关系,表示“追求个人目标的工人”,因此需要使用现在分词形式 pursuing 充当后置定语。

5、 Undoubtedly

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的副词用作全句的状语,用来表明作者对后文观点的态度。后文提到“泰勒对人类动机的看法有些过于片面,且他对群体重要性的理解非常有限且通常是负面的”,这是管理学界对泰勒科学管理理论公认的、毫无争议的评价。因此,选择 Undoubtedly(毫无疑问地、毋庸置疑地)最符合客观评述的语境。

Mechanical engineering was at the heart of Taylor's theorizing, providing the context for its development, the world view by which it was sustained and, finally, the justification for its widespread application.

机械工程是泰勒理论体系的核心,为该理论的发展提供了背景、支撑该理论的世界观,并最终为其广泛应用提供了正当理由。

Scientific management aimed to analyse and control the activities of people in the same way that engineers analysed and controlled machines.

科学管理旨在分析和控制人的活动,正如工程师分析和控制机器那样。

Central to Taylor's system was the desire to rationalize and standardize production techniques in the interests of economy, efficiency and mutual prosperity.

泰勒体系的核心在于,为了经济、效率和共同繁荣的利益,而精简和标准化生产技术的愿望。

His primary point of interest was the individual worker pursuing individual goals and motivated by incentive payments.

他最核心的关注点是那些追求个人目标并受到激励性薪酬驱动的单个工人。

Undoubtedly Taylor's view of human motivation was somewhat simplistic and his apprehension of the significance of groups was limited and generally negative.

毋庸置疑,泰勒对人类动机的看法有些过于片面,并且他对群体重要性的理解非常有限且通常是负面的。

questions.title: Noisy Studying
questions.passage_html: Some students say that they need complete quiet to read and study. Others study best in a crowded, noisy room because the noise actually them concentrate. Some students like quiet music playing; others not. The point is, you should know the level of noise that is optimal for your own studying. However, one general rule for all students is that the television seems to be more of a distraction than music or other background noise, so the TV off when you are reading or studying. , don't let yourself become distracted by computer games, email, or Internet surfing.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 helps

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定动词。前半句提到“另一些学生在拥挤、嘈杂的房间里学习效果最好”,后面用 because(因为)引导原因状语从句。既然他们能在嘈杂环境中“学得最好”,那必然是因为这种噪音在他们看来非但没有干扰,反而“帮助(helps)”了他们集中注意力。在选项中,虽然 aids 和 assists 也有帮助的意思,但 help 后面可以接省略 to 的动词不定式(help sb do sth),而 aid 和 assist 通常不这样搭配,故在单句内部即可直接锁定 helps。

2、 do

考点：上下文语境

解析：前句说 Some students like quiet music playing,本句用 others 对应,结构为 others ______ not。do not 用于替代前文提到的谓语动词 like,构成 others do not (like quiet music playing) 的省略结构。prefer not、perform not、complete not 均不符合英语语法习惯。

3、 leave

考点：固定搭配

解析：leave the TV off 为固定搭配,意为“让电视保持关闭状态”。leave + 名词 + 形容词 表示“使......处于某种状态”。cut off(切断/中断)、keep off(避开/不靠近,如 keep off the grass)、place off(不搭配),均不符合。

4、 Also

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的副词用来连接前后两句话。前一句话建议学生们在学习时关闭电视以防分心,这一句话接着提到“不要让自己被电脑游戏、邮件或上网冲浪所分心”。这两句话在语义上是并列、递进和补充的关系,因此选择表示“此外、而且”的 Also 最为合适。
questions.translation_html:
Some students say that they need complete quiet to read and study.

一些学生说,他们需要完全安静的环境才能阅读和学习。

Others study best in a crowded, noisy room because the noise actually helps them concentrate. Some students like quiet music playing; others do not.

其他人在拥挤嘈杂的房间里学习效果最好,因为噪音实际上帮助他们集中注意力。有些学生喜欢安静的音乐;其他人则不喜欢。

The point is, you should know the level of noise that is optimal for your own studying.

关键是,你应该了解最适合你自己学习的噪音水平。

However, one general rule for all students is that the television seems to be more of a distraction than music or other background noise, so leave the TV off when you are reading or studying.

然而,对所有学生来说,一条普遍的规律是,电视似乎比音乐或其他背景噪音更容易让人分心,所以当你在阅读或学习时,请保持电视关闭的状态。

Also, don't let yourself become distracted by computer games, email, or Internet surfing.

此外,不要让自己被电脑游戏、电子邮件或上网冲浪分散了注意力。

questions.title: Australia's Dwellings
questions.passage_html: The stock of Australia's dwellings is , with current homes having more bedrooms on average than homes ten years ago. At the same time, households are getting smaller on average with decreasing of couple families with children and couple only and lone person households. This article the changes in household size and number of bedrooms from 1994-95 to 2003-04.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 evolving

考点：单句理解

解析：evolving: 这个单词表示“发展、演变”,符合句意中描述的澳大利亚住宅的“变化”或“发展”情况。

2、 proportions

考点：单句理解

解析：proportions: 这个词通常用来描述数量或比例的变化,这里指的是家庭类型的 比例变化,即家庭中夫妻有孩子的比例和只有夫妻或单身人士的家庭比例的变化。

3、 increasing

考点：并列结构

解析：increasing: 根据句意,家庭结构正在变小,这反映在夫妻有孩子的家庭比例在减少,而只有夫妻或单身人士的家庭比例在“增加”。

4、 examines

考点：单句理解

解析：examines: 这个单词表示“考察、研究”,符合文章要探讨的主题——从1994- 95年到2003-04年家庭规模和卧室数量的变化。

questions.title: Paraphrasing
questions.passage_html: Paraphrasing is often defined as putting a passage from an author into your own words. However, what are your own words? How different must your paraphrase be from the original? The answer is it should be different. The whole point of paraphrasing is to show you have read and understood another person's ideas, and can summarize them in your own writing style rather than borrowing their phrases. If you just change a few words, or add some bits your own to an otherwise reproduced passage, you will probably for plagiarism. You should aim to condense and simplify a writer's ideas and describe them using different sentence structures and expressions. also important to credit the original writer by referencing.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 considerably

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,副词作状语修饰后方的形容词 different。根据前文提出的核心疑问“你的改写文本必须与原文有多大的【不同(different)】?”,本句给出正面回答。在四个选项中,只有副词 considerably(相当大地、明显地)能够嵌入该句子的修饰位置,用来强调改写后的文本在字面上必须与原文产生“显著的、相当大的”差异。

2、 of

考点：固定搭配

解析：在单句语境中,介词 of 与后方的代词短语共同锁定了英语中极其常用且定型的经典习惯固定搭配 of one's own(属于某人自己的,此处表现为 of your own)。它在句中充当后置定语修饰前方的名词短语 some bits,用来极其地道地表达“在一段抄袭而来的段落里,加上一点点【属于你自己的】内容”这一语义。

3、 be penalized

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当主句的谓语。主语是人(you),而人与动词惩罚(penalize)之间是绝对的受动关系。结合情态动词 will 以及副词 probably,在语法结构上强制要求使用被动语态形式。在四个选项中,只有 be penalized(被惩罚、被处分)符合“主语被动受罚”的语法事实。

4、 It is

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,It is 置于句首充当形式主语结构。该句真正的逻辑主语是后方由 to 引导的不定式短语 to credit the original writer by referencing(通过注明出处来赞誉原作者)。根据英语的句子结构规范,当真正主语太长时,通常在句首使用无实际意义的 It is 来进行结构上的平衡。

questions.title: Abstract
questions.passage_html: It is an original work, not an excerpted passage. An abstract must be fully self-contained and sense by itself, without further reference to outside sources or to the actual paper. It highlights key areas, your research purpose, the relevance or importance of your work, and the main outcomes. It is a well-developed single paragraph of approximately 250 words length, which is indented and single spaced. The function of the abstract is to outline briefly all parts of the paper. Although at the beginning of your paper, immediately following the title page, the abstract should be the last thing that you write, you are sure of the conclusions you will reach.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 make

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 make 与后方的名词 sense 构成了固定搭配 make sense(有意义、讲得通)。它在单句中精准表达“摘要必须完全自成一体,且其自身就能够【说得通/让人理解】”。

2、 content

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,此处需要填入一个名词作定语修饰 areas(领域/方面)。结合后文列举的并列成分 your research purpose(你的研究目的)和 the main outcomes(主要结果)可知,这些都属于整篇论文的“【内容(content)】领域”。由此锁定名词 content。

3、 in

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词 in 与前方的名词 words 以及后方的名词 length 跨词构成了高频固定搭配 in length(在长度上/纵深上),用作后置定语。在单句中规范表达“一篇长度【在】250字左右的单段落文章”。

4、 it is placed

考点：语法结构

解析：在由 Although 引导的让步状语从句中,主语 it 指代单数名词 the abstract(摘要),它与动词“放置(place)”之间是绝对的受动关系。由于此处是在陈述一个客观的排版事实,根据语法规则必须强制使用一般现在时的被动语态形式 it is placed(它被放置于)。

5、 once

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：连词 once(一旦......就......)在此处引导条件/时间状语从句,用以连接前后两句话的逻辑。前文提到摘要应该是你写论文时最后才写的内容,本句引出其时间前提:“【一旦(once)】你对你将得出的结论有了十足的把握”,你就应该最后来写摘要。

It is an original work, not an excerpted passage.

这是一项原创作品,不是摘录的段落。

An abstract must be fully self-contained and make sense by itself, without further reference to outside sources or to the actual paper.

摘要必须完全独立,本身就能独立成章,无需进一步参考外部来源或实际论文。

It highlights key content areas, your research purpose, the relevance or importance of your work, and the main outcomes.

它强调了关键内容领域、你的研究目的、你的工作的重要性或相关性,以及主要 成果。

It is a well-developed single paragraph of approximately 250 words in length, which is indented and single spaced.

它是一个发育良好的单一段落,⻓约250字,缩进并单倍行距。

The function of the abstract is to outline briefly all parts of the paper.

摘要的作用是简要概述论文的所有部分。

Although it is placed at the beginning of your paper, immediately following the title page, the abstract should be the last thing that you write, once you are sure of the conclusions you will reach.

questions.title: Omniscience
questions.passage_html: Omniscience may be a foible of men, but it is not so of books. Knowledge, as Johnson said, is of two , you may know a thing yourself, and you may know where to find it. Now the amount which you may actually know yourself must, at its best, be limited, but what you may know of the of information may, with proper training, become almost boundless. And here come the and use of reference books-the working of one book in connection with another-and applying your own to both. By this means we get as near to that omniscient volume which tells everything as ever we shall get, and although the single volume or work which tells everything does not exist, there is a vast number of reference books in existence, a knowledge and proper use of which is essential to every intelligent person. Necessary as I believe reference books to be, they can easily be made to be to idleness, and too mechanical a use should not be made of them.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 kinds

考点：上下文语语境

解析：在单句语境中,此处需要填入一个表示分类的名词。紧接着看后文由逗号隔开的并列线索——“你可以自己知道一件事,你也可以知道在哪里可以找到它(you may know a thing yourself, and you may know where to find it)”,这明显是在将知识划分为两种不同的“种类”。在选项中,只有 kinds 符合这一客观分类的上下文线索。

2、 sources

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 sources 与后方的介词短语 of information 构成了高频固定搭配 sources of information(信息来源)。它在单句中精准表达“你对于信息【来源】所能了解到的知识,通过妥当的训练,几乎可以变得无穷无尽”。

3、 value

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 value 与后方的名词 use 借由并列连词 and 紧密连接,共同受到前方定冠词 the 的修饰。从句法结构上看,此处需要一个单数名词或不可数名词与 use 保持形式上的对称和对仗,共同充当主语。由此锁定名词单数形式 value(价值)。

4、 intelligence

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当动词 applying 的宾语。整句的字面逻辑在阐述如何使用参考书——“将你自己的【智力/智慧(intelligence)】运用到这两者之中”。其他选项(如记忆力、兴趣、心思)在单句字面逻辑的契合度上均不如 intelligence 贴切。

5、 contributory

考点：固定搭配

解析：形容词 contributory 与前方的动词 be 构成固定搭配 be contributory to(有助于...... / 促成......),在句中充当宾语补足语(由 make... to be... 结构引导)。在单句中规范表达“它们(参考书)很容易被用来【导致】懒惰”。

Omniscience may be a foible of men, but it is not so of books.

无所不知或许是人的弱点,但书籍却并非如此。

Knowledge, as Johnson said, is of two kinds , you may know a thing yourself, and you may know where to find it.

正如约翰逊所说,知识有两种,你可以自己知道一件事,也可以知道在哪里找到 它。

Now the amount which you may actually know yourself must, at its best, be limited, but what you may know of the sources of information may, with proper training, become almost boundless.

你自己真正能掌握的知识量,即使在最好的情况下,也是有限的,但如果经过适 当的训练,你可以对信息的来源有近乎无限的了解。

And here come the value and use of reference books-the working of one book in connection with another-and applying your own intelligence to both.

这就是工具书的价值和用途——将一本书与另一本书结合使用,并运用自己的智 慧来理解它们。

By this means we get as near to that omniscient volume which tells everything as ever we shall get, and although the single volume or work which tells everything does not exist, there is a vast number of reference books in existence, a knowledge and proper use of which is essential to every intelligent person.

通过这种方式,我们可以尽可能接近那个无所不知的书籍,尽管不存在一本能讲 述所有知识的书,但已经有大量的工具书存在,每个聪明人都应该了解并正确使 用它们。

Necessary as I believe reference books to be, they can easily be made to be contributory to idleness, and too mechanical a use should not be made of them.

尽管我认为工具书是必不可少的,但它们也很容易成为助⻓懒惰的因素,因此不 应机械地使用它们。

questions.title: Fossil Fuels
questions.passage_html: But look beyond fossil fuels for the most intriguing trends. One is that the energy intensity of the world economy - the amount of energy it takes to produce one dollar's of income - keeps falling, at a rate of about 2 percent. What this means is that even without any change in the shares of fossil-based and fossil-free sources in the world's energy mix, we could have 2 percent annual economic growth without increasing carbon emissions from energy use. Of course that is not enough to climate change and we need more economic growth than that. It is a stunning number, which refutes the claim by some environmentalists that permanent economic growth is fundamentally incompatible finite physical resources.
questions.analysis_html:
1、worth

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "one dollar's ______ of income" 结构中。在英语中,表达"价值多少的面值 / 价值多少的数量",习惯使用的是固定搭配 "...'s worth of + 名词"。此处意为"价值一美元的收入"。

2、relative

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格修饰名词 shares(份额)。文章在讨论世界能源组合中"化石能源与非化石能源的分摊比例"。在这两者的对比中,由于一方的增加必然导致另一方的减少,所以这种份额是"相对的",选用形容词 relative(相对的) 最符合单句内涵。

3、address

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格作及物动词,宾语是 climate change(气候变化)。在正式政经与学术语境中,表达"解决问题 / 应对挑战 / 处理危机",习惯使用的是固定动词短语搭配 "address + 问题/挑战"。

4、nonetheless

考点:逻辑衔接

解析: 空格位于句中,用来连接前后两句的逻辑。前句提到"仅仅这样对于解决气候变化来说是不够的(not enough)",后句指出"这依然是一个令人震惊的数字(a stunning number)"。前后两句在语义上构成了明显的让步转折关系,因此选用副词 nonetheless(尽管如此/然而) 最符合前后的逻辑衔接。

5、with

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "is fundamentally incompatible ______" 结构中。在英语中,表达"与......不兼容 / 与......格格不入",习惯使用的是由形容词与介词构成的固定短语搭配 "be incompatible with..."。
questions.translation_html:
But look beyond fossil fuels for the most intriguing trends.

但最耐人寻味的趋势要在化石燃料之外寻找。

One is that the energy intensity of the world economy - the amount of energy it takes to produce one dollar's worth of income - keeps falling, at a rate of about 2 percent.

其中一个趋势是，世界经济的能源强度，也就是创造一美元收入所需的能源量，正以约2%的速度持续下降。

What this means is that even without any change in the relative shares of fossil-based and fossil-free sources in the world's energy mix, we could have 2 percent annual economic growth without increasing carbon emissions from energy use.

这意味着，即使世界能源结构中化石能源和非化石能源的相对比例没有变化，我们也可以在不增加能源使用碳排放的情况下实现每年2%的经济增长。

Of course that is not enough to address climate change and we need more economic growth than that.

当然，这还不足以应对气候变化，而且我们需要的经济增长也不止这些。

It is nonetheless a stunning number, which refutes the claim by some environmentalists that permanent economic growth is fundamentally incompatible with finite physical resources.

尽管如此，这仍是一个惊人的数字，它反驳了一些环保人士的说法，即持续经济增长从根本上与有限的物质资源不相容。

questions.title: Sun and Moon
questions.passage_html: From the time of the very earliest civilisations man has wondered about the world he lives in, about how it was created and about how it will end. In these distant times the sun was seen to make its daily across the sky. At night the moon appeared. Every new night the moon waxed or waned a little and on a few nights it did not appear at all. At night the great dome of the heavens was dotted with tiny specks of light. They known as the stars. It was thought that every star in the heavens had its own purpose and that the of the universe could be discovered by making a study of them. It was well known that there were wandering stars, they appeared in different nightly positions against their neighbours and they became known as planets. It took centuries, in fact it took millennia, for man to the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model of the world to accommodate them and to their positions in the sky.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 journey

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 journey 与前方的动词 make 以及所有格 its 构成了高频固定搭配 make its journey(踏上旅程/进行移动)。在单句中精准表达“在那些遥远的时代,人们看到太阳每天在天空中【穿行/东升西落】”。

2、 became

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,此处需要填入谓语动词。通读本段可知,整篇文章都在使用一般过去时(如 was seen, appeared, waxed, waned)来描述远古人类对星空的认知历史。紧接着看后文第五句的直接平行线索——“它们被称为行星(they became known as planets)”,两处句式结构完全对仗。因此优先锁定过去时态的 became。

3、 secrets

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当宾语。整句的字面逻辑是:古人认为天空中的每颗星星都有其自身的使命,并且通过对它们进行研究,宇宙的“【奥秘/秘密(secrets)】”就能够被揭开。其他选项(如故事、观点、想象力)在字面逻辑上均不如 secrets 严谨。

4、 determine

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 determine 充当带 to 的动词不定式,与后方的宾语短语 the true nature...(真实本质)形成动宾搭配。整句字面逻辑表达:人类花费了几个世纪乃至几千年的时间,才最终“【查明/确定(determine)】”了这些漂移不定的星星的真实本质。

5、 predict

考点：并列结构

解析：动词 predict 与前方的动词 evolve 借由并列连词 and 紧密连接,共同承接前方的不定式符号 to。从字面逻辑的并列对仗来看,人类演化出了一套世界模型,其目的不仅是为了容纳这些行星,更是为了“【预测(predict)】”它们在天空中的位置。
questions.translation_html:
From the time of the very earliest civilisations man has wondered about the world he lives in, about how it was created and about how it will end.

从最早的文明时代起,人类就开始思考他所居住的世界,思考它是如何被创造 的,以及它将如何终结。

In these distant times the sun was seen to make its daily journey across the sky.

在那个遥远的年代,人们看到太阳每天在天空中进行一次旅程。

At night the moon appeared.

夜晚,月亮升起。每一个新的夜晚,月亮或盈或亏,而在少数几个夜晚中,它完 全没有出现。

Every new night the moon waxed or waned a little and on a few nights it did not appear at all.

夜晚,天空的大圆顶布满了微小的亮点。它们被称为星星。

At night the great dome of the heavens was dotted with tiny specks of light.

人们认为,天上的每一颗星星都有自己的使命,通过研究它们可以揭示宇宙的秘 密。

They became known as the stars.

人们也知道有些星星在夜空中是游移不定的,它们每晚相对于周围星星的位置都 会发生变化,人们便称它们为行星。

It was thought that every star in the heavens had its own purpose and that the secrets of the universe could be discovered by making a study of them.

人类花了几个世纪,甚至上千年,才确定这些游移星体的真实本质,并发展出一 个能容纳它们的世界模型,进而预测它们在天空中的位置。

It was well known that there were wandering stars, they appeared in different nightly positions against their neighbours and they became known as planets.

It took centuries, in fact it took millennia, for man to determine the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model of the world to accommodate them and to predict their positions in the sky.

blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,名词充当宾语。整句的字面逻辑是:古人认为天空中的每颗星星都有其自身的使命,并且通过对它们进行研究,宇宙的“【奥秘/秘密(secrets)】”就能够被揭开。其他选项(如故事、观点、想象力)在字面逻辑上均不如 secrets 严谨。

questions.title: Colour Preference
questions.passage_html: Many tests have shown that, in a very broad way, peoples in most parts of the world have similar color preferences. Blue is the most preferred and popular hue, followed in order by red, green, purple, yellow and orange. Overlaying this basic order of color preference, , are the responses of individuals, which of course vary and may also be very powerful. Children are likely to have strong for some colors and aversions to others, but sometimes will not admit to them, since outside may be influential in determining both color preferences and the way that they are expressed or suppressed. Current fashions in clothes and accessories, gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure may all play a significant part. Boys in particular may be reluctant to admit to any strong preferences for colors those of favorite football teams, because color awareness may be regarded by their peer-group as feminine.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 however

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：副词 however 在此处用作插入语,用来调节前后两句话的逻辑转折。前文提到世界各地的人们有着“相似的颜色偏好(similar color preferences)”,本句则引出“个体的反应(the responses of individuals)”,两者在语义上构成了明显的转折关系。因此锁定表示转折的 however。

2、 widely

考点：固定搭配

解析：副词 widely 与前方的动词 vary 构成了高频固定搭配 vary widely(广泛地变化/存在巨大差异)。它在单句中精准表达“个体的反应当然存在着【巨大的差异】,而且可能非常强烈”。

3、 preferences

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当宾语,并与后方的 to others(对其他颜色的厌恶)形成反义并列。结合整篇文章都在反复讨论的 color preferences(颜色偏好)这一核心线索,此处表达的是孩子们对某些颜色有着强烈的“【偏好(preferences)】”,而对另一些颜色感到厌恶。

4、 factors

考点：上下文语境

解析：前文提到儿童可能不愿承认自己对某些颜色的偏好,后文具体列举了影响因素:时装潮流、性别刻板印象、同伴压力。factors(因素)与后文的具体列举形成呼应。pressures(压力)只是其中之一,不够全面;appearances(外表)、reasons(原因)均不如 factors 准确概括后文所列的多项内容。

5、 other than

考点：固定搭配

解析：短语 other than 在此处用作介词短语,意为“除了......之外”。它与前方的 any 连用(any... other than...),在单句中精准表达“男孩子们特别不愿意承认自己对【除了】最喜欢的足球队颜色【之外】的任何颜色有强烈的偏好”。

Many tests have shown that, in a very broad way, peoples in most parts of the world have similar color preferences.

许多测试表明,世界大多数地区的人们在大致上有相似的颜色偏好。

Blue is the most preferred and popular hue, followed in order by red, green, purple, yellow and orange.

蓝色是最受欢迎和最受⻘睐的颜色,接下来依次是红色、绿色、紫色、⻩色和橙 色。

Overlaying this basic order of color preference, however , are the responses of individuals, which of course vary widely and may also be very powerful.

在这一基本的颜色偏好顺序之上,然而,是个体的反应,这些反应当然因人而 异,广泛变化,并且可能非常强烈。

Children are likely to have strong preferences for some colors and aversions to others, but sometimes will not admit to them, since outside factors may be influential in determining both color preferences and the way that they are expressed or suppressed.

Current fashions in clothes and accessories, gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure may all play a significant part.

当前的服装和配饰时尚、性别刻板印象以及同龄人压力可能都发挥着重要作用。

questions.title: Colonial Era
questions.passage_html: At the end of the colonial era, as many new nations gained independence, relative levels of economic development became an important criterion by which to distinguish between countries. The former colonial powers and parts of the world generally became known as advanced industrial, or developed countries, former colonies and poorer nations became known as less developed, or more positively, developing countries. Critics of the distribution of wealth across the globe highlighted the role which wealth creation in some places had played in impoverishing poorer nations and, rather, described them as actively underdeveloped. The question as to economic change is developing or underdeveloping countries remains a vital issue, as the debate over sweatshops highlights.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 wealthier

考点：并列结构

解析：形容词 wealthier 与前方的 the former colonial powers(前殖民强国)借由并列连词 and 紧密连接。从后文提及的这些国家被称为“发达国家(developed countries)”以及与后半句中“更贫穷的国家(poorer nations)”的对比逻辑来看,此处在经济富裕程度上必须形成对仗。因此锁定 wealthier(更富裕的)。

2、 while

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：连词 while 在此处用作转折/对比连词,用来连接前后两个具有强烈对照意义的分句。前一个分句在说明“前殖民强国和更富裕的地区被称为发达国家”,后一个分句则在说明“前殖民地和更贫穷的国家被称为不发达国家”,两部分在字面结构和语义上构成了完美的平行对比。

3、 uneven

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰名词 distribution(分布)。前文明确指出了世界上存在着发达国家(富裕地区)与不发达国家(贫穷地区)的强烈对立,这直接说明全球财富的分布是极不均衡的。由此锁定符合这种贫富分化线索的形容词 uneven(不均衡的)。

4、 whether

考点：语法结构

解析：连词 whether 在此处引导一个主语从句或同位语从句(作名词 question 的后置解释)。结合后文出现的并列选择结构 is developing or underdeveloping(是在促进发展还是在阻碍发展),直接触发了 whether... or...(是......还是......)的硬性句法搭配。
questions.translation_html:
At the end of the colonial era, as many new nations gained independence, relative levels of economic development became an important criterion by which to distinguish between countries.

在殖⺠时代结束之际,随着许多新国家获得独立,相对的经济发展水平高低成为 区分国家的重要标准。

The former colonial powers and wealthier parts of the world generally became known as advanced industrial, or developed countries, while former colonies and poorer nations became known as less developed, or more positively, developing countries.

前殖⺠国家和世界较富裕地区通常被称为先进的工业国或发达国家,而前殖⺠地 和较贫穷的国家被称为欠发达或更积极的发展中国家。

Critics of the uneven distribution of wealth across the globe highlighted the role which wealth creation in some places had played in impoverishing poorer nations and, rather, described them as actively underdeveloped.

批评全球财富分配不均的人强调,某些地方的财富创造使贫困国家更加贫困,并 使他们成为积极欠发达国家。

The question as to whether economic change is developing or underdeveloping countries remains a vital issue, as the debate over sweatshops highlights.

正如对血汗工厂的辩论所强调的,经济变化是发展中国家的还是发展不足的国家 的问题仍然是一个关键问题。

questions.title: Healthcare
questions.passage_html: In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare, the job of a doctor is more like the job of chief executive. The people who run hospitals and physicians' practices don't just need to know . They must also be able to balance budgets, motivate a large and diverse and make difficult marketing and legal .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 medicine

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作 know 的宾语。根据单句关于现代医院院长复合型职能要求的词义辨析可知,管理庞大医院的领导者们,现在绝不能仅仅懂得纯粹的“医学/医疗业务(medicine)”,还要掌握高级工商管理技能。

2、 staff

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词被形容词短语 large and diverse(规模庞大且背景多元的)所修饰。结合前文“管理医院和医生诊所”以及高管需要进行人员激励的上下文语境可知,医院负责人必须要能够调动全院“员工(staff)”的积极性。

3、 decisions

考点：固定搭配

解析：make legal decisions / make decisions ,意为“做出法律决策/做出商业决断”。在单句语境中,指代现代医疗体系的管理高层需要制定极其艰难的营销与法律决策。

In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare, the job of a doctor is more like the job of chief executive.

在瞬息万变的现代医疗世界中,医生的工作更像是首席执行官的工作。

The people who run hospitals and physicians' practices don't just need to know medicine.

管理医院和医生诊所的人不仅需要了解医学。

They must also be able to balance budgets, motivate a large and diverse staff and make difficult marketing and legal decisions.

他们还必须能够平衡预算,激励庞大而多元的员工,并做出艰难的营销和法律决策。

questions.title: Ikebana
questions.passage_html: More than simply putting flowers in a , Ikebana is a art form in which nature and humanity are brought together. Contrary to the idea of a particolored or multicolored of blossoms, Ikebana often emphasizes other areas of the , such as its stems and leaves, and puts emphasis on shape, line, and form. Though Ikebana is an expression of creativity, certain rules govern its form. The artist's intention is shown through a piece's color combinations, natural shapes, graceful lines, and the implied meaning of the arrangement.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 container

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当介词 in a 的宾语。整句的字面逻辑在阐述插花艺术的表面形态与深层内涵的关系——“插花不仅仅是把花放进一个【容器/花瓶(container)】里”。其他选项(如形状、方式、时尚)均无法与“插花(putting flowers)”这一具体的动作形成最贴切的物理搭配。

2、 disciplined

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰 art form。空格本身看有多个选项可填,但紧接着看后文第五句给出的直接限定线索——“虽然花道是创造力的表达,但特定的规则支配着它的形式(certain rules govern its form)”,这说明它绝不是随机或转瞬即逝的,而是一种受规则约束的艺术。由此锁定 disciplined(受过严格训练的、有纪律约束的)。

3、 arrangement

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 arrangement 与前方的形容词构成插花领域的行业习惯搭配 a multicolored arrangement of blossoms(色彩斑斓的插花/鲜花组合)。它在单句中精准表达“与那种色彩斑斓的鲜花【组合/陈列】观念相反,花道往往更强调其他部位”。

4、 plant

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当介词短语 areas of the 的宾语。紧接着看后文由 such as 引导的同位语解释线索——“例如它的茎和叶(such as its stems and leaves)”,茎和叶属于典型的植物结构。在选项中,flora 指植物群(宏观概念),organism 指生物体(过于宽泛),唯有 plant(植物)最符合这一微观解剖结构的复现。

与仅仅是把花插进容器里不同,Ikebana是一种有纪律的艺术形式,在其中自然 和人性结合在一起。

Contrary to the idea of a particolored or multicolored arrangement of blossoms, Ikebana often emphasizes other areas of the plant , such as its stems and leaves, and puts emphasis on shape, line, and form.

Though Ikebana is an expression of creativity, certain rules govern its form.

虽然Ikebana是创造力的表现,但是某些规则支配它的形式。

questions.title: Ozone
questions.passage_html: Clones of an Eastern cottonwood (Populus deltoides) in the Bronx and other city spots grew to double the biomass of clones outside small towns upstate or on Long Island, says Jillian Gregg, now of the Environmental Protection Agency's western-ecology division in Corvallis, Ore. The growth gap comes from ozone damage, she and her New York colleagues report. Ozone chemists have known that concentrations may spike skyscraper high in city air, but during a full 24 hours, rural trees actually get a higher cumulative ozone exposure from urban pollution that in and lingers. A series of new experiments now shows that this hang-around ozone is the factor in tree growth, the researchers say in the July 10 Nature. "This study has profound importance in showing us most vividly that rural areas the price for urban pollution," says Stephen P. Long of the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. "This work should be a wake-up call," he adds.

1、 planted

考点：固定搭配

解析：过去分词 planted 在此充当非谓语形式,作后置定语修饰前方的 clones(克隆苗),并与后方的介词 outside 及其地点短语构成物理空间上的固定搭配。在单句中精准表达“在布朗克斯及其他城市地点【种植】的东部棉白杨克隆苗”。

2、 blows

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当由关系代词 that 引导的定语从句的谓语。紧接着看前文的逻辑线索——这些污染原本是“城市污染(urban pollution)”,但承受污染的却是“乡村树木(rural trees)”。污染气体跨越空间从城市移动到乡村,在选项中只有 blows(吹袭、飘散)最符合气体流动的上下文线索,精准表达“从城市【吹】来并滞留下来的城市污染”。

3、 overwhelming

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰 factor(因素)。整句的字面逻辑在总结核心实验结论:一系列新实验表明,这种长久滞留的臭氧是影响树木生长的“【决定性的/压倒性的(overwhelming)】”因素。

4、 pay

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 pay 与后方的名词短语 the price 构成了极其高频的惯用固定搭配 pay the price(付出代价 / 承担后果)。它在单句中规范且地道地表达了“乡村地区正在为城市污染【付出】代价”。

questions.title: Dog Emotion
questions.passage_html: Can dogs tell when we are happy, sad or angry? As a dog owner, I feel not only that I can tell what kind of state my pets are in, but also that they respond to my emotions. Yet as a hard-headed scientist, I try to take a more and pragmatic view. These observations seem more likely to result from my desire for a good relationship with my dogs.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 confident

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作表语。空格本身看有多个选项可填,但紧接着看后文由 yet 引导的转折句线索——“然而作为一名头脑冷静的科学家,我试图采取一种更客观的视角,这些观察更像是出自我的主观愿望(desire)”。这说明前文作者作为狗主人时,态度是非常笃定、深信不疑的。在选项中,只有 confident(确信的、有信心的)能与后文科学家的理性审视形成完美的态度对比。

2、 emotional

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰 state(状态)。紧接着看前文的首句问题线索“Can dogs tell when we are happy, sad or angry?”(狗能看出我们是高兴、悲伤还是愤怒吗?)以及本句后半部分的“respond to my emotions”,高兴、悲伤、愤怒全部属于情感范畴。由此优先锁定符合上下文主题的 emotional(情感的)。

3、 rational

考点：并列结构

解析：形容词 rational 与后方的形容词 pragmatic(务实的)借由并列连词 and 紧密连接,共同修饰名词 view(观点)。从字面逻辑的并列对仗来看,前文提到了“头脑冷静的科学家(hard-headed scientist)”,科学家的视角必然是极其理智、不带主观感情色彩的。由此锁定 rational(理性的)。

4、 personal

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰 observations(观察)。紧接着看前文的线索——这些观察全部来自于“我作为一个狗主人(As a dog owner)”对自己宠物的观察,并且后文明确指出这来自于“我的愿望(my desire)”,这属于非常典型的主观和个体行为。因此优先锁定 personal(个人的、私人的)。
questions.translation_html:
Can dogs tell when we are happy, sad or angry?

我们的喜怒哀乐狗狗们都知道吗?作为一只狗狗的主人,我很有信心,我不仅知 道我的宠物们处于什么样的情绪状态,而且他们也对我的情绪做出反应。

As a dog owner, I feel confident not only that I can tell what kind of emotional state my pets are in, but also that they respond to my emotions.

然而,作为一个务实的科学家,我试图更加理性和务实看待这个问题。

Yet as a hard-headed scientist, I try to take a more rational and pragmatic view.

这些个人观察似乎更可能是因为我渴望与我的狗狗们保持良好的关系。

These personal observations seem more likely to result from my desire for a good relationship with my dogs.

questions.title: Sandra Lousada
questions.passage_html: London's National Portrait Gallery is currently celebrating the fifty- year of photographer Sandra Lousada. The twenty one portraits on display depict key in literature, film and fashion from the early 1960s. Subsequent to the acquisition of forty portraits by Lousada, the display at The National Portrait Gallery highlights shots taken between 1960 and 1964, many of which feature in Lousada's book Public Faces Private Places (2008). Formal commissioned portraits are shown alongside behind-the-scenes photographs taken on film and unguarded portraits of sitters captured at home.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 career

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词作五十年的定语修饰对象。结合整篇文章关于摄影师举办摄影回顾展的上下文可知,伦敦国家肖像馆正在庆祝摄影师桑德拉·卢萨达五十年的摄影“职业生涯(career)”。

2、 figures

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作 depict 的宾语。纯靠本句关于肖像画表现题材的词义辨析可知,展出的21幅肖像画描绘了20世纪60年代初文学、电影和时尚界的核心“关键人物(figures)”。

3、 sets

考点：固定搭配

解析：film sets 固定搭配,意为“电影拍摄现场/电影布景”。在单句语境中,指代除正式受托拍摄的肖像外,还有在电影拍摄现场捕捉到的幕后照片。
questions.translation_html:
London's National Portrait Gallery is currently celebrating the fifty-year career of photographer Sandra Lousada.

伦敦国家肖像馆目前正在庆祝摄影师桑德拉·卢萨达五十年的职业生涯。

The twenty one portraits on display depict key figures in literature, film and fashion from the early 1960s.

展出的21幅肖像画描绘了20世纪60年代初文学、电影和时尚界的关键人物。

Subsequent to the acquisition of forty portraits by Lousada, the display at The National Portrait Gallery highlights shots taken between 1960 and 1964, many of which feature in Lousada's book Public Faces Private Places (2008).

在国家肖像馆收购了卢萨达的40幅肖像画之后,此次展览重点展出了她在1960年至1964年间拍摄的照片,其中许多都收录在卢萨达2008年的著作《公众面孔,私人场所》中。

Formal commissioned portraits are shown alongside behind-the-scenes photographs taken on film sets and unguarded portraits of sitters captured at home.

正式受托拍摄的肖像与在电影拍摄现场拍摄的幕后照片,以及在坐者家中捕捉到的不经意的肖像一同展出。

questions.title: Human Brain
questions.passage_html: We now know through the work of neuroscientists that the human brain is wired to mimic other people, and this mimicry involves actual involuntary physiological in the observer. Human beings tend to actions that they see. Physiologically, our brains include mirror neurons, which to actions that are seen as if we are doing the action ourselves. It is largely an unconscious and automatic experience. When we hear people speak, observe their vocal , watch their posture, gestures, and facial expressions, etc, neural networks in our brains are stimulated by the 'shared representations' generating feelings within us that the experience of those we are observing.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 experience

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作宾语的核心成分。根据本句关于神经科学镜像机制的词义辨析可知,人类大脑在观察他人时会进行模仿,而这种模仿包含了观察者体内发生的真切的、非自发的生理“体验/物理反应(experience)”。

2、 imitate

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,动词原形紧跟在 tend to 后面作谓语。结合前句中已经给出的核心学术词汇“mimic(模仿)”以及后文“观察他们所看到的行为”这一线索可知,人类具有天然的去“模仿/效仿(imitate)”视觉所见动作的倾向。

3、 react

考点：定语从句

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当由关系代词 which 引导的限制性定语从句的谓语。由于先行词为复数名词 mirror neurons(镜像神经元),根据主谓一致原则及神经元对外部刺激做出电生理反应的特征,填入原形动词“做出反应(react)”。

4、 nuances

考点：单句理解

解析：vocal nuances 表示“声音中的细微变化/细微差别”。句中列举人在观察他人时会注意到的线索,包括声音细节、姿势、手势和面部表情,因此填 nuances。

5、 reflect

考点：定语从句

解析：that reflect the experience... 是定语从句,修饰前面的 feelings。句意是“这些感受反映了我们所观察对象的体验”,因此填 reflect。
questions.translation_html:
We now know through the work of neuroscientists that the human brain is wired to mimic other people, and this mimicry involves actual involuntary physiological experience in the observer.

我们现在通过神经科学家的工作知道,人类的大脑天生就会模仿他人,这种模仿涉及观察者实际的、不由自主的生理体验。

Human beings tend to imitate actions that they see.

人类倾向于模仿他们看到的行为。

Physiologically, our brains include mirror neurons, which react to actions that are seen as if we are doing the action ourselves.

从生理学上讲,我们的大脑包含了镜像神经元,它们对看到的行为做出反应,就像我们自己正在做这个行为一样。

It is largely an unconscious and automatic experience.

这在很大程度上是一种无意识且自动的体验。

When we hear people speak, observe their vocal nuances, watch their posture, gestures, and facial expressions, etc, neural networks in our brains are stimulated by the 'shared representations' generating feelings within us that reflect the experience of those we are observing.

当我们听到人们说话、观察他们声音的细微变化、注视他们的姿势、手势和面部表情等时,我们大脑中的神经网络会受到“共享表征”的刺激,在我们内心产生反映我们所观察到的那些人体验的感受。

questions.title: Drones
questions.passage_html: Antarctic plants can be important indicators of subtle changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Traditional ground-based assessments of vegetation health are, however, not ideal in Antarctica, as they can destroy the vegetation and are physically in the harsh weather conditions. Co-author Professor Sharon Robinson from UOW’s School of Biological Sciences said the study found drone- based monitoring of vegetation health produced similar results to traditional techniques, but with much greater efficiency and with no damage to the vegetation. “Drones are a powerful tool for monitoring fragile Antarctic vegetation,” Professor Robinson said. “They could be used to provide timely warnings about specific environmental stress events, monitoring the longer-term impacts of climate change. “These methods could also be adapted to monitor the health of other small-stature, patchy plant communities, including in alpine or desert regions.” The researchers found that drones with sensors were able to detect vegetation health indicators more accurately than satellite imagery. Mosses are one of the key Antarctic vegetation types that need to be monitored. However, they tend to occur in patches among rocks, ice and soil, it important that the imagery used to assess their health is as accurate and spatially detailed as possible.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 demanding

考点：单句理解

解析：demanding在这里作为形容词,表示“苛求的,费力的”,符合文中的描述,即在南极严酷的天气条件下进行地面评估非常困难和费力。

2、 as well as

考点：并列结构

解析：as well as表示“以及”,连接两个并列的成分,这里用于说明无人机不仅可以及时警告特定的环境压力事件,还可以监测气候变化的⻓期影响。

3、 equipped

考点：非谓语形式

解析：equipped 解释:equipped with sensors表示“装有传感器”,是一个过去分词短语用作定语,修饰drones,说明无人机配备了传感器来更准确地检测植被健康指标。

4、 making

考点：非谓语形式

解析：making 解释:making it important表示“使得......重要”,是一个现在分词作状语的结构, 用于描述由于地衣通常分布在岩石、冰和土壤之间的碎片中,因此用于评估其健康的图像尽可能准确和空间详细是很重要的。
questions.translation_html:
Antarctic plants can be important indicators of subtle changes in environmental conditions, including climate change.

南极植物可以作为环境条件（包括气候变化）细微变化的重要指示物。

Traditional ground-based assessments of vegetation health are, however, not ideal in Antarctica, as they can destroy the vegetation and are physically demanding in the harsh weather conditions.

然而，在南极地区，传统的基于地面的植被健康评估并不理想，因为它们会破坏植被，并且在恶劣的天气条件下对体力要求很高。

Co-author Professor Sharon Robinson from UOW’s School of Biological Sciences said the study found drone-based monitoring of vegetation health produced similar results to traditional techniques, but with much greater efficiency and with no damage to the vegetation.

该研究的合著者、伍伦贡大学生物科学学院的莎伦·罗宾逊教授表示，研究发现基于无人机的植被健康监测产生了与传统技术相似的结果，但效率更高，且不会对植被造成破坏。

“Drones are a powerful tool for monitoring fragile Antarctic vegetation,” Professor Robinson said.

罗宾逊教授说：“无人机是监测脆弱的南极植被的强大工具。”

“They could be used to provide timely warnings about specific environmental stress events, as well as monitoring the longer-term impacts of climate change.

“它们可用于对特定的环境压力事件提供及时预警，以及监测气候变化的长期影响。

These methods could also be adapted to monitor the health of other small-stature, patchy plant communities, including in alpine or desert regions.”

这些方法也可以适用于监测其他矮小、呈斑块状分布的植物群落的健康状况，包括高山或沙漠地区。”

The researchers found that drones equipped with sensors were able to detect vegetation health indicators more accurately than satellite imagery.

研究人员发现，配备传感器的无人机能够比卫星图像更准确地检测植被健康指标。

Mosses are one of the key Antarctic vegetation types that need to be monitored.

苔藓是需要监测的关键南极植被类型之一。

However, they tend to occur in patches among rocks, ice and soil, making it important that the imagery used to assess their health is as accurate and spatially detailed as possible.

然而，它们往往成片地出现在岩石、冰和土壤之间，这使得用于评估其健康状况的图像尽可能准确且具有空间细节变得非常重要。

blanks.explanation: demanding在这里作为形容词,表示“苛求的,费力的”,符合文中的描述,即在南极严酷的天气条件下进行地面评估非常困难和费力。

questions.title: Marshmallow Test
questions.passage_html: Mischel is the creator of the marshmallow test, one of the most famous experiments in the history of psychology, which is often cited as evidence of the importance of self-control. In the original test, which was administered at the Bing Nursery School, at Stanford, in the nineteen-sixties, Mischel's team would present a child with a treat (marshmallows were just one option) and tell her that she could either eat the one treat or wait alone in the room for several minutes until the researcher returned, at which point she could have two treats. The promised treats were always visible and the child knew that all she had to do to stop the agonizing was ring a bell to call the experimenter back-- although in that , she wouldn't get the second treat. The longer a child delayed gratification, Mischel found--that is, the longer she was able to wait-- the better she would fare later in life at numerous measures of what we now call executive function. She would better academically, earn more money, and be healthier and happier. She would also be more likely to avoid a number of negative outcomes, including jail time, obesity, and drug use.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 immediately

考点：并列结构

解析：副词 immediately 与后方的 wait 借由并列连词 or 紧密连接,在句中构成了非此即彼的对立和并列。整个句子的字面逻辑在阐述实验的规则:孩子们要么【立即】吃掉面前的那一份奖励,要么在房间里独自等待。由此锁定符合逻辑对仗的 immediately。

2、 wait

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当动词 stop 的宾语。紧接着看前文第二句中反复出现的核心线索——“等待几分钟(wait alone in the room for several minutes)”以及后文第四句的“延迟满足/等待(delayed gratification / able to wait)”,这说明孩子们正在经历的过程就是等待。因此优先锁定名词 wait,精准表达“结束这一令人痛苦的【等待】”。

3、 case

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 case 与前方的指示代词 that 以及介词 in 构成了极其常用的习惯固定搭配 in that case(在那种情况下)。它在单句中规范地表达了“尽管在【那种情况下】,她将无法得到第二份奖励”。

4、 perform

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 perform 与后方的副词 better 结合,并与后方的学术领域名词 academically 构成了高频固定搭配 perform better academically(在学业上表现得更好 / 取得更好的学业成绩)

questions.title: Dark-silvery Rock
questions.passage_html: People in parts of western Africa and southwestern Asia were the first to realize that the dark-silvery rocks poking out of the earth could be worked into tools and weapons, sometime around 1500 B.C., evidence shows. The metal was probably discovered there accident when some ore was dropped into a fire and cooled into wrought iron, historians think. The eureka moment didn't reach Europe for 500 years, traveling slowly north and west through Greece, Italy, central Europe and finally to the British Isles the spread of the famous Celtic tribes. The Celts diffused iron technology over much of the continent through warfare, where their victory was assured due to the strength of iron weapons. Perhaps not the most peaceful of cultural exchanges, but where the technology did travel, it caught on fast. Iron life a lot easier in those days, when just living to the age of 45 was a feat. By that time, much of Europe had settled into small village life, the soil with bronze and stone tools. Iron farming tools, such as sickles and plough tips, made the process more efficient and allowed farmers tougher soils, try new crops and have more time for other activities.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 by

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。by accident 构成固定搭配,意思是“偶然地、意外地”。在单句语境中,用来描述历史学家们认为这种金属最初是被“顺理成章、不经意地”发现的,因为当时一些矿石被掉进了火里,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

2、 another

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格后为数字 500 years。前文提到该技术大约在公元前 1500 年被发现,此处表达这个伟大的时刻在“另外过了、再过了(another)”500 年后才传到欧洲。another 后面直接接“数字 + 复数名词”属于标准单句语法结构,用以表示数量的递增。

3、 with

考点：固定搭配

解析：该空需要平衡前后两句话的逻辑。前半句提到这项技术历经漫长的岁月最终传播到了不列颠群岛,后半句提到了著名的凯尔特部落的扩张与扩散。技术在欧洲的“传播”与凯尔特人的“扩张”在时间与空间上是相伴相随的,因此使用介词 with(随着)。

4、 made

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处构成了经典的标准句型:make + 名词/代词 + 形容词(make life a lot easier),意为“使生活变得容易得多”。在选项中,只有动词 made 能够直接接宾语 life 再接形容词比较级 easier 作宾语补足语,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

5、 toiling

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,这是一个由现在分词短语充当的伴随状语,用来描述当时欧洲小村庄居民的生存状态。动词 toil 意为“辛勤劳作、艰难地耕作”,toiling the soil with... 意为“用青铜和石头工具在土地上艰苦劳作”,在单句内部通过动宾的语义搭配即可直接确定。

6、 to exploit

考点：固定搭配

解析：allow someone to do something 构成固定搭配,意思是“允许、使得某人做某事”。在单句语境中,主语为铁制农具,宾语为 farmers(农民),后面需要接动词不定式 to exploit 作宾语补足语,意为“使农民能够开发更坚硬的土壤”,这一结构在单句内部即可直接锁定。

People in parts of western Africa and southwestern Asia were the first to realize that the dark-silvery rocks poking out of the earth could be worked into tools and weapons, sometime around 1500 BC, evidence shows.

证据显示,大约在公元前 1500 年,西非和西南亚部分地区的人们最先意识到,露出地面的深银色岩石可以被加工成工具和武器。

The metal was probably discovered there by accident when some ore was dropped into a fire and cooled into wrought iron, historians think.

历史学家认为,这种金属很可能是在那里偶然被发现的:一些矿石掉进火中,冷却后变成了熟铁。

The eureka moment did not reach Europe for another 500 years, traveling slowly north and west through Greece, Italy, central Europe and finally to the British Isles with the spread of the famous Celtic tribes.

这一发现又过了 500 年才传到欧洲,并随着著名凯尔特部落的扩散,经希腊、意大利、中欧,最终缓慢向北向西传到不列颠群岛。

The Celts diffused iron technology over much of the continent through warfare, where their victory was assured due to the strength of iron weapons.

凯尔特人通过战争把铁器技术传播到欧洲大陆大部分地区,而铁制武器的强度确保了他们的胜利。

Perhaps not the most peaceful of cultural exchanges, but where the technology did travel, it caught on fast.

这也许不是最和平的文化交流方式,但这项技术传播到哪里,就在哪里迅速流行起来。

Iron made life a lot easier in those days, when just living to the age of 45 was a feat.

在那个活到 45 岁都算了不起的年代,铁让生活轻松了许多。

By that time, much of Europe had settled into small village life, toiling the soil with bronze and stone tools.

到那时,欧洲大部分地区已经进入小村庄生活,人们用青铜和石制工具辛苦耕作土地。

Iron farming tools, such as sickles and plough tips, made the process more efficient and allowed farmers to exploit tougher soils, try new crops and have more time for other activities.

镰刀和犁头等铁制农具提高了耕作效率,使农民能够开发更坚硬的土壤、尝试新作物,并有更多时间从事其他活动。

questions.title: Contexts
questions.passage_html: Contexts is a quarterly magazine of the American Sociological Association about society and social behavior. Directed to interested in the latest sociological ideas and research, Contexts seeks to apply new knowledge, stimulate fresh thinking, and disseminate important information by the discipline. The publication's articles synthesize key findings, weave diverse strands of work, draw out implications for policy, and debate issues of controversy. The hallmarks of Contexts are accessibility, broad appeal, and timeliness. By design, it is not a technical journal, a magazine for diverse readers, who wish to be current about social science knowledge, emerging trends, and their relevance.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 anyone

考点：单句理解

解析：代词 anyone 在句中作介词 directed to 的宾语。整句的字面逻辑在阐述该杂志的受众定位:“Contexts 是一本面向任何对最新社会学观点和研究感兴趣的人的季度杂志”。在选项中,只有 anyone(任何人)最符合这种无门槛、面向大众的宽泛受众定位。

2、 produced

考点：上下文语境

解析：过去分词 produced 在此充当非谓语形式,作后置定语修饰名词 information。紧接着看前文的逻辑线索——主语是社会学学会的杂志,旨在“应用新知识(apply new knowledge)”和传播重要信息。这些知识和信息显然是由社会学这一学科所“创造、产生”出来的。因此优先锁定 produced(生产、产生)。

3、 together

考点：固定搭配

解析：副词 together 与前方的动词 weave 构成了高频固定搭配 weave together(交织在一起、融合)。它在单句中精准表达“该出版物的文章能够综合核心发现,将不同的研究分支【交织在一起/融合在一起】”。

4、 but

考点：并列结构

解析：连词 but 与前方的否定词 not 跨词组成了极高频的经典并列对仗结构 not..., but...(不是......而是......)。它在单句中完美连接了前后的并列成分,精准表达“根据设计,它不是一本技术性学术期刊,【而是】一本面向多元化读者的杂志”。

5、 those

考点：定语从句

解析：代词 those 在句中充当先行词,其后紧跟着由关系代词 who 引导的定语从句(who wish to be current...)。在英语语法规则中,通常使用 those who 来指代“那些......的人”,用以作前方 readers 的同位语。
questions.translation_html:
Contexts is a quarterly magazine of the American Sociological Association about society and social behavior.

《Contexts》是美国社会学协会出版的一本关于社会与社会行为的季刊。

Directed to anyone interested in the latest sociological ideas and research, Contexts seeks to apply new knowledge, stimulate fresh thinking, and disseminate important information produced by the discipline.

该杂志面向任何对最新社会学观点和研究感兴趣的人，致力于应用新知识、激发新思维，并传播由社会学学科所产生的重要信息。

The publication's articles synthesize key findings, weave together diverse strands of work, draw out implications for policy, and debate issues of controversy.

该刊所发表的文章综合了关键研究发现，融合了不同的研究分支，提炼出对政策的启示，并对争议性问题展开讨论。

The hallmarks of Contexts are accessibility, broad appeal, and timeliness.

《Contexts》的显著特点是通俗易懂、吸引力广泛以及时效性强。

By design, it is not a technical journal, but a magazine for diverse readers, those who wish to be current about social science knowledge, emerging trends, and their relevance.

根据其设计理念，它并非一本技术性学术期刊，而是一本面向多元化读者的杂志，面向那些希望及时了解社会科学知识、新兴趋势及其现实意义的人。

questions.title: Feature Films
questions.passage_html: The universality of story feature films are narratives - they tell stories. Even films based on events will fictionalize them in order to produce drama, to telescope time, to avoid being filled up with too many characters ,or simply to be more entertaining. Even in the current welter of special-effect movies, feature films are usually summarized by their plots - in their first 'treatment' (or outline of the script idea), in the advance publicity, in the TV guide, in reviews, and in conversations. Films may differ from other of narrative - literary fiction or television drama, for instance - in the medium used and the representational conventions. They do, however, with literary fiction and television drama the basic structure and functions of narrative. Much work has been done by researchers in the field known as 'narratology' on exactly what constitutes the structures and functions of the narrative. Their conclusions are of great use to students of the feature film.

1、 true

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰 events。紧接着看后文给出的行为线索——“将它们进行虚构以产生戏剧效果(will fictionalize them in order to produce drama)”。既然需要大费周章地去“虚构化”,说明这些事件原本是真实发生的。因此优先锁定 true(真实的)。

2、 minor

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,此处需要一个形容词修饰 characters(角色)。整句的字面逻辑在解释电影为了戏剧效果而删繁就简的原因:“缩短时间,避免充斥着太多【次要的/无足轻重的】角色”。在选项中,minor(次要的)最符合电影编剧精简登场人物、集中戏剧冲突的客观规律。

3、 kinds

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 kinds 与前方的形容词 other 以及后方的介词短语 of narrative 构成了固定搭配 other kinds of narrative(其他种类的叙事)。它在单句中精准表达“电影可能在所使用的媒介和表现常规上,与其他【种类】的叙事(例如文学虚构作品或电视剧)有所不同”。

4、 share

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 share 与后方的名词短语 the basic structure and functions 结合,并与后方的介词 with 跨词构成了高频固定搭配 share something with somebody/something(与......分享/共有某物)。它在单句中精准地表达了“然而,电影与文学虚构作品及电视剧【共有】叙事的基本结构和功能”。

即使是基于真实事件的故事片也会对其进行虚构,以产生戏剧性、浓缩时间、避 免被太多次要⻆色填满,或者只是为了更好地娱乐观众。

Even in the current welter of special-effect movies, feature films are usually summarized by their plots - in their first 'treatment' (or outline of the script idea), in the advance publicity, in the TV guide, in reviews, and in conversations.

即使在当下充斥着特效电影的情况下,故事片也通常被其情节所总结——第一次 “处理(” 或者剧本理念的概述)、在提前宣传中、在电视指南中、在评论中以及在 对话中都是这样。

电影可能因其所使用的媒介和表现惯例而不同于其他类型的叙事,比如文学小说 或电视戏剧。

不过,它们确实与文学小说和电视戏剧共享叙事的基本结构和功能。

Much work has been done by researchers in the field known as 'narratology' on exactly what constitutes the structures and functions of the narrative.

所谓“叙事学”领域的研究人员对叙事的结构和功能进行了大量研究。

Their conclusions are of great use to students of the feature film.

他们的结论对故事片研究学生大有裨益。

questions.title: Families
questions.passage_html: Families provide emotional, physical and financial care and support to their members and are often the basis on which government assistance is determined and administered. Australians have experienced three main living arrangements over a lifecycle: living with parents, living with a partner (for some of this period with children) and living alone in old age if that partner died. Now and into the future, living arrangements a lifecycle may also include living alone or in a group household before perhaps forming a long-term partnership, or living as a parent or alone after divorce or separation. These changes in living arrangements and family are the outcome of various demographic and social trends, such as declining fertility, increased rates of divorce and longer life .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 traditionally

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,副词充当状语修饰动词 experienced。结合后文给出的 Now and into the future(现在及未来)这一明显的时代对比线索,前半句必然是在交代过去的历史常态。因此优先锁定符合上下文语境的 traditionally(传统上)。

2、 throughout

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词 throughout 与后方的名词短语 a lifecycle 构成了不可分割的、表示时间范围的高频固定搭配 throughout a lifecycle(贯穿整个生命周期 / 在人生的整个过程中)。

3、 lone

考点：固定搭配

解析：形容词 lone 与后方的名词 parent 构成了社会学及人口学领域的行业专属固定搭配 lone parent(单亲家长)。其他选项在单句语法或语义上均无法形成此类地道搭配。

4、 characteristics

考点：并列结构

解析：名词 characteristics 与前方的名词 living arrangements(居住安排)借由并列连词 and 紧密连接。从单句字面逻辑的并列对仗来看,前文在探讨居住安排的变化,此处自然顺承到“家庭【特征(characteristics)】”的变化。

5、 expectancy

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 expectancy 与前方的形容词 life 构成了极其高频的专有名词固定搭配 life expectancy(预期寿命),用来精准表达人口学中寿命延长的客观现象。
questions.translation_html:

Australians have traditionally experienced three main living arrangements over a lifecycle: living with parents, living with a partner (for some of this period with children) and living alone in old age if that partner died.

澳大利亚人传统上在生命周期中经历了三种主要的居住安排:与父母住在一起, 与伴侣住在一起(有时是带着孩子),如果伴侣去世了,在年老时独自生活。

Now and into the future, living arrangements throughout a lifecycle may also include living alone or in a group household before perhaps forming a long-term partnership, or living as a lone parent or alone after divorce or separation.

These changes in living arrangements and family characteristics are the outcome of various demographic and social trends, such as declining fertility, increased rates of divorce and longer life expectancy .
