questions.title: Teaching of Languages
questions.passage_html: The teaching of languages could be revolutionised following ground-breaking research by Victoria University, New Zealand, PhD graduate Paul Sulzberger. Dr Sulzberger has found that the best way to learn a language is through frequent exposure to its sound patterns--even if you haven't a what it all means. "However crazy it might sound, just listening to the language, you don't understand it, is critical. A lot of language teachers may not accept that," he says. "Our ability to learn new words is directly related to how often we have been exposed to the particular combinations of the sounds which make the words. If you want to learn Spanish, for example, frequently listening to a Spanish language radio station on the internet will dramatically your ability to pick up the language and learn new words." Dr Sulzberger's research challenges existing language learning theory. His main hypothesis is that simply listening to a new language sets up the structures in the brain to learn the words.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 clue

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 clue 与前方的否定形式 haven't a 构成了极其地道的高频习惯固定搭配 haven't a clue(毫无头绪 / 一窍不通 / 根本不知道)。它在单句中精准表达“学习一门语言最好的方法就是频繁接触它的声音模式——即使你【根本不知道】它到底是什么意思”。

2、 even though

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：连词短语 even though(即使 / 尽管)在此处引导一个让步状语从句。它在单句中完美连接了前后的让步逻辑关系,精准表达“不管这听起来有多疯狂,仅仅听这门语言,【尽管】你听不懂它,也是至关重要的”。其他选项中,in spite of 和 despite 属于介词短语,后方不能直接跟完整的句子。

3、 up

考点：固定搭配

解析：副词 up 与前方的动词 make 构成了极高频的经典固定搭配 make up(构成 / 组成)。它与后方的宾语 the words 结合,在单句中精准表达“我们学习新单词的能力,直接取决于我们接触【构成】这些单词的特定声音组合的频率”。

4、 boost

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词 boost 充当谓语。整句的字面逻辑在阐述一种高效率的实际学习效果:如果你想学西班牙语,频繁在互联网上收听西班牙语广播电台,将会极大地“【促进 / 提高(boost)】”你掌握这门语言和学习新单词的能力。其他选项(如评估、夸大、描写)在字面逻辑上均不符合。

5、 required

考点：非谓语形式

解析：句中 structures in the brain ______ to learn the words,动词 require 与 structures 之间为被动关系(大脑中“被需要”的结构),故用过去分词 required 作后置定语。requiring(现在分词,主动关系)语态错误;directed(被指示/被指导)语义不符;to require(不定式,表将来或目的)不符合此处被动修饰关系。
questions.translation_html:
The teaching of languages could be revolutionised following ground-breaking research by Victoria University, New Zealand, PhD graduate Paul Sulzberger.

新西兰惠灵顿维多利亚大学的博士毕业生保罗·萨尔茨伯格进行了一项开创性研究，这项研究可能会彻底改变语言教学方式。

Dr Sulzberger has found that the best way to learn a language is through frequent exposure to its sound patterns—even if you haven't a clue what it all means.

萨尔茨伯格博士发现，学习一门语言的最佳方法是频繁接触其声音模式——即使你对其含义完全一无所知。

"However crazy it might sound, just listening to the language, even though you don't understand it, is critical. A lot of language teachers may not accept that," he says.

他说：“不管这听起来有多疯狂，仅仅是听这门语言，即使你听不懂，也是至关重要的。很多语言教师可能不会接受这一点。”

"Our ability to learn new words is directly related to how often we have been exposed to the particular combinations of the sounds which make up the words.

“我们学习新单词的能力，直接取决于我们接触构成这些单词的特定声音组合的频率。”

If you want to learn Spanish, for example, frequently listening to a Spanish language radio station on the internet will dramatically boost your ability to pick up the language and learn new words."

“例如，如果你想学西班牙语，频繁在互联网上收听西班牙语广播电台，将会极大地提高你掌握这门语言和学习新单词的能力。”

Dr Sulzberger's research challenges existing language learning theory.

萨尔茨伯格博士的研究对现有的语言学习理论提出了挑战。

His main hypothesis is that simply listening to a new language sets up the structures in the brain required to learn the words.

他的主要假设是，仅仅通过听一门新语言，就能在大脑中建立起学习单词所需的结构。

questions.title: Ancient Superhighway
questions.passage_html: Even after thousands of years exploring Earth, we're still uncovering new things like an ancient 'superhighway' in the Guatemalan rain forest. Hidden beneath a thick layer of vegetation, the of roads stretches over 150 miles and was most likely built by the Mayan empire some 2,000 years ago. The newly mapped roads are connected to the ruins of El Mirador (sometimes called the Kan Kingdom) in northern Guatemala. Archaeologists believe El Mirador around the 6th century BCE, and was at its most powerful around the early first century CE. At that time, it had a population of as many as a quarter of a million, a quarter the size of Rome itself at the time. It also has some of the largest pyramids in the world. It was the of the Mayan civilization, and naturally needed some major roadways. The roads of El Mirador have been known about since 1967, but scientists had no idea how extensive they were until now. The thick jungle obscured the remnants of the road, it difficult to see from the air.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 network

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 network 与后方的介词短语 of roads 构成了高频固定搭配 a network of roads(公路网 / 道路网络)。它在单句中精准表达“隐藏在厚厚的植被层之下,这一道路网络延伸了150多英里”。

2、 was founded

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 found(建立、奠基)在此处充当谓语。由于主语 El Mirador(埃尔米拉多,古代玛雅城邦遗址)与动词“建立”之间是被动关系(即城邦是在公元前6世纪【被建立】的),且交代的是遥远的过去历史,根据时态语态规则,强制锁定一般过去时的被动语态形式 was founded。

3、 heart

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 heart 与后方的介词短语 of the Mayan civilization 构成了高频地道固定搭配 the heart of...(......的心脏 / ......的中心 / ......的核心地带)。它在单句中精准表达“它是玛雅文明的核心中心,自然需要一些主要的躯干道路”。

4、 making

考点：非谓语形式

解析：现在分词 making 在此充当非谓语形式,在句中作伴随状语,承接前方的整个句子,表示顺理成章带来的自然结果。前文提到“茂密的丛林掩盖了道路的遗迹”,这一客观事实自然而然地“【使得(making)】从空中很难看清它们”。
questions.translation_html:
Even after thousands of years exploring Earth, we're still uncovering new things like an ancient 'superhighway' in the Guatemalan rain forest.

即使在对地球进行了数千年的探索之后，我们仍然在不断发现新事物，比如危地马拉雨林中一条古老的“超级公路”。

Hidden beneath a thick layer of vegetation, the network of roads stretches over 150 miles and was most likely built by the Mayan empire some 2,000 years ago.

这条道路网络隐藏在厚厚的植被层之下，延伸超过150英里，极有可能是大约2000年前由玛雅帝国修建的。

The newly mapped roads are connected to the ruins of El Mirador (sometimes called the Kan Kingdom) in northern Guatemala.

这些新被绘制成地图的道路与危地马拉北部的埃尔米拉多遗址（有时被称为坎王国）相连。

Archaeologists believe El Mirador was founded around the 6th century BCE, and was at its most powerful around the early first century CE.

考古学家认为，埃尔米拉多大约在公元前6世纪建立，并在公元1世纪早期左右达到其鼎盛时期。

At that time, it had a population of as many as a quarter of a million, a quarter the size of Rome itself at the time.

当时，它拥有多达25万人口，是当时罗马城人口的四分之一。

It also has some of the largest pyramids in the world.

它还拥有一些世界上最大的金字塔。

It was the heart of the Mayan civilization, and naturally needed some major roadways.

它是玛雅文明的核心中心，自然需要一些主要的大道。

The roads of El Mirador have been known about since 1967, but scientists had no idea how extensive they were until now.

自1967年以来，人们就已经知道了埃尔米拉多的这些道路，但直到现在，科学家们才了解到它们的规模有多么庞大。

The thick jungle obscured the remnants of the road, making it difficult to see from the air.

茂密的丛林掩盖了道路的遗迹，使得从空中很难看清它们。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 名词 network 与后方的介词短语 of roads 构成了高频固定搭配 a network of roads(公路网 / 道路网络)。它在单句中精准表达“隐藏在厚厚的植被层之下,这一道路网络延伸了150多英里”。

blanks.label: 时态语态
blanks.explanation: 动词 found(建立、奠基)在此处充当谓语。由于主语 El Mirador(埃尔米拉多,古代玛雅城邦遗址)与动词“建立”之间是被动关系(即城邦是在公元前6世纪【被建立】的),且交代的是遥远的过去历史,根据时态语态规则,强制锁定一般过去时的被动语态形式 was founded。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 名词 heart 与后方的介词短语 of the Mayan civilization 构成了高频地道固定搭配 the heart of...(......的心脏 / ......的中心 / ......的核心地带)。它在单句中精准表达“它是玛雅文明的核心中心,自然需要一些主要的躯干道路”。

blanks.label: 非谓语形式
blanks.explanation: 现在分词 making 在此充当非谓语形式,在句中作伴随状语,承接前方的整个句子,表示顺理成章带来的自然结果。前文提到“茂密的丛林掩盖了道路的遗迹”,这一客观事实自然而然地“【使得(making)】从空中很难看清它们”。

questions.title: Stressors
questions.passage_html: Research has suggested that major stressors in our lives are life , for example, moving house, marriage or relationship breakdown. Work-related factors, unemployment and boredom, are also common of stress. Differences in personality may also a part.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 changes

考点：固定搭配

解析：life changes 固定搭配,意为“生活剧变/生活层面的重大改变”。在单句语境中,用以作为大类词来统领后文搬家、结婚等具体生活变动。

2、 including

考点：非谓语形式

解析：在单句语境中,现在分词形式(including)充当介词性后置定语,用来引出前文复数名词短语 Work-related factors(与工作相关的因素)的具体涵盖项目(如失业和职场枯燥)。

3、 causes

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作从句的表语。纯靠单句关于压力来源分析的词义辨析可知,失业、职场枯燥等工作相关因素,也是在现代都市生活中导致心理压力的常见“原因/诱因(causes)”。

4、 play

考点：固定搭配

解析：play a part意为“在......中起作用/扮演某种角色”。在单句语境中,指代个人性格上的个体差异同样在压力形成机制中发挥着作用。

Research has suggested that major stressors in our lives are life changes, for example, moving house, marriage or relationship breakdown.

研究表明,我们生活中的主要压力源是生活的改变,例如搬家、结婚或恋爱关系破裂。

Work-related factors, including unemployment and boredom, are also common causes of stress.

与工作相关的因素,包括失业和枯燥,也是压力的常见原因。

Differences in personality may also play a part.

性格的差异也可能起一定作用。

questions.title: English Language
questions.passage_html: With about one and a half billion non-native speakers, English has become the world's own language. Such has its downside, of course. There are now about 6,800 languages left in the world, compared with perhaps that number back at the dawn of agriculture. Thanks in to the rise of über-languages, most importantly English, the remaining languages are now dying at the of about one a fortnight. Want to learn Busuu, anyone? Then you'd better head to Cameroon fast, before one of the language's last eight speakers kicks the bucket (as the Busuu-nese presumably doesn't say).
questions.analysis_html:
1、 dominance

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句,四个名词在语法上都可以修饰它的 downside(负面影响)。但必须结合前文的跨句线索——第一句提到“英语拥有大约15亿的非母语使用者,已经成为了世界自己的语言”。一个语言拥有如此庞大的使用者基数,这属于它在世界范围内的“统治地位、主导地位”。因此选择 dominance 最符合前文语境(supremacy 侧重至高无上的权力,authority 侧重权威,control 侧重具体控制,均不如主导地位准确)。

2、 twice

考点：固定搭配

解析：twice that number 构成固定搭配,意为“那个数字的两倍”。在单句语境中,后文的 that number 指代前半句的 6,800,整句话用于对比现在和农业文明初期语言数量的变化,意为“相比于农业文明初期大约是这个数字‘两倍’的语言数量”。其他选项中,multiple(倍数/许多)、twofold(两倍的/双重的,常作形容词或副词)、as much(同样多)均无法与后面的 ┪that number┫ 直接构成正确的数量修饰结构。

3、 part

考点：固定搭配

解析：thanks in part to 构成固定搭配,意思是“部分由于、部分归功于”。在单句语境中,用来解释导致其他语言消亡的原因。整句话意为“‘部分由于’超级语言(尤其是英语)的兴起,现存的语言正以每两周一种的速度消亡”,在单句内部即可直接锁定名词 part。

4、 rate

考点：固定搭配

解析：at the rate of 构成固定搭配,意思是“以......的速度/比率”。在单句语境中,后面接了具体的时间和频率概念 one a fortnight(每两周一种),在英语中描述某种趋势、数字、比率的消亡速度时,习惯与介词 at 搭配使用 at the rate of,在单句内部即可直接锁定。
questions.translation_html:
With about one and a half billion non-native speakers, English has become the world's own language.

英语拥有大约15亿的非母语使用者,已经成为了世界自己的语言。

Such dominance has its downside, of course.

当然,这种主导地位也有其负面影响。

There are now about 6,800 languages left in the world, compared with perhaps twice that number back at the dawn of agriculture.

现在世界上大约还剩下6,800种语言,而在农业文明初期,这个数字可能大约是现在的两倍。

Thanks in part to the rise of über-languages, most importantly English, the remaining languages are now dying at the rate of about one a fortnight.

部分由于超级语言(最主要的是英语)的兴起,现存的语言目前正以大约每两周一种的速度消亡。

Want to learn Busuu, anyone? Then you'd better head to Cameroon fast, before one of the language's last eight speakers kicks the bucket (as the Busuu-nese presumably doesn't say).

有人想学布苏语(Busuu)吗?

那你最好快点前往喀麦隆,在这门语言最后八位使用者之一“翘辫子”之前(当然,布苏人大概不会用这个俗语来表达)。

questions.title: Research Ship
questions.passage_html: The modern research ship takes its origins from the early exploration voyages such as HMS Endeavour and HMS Challenger, both of which were converted vessels, fitted with a range of research facilities to sample and measure across a range of disciplines in extreme environments. Early research vessels were fairly basic and simplistic compared to the state-of-the-art ships we see being developed today. Gradually, the trend of converting other vessels into research ships by the challenging demands of investigating increasingly complex areas of oceanographic research, such as physical, biological and chemical oceanography; marine geology and geophysics; ocean engineering and atmospheric science in one expedition. In order to carry multi-disciplinary research in extreme environments, specially designed research vessels became a requirement. Research ships are the primary source of oceanographic observations and so for the foreseeable future. As time , science is likely to be conducted in increasingly remote and environmentally challenging areas, including the polar seas, so the ability to operate with minimal interruptions from the natural elements remains unchanged from the days of the Challenger Expedition.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 was challenged

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 challenge 在此充当谓语。首先,本句的主语是单数名词短语 the trend of converting other vessels(将其他船只改装的趋势),排除了复数谓语 were challenged。其次,整段文字都在回顾科学考察船的发展历史,基调为过去时。最后,趋势与动词“挑战”之间是被动关系(这一趋势【受到了】海洋学研究日益复杂的迫切需求的挑战),因此锁定过去时的被动语态形式 was challenged。

2、 out

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 carry 与后方的副词 out 构成了极高频的经典固定搭配 carry out(执行 / 开展 / 实施)。它在单句中精准表达“为了在极端环境中【开展】多学科研究,专门设计的科考船变成了一种必然要求”。

3、 will remain

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,动词短语充当并列谓语。紧接着看后文给出的时间线索——“在可预见的未来(for the foreseeable future)”。这一明确指向未来的时间状语,要求前面的动词必须使用一般将来时。因此优先锁定 will remain(将仍然是)。

4、 goes on

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 goes 与后方的介词 on 构成了非常地道的习惯固定搭配 as time goes on(随着时间的推移)。它在单句中规范地交代了时间背景,精准表达“【随着时间的推移】,科学研究很可能会在日益遥远且对环境极具挑战性的地区进行”。

The modern research ship takes its origins from the early exploration voyages such as HMS Endeavour and HMS Challenger, both of which were converted vessels, fitted with a range of research facilities to sample and measure across a range of disciplines in extreme environments.

现代研究船起源于早期的探险航行,如HMS Endeavour和HMS Challenger,这两艘船都是经过改造的船只,装备了一系列研究设施,在极端环境下进行跨学科的采样和测量。

Early research vessels were fairly basic and simplistic compared to the state-of-the-art ships we see being developed today.

相比于今天正在开发的最先进船只,早期的研究船只是非常基本和简单的。

Gradually, the trend of converting other vessels into research ships was challenged by the challenging demands of investigating increasingly complex areas of oceanographic research, such as physical, biological and chemical oceanography; marine geology and geophysics; ocean engineering and atmospheric science in one expedition.

逐渐地,将其他船只改装成研究船的趋势受到了挑战,挑战的需求是调查海洋学研究日益复杂的领域,例如物理、生物和化学海洋学;海洋地质学和地球物理 学;海洋工程和大气科学一次探险。

In order to carry out multi-disciplinary research in extreme environments, specially designed research vessels became a requirement.

为了在极端环境下进行跨学科研究,专⻔设计的研究船成为必需。

Research ships are the primary source of oceanographic observations and will remain so for the foreseeable future.

研究船是海洋观测的主要来源,在未来可预⻅的将来也会如此。

As time goes on , science is likely to be conducted in increasingly remote and environmentally challenging areas, including the polar seas, so the ability to operate with minimal interruptions from the natural elements remains unchanged from the days of the Challenger Expedition.

随着时间的推移,科学很可能在越来越偏远和环境具有挑战性的地区进行,包括极海,因此从挑战者号探险的时代起,在自然环境因素极小中断情况下开展工作的能力就保持不变。

questions.title: Learning by Doing
questions.passage_html: An analysis of more than 500 graduates found no significant difference between business schools that offered traditional courses and those that emphasise a 'learning-by-doing' approach to entrepreneurship education. The research challenges the ongoing trend across higher education institutes (HEIs) of on experiential learning, and suggests that universities need to reconsider their approach if they increase entrepreneurship among their students. Ms Inna Kozlinska, research associate at Aston Business School and author of the study, said: 'Entrepreneurship education as a major force capable of generating long-term socio-economic changes through developing entrepreneurial, creative, flexible and wise individuals. There is an ongoing shift towards experiential learning in business schools, there is little empirical evidence to suggest this approach has better impact than traditional learning.'
questions.analysis_html:
1、 focusing

考点：固定搭配

解析：focus on 固定搭配,意为“聚焦于......、专注于......”。在此处以动名词形式(focusing on)作介词 of 的宾语,形容高等教育界目前大力推行体验式学习的趋势。

2、 are to

考点：固定搭配

解析：be to do sth在 if 引导的条件状语从句中意为“如果想要实现某种长远目标/如果打算做某事”。此处表示如果大学“想要(are to)”切实提高学生的创业率,就得重新审视教学方法。

3、 is seen

考点：时态语态

解析：在单句语境中,动词的一般现在时态被动语态充当句子的谓语。根据主谓语义逻辑可知,创业教育在当今的社会共识中,通常“被视为(is seen)”是一股能够带来长期社会经济变革的核心推动力。

4、 yet

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,连词引导一个并列分句。前文提到商业院校目前正大刀阔斧地推行向体验式学习的范式转移,后文却泼冷水指出实际上几乎没有实证经验能证明这种新方法比传统教学更有效,前后构成强烈的转折对比,故选用 yet。
questions.translation_html:
An analysis of more than 500 graduates found no significant difference between business schools that offered traditional courses and those that emphasise a 'learning-by-doing' approach to entrepreneurship education.

对500多名毕业生的分析发现,开设传统课程的商学院与强调“从做中学”创业教育方法的商学院之间没有显著差异。

The research challenges the ongoing trend across higher education institutes (HEIs) of focusing on experiential learning, and suggests that universities need to reconsider their approach if they are to increase entrepreneurship among their students.

该研究挑战了目前高等教育机构(HEIs)专注于体验式学习的趋势,并表明如果大学想要提高学生的创业精神,就需要重新考虑他们的方法。

Ms Inna Kozlinska, research associate at Aston Business School and author of the study, said: 'Entrepreneurship education is seen as a major force capable of generating long-term socio-economic changes through developing entrepreneurial, creative, flexible and wise individuals.

阿斯顿商学院研究助理兼该研究的作者因娜·科兹林斯卡女士说:“创业教育被视为一种主要力量,能够通过培养具有创业精神、创造力、灵活性和智慧的个人来带来长期的社会经济变革。”

There is an ongoing shift towards experiential learning in business schools, yet there is little empirical evidence to suggest this approach has better impact than traditional learning.'

“商学院正在向体验式学习转变,然而几乎没有实证证据表明这种方法比传统学习具有更好的效果。”

questions.title: Desert Ants
questions.passage_html: There comes a time in a desert ant's life when a piece of food is too large to ignore, but too heavy to lift, and the only way to get it home is to adopt a new style of walking. The long-legged and speedy Cataglyphis fortis normally covers ground with a three-legged stride that moves two legs forwards on one side, and one on the other. For the next step, the insect mirrors the move with other three legs. But recordings of ants in the Tunisian desert reveal that when faced with oversized lumps of food 10 times their own weight, the forward 'tripod' walking style is . Unable to lift the morsels in their mandibles, the ants drag the food backwards instead, moving all six legs independently. 'This is the first time we this in any ants,' said lead author Sarah Pfeffer at the University of Ulm in Germany. The ants' long legs already help keep their bodies away from the desert floor and enable them to speed around at up to 60 cm per second. The researchers, who publish the findings on ant locomotion and navigation in the Journal of Experimental Biology, believe that robotics will be one of the first technologies from the discovery.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 its

考点：单句理解

解析：代词 its 在句中作定语修饰名词 legs。整句的字面逻辑在描述蚂雅交替迈步的生物学过程:在走前一步时,它用一侧的两条腿和另一侧的一条腿组合成三足步态(a three-legged stride)向前迈进;而到了下一步,这只昆虫(the insect)则用【它的】另外三条腿做出镜像交替动作。由于主语 the insect 是单数,对应的物主代词锁定单数形式 its。

2、 abandoned

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 abandon(放弃)在此处充当谓语。首先,本句的主语是单数名词短语 the forward 'tripod' walking style(向前的“三足”行走方式),结合前方的系动词 is,构成被动语态的结构。由于行走方式与动词“放弃”之间是被动关系(即当面对超重食物时,这种向前的三足步态【被放弃了】),根据时态语态规则,强制锁定过去分词形式 abandoned。

3、 have seen

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 see 在此充当宾语从句的谓语。前文有经典的最高级时间标志词 This is the first time(这是第一次......),根据英语语法及语态时态规则,当出现“This is the first/second time that...”结构时,从句中的谓语动词必须强制使用现在完成时。因此锁定 have seen。

4、 scorching

考点：固定搭配

解析：形容词 scorching 与后方的名词短语 desert floor 构成了非常地道且形象的词汇级固定搭配 scorching desert floor(灼热的沙漠地面 / 滚烫的沙漠表面)。其他选项(如情感的、卡住的、未审查的)在字面逻辑和地理常识上均完全不符。

5、 to benefit

考点：非谓语形式

解析：动词不定式 to benefit 在此充当非谓语形式,作后置定语修饰前方的受保护名词 one of the first technologies。在英语语法规则中,当被修饰的名词前面有 the first, the last, the only 等序数词或最高级限定时,后方必须强制使用动词不定式形式(to do)来作后置定语。因此锁定 to benefit。

questions.title: Kennedy
questions.passage_html: John F. Kennedy had a high academic degree and was handsome, with a Hollywood-style appearance. He was the most popular politician partly because of his heroism in the war. He was awarded a medal in the war to his personal , and these qualities― along with his charisma―made him admired by the public. Because of these three characteristics, he became in people’s eyes. He was also blessed handsome looks, a political style, and a beautiful wife. All of this helped him prepare in advance for his reelection campaign.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 prove

考点：单句理解

解析：句中说他在战争中被授予一枚勋章,以______他个人的勇气。prove 意为“证明”,勋章是用来证明其勇气的。show(展示)语义较浅;evidence(作动词时意为“证明”,但用法较正式且常为 evidence sth.,不如 prove 常见);upthrow(向上抛/升起)完全不符合。

2、 courage

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当动词 show 的宾语。紧接着看前文给出的环境线索——“他在战争中的英雄主义(his heroism in the war)”。既然是在残酷的战争中表现出了英雄主义并荣获勋章,这无庸置疑是为了展示他个人的“【勇气(courage)】”。因此优先锁定 courage。

3、 iconic

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,形容词 iconic 充当系动词 became 的表语。整句的字面逻辑在阐述这三种特质给民众心理带来的终极影响:正因为这三种特征,他在人们的心目中变得“【极具偶像色彩的 / 符号化的(iconic)】”。其他选项(如讽刺的、完全相同的、无能的)在字面逻辑上完全背道而驰。

4、 with

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词 with 与前方的被动语态形容词短语 was blessed 跨词构成了极其规范的高频固定搭配 be blessed with something(幸运地拥有某物 / 享有某物 / 赋予某物)。它在单句中精准表达“他同时也幸运地【拥有】英俊的外表......”。

5、 mending

考点：并列结构

解析：解:有英俊的外表、______的政治风格和美丽的妻子。mending 意为“修补的/改进的”,结合上下文描述他受人爱戴、连任竞选准备充分,mending political style 可理解为“不断改进/调整的政治风格”,与前文的英雄主义、魅力、英俊外表并列,共同构成他的优势。mends(动词第三人称单数)不能作定语;mended(修补过的)暗示之前有损坏;mend(原形)不能作形容词。

He was also blessed with handsome looks, a mending political style, and a beautiful wife.

所有这些都帮助他为连任竞选提前做好了准备。

All of this helped him prepare in advance for his reelection campaign.

questions.title: Internet Use
questions.passage_html: People are spending twice as much time online compared to 10 years ago, fueled by increasing use of tablets and smartphones. The biggest increase has been young adults, with time spent online almost tripling from 10 hours and 24 minutes each week in 2005 to 27 hours and 36 minutes in 2014. In total, the average adult spends more than 20 hours online a week, which includes time spent on the internet at work. the average person spends 2.5 hours every week 'online while on the move' - away from their home, work or place of study. This is a five-fold from 2005, when the figure was just 30 minutes. Overall, the proportion of adults using the internet has risen by half - from six in ten in 2005 to almost nine in ten today, to Ofcom's Media Use and Attitudes 2015 report, which questioned 1,890 adults aged 16 and over about their internet consumption habits.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 among

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词 among 与前方的复数名词 young adults(年轻人)搭配,表示在某一特定群体内部。整句的字面逻辑在描述增长速度最快的群体:“增幅最大的是在【年轻人中】”。among 在此精准表达了群体范围的分布。

2、 Meanwhile

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：副词 meanwhile(同时 / 在此期间)在此处起到逻辑过渡的作用。前文在总结总体的在线时间增长,此处引出另一个细分场景(移动端在线时间),表达在总体增长的背景下,“【同时】,普通人每周花两个半小时‘在移动中在线’”。其他选项在逻辑连接上均不符合文意。

3、 increase

考点：上下文语境

解析：名词 increase 与前方的 a five-fold(五倍的)构成量化搭配。根据上下文的时间线索,从2005年的30分钟增长到现在的2.5小时,这显然是一个数量上的增长。因此优先锁定 increase(增长)。

4、 according

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词短语 according to(根据 / 按照)在此处引导信息来源。它是一个非常标准的固定搭配,用来衔接后方的 Ofcom 报告。

questions.passage_html: Studies show that children who learn music often achieve higher average IQ scores. , while Mozart is often associated with claims of higher intelligence, there is a lack of scientific evidence from proper to fully support this. The key in such research involved six-year-old children who learned music lessons and displayed an IQ gain of 3.2 points, and some even an increase of 7.1 points. Scientists also note that people who prefer heavy food often think it is more satisfying than food, and people sometimes have the that light drinks such as wine are healthier. This psychological of perception influences lifestyle choices just as much as measured IQ does.
questions.analysis_html:
1、However

考点:逻辑衔接

解析: 空格位于句首,用以连接前后两句。前句提到"学习音乐的孩子通常能获得更高的平均IQ分数(积极支持)",后句转而指出"尽管莫扎特常与高智商联系在一起,但缺乏来自规范测试的科学证据(消极质疑)"。前后语义构成了明显的转折关系,因此选用 However(然而) 满足前后的逻辑衔接。

2、tests

考点:固定搭配

3、process

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作句子的主语:"The key ______ in such research involved six-year-old children..."。后文详细描述了这项研究的具体实施:让六岁儿童上音乐课并记录他们的IQ得分变化。在单句内部语义中,这属于这项研究的"核心过程 / 核心流程",因此选用名词 process(过程)。

4、exhibited

考点:并列结构

解析: 空格位于由连词 and 连接的并列结构中。前方是 "displayed an IQ gain...",根据并列结构的对称原则,and 后方也必须填入一个动词的过去式,与 displayed(展现出)构成同义并列。exhibited(表现出/展现出) 填入其中,完美满足了动作与时态的并列对称。

5、lighter

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格修饰名词 food。核心线索是前文的 "heavy food(高热量/重口味的食物)" 以及连词 "than(比......)"。在饮食习惯的直接对比中,"重口/油腻食物(heavy food)"最经典的反义对照概念就是"清淡的食物"。因此,选用比较级形容词 lighter(更清淡的),完成了语境上的反义呼应。

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "have the ______ that..." 结构中。结合后文"轻度饮料如葡萄酒更健康",这其实是一种人们普遍存在但缺乏严谨科学依据的观念。在英语中,表达"抱有某种错觉 / 产生某种幻觉",习惯使用的是固定搭配 "have the illusion that..."。

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "This psychological ______ of perception" 结构中。在心理学和认知科学中,表达人类在感知觉上所表现出的"心理特征",习惯使用的是固定名词短语搭配 "psychological feature"。
questions.translation_html:
Studies show that children who learn music often achieve higher average IQ scores.

研究表明，学习音乐的儿童通常平均智商得分更高。

However, while Mozart is often associated with claims of higher intelligence, there is a lack of scientific evidence from proper tests to fully support this.

然而，尽管莫扎特常常与提高智力的说法联系在一起，但缺乏来自正规测试的科学证据来充分支持这一点。

The key process in such research involved six-year-old children who learned music lessons and displayed an IQ gain of 3.2 points, and some even exhibited an increase of 7.1 points.

这类研究的关键过程涉及学习音乐课程的六岁儿童，他们的智商提高了3.2分，有些甚至提高了7.1分。

Scientists also note that people who prefer heavy food often think it is more satisfying than lighter food, and people sometimes have the illusion that light drinks such as wine are healthier.

科学家还指出，偏爱厚重食物的人往往认为它比清淡食物更令人满足，而人们有时也会产生一种错觉，认为葡萄酒等较轻饮品更健康。

This psychological feature of perception influences lifestyle choices just as much as measured IQ does.

这种感知上的心理特征对生活方式选择的影响，并不亚于测得的智商。

questions.title: Green Spaces
questions.passage_html: Green spaces contribute significantly to a in soil and aerial temperatures during spells of hot weather, so contributing to human wellbeing. In the garden , there is, however, little information as to what extent various types of plants in their cooling potential and how certain planting combinations may maximize cooling under a scenario of rainfall and minimal water inputs.
questions.analysis_html:
1、reduction

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "contribute significantly to a ______ in soil and aerial temperatures" 结构中。根据常识,绿地在炎热天气下的作用是降低温度。在英语中,表达"导致......的降低/减少",习惯使用的是由名词引出的固定搭配 "a reduction in..."。

2、context

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "In the garden ______" 结构中。前文讨论了宏观的绿地,本句将范围缩小到了"园艺/花园"这一具体领域。在正式行文中,表达"在......的背景下 / 在......的语境下",习惯使用的是固定介词短语搭配 "in the context of..."。

3、differ

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格在由 what extent 引导的宾语从句中作谓语动词,且后接介词 in。后文提到研究的目的是为了找出如何通过植物组合来最大化降温,这暗示了不同植物的降温潜力是不同的。在英语中,表达"在......方面存在不同",习惯使用的是固定短语搭配 "differ in..."。

4、low

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格修饰名词 rainfall(降雨量)。后文的 "minimal water inputs(极少的水分投入)" 是核心线索。根据上下文语境的语义对应原则,与"极少水分"相呼应的降雨场景必然是"低降雨量",因此选用形容词 low(低的)。

Green spaces contribute significantly to a reduction in soil and aerial temperatures during spells of hot weather, so contributing to human wellbeing.

在炎热天气期间，绿地能显著降低土壤和空气温度，从而有助于人类福祉。

In the garden context, there is, however, little information as to what extent various types of plants differ in their cooling potential and how certain planting combinations may maximize cooling under a scenario of low rainfall and minimal water inputs.

然而，在花园环境中，关于不同植物类型在降温潜力上有多大差异，以及在低降雨和极少灌溉的情况下某些种植组合如何最大化降温效果，目前信息仍然很少。

questions.title: Shrimp Farm
questions.passage_html: Over the past two decades around a third of the world’s mangrove swamps have been for human use, with many turned into valuable shrimp farms. In 2007 an economic study of such shrimp farms in Thailand showed that the commercial profits per hectare were $9,632. If that were the only , conversion would seem an excellent idea. However, proper shows that for each hectare government subsidies formed $8,412 of this figure and there were costs, too: $1,000 for pollution and $12,392 for losses to ecosystem services. These damage to the supply of foods and medicines that people had taken from the forest, the loss of habitats for fish, and less buffering against storms. And because a given shrimp farm only stays for three or four years, there was the additional cost of restoring them afterwards: if you do so with mangroves themselves, add another $9,318 per hectare. The overall lesson is that what looks only does so because the profits are retained by the private sector, while the problems are spread out across society at large, appearing on no specific balance sheet.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 converted

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,主语为 a third of the world’s mangrove swamps(世界上三分之一的红树林沼泽),后文搭配介词 for human use(供人类使用),并紧接着用分词短语 with many turned into...(其中许多被变成了珍贵的虾养殖场)进行了解释。这表明红树林是被“转换、改变”成了其他用途,在单句内部即可直接锁定动词 converted。

2、 factor

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法确定具体的名词。必须结合前一句所提到的具体经济数字“每公顷的商业利润为 9,632 美元”,本句的 If that were the only... 是在对前文这唯一的经济数据进行假设,表示“如果那是唯一的考量因素或因素”,属于跨句的线索呼应。

3、 accounting

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接确定名词。后文紧接着用冒号引出了一系列极其详细的财务账目明细(如政府补贴、污染成本、生态系统服务损失的具体美金数额),这表明此处指的是一种全面的、长期的“账目核算或经济清算”,必须结合后文的财务列举才能推断出答案。

4、 comprised

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,主语 These 指代前文的多种成本与损失,空格后面则是具体的损失内容:对食物和药物供应的破坏、鱼类栖息地的丧失以及风暴缓冲能力的减弱。这属于典型的整体与部分的关系,表明这些损失“包含、由......构成”,在单句内通过动词与宾语的包含关系即可确定。

5、 productive

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,主语为一个给定的虾养殖场(a given shrimp farm),后文提到它只能维持“三年或四年(for three or four years)”,之后就需要付出额外的修复成本。这表明养殖场在几年后就失去了高产的经济效益,在单句内部通过时间限制和修复结果即可推导出其表达的是“多产的、有生产效益的”。

6、 beneficial

考点：上下文语境

解析：该空是对整篇文章核心结论的概括,单看此句无法锁定。前文通过一系列精细的成本收益对比,证明了虾养殖场虽然表面上有商业利润,但扣除环境成本后其实是亏损的。因此,整篇文章的教训是:那些看起来“有利可图的、有益的”事情,只是因为利润被私人拿走、成本被社会分摊了,需要结合整篇宏观语境进行推导。
questions.translation_html:
Over the past two decades around a third of the world's mangrove swamps have been converted for human use, with many turned into valuable shrimp farms.

在过去二十年里,世界上约三分之一的红树林沼泽被转为人类用途,其中许多变成了有价值的虾场。

In 2007 an economic study of such shrimp farms in Thailand showed that the commercial profits per hectare were $9,632.

2007 年,一项针对泰国此类虾场的经济研究显示,每公顷商业利润为 9632 美元。

If that were the only factor, conversion would seem an excellent idea.

如果这就是唯一因素,那么转变用途似乎是个很好的主意。

However, proper accounting shows that for each hectare government subsidies formed $8,412 of this figure and there were costs, too: $1,000 for pollution and $12,392 for losses to ecosystem services.

然而,合理核算显示,每公顷收益中有 8412 美元来自政府补贴,而且还存在成本:污染成本 1000 美元,生态系统服务损失 12392 美元。

These comprised damage to the supply of foods and medicines that people had taken from the forest, the loss of habitats for fish, and less buffering against storms.

这些成本包括人们从森林中获取的食物和药物供应受损、鱼类栖息地丧失,以及抵御风暴的缓冲能力减弱。

And because a given shrimp farm only stays productive for three or four years, there was the additional cost of restoring them afterwards: if you do so with mangroves themselves, add another $9,318 per hectare.

而且,由于一个虾场通常只能保持三四年的生产力,之后还会产生恢复成本;如果用红树林本身进行恢复,每公顷还要再增加 9318 美元。

The overall lesson is that what looks beneficial only does so because the profits are retained by the private sector, while the problems are spread out across society at large, appearing on no specific balance sheet.

总体教训是,看似有利的事情之所以显得有利,只是因为利润被私人部门保留,而问题则分散到整个社会,并不会出现在某一张具体的资产负债表上。

questions.title: Selfies
questions.passage_html: To better understand selfies and how people form their identities online, the researchers combed through 2.5 million selfie posts Instagram to determine what kinds of identity statements people make by taking and sharing the photos. Nearly 52 percent of all selfies into the appearance category: pictures of people showing off their make-up, clothes, lips, etc. , an overwhelming 57 percent of selfies on Instagram were posted by the 18-35-year-old crowd, something the researchers say isn't too surprising the demographics of the social media platform. The under-18 age group posted about 30 percent of selfies.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 on

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词 on 与后方的社交媒体平台 Instagram 构成了地道的行业习惯固定搭配 on Instagram(在 Instagram 上)。在描述社交平台或网络平台时,英语习惯使用介词 on。

2、 fell

考点：时态语态

解析：句描述研究人员对Instagram上自拍帖子进行分析的结果,使用一般过去时叙述研究发现。主语 Nearly 52 percent of all selfies 为复数概念,谓语需用复数形式 fell into(属于/归类为)。fall 为原形,时态错误;fallen 为过去分词,不能单独作谓语;falls 为第三人称单数,主谓不一致且时态错误。

3、 Overall

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：副词 Overall(总体上 / 总的来说)在此处起到总结陈述的作用。前文在分析自拍的分类占比,此处引出年龄段的占比统计,从局部数据转向总体特征的描述,Overall 是最符合语境的逻辑衔接词。

4、 considering

考点：非谓语形式

解析：现在分词 considering 在此处充当介词,引导原因状语,意为“考虑到......”。在英语语法中,considering 经常用来引出对某种现象背景或前提的考量,在此处精准表达“考虑到该社交媒体平台的人口统计学特征,这并不令人惊讶”。
questions.translation_html:
To better understand selfies and how people form their identities online, the researchers combed through 2.5 million selfie posts on Instagram to determine what kinds of identity statements people make by taking and sharing the photos.

为了更好地理解自拍以及人们如何在网上形成自己的身份,研究人员梳理了 Instagram 上 250 万条自拍帖子,以确定人们通过拍照和分享照片所表达的身份声明类型。

Nearly 52 percent of all selfies fell into the appearance category: pictures of people showing off their make-up, clothes, lips, etc.

几乎 52% 的自拍属于外貌类:人们展示自己妆容、衣服、嘴唇等的照片。

Overall , an overwhelming 57 percent of selfies on Instagram were posted by the 18-35-year-old crowd, something the researchers say isn't too surprising considering the demographics of the social media platform.

总体而言,Instagram 上高达 57% 的自拍由 18-35 岁人群发布,研究人员表示 这并不令人意外,考虑到这一社交媒体平台的人口构成。

The under-18 age group posted about 30 percent of selfies.

Giant exoplanets, like the so-called 'hot Jupiters' that are similar in characteristics to the solar system's biggest planet and orbit very close to their host stars, are excellent targets for astronomers in their search for their extrasolar worlds.

questions.title: European Culture
questions.passage_html: Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe during the 18th and early 19th centuries. This of culture reflected inequalities within European societies and their colonies around the world. This understanding of culture equates culture with civilization and contrasts both with nature or non-civilization. According to this understanding of culture, some countries are more civilized than others, and some people are more cultured than others. Anything that doesn't into this category is labeled as chaos or anarchy. From this perspective, culture is closely tied to cultivation, which is the progressive refinement of human . In practice, culture referred to elite goods and activities such as haute cuisine, high fashion or haute couture, museum-caliber art and classical music. The word cultured referred to people who knew about and took part in these activities. , someone who used culture in this sense might that classical music is more refined than music by working-class people, such as jazz or the indigenous music traditions of aboriginal peoples .
questions.analysis_html:
1、concept

考点：上下文语境

解析： 空格作主语，用来指代前一句提到的 “Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe...（很多人依然用18、19世纪欧洲的方式来思考文化）”。将一种宏观的历史性思维方式提炼为一个学术定义时，使用名词 concept（概念） 最具学术和理论厚度，完美契合探讨“文化定义”的上下文语境。

2、fit

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格作动词原形，位于 “Anything that doesn't ______ into this category...” 结构中。本句在阐述当时的文化偏见：任何不能被“归入”这一正统范畴的东西，都会被贴上混乱或无政府状态的标签。在英语习惯用法中，表达“符合……、被纳入……的范畴/归入……之内”，其标准的固定动词短语搭配为 “fit into...”。

3、behavior

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作名词，被 human（人类的）所修饰。本句指出：从当时的视角来看，文化与教化紧密相关，而教化就是指人类“行为”的渐进式改良。在单句内部的社会学词义辨析下，表达人类在社会生活中的“行为表现/举止规范”，选用名词 behavior（行为/举止） 最符合学术定义（conduct 偏向具体的品行或办事方式，范围过窄）。

4、For example

考点：逻辑衔接

解析： 空格位于句首，用来引入前后句的逻辑关系。前一单句提到“文化在当时指的是精英阶层的物品和活动，如高级时装、博物馆级的艺术和古典音乐”。本句紧接着指出“一个在这种语境下使用文化一词的人可能会认为，古典音乐比工人阶级的音乐更高级”。后句显然是前句“精英文化活动（古典音乐）”的具体化实例。因此选用 For example（例如） 满足句间的事例逻辑衔接。

5、argue

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作动词原形，紧跟在情态动词 might 后面，后接一个 that 引导的观点宾语从句。在单句内部的语言行为辨析中，表达某人提出一种带有主观偏见、需要论证或容易引发争议的学术“论点/观点”时，标准的学术动词选用 argue（提出论点/论证/认为） 最为精准（claim 偏向对事实的主张/索赔，insist 偏向固执己见，在此处都不如 argue 贴合论文语境）。
questions.translation_html:
Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe during the 18th and early 19th centuries.

今天，许多人对文化的理解仍类似于18世纪和19世纪初欧洲人对文化的理解。

This concept of culture reflected inequalities within European societies and their colonies around the world.

这种文化概念反映了欧洲社会及其世界各地殖民地内部的不平等。

This understanding of culture equates culture with civilization and contrasts both with nature or non-civilization.

这种对文化的理解把文化等同于文明，并把二者与自然或非文明相对立。

According to this understanding of culture, some countries are more civilized than others, and some people are more cultured than others.

按照这种文化观，一些国家比另一些国家更文明，一些人也比另一些人更有文化。

Anything that doesn't fit into this category is labeled as chaos or anarchy.

任何不符合这一类别的事物都会被贴上混乱或无政府状态的标签。

From this perspective, culture is closely tied to cultivation, which is the progressive refinement of human behavior.

从这一角度看，文化与教化密切相关，而教化就是人类行为的逐步完善。

In practice, culture referred to elite goods and activities such as haute cuisine, high fashion or haute couture, museum-caliber art and classical music.

在实践中，文化指的是精英商品和活动，例如高级烹饪、高级时装或高级定制、博物馆级艺术和古典音乐。

The word cultured referred to people who knew about and took part in these activities.

“有文化的”这个词指的是了解并参与这些活动的人。

For example, someone who used culture in this sense might argue that classical music is more refined than music by working-class people, such as jazz or the indigenous music traditions of aboriginal peoples.

例如，以这种意义使用“文化”一词的人可能会认为，古典音乐比工人阶级的音乐更精致，如爵士乐或原住民的本土音乐传统。

questions.passage_html: The logic of the scientific method was set out by John Stuart Mill in 1843 and was the method of difference. A simple example of what he by this is to take two glasses of water which are identical in every . Introduce a few drops of ink into one of these glasses. The water changes color! to Mill’s method of difference it is safe to that the change in the color of the water is due to the of a new factor ― the independent variable ― in this case, the ink.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 named

考点：上下文语境

解析：动词 name 在此意为“命名”。整句在陈述历史事实:这一逻辑由约翰·斯图亚特·穆勒在1843年阐述,并被“【命名为】”求异法(the method of difference)。

2、 meant

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 mean 在此意为“意指/表达的意思”。整句逻辑是举例说明他对这一方法所表达的含义:“他【意指】的简单例子是......”。

3、 respect

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 respect 与前方的介词 in 以及形容词 every 构成了经典固定搭配 in every respect(在每一个方面)。它在单句中精准表达“取两杯在各个方面都完全相同的清水”。

4、 According

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词短语 According to(根据)在此引导引用来源。它在句中完美衔接了穆勒提出的理论,意为“【根据】穆勒的求异法”。

5、 assume

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 assume(假设/断定)在此处最符合科学推论的逻辑。它表达了基于实验结果进行逻辑判断的过程,即“可以安全地【断定】水颜色的变化是由于......”。

6、 introduction

考点：上下文语境

解析：名词 introduction(引入)与后方的介词 of 构成搭配。整句在解释变量控制实验的逻辑,即水颜色变化是因为“新因素(即墨水)的【引入】”。
questions.translation_html:
The logic of the scientific method was set out by John Stuart Mill in 1843 and was named the method of difference.

科学方法的逻辑由约翰·斯图尔特·密尔于1843年提出,并被命名为差异法。

A simple example of what he meant by this is to take two glasses of water which are identical in every respect.

他所说的这种方法的简单例子是:取两杯在各个方面都完全相同的水。

Introduce a few drops of ink into one of these glasses.

向其中一杯水中滴入几滴墨水。

The water changes color!

水的颜色发生了变化!

According to Mill’s method of difference it is safe to assume that the change in the color of the water is due to the introduction of a new factor — the independent variable — in this case, the ink.

根据密尔的差异法,可以稳妥地假设,水的颜色变化是由于引入了一个新的因素——自变量——在这里就是墨水。

questions.title: Panic-striken Climate
questions.passage_html: First, the scientific community that studies climate change is quietly panic-stricken, because things are moving faster than they expected. Greenhouse gas emissions are going up faster than both from industrializing countries in Asia and from melting permafrost in Siberia and Canada. The Arctic Sea ice is melting so fast that the whole ocean may be ice-free in late summer in five years' time. Most climate scientists now see last year's report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, whose forecasts are used by most governments for planning purposes, as a historical document. Second, the biggest early impact of global warming will be on the food supply, both locally and globally. When the global average temperature hits one and a half degrees hotter - and it will; the carbon dioxide already in the atmosphere us to that much warming - some countries will no longer be able to feed their people. Others, further from the equator, will still have enough food for themselves, but none to .
questions.analysis_html:
1、much

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "______ faster than..." 结构中。在英语语法中,修饰形容词或副词的比较级以表达"快得多 / 明显更聪明"时,习惯使用的是由副词 much 领衔的固定修饰搭配 "much + 比较级"。

2、predicted

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "going up faster than ______" 结构中。在学术和描述数据的语境中,表达实际增速"比预测的要快 / 超过预期",习惯使用的是固定短语搭配 "faster than predicted"(或 faster than expected)。

3、purely

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格修饰形容词 historical(历史的)。前文提到由于气候变暖速度远超预期,联合国气候委员会去年的报告预测已经完全跟不上现状了。在单句内部的逻辑下,科学家们现在将这份报告看作是一份【纯粹的/完全的】历史文件,失去了现实指导意义。因此选用副词 purely(纯粹地)。

4、commits

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "______ us to that much warming" 结构中。在环境科学和日常英语中,表达某事不可避免地"使......陷入某种必然状态 / 促成某种结果",习惯使用的是固定动词短语搭配 "commit somebody/something to..."。此处意为大气中已有的二氧化碳必将让我们面临这种程度的升温。

5、spare

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格位于 "have enough food for themselves, but none to ______" 结构中。前文提到"其他远离赤道的国家仍会有足够的食物留给自己",通过连词 but 转折后,单句内部的语义转化为"但是没有【多余的】可以拿出来分享/施舍"。动词原形 spare(抽出/匀出多余的) 完美契合这一转折后的语义。
questions.translation_html:
First, the scientific community that studies climate change is quietly panic-stricken, because things are moving much faster than they expected.

首先，研究气候变化的科学界正在暗自恐慌，因为情况的发展比他们预期的快得多。

Greenhouse gas emissions are going up faster than predicted both from industrializing countries in Asia and from melting permafrost in Siberia and Canada.

无论是来自亚洲工业化国家的温室气体排放，还是来自西伯利亚和加拿大永久冻土融化的排放，都比预测上升得更快。

The Arctic Sea ice is melting so fast that the whole ocean may be ice-free in late summer in five years' time.

北极海冰融化得如此之快，以至于五年后整个北冰洋可能在夏末无冰。

Most climate scientists now see last year's report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, whose forecasts are used by most governments for planning purposes, as a purely historical document.

如今，大多数气候科学家把政府间气候变化专门委员会去年的报告视为一份纯粹的历史文件，而该报告的预测曾被大多数政府用于规划。

Second, the biggest early impact of global warming will be on the food supply, both locally and globally.

其次，全球变暖早期最大的影响将体现在粮食供应上，无论是地方层面还是全球层面。

When the global average temperature hits one and a half degrees hotter - and it will; the carbon dioxide already in the atmosphere commits us to that much warming - some countries will no longer be able to feed their people.

当全球平均气温升高1.5度时，一些国家将无法再养活自己的人民；而这种升温必然会发生，因为大气中已有的二氧化碳已经锁定了这一程度的变暖。

Others, further from the equator, will still have enough food for themselves, but none to spare.

其他离赤道较远的国家仍会有足够的粮食供自己使用，但不会有多余的粮食可供输出。

blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "______ faster than..." 结构中。在英语语法中,修饰形容词或副词的比较级以表达"快得多 / 明显更聪明"时,习惯使用的是由副词 much 领衔的固定修饰搭配 "much + 比较级"。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "going up faster than ______" 结构中。在学术和描述数据的语境中,表达实际增速"比预测的要快 / 超过预期",习惯使用的是固定短语搭配 "faster than predicted"(或 faster than expected)。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 空格修饰形容词 historical(历史的)。前文提到由于气候变暖速度远超预期,联合国气候委员会去年的报告预测已经完全跟不上现状了。在单句内部的逻辑下,科学家们现在将这份报告看作是一份【纯粹的/完全的】历史文件,失去了现实指导意义。因此选用副词 purely(纯粹地)。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "______ us to that much warming" 结构中。在环境科学和日常英语中,表达某事不可避免地"使......陷入某种必然状态 / 促成某种结果",习惯使用的是固定动词短语搭配 "commit somebody/something to..."。此处意为大气中已有的二氧化碳必将让我们面临这种程度的升温。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 空格位于 "have enough food for themselves, but none to ______" 结构中。前文提到"其他远离赤道的国家仍会有足够的食物留给自己",通过连词 but 转折后,单句内部的语义转化为"但是没有【多余的】可以拿出来分享/施舍"。动词原形 spare(抽出/匀出多余的) 完美契合这一转折后的语义。

questions.title: Egg-eating Snakes
questions.passage_html: Egg-eating snakes are a small group of snakes whose consists only of eggs. Some eat only small eggs, which they have to swallow , as the snake has no teeth. Instead, some other snakes eat bigger eggs, but it requires special . These snakes have spines that stick from the backbone. The spines crack the egg as it passes through the throat.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 diet

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格前的定语从句主语为 whose ______,谓语动词为 consists only of eggs(仅仅由蛋组成)。在选项中,通常用名词 diet 来指代人或动物长期的“饮食、日常食物”,且符合 consist of 的语义搭配。在单句内部通过主谓宾的语义和固定用法即可直接锁定。

2、 whole

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。swallow something whole 构成固定搭配,意思是“把某物整个吞下去”。在单句语境中,后文提到因为这种蛇没有牙齿(as the snake has no teeth),无法咀嚼,所以它们必须把蛋“整个”吞下。

3、 treatment

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看这一句无法直接锁定名词。前半句提到“另一些蛇则吃更大的蛋,但这需要特殊的......”;必须结合后文跨句的详细描述——这些蛇的脊椎骨上长有突出的刺,当蛋经过喉咙时,这些刺会把蛋壳刺破。这种特殊的生理结构和处理食物的方式,正属于对蛋的特殊“处理或对待(treatment)”。

4、 out

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。stick out 构成固定搭配,意思是“伸出、突出”。在单句语境中,主语为 spines(刺),后文搭配介词 from the backbone(从脊椎骨上),用来描述这些刺从骨头上“突出来”的解剖学特征,在单句内即可直接确定。

5、 open

考点：固定搭配

解析：这个答案考查的是固定搭配。crack open 构成固定搭配,意思是“砸开、裂开”。在单句语境中,主语为 The spines(刺),宾语为 the egg(蛋),用来生动地描述当蛋经过喉咙时,突出的刺将蛋壳“刺破并使之裂开”的动作,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

Egg-eating snakes are a small group of snakes whose diet consists only of eggs.

食蛋蛇是一小类只以蛋为食的蛇。

Some eat only small eggs, which they have to swallow whole, as the snake has no teeth.

有些食蛋蛇只吃小蛋,因为它们没有牙齿,所以必须把蛋整个吞下。

Instead, some other snakes eat bigger eggs, but it requires special treatment.

另一些蛇则吃较大的蛋,但这需要特殊处理。

These snakes have spines that stick out from the backbone.

这些蛇有从脊椎伸出的骨刺。

The spines crack open the egg as it passes through the throat.

当蛋经过喉部时,这些骨刺会把蛋壳刺破。

questions.title: Video Conference
questions.passage_html: Never has the carbon footprint of multi-national corporations been under such intense scrutiny. Inter-city train journeys and long-haul flights to face-to-face business meetings contribute significantly to greenhouse gases and the resulting on the environment. The Anglo-US company Teliris has introduced a new video-conferencing technology and partnered with the Carbon Neutral Company, enabling corporate outfits to become more environmentally responsible. The innovation allows simulated face-to-face meetings to be held across continents without the time or environmental burden of international travel. Previous designs have enabled video-conferencing on a point-to- point, dual-location basis. The firm's VirtuaLive technology, however, can bring people together from up to five locations anywhere in the world - with transmission quality.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 conduct

考点：固定搭配

解析：conduct business meetings,意为“举行商务会议/召开业务会谈”。在单句语境中,动词不定式(to conduct)用作目的状语。

2、 strain

考点：固定搭配

解析：strain on the environment,意为“给环境带来沉重负担/造成巨大压力”。在单句语境中,指代跨国长途飞行给自然生态带来的不可逆的沉重压力。

3、 pressure

考点：固定搭配

解析：without the time pressure “没有时间压力”。在单句语境中,用来形容新型视频会议技术的优势,它使各跨国大企业在开会时完全免受高昂的时间压力。

4、 separate

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰复数名词 locations(地点)。根据前文“以往的设计只能支持点对点、双位置的视频会议”的对比可知,该公司的全新技术可以将来自全球多达五个“独立的/不同的(separate)”地点的团队连接在一起。

5、 unrivaled

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰名词 quality(质量)。纯靠单句关于尖端视讯技术突破的词义辨析可知,其跨洲传输技术非常强大,能够提供“无与伦比的/无可匹敌的(unrivaled)”超高传输质量。
questions.translation_html:
Never has the carbon footprint of multi-national corporations been under such intense scrutiny.

跨国公司的碳足迹从未受到过如此严厉的审视。

Inter-city train journeys and long-haul flights to conduct face-to-face business meetings contribute significantly to greenhouse gases and the resulting strain on the environment.

为了举行面对面的商务会议而进行的城市间火车旅行和长途飞行,产生了大量的温室气体,并由此给环境带来了沉重的负担。

The Anglo-US company Teliris has introduced a new video-conferencing technology and partnered with the Carbon Neutral Company, enabling corporate outfits to become more environmentally responsible.

英美合资的 Teliris 公司推出了一种新的视频会议技术,并与碳中和公司合作,使企业机构能够对环境承担更多责任。

The innovation allows simulated face-to-face meetings to be held across continents without the time pressure or environmental burden of international travel.

这一创新允许跨大洲举行模拟的面对面会议,而没有国际旅行的时间压力或环境负担。

Previous designs have enabled video-conferencing on a point-to-point, dual-location basis.

以前的设计实现了点对点、双位置基础上的视频会议。

The firm's VirtuaLive technology, however, can bring people together from up to five separate locations anywhere in the world - with unrivaled transmission quality.

然而,该公司的 VirtuaLive 技术可以将来自世界上任何地方多达五个不同地点的人聚集在一起——并具有无与伦比的传输质量。

questions.title: Teen Writing
questions.passage_html: Teens write for a variety of reasons―as part of a school assignment, to a good grade, to stay in touch with friends, to share their artistic creations with others or simply to put their thoughts to paper (whether virtual or otherwise). In our focus groups, teens said they are motivated to write when they can topics that are relevant to their lives and interests, and report greater enjoyment of school writing when they have the opportunity to write creatively. Having teachers or other adults who challenge them, them with interesting curricula and give them detailed feedback also serves as a motivator for teens. Teens also writing for an audience motivates them to write and write well.
questions.analysis_html:
1、get

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格在名词短语 a good grade(好成绩)的前方作及物动词。作为学校作业的一部分(as part of a school assignment),青少年写文章最直接的目的就是为了"获得"好成绩。在日常英语中,表达"取得好成绩",习惯使用的是固定动词短语搭配 "get a good grade"。

2、select

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作及物动词,宾语是 topics(主题)。后文的定语从句限制了这些话题的范围是"与他们的生活 and 兴趣相关的"。在单句内部的语境下,当青少年能够自己去"挑选 / 选择"感兴趣的话题时,他们才会受到激励去写作,因此选用动词原形 select(挑选)。

3、present

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "______ them with interesting curricula" 结构中。在英语中,表达"向某人提供某物 / 把某物呈现在某人面前",习惯使用的是由动词 present 引导的固定短语搭配 "present somebody with something"。

4、report

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格后接一个省略了 that 的宾语从句。在调查、学术和正式行文中,表达研究对象"声称/反映/报告"某种情况,习惯使用的是固定搭配 "report + 宾语从句"。本篇第二句就使用了 "...and report greater enjoyment...",此处填入 report 构成"青少年们反映......"的固定论述结构。
questions.translation_html:
Teens write for a variety of reasons―as part of a school assignment, to get a good grade, to stay in touch with friends, to share their artistic creations with others or simply to put their thoughts to paper (whether virtual or otherwise).

青少年写作有各种原因：作为学校作业的一部分、为了取得好成绩、为了与朋友保持联系、为了与他人分享自己的艺术创作，或者只是把想法写在纸上或电子媒介上。

In our focus groups, teens said they are motivated to write when they can select topics that are relevant to their lives and interests, and report greater enjoyment of school writing when they have the opportunity to write creatively.

在我们的焦点小组中，青少年表示，当他们可以选择与自己生活和兴趣相关的话题时，他们更有写作动力；当他们有机会进行创造性写作时，也会更享受学校写作。

Having teachers or other adults who challenge them, present them with interesting curricula and give them detailed feedback also serves as a motivator for teens.

有老师或其他成年人挑战他们、提供有趣的课程并给予详细反馈，也会成为青少年写作的动力。

Teens also report writing for an audience motivates them to write and write well.

青少年还表示，为读者写作会激励他们去写，并且写得更好。

questions.title: Enough Exercise
questions.passage_html: One thing is certain. Most people do not get enough exercise in their routines. All of the advances of modern technology ― from can openers to power steering have made life easier, more comfortable and much less physically . Yet our bodies need activities, especially if they are carrying around too fat. Satisfying this need requires a sustainable plan, and a commitment. There are two ways to increase the number of calories you spend: start a regular exercise program if you do not have one already. Increase the amount of physical activity in your daily routine.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 daily

考点：固定搭配

解析：daily routine 构成固定搭配,意为“日常生活、日常事务”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“大多数人在他们的‘日常生活’中都得不到足够的锻炼”,在单句内部即可直接锁定形容词 daily。

2、 electric

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,空格处的形容词用来修饰 can openers(开罐器),作为现代科技进步(advances of modern technology)的具体例子。根据常识,现代厨房电器中常见的是“电动开罐器”。在选项中,vibrational(振动的)、electronic(电子的)、synthetic(合成的)均不符合开罐器的常见属性,只有 electric(电动的)最符合单句内部的常识和词义辨析。

3、 demanding

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,前半句提到现代科技的进步让生活变得更加轻松、更加舒适(easier, more comfortable),后半句用 and 连接,表示并列和顺承。既然生活变轻松了,那么它在身体身体层面上造成的负担就会变少,即“不那么费体力的”。physically demanding 为常用表达,意为“对体力要求高的、费体力的”,符合单句内部的逻辑。

4、 much

考点：固定搭配

解析：too much fat 构成固定搭配。在单句语境中,fat(脂肪)作为不可数名词,前面需要使用修饰不可数名词的代词。选项中 few、many、several 均只能修饰可数名词复数,只有 much 可以修饰不可数名词,表示“过多的脂肪”,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

5、 main

考点：上下文语境

解析：单看前半句有两个什么样的途径(two... ways)无法直接锁定形容词。但必须结合后文的顺承线索——后文列举了具体的两个核心途径:一个是“开始定期的锻炼计划(start a regular exercise program)”,另一个是“增加日常事务中的身体活动量(Increase the amount of physical activity...)”。这两点是增加卡路里消耗的两个最核心、最主要的手段。因此,选择 main(主要的)最符合后文列举的语境。
questions.translation_html:
One thing is certain. Most people do not get enough exercise in their daily routines.

有一件事是确定无疑的。大多数人在他们的日常生活中都得不到足够的锻炼。

All of the advances of modern technology ― from electric can openers to power steering have made life easier, more comfortable and much less physically demanding .

现代科技的所有进步——从电动开罐器到动力转向系统——都使生活变得更轻松、更舒适,对体力的要求也大为降低。

Yet our bodies need activities, especially if they are carrying around too much fat.

然而,我们的身体需要活动,尤其是当体内带有过多的脂肪时。

Satisfying this need requires a sustainable plan, and a commitment.

满足这一需求需要一个可持续的计划以及一份坚持。

There are two main ways to increase the number of calories you spend: start a regular exercise program if you do not have one already. Increase the amount of physical activity in your daily routine.

增加卡路里消耗有两种主要途径:如果你还没有定期锻炼计划,那就开始一个;或者增加你日常事务中的身体活动量。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: daily routine 构成固定搭配,意为“日常生活、日常事务”。在单句语境中,整句话意为“大多数人在他们的‘日常生活’中都得不到足够的锻炼”,在单句内部即可直接锁定形容词 daily。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,空格处的形容词用来修饰 can openers(开罐器),作为现代科技进步(advances of modern technology)的具体例子。根据常识,现代厨房电器中常见的是“电动开罐器”。在选项中,vibrational(振动的)、electronic(电子的)、synthetic(合成的)均不符合开罐器的常见属性,只有 electric(电动的)最符合单句内部的常识和词义辨析。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 在单句语境中,前半句提到现代科技的进步让生活变得更加轻松、更加舒适(easier, more comfortable),后半句用 and 连接,表示并列和顺承。既然生活变轻松了,那么它在身体身体层面上造成的负担就会变少,即“不那么费体力的”。physically demanding 为常用表达,意为“对体力要求高的、费体力的”,符合单句内部的逻辑。

blanks.label: 固定搭配
blanks.explanation: too much fat 构成固定搭配。在单句语境中,fat(脂肪)作为不可数名词,前面需要使用修饰不可数名词的代词。选项中 few、many、several 均只能修饰可数名词复数,只有 much 可以修饰不可数名词,表示“过多的脂肪”,在单句内部即可直接锁定。

blanks.label: 上下文语境
blanks.explanation: 单看前半句有两个什么样的途径(two... ways)无法直接锁定形容词。但必须结合后文的顺承线索——后文列举了具体的两个核心途径:一个是“开始定期的锻炼计划(start a regular exercise program)”,另一个是“增加日常事务中的身体活动量(Increase the amount of physical activity...)”。这两点是增加卡路里消耗的两个最核心、最主要的手段。因此,选择 main(主要的)最符合后文列举的语境。

questions.analysis_html:
1、 One

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,代词充当主语。前句明确指出在过去的城市发展史上存在着“两种截然相反、彼此冲突的建设心态(two separate and conflicting building sentiments)”,本句顺承引出其中的第一种,故强制填入 “One(其中一种心态是......)”,并与后文的 “The other” 形成绝对呼应。

2、 marks

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当由连词 or 引导的并列分句的谓语。根据单句关于新兴城市崛起背景的词义辨析可知,一座崭新城市的平地起步,往往“标志着(marks)”一个全然不同的政治全新开端。

3、 tend to

考点：固定搭配

解析：tend to do something 固定搭配,意为“往往会......、倾向于......”。此处用来形容在马太效应的影响下,既有的成熟定居点往往会源源不断地吸引大批民众自发前来。

4、 unless

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：此处考查连词辨析,用以引导条件状语从句。句意为“只要城市是有计划地发展的,那么“规划”与“随性增长”这两种冲突就一定存在。” “在每个成熟城市中,这种冲突都是显而易见的,除非它的发展完全是偶然的(即:如果是偶然的,那么冲突就不明显)。”

5、 was surveyed

考点：时态语态

解析：which was surveyed in the second half of the 19th century 是定语从句,修饰 Currowan。Currowan 与 survey 是被动关系,且时间是 19 世纪下半叶,所以用一般过去时被动语态 was surveyed。

One is the desire to start again, for a variety of reasons: an earthquake or a tidal wave may have demolished the settlement, or fire destroyed it, or the new city marks a new political beginning.

一种是重新开始的欲望,原因多种多样:地震或海啸可能摧毁了定居点,或者大火烧毁了它,或者新城市标志着一个新的政治开端。

另一种可以比作磁铁的效应:既有的定居点吸引着人们,无论对他们的到来是否有任何规划,他们往往都会来。

But no one came.

questions.title: Higher Education Funding
questions.passage_html: Financing of Australian higher education has undergone dramatic since the early 1970s. Although the Australian Government provided regular funding for universities from the late 1950s, in 1974 it full responsibility for funding higher education ― abolishing tuition fees with the intention of making university education affordable to all Australians who had the ability and who wished to participate in higher education. Since the late 1980s, there has been a move towards greater private contributions, student fees. In 1989, the Australian Government introduced the Higher Education Contribution Scheme (HECS) which included a loans scheme to help students finance their contributions. This enabled university to remain to students by delaying their payments until they could afford to pay off their loans. In 2002, the Australian Government a scheme similar to HECS for postgraduate students - the Postgraduate Education Loan Scheme (PELS). Funding for higher education comes from various sources. This article examines the three main sources - Australian Government funding, student fees and charges, and HECS. While the proportion of total raised through HECS is relatively small, HECS payments are a significant component of students' university costs, with many students carrying a HECS debt for several years after leaving university. This article also focuses on characteristics of university students based on their HECS liability status, and the level of accumulated HECS debt.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 change

考点：固定搭配

解析：undergo change意为“经历变化”。在单句语境中,用以指出自20世纪70年代初以来,澳大利亚高等教育的资助模式经历了巨大的变革。

2、 assumed

考点：固定搭配

解析：assume responsibility for...意为“承担起......的责任”。在单句语境中,指代澳大利亚政府在1974年正式承担起了全额资助高等教育的全面责任。

3、 particularly

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：在单句语境中,副词充当状语引出后文需要重点强调的具体项目。前文指出自20世纪80年代末以来,高等教育开始倾向于要求更多的私人力量进行贡献,本句通过“特别是/尤其是(particularly)”来明确点出学生学费这一大头。

4、 accessible

考点：固定搭配

解析：remain accessible to students意为“保持让学生能够负担得起/依然向学生敞开大门”。在单句语境中,指代助学贷款制度能够确保大学教育的大门不会对贫困学生关闭。

5、 introduced

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当主句的谓语。结合前文“在1989年,澳大利亚政府推出了(introduced)高等教育贡献计划”这一高度对齐的并列叙事可知,此处同样指代政府在2002年“推出/出台(introduced)”了一项针对研究生的类似贷款方案。

6、 revenue

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作 raised through HECS 的核心修饰语。根据财政资助与学费收支的词义辨析可知,此处是指虽然通过该贷款计划所筹集到的“总财政收入/总款项(revenue)”比例相对较小,但其对学生而言依然是一笔沉重的成本。
questions.translation_html:
Financing of Australian higher education has undergone dramatic change since the early 1970s.

自20世纪70年代初以来,澳大利亚高等教育的资助方式经历了剧烈的变革。

Although the Australian Government provided regular funding for universities from the late 1950s, in 1974 it assumed full responsibility for funding higher education ― abolishing tuition fees with the intention of making university education affordable to all Australians who had the ability and who wished to participate in higher education.

尽管澳大利亚政府从20世纪50年代末开始为大学提供定期资助,但在1974年,它承担了资助高等教育的全部责任——取消了学费,其意图是让所有有能力且希望接受高等教育的澳大利亚人都能负担得起大学教育。

Since the late 1980s, there has been a move towards greater private contributions, particularly student fees.

自20世纪80年代末以来,出现了一种倾向于更多私人贡献的趋势,特别是学生的学费。

In 1989, the Australian Government introduced the Higher Education Contribution Scheme (HECS) which included a loans scheme to help students finance their contributions.

1989年,澳大利亚政府推出了高等教育贡献计划(HECS),其中包括一项贷款计划,以帮助学生资助他们的贡献。

This enabled university to remain accessible to students by delaying their payments until they could afford to pay off their loans.

这通过延迟学生的付款,直到他们能够负担得起偿还贷款,从而使大学教育对学生来说依然是可及的。

In 2002, the Australian Government introduced a scheme similar to HECS for postgraduate students - the Postgraduate Education Loan Scheme (PELS).

2002年,澳大利亚政府为研究生推出了一项类似于 HECS 的计划——研究生教育贷款计划(PELS)。

Funding for higher education comes from various sources. This article examines the three main sources - Australian Government funding, student fees and charges, and HECS.

高等教育的资金来自不同的渠道。

本文考察了三个主要来源——澳大利亚政府资助、学生学费和收费以及 HECS。

While the proportion of total revenue raised through HECS is relatively small, HECS payments are a significant component of students' university costs, with many students carrying a HECS debt for several years after leaving university.

虽然通过 HECS 筹集的总收入比例相对较小,但 HECS 的支付是学生大学成本的重要组成部分,许多学生在离开大学后仍连续几年背负着 HECS 债务。

This article also focuses on characteristics of university students based on their HECS liability status, and the level of accumulated HECS debt.

本文还侧重于基于 HECS 责任状态的大学生的特征,以及累计 HECS 债务的水平。

questions.title: Sales Activities
questions.passage_html: Organizations need to integrate their sales activities more both internally and with customers' needs according to a new book co- authored by an academic at the University of East Anglia. The book how sales can help organizations to become more customer-oriented and considers how they are responding to challenges such as increasing competition, more customers and a more complex selling environment. Many organizations are facing escalating costs and a growth in customer power, makes it necessary to allocate resources more strategically. The sales function can provide critical customer and market knowledge to help inform both innovation and marketing. However, the authors say that within the industry is still uncertainty about the shape a future sales team should take, how it should be managed, and how it into their organization's business model.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 addresses

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当主句谓语。主语是 `The book`(这本书),宾语是由 `how` 引导的从句。单句字面逻辑在阐述这本书的核心内容,表示这本书“【探讨/论述(addresses)】”了销售如何帮助组织变得更加以客户为导向。其他干扰项(如预测、通知)不符合该学术书籍的论述属性。

2、 demanding

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,形容词作定语修饰名词 `customers`(客户)。它与前方的名词 `competition`(日益激烈的竞争)处于同一个应对挑战的递进线索中。在四个选项中,只有 demanding(苛求的、高要求的)符合现代市场营销学中企业所面临的“越来越【挑剔/高要求】的客户”这一字面逻辑。

3、 which

考点：定语从句

解析：在单句语境中,关系代词 which 在此引导一个非限制性定语从句,并在从句中充当主语。它的指代对象是前方的整个主句事实(许多组织面临成本上升和客户权力增长),在语义上精准表达“【这一情况】使得更有策略地分配资源变得极其必要”。

4、 there

考点：固定搭配

解析：在由 `that` 引导的宾语从句中,代词 there 与后方的系动词 `is` 构成了英语中最核心的固定搭配 `there is`(存在...... / 有......)。它在单句中用来极其规范地引出从句的实际主语 `uncertainty`(不确定性)。

5、 fits

考点：固定搭配

解析：动词 fits 与后方的介词 `into` 构成了固定搭配 `fit into`(融入...... / 适合......)。它在单句中充当并列从句的谓语核心,精准表达了销售团队未来应当“如何【融入】其组织的商业模式”这一管理学命题。
questions.translation_html:
Organizations need to integrate their sales activities more both internally and with customers' needs according to a new book co- authored by an academic at the University of East Anglia.

根据东英吉利大学一位学者合著的一本新书,企业需要将他们的销售活动在内部以及与客户需求之间进行更紧密的整合。

The book addresses how sales can help organizations to become more customer-oriented and considers how they are responding to challenges such as increasing competition, more demanding customers and a more complex selling environment.

该书探讨了销售如何帮助企业变得更加以客户为导向,并思考了它们如何应对诸如日益激烈的竞争、要求更高的客户以及更复杂的销售环境等挑战。

Many organizations are facing escalating costs and a growth in customer power, which makes it necessary to allocate resources more strategically.

许多组织正面临着不断攀升的成本和客户权力的增长,这使得更有策略地分配资源变得极其必要。

The sales function can provide critical customer and market knowledge to help inform both innovation and marketing.

销售职能可以提供关键的客户和市场知识,以帮助隐喻和指导创新与营销。

However, the authors say that within the industry there is still uncertainty about the shape a future sales team should take, how it should be managed, and how it fits into their organization's business model.

然而,作者表示,在行业内部,关于未来销售团队应当采取的形式、应当如何管理以及它如何融入其企业的商业模式,依然存在着不确定性。

questions.title: Dog
questions.passage_html: A DOG may be man's best friend. But man is not always a dog's. Over the centuries breeding has pulled at the canine body shape to produce what is often a grotesque distortion of the underlying wolf. Indeed, some of these distortions are, when found in people, regarded as . Dog breeding does, though, offer a chance to those who would like to understand how body shape is controlled. The ancestry of pedigree pooches is well recorded, their generation time is short and their size reasonably large, so there is plenty of material to work with. ,breeds are, by definition, inbred, and this simplifies genetic analysis. Those such as Elaine Ostrander, of America's National Human Genome Research Institute, who wish to identify the genetic basis of the features of particular pedigrees thus have an experimental animal.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 selective

考点：上下文语境

解析：形容词 selective(选择性的)在此处描述育种方式。单句逻辑指人类通过“【选择性】”育种来塑造犬只体型,最终产生远超原始狼类特征的变异。

2、 pathologies

考点：单句理解

解析：名词 pathologies(病理状态)在此处与人类的生理失调对比。文中指出狗身上的一些体型扭曲,若出现在人类身上,会被视为某种“【病理状态】”。

3、 litter

考点：上下文语境

解析：名词 litter(一窝幼崽)在此处指代繁殖数量。犬只繁殖的特点是“【一窝】”数量较大,这为研究提供了丰富的实验素材。

4、 Moreover

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：副词 Moreover(此外 / 而且)在此处起到递进逻辑的作用。前文提到了研究犬只的优势,此处进一步递进说明“【此外】”,品种本身就是近亲繁殖的,这进一步简化了遗传分析。

5、 ideal

考点：单句理解

解析：形容词 ideal(理想的)在此处描述实验动物。因为品种特征明确且易于分析,所以对于 Elaine Ostrander 等研究人员来说,这是一种“【理想的】”实验动物。

questions.title: Complementary Therapies
questions.passage_html: Complementary therapies―such as those by naturopaths, chiropractors and acupuncturists―have become increasingly popular in Australia over the last few . Interest initially coincided with for alternative lifestyles, while immigration and increased contact and trade with China have also had an . The status of complementary therapies is being re-visited in a number of areas: legal regulation; the stances of doctors' associations; their inclusion in medical education; and scientific research into their .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 practiced

考点：固定搭配

解析：therapies practiced by...,意为“由(某类医生)所实施/开展的疗法”。在单句语境中,过去分词形式被用来充当后置定语。

2、 decades

考点：固定搭配

解析：over the last few decades,意为“在过去的几个年代/几十年里”。用来指出补充疗法在澳大利亚热度持续飙升的长远时间线。

3、 enthusiasm

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作介词 with 的宾语。根据单句关于社会思潮演变的词义辨析可知,公众对自然疗法的早期兴趣,在时间上恰好与当时大众对寻找替代性生活方式的“热忱/狂热(enthusiasm)”不谋而合。

4、 influence

考点：固定搭配

解析：have an influence on/in...意为“对......产生深远影响”。在单句语境中,指出移民涌入以及与中国日益频繁的贸易往来对补充疗法在澳洲的流行产生了重大影响。

5、 efficacy

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作介词 into 的最终宾语。结合前文“开展科学研究”的医学科研语境可知,针对医学疗法所展开的严谨临床科研,其终极目标是为了检验这些补充疗法的真实“疗效/有效性(efficacy)”。

最初的兴趣与对替代生活方式的热忱相吻合,而移民以及与中国增加的接触和贸易也产生了影响。

补充疗法的地位正在许多领域被重新审视:法律监管、医生协会的立场、它们被纳入医学教育,以及对其疗效的科学研究。

questions.title: David Lynch
questions.passage_html: David Lynch is professor and head of education at Charles Darwin University. to this he was sub dean in the Faculty of Education and Creative Arts at Central Queensland University and foundation head of the University’s Noosa . David’s career in education began as a primary school teacher in Queensland in the early 1980’s and to four principal positions before higher education. David’s research interests predominate in teacher education with particular interest in building teacher capability to meet a changed world.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 Prior

考点：固定搭配

解析：介词短语 Prior to(在......之前)在学术传记中是非常正式的时间表达方式。整句逻辑表达他在担任现职“【之前】”,曾在其他大学任职。

2、 campus

考点：上下文语境

解析：名词 campus(校区)与 university(大学)是配套的地理位置词汇。文中提到的 Noosa 是该大学的一个“【校区】”,这符合高等教育机构的组织架构描述。

3、 progressed

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 progress(进展 / 逐步发展)在此处描述职业生涯的晋升路径。从小学教师到担任四所学校的校长,这是一个职业阶梯的自然“【发展 / 进阶】”过程。

4、 entering

考点：单句理解

解析：动词 enter(进入)在此处指代职业生涯的转换。单句表达他在“【进入】”高等教育领域之前,已经担任过四所学校的校长职位。

questions.title: Folklore
questions.passage_html: Folklore, a modern term for the of traditional customs, superstitions, stories, dances, and songs that have been adopted and maintained within a given by processes of repetition is not reliant on the written word. Along with folk songs and folktales, this broad of cultural forms embraces all kinds of legends, riddles, jokes, proverbs, games, charms, omens, spells, and rituals, especially those of pre-literate societies or social classes. Those forms of verbal expression that are handed on from one generation or locality to the next by of mouth are said to constitute an oral .
questions.analysis_html:
1、 body

考点：固定搭配

解析：a body of 固定搭配,意为“一整套”。在单句语境中,用来对“民俗(folklore)”进行学术定义。

2、 community

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词作介词 within 的宾语。结合整篇关于民间文化代代口耳相传的上下文可知,这些民俗歌曲和故事是在一个特定的“社群/社区(community)”内部被长期继承和固守的。

3、 category

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,名词作主语的核心成分。根据单句层面的分类词义辨析可知,民间歌曲、民间传说以及谜语、笑话、谚语等,共同构成了文化表现形式中一个内涵极为宏大的“大类/范畴(category)”。

4、 word

考点：固定搭配

解析：by word of mouth固定搭配,意为“通过口口相传、通过口头表达”。在单句语境中,指代在前文字时代的社会中,知识完全依赖口头渠道相传。

5、 tradition

考点：固定搭配

解析：oral tradition 固定搭配,意为“口头传统/口承传统”。在单句语境中,作为本段结论,指出通过口头 handed on 的言语表达构成了人类宝贵的口头传统。

questions.title: Canadian Arctic
questions.passage_html: This summer, 41 UBC alumni and friends participated in expeditions to the Canadian Arctic and the legendary Northwest Passage. Presentations, conversations and learning accompanied their exploration of the great aboard the Russian-flagged Akademik Ioffe, designed and built in Finland as a scientific research vessel in 1989. Her bridge was open to passengers virtually 24 hours a day. Experts on presented on topics including climate change, wildlife, Inuit culture and history, and early European explorers. UBC professor Michael Byers presented on the issue of Arctic sovereignty, a cause of debate as ice melts, new shipping routes open, and natural resources accessible. Recommended pre-trip reading was late UBC alumnus Pierre Bertons book, The Arctic Grail.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 outdoors

考点：单句理解

解析：名词 outdoors(户外 / 野外)在此处指代极地探险的自然环境。单句表达他们在探索伟大的“【户外】”的同时,伴随着讲座和交流,这一用词准确勾勒了极地旅游的探险性质。

2、 board

考点：固定搭配

解析：名词 board 与介词 on 构成固定搭配 on board(在船上 / 在飞机上)。单句意为“船上的(on board)专家们就气候变化等话题进行了演讲”。

3、 growing

考点：单句理解

解析：形容词 growing(日益增长的)在此处修饰 debate(辩论)。逻辑线索在于“随着冰川融化、新航线开放”,关于北极主权的争议自然是“【日益增长的】”。

4、 become

考点：时态语态

解析：动词 become 在此充当从句谓语,与前文的时态保持一致。整句由 as 引导的并列短语构成(ice melts, new shipping routes open, and natural resources become...),动作均发生在当前背景下,故使用一般现在时。
questions.translation_html:
This summer, 41 UBC alumni and friends participated in expeditions to the Canadian Arctic and the legendary Northwest Passage.

今年夏天，不列颠哥伦比亚大学的41位校友及友人参加了前往加拿大北极地区和传奇的西北航道的探险活动。

Presentations, conversations and learning accompanied their exploration of the great outdoors aboard the Russian-flagged Akademik Ioffe, designed and built in Finland as a scientific research vessel in 1989.

他们乘坐悬挂俄罗斯国旗的“阿卡德米克·约费”号进行探索，在领略伟大户外风光的同时，还伴随有讲座、交流和学习活动。该船于1989年在芬兰设计并建造，原为一艘科学研究船。

Her bridge was open to passengers virtually 24 hours a day.

该船的驾驶室几乎全天24小时对乘客开放。

Experts on board presented on topics including climate change, wildlife, Inuit culture and history, and early European explorers.

船上的专家就气候变化、野生动物、因纽特文化与历史以及早期欧洲探险家等主题进行了演讲。

UBC professor Michael Byers presented on the issue of Arctic sovereignty, a growing cause of debate as ice melts, new shipping routes open, and natural resources become accessible.

不列颠哥伦比亚大学的迈克尔·拜尔斯教授就北极主权问题发表了演讲。随着冰川融化、新的航运路线开通以及自然资源变得可获取，这一问题正日益引发争论。

Recommended pre-trip reading was late UBC alumnus Pierre Berton's book, The Arctic Grail.

questions.title: EE and AVG
questions.passage_html: Currently, there is concern about the increasing amount of time children spend in sedentary activities, the number of children who fail to achieve daily physical activity guidelines (i.e. 60 min of moderate-to-vigorous intensity activities every day), and the apparent increase in obesity prevalence as a result of such sedentary . Screen-based activities, including television viewing and playing computer games, are of the most frequently observed sedentary activities that children partake with children spending 2.5‒4 h per day participating in such activities. The introduction of “active video games” (AVGs) into the gaming market presents an opportunity to convert traditional, sedentary screen-time into active screen-time and thus increases total daily energy expenditure (EE). Modern AVGs utilize cameras and motion sensors to allow the gamer to physically perform a variety of actions, dependent on the console, such as swinging a tennis racquet or running. The most demanding AVGs provided similar responses to walking and, based on international standards, should be classified as low-intensity activities. Whilst AVGs may provide children with a better alternative to sedentary gaming, they are not a sufficient for normal physical activity, e.g. sports and outdoor play.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 engaged

考点：固定搭配

解析：分词 engaged 与介词 in 构成经典固定搭配 be engaged in(从事于 / 忙于)。单句意为“人们担心儿童【从事】久坐不动活动的时间日益增加”。

2、 minimum

考点：单句理解

解析：名词 minimum(最低限度)在此处指代每日活动指南的底线要求。整句逻辑为:儿童未能达到每日【最低】身体活动指南(即每天60分钟的中高强度活动)的要求。

3、 behavior

考点：上下文语境

解析：名词 behavior(行为)在此处是对前文“久坐活动”的概括。单句指出由于这类久坐的“【行为】”,导致了肥胖症患病率的上升。

4、 part

考点：固定搭配

解析：短语 part of(......的一部分)在此处与最高级修饰语组合。单句表达电视和电脑游戏是儿童最常进行的久坐活动中的一部分。

5、 replacement

考点：单句理解

解析：名词 replacement(替代品)在此处表达AVGs与传统体育活动的关系。尽管AVGs比久坐游戏好,但它们并不能成为正常身体活动(如运动和户外游戏)的充分“【替代品】”。

目前，人们担忧以下几个方面：儿童从事久坐不动活动的时间日益增加，未能达到每日最低身体活动指南（即每天60分钟中高强度活动）要求的儿童数量，以及由这种久坐行为导致的肥胖率明显上升。

Screen-based activities, including television viewing and playing computer games, are part of the most frequently observed sedentary activities that children partake with children spending 2.5‒4 h per day participating in such activities.

现代活动视频游戏利用摄像头和运动传感器，让游戏者根据游戏机类型实际做出各种动作，例如挥动网球拍或奔跑。

强度最大的活动视频游戏所产生的身体反应与步行相似，根据国际标准，应被归类为低强度活动。

Whilst AVGs may provide children with a better alternative to sedentary gaming, they are not a sufficient replacement for normal physical activity, e.g. sports and outdoor play.

虽然活动视频游戏可能为儿童提供比久坐游戏更好的选择，但它们并不能充分替代正常的身体活动，例如体育运动和户外游戏。

questions.title: Fluid Behavior
questions.passage_html: If you see a movie, or a TV advertisement, that involves a fluid behaving in an unusual way, it was probably made using technology based on the work of a Monash researcher. Professor Joseph Monaghan who pioneered an influential for interpreting the behavior of liquids that underlies most special effects involving water has been with election to the Australian Academy of Sciences. Professor Monaghan, one of only 17 members elected in 2011, was recognized for developing the method of Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) which has applications in the fields of astrophysics, engineering and physiology, as well as movie special effects. His research started in 1977 when he tried to use computer to describe the formation of stars and stellar systems. The algorithms available at the time were of describing the complicated systems that evolve out of chaotic clouds of gas in the galaxy. Professor Monaghan, and his colleague Bob Gingold, took the novel and effective approach of replacing the fluid or gas in the simulation with large numbers of particles with properties that those of the fluid. SPH has become a central tool in astrophysics, where it is currently used to simulate the evolution of the universe after the Big Bang, the formation of stars, and the processes of planet building.
questions.analysis_html:
1、 method

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词被 pioneer(首创/开拓)所修饰。结合后文“被认可用于开发了光滑粒子流体动力学(SPH)这一......”的线索可知,莫纳什大学的研究员发明了一种用于诠释液体行为的高效“方法/通用模型(method)”。

2、 honored

考点：固定搭配

解析：has been honored with election to... 固定搭配,意为“因当选为......而荣膺奖项/获得殊荣”。在单句语境中,指代这位教授因其在液体行为技术领域的卓越贡献而荣膺当选为澳大利亚科学院院士。

3、 simulation

考点：固定搭配

解析：computer simulation 固定搭配,意为“计算机模拟/计算机仿真”。在单句语境中,指代他早在1977年便尝试使用计算机模拟来描述恒星系统的形成。

4、 incapable

考点：固定搭配

解析：be incapable of doing something 固定搭配,意为“没有能力做某事/无法做到某事”。在单句语境中,指代受限于时代,1977年时现有的计算机算法完全“没有能力”去描述银河系中那些极其复杂的演化系统。

5、 mimicked

考点：单句理解

解析：在单句语境中,动词充当由关系代词引导的定语从句的谓语。根据 SPH 技术的核心运行机制可知,该方法的精妙之处在于创新性地引入了海量的“粒子”来代替流体,而这些粒子的物理属性完美地“模拟了/仿效了(mimicked)”真实流体的特征。

questions.title: Fingerprints
questions.passage_html: Fingerprints can that a suspect was actually at the scene of a crime. As long as a human entered a crime scene, there will be traces of DNA. DNA can help the police to an individual to crack a case. An institute in London can help DNA and be used to match with the taken from the crime scenes.
questions.analysis_html:
1、prove

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作及物动词,宾语是一个宾语从句(that a suspect was actually at the scene of a crime)。指痕(Fingerprints)作为法医学上的硬核铁证,其作用不仅仅是展示,而是可以直接"证实/证明"嫌疑人确实去过犯罪现场,在单句内部逻辑下,prove(证明)最符合法律证据的确定性。

2、identify

考点:单句理解

解析: 前文提到警方会利用现场留下的 DNA 痕迹来破案(crack a case)。在单句内部的语境下,警方利用这些证据的核心目的,是为了"确认/识别(identify)"出具体的某个人(an individual),从而锁定嫌疑人。

3、preserve

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作动词原形。后文提到这些DNA会被用来与犯罪现场采集到的样本进行比对。既然要留作日后比对使用,那么该英国机构的核心职能就是负责把这些珍贵的DNA"保存/储存"起来。因此选用动词 preserve(保存/留存) 最符合单句的行为目的逻辑。

4、samples

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格后有后置定语 taken from the crime scenes(从犯罪现场带回来的......)。结合整篇文章都在讨论法医学(DNA、指纹、破案)的专业语境,警方从现场带回实验室进行比对的物质,在学术和专业语境下统称为"样本(samples)"。

DNA 可以帮助警方识别个人身份，从而侦破案件。

An institute in London can help preserve DNA and be used to match with the samples taken from the crime scenes.

questions.title: Tutankhamun
questions.passage_html: The last tourists may have been leaving the Valley of the Kings on the West Bank in Luxor but the area in front of the tomb of Tutankhamun remained far from deserted. Instead of the that usually descends on the area in the evening it was a hive of activity. TV crews trailed masses of equipment, journalists milled and photographers held their cameras at the ready. The reason? For the first time since Howard Carter the tomb in 1922 the mummy of Tutankhamun was being prepared for public display. Inside the subterranean burial chamber Egypt's archaeology supremo Zahi Hawass, by four Egyptologists, two restorers and three workmen, were slowly lifting the mummy from the golden sarcophagus where it has been rested -- mostly undisturbed -- for more than 3,000 years. The body was then placed on a wooden stretcher and to its new home, a high- tech, climate-controlled plexi-glass showcase located in the outer chamber of the tomb where, covered in linen, with only the face and feet exposed, it now greets visitors.
questions.analysis_html:
1、tranquillity

考点:上下文语境

解析: 空格位于 "Instead of the ______ that usually descends on the area in the evening..." 结构中。句中 Instead of(而不是......)构成了强烈的反义对照线索。后文提到"这里是一片繁忙的景象(a hive of activity),挤满了电视媒体、记者和摄影师",这说明往常傍晚该地区本应该迎来平静。因此选用名词 tranquillity(宁静/安静) 完美契合语境。

2、discovered

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格在时间状语从句中作谓语动词:"For the first time since Howard Carter ______ the tomb in 1922..."。根据历史常识与单句内部逻辑,考古学家霍华德·卡特在1922年对图坦卡蒙墓做出的核心历史事件是将其"发现"。因此选用动词过去式 discovered(发现)。

3、accompanied

考点:固定搭配

解析: 空格位于 "Egypt's archaeology supremo Zahi Hawass, ______ by four Egyptologists..." 结构中。在英语中,表达"在......的陪同下 / 由......陪同",习惯使用的是由过去分词构成的固定被动搭配 "be accompanied by..."(此处为过去分词短语作后置定语,省略了 who was)。

4、transported

考点:单句理解

解析: 空格作谓语动词,主语是木乃伊遗体(The body),后接介词短语 to its new home(去它的新家)。在单句内部的动作行为逻辑下,将遗体从原位置挪动到一个高科技的展示柜中,属于空间位置上的"运送/搬运",因此选用动词过去式 transported(运送/运输)。
questions.translation_html:
The last tourists may have been leaving the Valley of the Kings on the West Bank in Luxor but the area in front of the tomb of Tutankhamun remained far from deserted.

最后一批游客也许已经离开了卢克索西岸的帝王谷，但图坦卡蒙墓前的区域仍远非空无一人。

Instead of the tranquillity that usually descends on the area in the evening it was a hive of activity.

那里没有像往常傍晚那样归于宁静，反而是一片忙碌景象。

TV crews trailed masses of equipment, journalists milled and photographers held their cameras at the ready.

电视摄制组拖着大量设备，记者们来回穿梭，摄影师们端着相机随时准备拍摄。

The reason?

原因是什么？

For the first time since Howard Carter discovered the tomb in 1922 the mummy of Tutankhamun was being prepared for public display.

自霍华德·卡特于1922年发现这座陵墓以来，图坦卡蒙的木乃伊首次被准备公开展出。

Inside the subterranean burial chamber Egypt's archaeology supremo Zahi Hawass, accompanied by four Egyptologists, two restorers and three workmen, were slowly lifting the mummy from the golden sarcophagus where it has been rested -- mostly undisturbed -- for more than 3,000 years.

在地下墓室内，埃及考古界权威扎希·哈瓦斯在四名埃及学家、两名修复师和三名工人的陪同下，正缓慢地把这具木乃伊从金棺中抬出；它已在那里基本不受打扰地安放了三千多年。

The body was then placed on a wooden stretcher and transported to its new home, a high- tech, climate-controlled plexi-glass showcase located in the outer chamber of the tomb where, covered in linen, with only the face and feet exposed, it now greets visitors.

随后，遗体被放在木担架上，并运往它的新居：位于墓穴外室的一座高科技恒温有机玻璃展示柜；如今它身披亚麻布，只露出脸和脚，迎接参观者。

2、 broad

考点：并列结构

解析：在单句语境中,形容词与后面的 current(前沿的/时下的)通过连词 and 构成了直接的并列结构,共同修饰名词 education。结合前文涵盖了国家安全、边境控制等多项跨领域课题可知,课程旨在让学生获得“广泛的(broad)”且前沿的教育。

3、 options

考点：上下文语境

解析：在单句语境中,名词充当介词 of 的宾语。结合后文由 including 引导的“政治传播、国际研究、国际商务”等多门可供学生自主挑选的专业课程线索可知,此处填入“选择/选修项(options)”最符合高校选修大类的语境。

考点：固定搭配

5、 knowledge

考点：固定搭配

6、 responsible

考点：单句理解

解析：socially responsible意为“对社会负责的/具社会责任感的”。在单句语境中,作为定语来修饰学生们将要树立的处事态度与行为。
