blanks.explanation: 空格出现在“faces in the ______”结构中。前文多次提到 Harris 研究的是“illustration”（插画），此处使用复数名词 illustrations 概括了前文所述的各类手绘作品，使指代对象在该段落中保持统一。

blanks.label: 单句理解
blanks.explanation: 句子分析：“faces... have ______ at all”。从句意上看，作者在批评画作中脸部表情的僵化。此处需要一个名词与“at all”结合，表示“根本不存在”某种状态。expressions（表情）符合手绘人物僵硬姿态的逻辑批评。

blanks.label: 语法结构
blanks.explanation: 空格出现在“like an emperor's bust ______ on a Roman coin”结构中。这是一个省略了关系代词的被动语态后置定语（即：which is embossed on...）。embossed 采用过去分词形式，修饰 bust（半身像），符合英语语法中动词做后置定语的结构规律。

blanks.label: 上下文语境
blanks.explanation: 空格位于“on a Roman ______”结构中。前文类比的是“emperor's bust”（皇帝半身像）。根据常识逻辑与语境要求，这种肖像艺术通常镌刻在“钱币”（coin）上。这是一个通过语义关联完成的指代，将绘画艺术与历史实物紧密结合。

questions.title: American People
questions.passage_html: The American People: Creating a Nation and a Society examines U.S. history as revealed through the of all Americans, both ordinary and extraordinary. With a thought- provoking and rich presentation, the authors explore the complex lives of Americans of all national and cultural backgrounds, at all levels of society, and in all of the country.
questions.analysis_html:
1、experiences

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“revealed through the ______ of all Americans”结构中。本句的主旨是探讨美国历史，作者通过美国人的“生活经历”来展现历史，而非单纯的“事件（events）”或“信仰（beliefs）”。experiences（经历）一词最能涵盖普通人和非凡人物的人生历程，是叙述历史发展最全面的切入点。

2、origins

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“national ______ and cultural backgrounds”结构中。这里的 “and” 连接了两个并列的修饰词（national 和 cultural），共同修饰中心名词 “backgrounds”。既然 backgrounds 指代背景，那么 national 后面的词必须与 cultural 词性一致，且逻辑上要与 national 构成对背景的描述。origins（出身/起源）与 cultural backgrounds 在结构上并列，共同构成了对“个人背景”的完整描述。

3、regions

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“in all ______ of the country”结构中。前文已经列举了背景（national/cultural）和社会阶层（levels of society），此处逻辑上需要补充“地理分布”。regions（地区）是地理学名词，用于概括美国国土上的各个板块，使文章在社会、文化和地理三个维度上实现了完整覆盖。

作者以发人深省、内容丰富的方式，探讨了不同民族、不同文化背景、社会各阶层、全国各地区的美国人的复杂生活。

questions.title: Dog Emotion
questions.passage_html: Can dogs tell when we are happy, sad or angry? As a dog owner, I feel not only that I can tell what kind of state my pets are in, but also that they respond to my emotions. Yet as a hard-headed scientist, I try to take a more and pragmatic view. These observations seem more likely to result from my desire for a good relationship with my dogs.
questions.analysis_html:
1、confident

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“I feel ______ not only that...”结构中。作者作为狗主人，此处表达的是一种主观的心态，即对自己的判断力非常有把握。confident（确信的）在此处准确描述了这种主观心理状态，与其后文作为科学家必须保持的客观态度形成对比。

2、emotional

考点：上下文语境

解析：该空位于“what kind of ______ state my pets are in”结构中。我们需要联系上文提到的“happy, sad or angry”（快乐、悲伤或愤怒）。作者正是通过这些具体的、带有情绪特征的例子，反推狗所处的状态。因此，emotional（情绪的）这个词是根据上下文列举的例子总结出来的，是对前文语义的概括与回指。

3、rational

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于“take a more ______ and pragmatic view”结构中。句中使用了连接词“Yet”引出转折，将作者的身份从“狗主人”切换为“科学家”。与 pragmatic（务实的）并列，rational（理性的）体现了科学思维的核心特征，是对应“hard-headed scientist”（冷静务实的科学家）的最佳逻辑选择。

4、personal

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“These ______ observations...”结构中。作者分析认为，之所以感觉到狗能读懂情绪，很可能是源于自己内心对于建立良好人宠关系的渴望，而非客观事实。personal（个人的）强调了这种观察结果源于主观意愿，带有鲜明的个人情感偏向。

Yet as a hard-headed scientist, I try to take a more rational and pragmatic view.

然而，作为一名头脑冷静的科学家，我尝试采取更加理性和务实的观点。

These personal observations seem more likely to result from my desire for a good relationship with my dogs.

这些个人观察似乎更可能是由于我渴望与我的狗建立良好关系的结果。

questions.passage_html: Fingerprints can that a suspect was actually at the scene of a crime. As long as a human entered a crime scene, there will be traces of DNA. DNA can help the police to identify an individual to crack a case. An institute in London can help a DNA database and be used to match with the taken from the crime scenes.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. prove

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“Fingerprints can ______ that...”。prove 后接 that 从句，意为“证明”，句意是“指纹可以证明嫌疑人确实在犯罪现场”。其他选项中，reserve（保留/预订）和 maintain（维持/维护）虽可接 that 从句，但分别表示“保留说/声称”和“主张/维持”，均不符合“指纹作为证据”的语义；embody（体现）后接名词而非 that 从句。因此填 prove。

2. maintain

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“help ______ a DNA database”。maintain a database 是固定搭配，意为“维护/管理数据库”，句意是“伦敦的一家机构可以帮助维护DNA数据库”。reserve（保留/储备）与 database 搭配意为“预留数据库”，语义不通；embody（体现）与“数据库”搭配不当。因此填 maintain。

3. samples

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“match with the ______ taken from the crime scenes”。samples 意为“样本”，指从犯罪现场采集的DNA样本，与数据库中存储的样本进行匹配。句意是“与从犯罪现场采集的样本进行匹配”。evidence 意为“证据”，虽然DNA样本是证据的一种，但“从犯罪现场采集的证据”范围过宽，且与“DNA数据库匹配”的具体操作中常用 samples（样本）；reserve（储备）语义不符。因此填 samples。

questions.title: Linguistic Effects
questions.passage_html: An important corollary of this focus on language as the window to legal epistemology is the central role of to law and other sociocultural processes. In particular, the that people hold about how language works combine with linguistic structuring to create powerful, often unconscious effects. In recent years, anthropologists have made much progress in developing more precisely analytic for tracking those effects.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. discourse

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“central role of ______ to law”。discourse to law 可理解为“法律话语”或“与法律相关的话语”。discourse 指“话语/论述”，在法律认识论中，语言作为窗口，其核心是话语在法律及其他社会文化过程中的作用。speech 虽也指“言语”，但更多指口头表达，而 discourse 涵盖更广的书面和口头论述，与法律文本和语言分析更匹配。因此填 discourse。

2. ideas

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“the ______ that people hold about how language works”。hold ideas about 意为“持有关于……的观念/看法”，句意是“人们对语言运作方式所持有的观念”。facts 意为“事实”，但人们“持有的事实”搭配不当（应为 know facts）；“对语言运作持有的观念”强调主观认识而非客观事实。因此填 ideas。

3. linguistic

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“______ anthropologists”。linguistic anthropologists 是固定学科术语，意为“语言人类学家”。前文主题围绕语言与法律、语言运作方式，因此指语言人类学家的研究。speech 虽也与语言相关，但“speech anthropologists”不是标准学科术语。因此填 linguistic。

4. tools

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“analytic ______ for tracking those effects”。analytic tools 是固定搭配，意为“分析工具/分析手段”。句意是“语言人类学家在开发更精确的分析工具以追踪这些效应方面取得了很大进展”。implements 虽也指“工具/器具”，但更侧重于“器械/设备”，而 tools 在学术分析语境中更常用。因此填 tools。

An important corollary of this focus on language as the window to legal epistemology is the central role of discourse to law and other sociocultural processes.

In particular, the ideas that people hold about how language works combine with linguistic structuring to create powerful, often unconscious effects.

尤其是，人们对语言运作方式所持有的观念与语言结构相结合，产生了强大且往往无意识的影响。

In recent years, linguistic anthropologists have made much progress in developing more precisely analytic tools for tracking those effects.

近年来，语言人类学家在开发更精确的分析工具以追踪这些效应方面取得了很大进展。

questions.title: Complementary Therapies
questions.passage_html: Complementary therapies - such as those by naturopaths, chiropractors, and acupuncturists - have become increasingly popular in Australia over the last few . Interest initially coincided with for alternative lifestyles, while immigration and increased contact and trade with China have also had an . The status of complementary therapies is being re-visited in a number of areas: legal regulation; the stances of doctors' associations; their inclusion in medical education; and scientific research into their .
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. practiced

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“such as those ______ by naturopaths...”。those 指代 therapies（疗法），与 practice（实践/施行）之间为被动关系，用过去分词 practiced 作后置定语。句意是“由自然疗法师、脊椎按摩师和针灸师施行的补充疗法”。theorized 意为“理论化的”，虽可作过去分词，但疗法是由从业者“施行”而非“理论化”。因此填 practiced。

2. decades

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“over the last few ______”。over the last few decades 是固定搭配，意为“在过去的几十年里”。times 虽也可表示“时代”，但“last few times”意为“最近几次”，与“几十年”的时间跨度不符。因此填 decades。

3. enthusiasm

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“coincided with ______ for alternative lifestyles”。enthusiasm for 是固定搭配，意为“对……的热情/热衷”。句意是“最初的兴趣与对替代生活方式的热情同时出现”。affluence（富裕）虽可与 for 搭配，但“对富裕生活方式的热情”与替代生活方式（alternative lifestyles，通常指向非主流生活方式）逻辑上不太吻合——替代生活方式往往与反主流文化有关，而非富裕。因此填 enthusiasm。

4. influence

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“have also had an ______”。have an influence 是常见搭配，意为“有影响”。句意是“移民以及与中国日益增加的接触和贸易也产生了影响”。ambition（雄心/抱负）与 have an 搭配为“有抱负”，语义不符。因此填 influence。

5. efficacy

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“scientific research into their ______”。efficacy 意为“功效/疗效”，指对补充疗法疗效的科学研究。句意是“对其疗效的科学研究”。field（领域）与“研究其领域”搭配不当；ambition（抱负）和 affluence（富裕）均不符合。因此填 efficacy。

questions.title: Moth
questions.passage_html: Why are moths fatally attracted to the light? is the old glib theory that the moths are trying to use the flame to navigate. does not tell us, , why it is that in many species only males are thus attracted, and in a few, only females. , if moths need to navigate, they must be from a migrating species. most of the time such moths are not migrating. Indeed most species do not migrate at all and thus have no need of navigation.
questions.analysis_html:
1、One solution

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于文章开头，第一句提出问题“Why are moths fatally attracted to the light?”，后文需要给出一个解释或答案。下文提到 the old glib theory（老套的花言巧语的理论），说明这是在提出一个可能的解答。因此填 One solution，表示“一个解决方案/解释”。

2、This explanation

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格所在句“______ does not tell us...”是对前一句提到的 the old glib theory（即 One solution）的回应。前文提出了一种解释，此处指出这种解释未能说明的问题，用 This explanation 指代前文提到的理论，形成上下文的逻辑衔接。因此填 This explanation。

3、however

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格位于“does not tell us, ______, why it is that...”，前后句之间存在转折关系。前文提出了一种解释，此处指出这种解释有不足之处，然而它并未告诉我们某些现象的原因。however 表示转折，符合此处语义逻辑。因此填 however。

4、What's more

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格位于“______, if moths need to navigate, they must be from a migrating species.” 前文已指出该解释未能解释为何不同性别被吸引的情况不同，此处进一步提出另一个漏洞：如果该解释成立，那么这些飞蛾必须是迁徙物种。What's more 表示递进关系，意为“更有甚者/此外”，引出进一步的质疑。因此填 What's more。

5、Yet

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格位于“______ most of the time such moths are not migrating.” 前句提到按照该解释飞蛾必须是迁徙物种，本句指出大多数时候这些飞蛾并不迁徙，与前句形成转折关系。Yet 表示转折，意为“然而”，符合逻辑。因此填 Yet。

One solution is the old glib theory that the moths are trying to use the flame to navigate.

有一种解释是,⻜蛾试图用火焰来导航,这是一个老而圆滑的理论。

This explanation does not tell us, however, why it is that in many species only males are thus attracted, and in a few, only females.

然而,这种解释并没有告诉我们,为什么在许多物种中,只有雄性会被如此吸

引,而在少数物种中,只有雌性会被吸引。

What's more, if moths need to navigate, they must be from a migrating species.

Yet most of the time such moths are not migrating.

然而,大多数时候,这样的⻜蛾并没有迁徙。

Indeed most species do not migrate at all and thus have no need of navigation.

事实上,大多数物种根本不会迁移,因此不需要导航。

questions.title: Paris
questions.passage_html: Paris is very old — there has been a settlement there for at least 6,000 years and its shape has been determined in by the River Seine, and in part by the edicts of France' s rulers. But the great boulevards we admire today are relatively new, and were constructed to prevent any more barricades being by the rebellious population; that work was carried out in the middle 19th century. The earlier Paris had been in part a maze of narrow streets and alleyways. But you can imagine that the work was not only highly expensive, but caused great distress among the half a million or so whose houses were razed, and whose neighborhoods disappeared. What is done cannot usually be undone, especially when buildings are torn .
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. part

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“in ______ by the River Seine, and in part by the edicts”。in part 是固定搭配，意为“部分地”。此处与后文“and in part”形成并列结构，共同说明巴黎形态的成因——部分由塞纳河决定，部分由法国统治者的法令决定。因此填 part。

2. created

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“prevent any more barricades being ______”。barricades 与 create 之间为被动关系，being created 为被动语态，意为“街垒被筑起”。句意是“防止反抗民众再筑起街垒”。因此填 created。

3. simply

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“whose houses were ______ razed”。simply 意为“完全地/彻底地”，此处修饰 razed，强调房屋被“彻底”夷为平地。句意是“大约五十万人的房屋被彻底夷为平地”。因此填 simply。

4. down

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“torn ______”。torn down 是固定搭配，意为“拆除/推倒”，指建筑被拆毁。句意是“尤其是当建筑物被拆除时”。因此填 down。

But the great boulevards we admire today are relatively new, and were constructed to prevent any more barricades being created by the rebellious population; that work was carried out in the middle 19th century.

但我们今天所欣赏的那些宽阔大道相对较新，它们是为了防止反抗民众再筑起街垒而修建的；这项工程于19世纪中叶进行。

但你可以想象，这项工程不仅耗资巨大，还给大约五十万房屋被彻底夷为平地、社区随之消失的人们带来了巨大的痛苦。

What is done cannot usually be undone, especially when buildings are torn down.

做过的事通常无法挽回，尤其是当建筑物被拆除时。

questions.title: Air Moving
questions.passage_html: Wind is air moving around. Some winds can move as fast a racing car, over 100 miles per . Winds travel around the world. Wind can make you feel cold because you lose heat from your body when it is windy. Weather forecasters need know the speed and direction of the wind. The strength of wind is measured using the Beaufort scale from wind force 0 when there is no wind, to wind force 12 which can damage houses and buildings and is called hurricane force.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

根据您给定的8大官方考点红线，现将本篇题目进行绝对精准的分类与纯粹解析：

1、as

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于 “move as fast ______ a racing car” 结构中。本句在形容某些强风的速度极其惊人，快得就像赛车一样。在英语中，表达“和……一样（快/慢/好）”，其标准的同级比较固定搭配为 “as + 形容词/副词 + as”。

2、hour

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于 “over 100 miles per ______” 结构中。本句在描述风速的计量单位。在英语基本常识和日常计量中，表达时速（每小时多少英里），标准的固定短语搭配为 “miles per hour”（常缩写为 mph）。

3、can

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作情态动词，后接动词原形 travel around the world。本句在陈述一个关于风的客观自然能力：某些风【能够/可以】环绕地球移动。在单句内部的语义逻辑下，选用表示能力的轻度情态动词 can（能够） 最符合客观事实陈述。

4、faster

考点：上下文语境

解析： 空格位于 “you lose heat from your body ______ when it is windy” 结构中。前文提到“风会让你感到寒冷”，这里在解释其背后的物理原因：因为当刮风的时候，你身体散热的速度会变得【更快】。结合常识与前文带来的“寒冷感”因果语境，选用副词比较级 faster（更快地） 最契合语境。

5、to

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于 “Weather forecasters need ______ know...” 结构中。本句主语是气象预报员，谓语是动词 need。在英语习惯用法中，表达“需要去做某事”，need 后接动词不定式构成标准的固定搭配 “need to do sth”（注：原题给出的答案为 do，但在该句型中，标准官方真题的实际空格处应填入不定式符号 to 作为固定结构）。

The strength of wind is measured using the Beaufort scale from wind force 0 when there is no wind, to wind force 12 which can damage houses and buildings and is called hurricane force.

questions.title: Shakespeare's Work
questions.passage_html: Shakespeare produced most of his between 1589 and 1613. His early plays were comedies and histories - he raised to the peak of sophistication and artistry by the end of the 16th century. He then wrote tragedies until about 1608, including Hamlet, King Lear, Othello, and Macbeth, considered some of the finest in the English language. In his last phase, he wrote tragicomedies, also known as romances, and with other playwrights.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. work

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“produced most of his ______”。produce one's work 是常见搭配，意为“创作某人的作品”。句意是“莎士比亚在1589年至1613年间创作了他大部分的作品”。actors 意为“演员”，莎士比亚是剧作家而非演员，不能 produce actors（培养演员）。因此填 work。

2. genres

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“comedies and histories - ______ he raised to the peak”。genres 意为“体裁/类型”，指代前文的 comedies and histories（喜剧和历史剧）这两种戏剧体裁。句意是“他的早期作品是喜剧和历史剧——到16世纪末他将这些体裁提升到了成熟和艺术性的巅峰”。actors（演员）和 philosophy（哲学）均不能指代“喜剧和历史剧”这一类别。因此填 genres。

3. examples

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“considered some of the finest ______ in the English language”。examples 意为“典范/范例”，指 Hamlet、King Lear 等悲剧被认为是英语语言中最优秀的典范之作。句意是“包括《哈姆雷特》《李尔王》《奥赛罗》和《麦克白》，这些被认为是英语语言中最优秀的典范”。philosophy（哲学）和 actors（演员）均不符合。因此填 examples。

4. collaborated

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“and ______ with other playwrights”。collaborated with 是固定搭配，意为“与……合作”。句意是“在最后阶段，他写了悲喜剧（也称为传奇剧），并与其他剧作家合作”。designed with 意为“与……一起设计”，虽可搭配但语义上“设计剧本”不如“合作创作”贴切。因此填 collaborated。

questions.title: Lithium
questions.passage_html: The lightest of any solid element, lithium has, until now, played a role in industry. Silvery in color, and softer than lead, it has been used mainly as an alloy of aluminum, a base for automobile grease, and in the of glass and ceramics. It is so that it is never found in its pure form in nature. Lithium floats on water ― or, , it skitters wildly about, trailing a vapor cloud of hydrogen, it dissolves.
questions.analysis_html:
1、modest

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰“role in industry”。文中描述锂在工业中的历史地位，即“played a ______ role”。鉴于后文提到它主要作为铝合金或润滑脂基料，其角色相对基础，而非主导，modest（适度的/有限的）准确界定了其在工业中的定位。

2、production

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“in the ______ of glass and ceramics”结构中。锂是制造玻璃和陶瓷的重要原料，此处考查工业生产领域名词，production（生产）是最符合工业应用场景的词汇。

3、unstable

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“It is so ______ that it is never found in its pure form in nature”结构中。因为锂化学性质极活泼，在自然界中极易发生反应，无法以纯态存在，unstable（不稳定的）是对其化学性质的专业概括。

4、rather

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于“or, ______ , it skitters wildly about”结构中。作者在此处对前文的描述（浮在水面上）进行了精确化修正，即“或者说，更确切地讲”。rather 在此起到逻辑校正的作用。

5、until

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于“trailing a vapor cloud... ______ it dissolves”结构中。这描述了化学反应的时间过程，锂在水中剧烈反应，这一状态持续的终点就是其“溶解”的时刻。until 引导时间状语从句，界定动作的截止时间。

The lightest of any solid element, lithium has, until now, played a modest role in industry.

锂是所有固体元素中最轻的，迄今为止，它在工业中发挥的作用并不大。

Silvery in color, and softer than lead, it has been used mainly as an alloy of aluminum, a base for automobile grease, and in the production of glass and ceramics.

它呈银色，比铅软，主要用作铝合金、汽车润滑脂的基质以及玻璃和陶瓷的生产。

It is so unstable that it is never found in its pure form in nature.

它是如此不稳定，以至于在自然界中从未发现过它的纯净形式。

Lithium floats on water ― or, rather, it skitters wildly about, trailing a vapor cloud of hydrogen, until it dissolves.

锂漂浮在水面上——或者更确切地说，它在水中疯狂地游动，尾随氢蒸气云，直到溶解。

questions.passage_html: Memories can become scrambled, sometimes in the process of attempting to something. You might relate a story to a friend but include some mistaken details. 考点:单句理解

解析:句子说回忆可能会变得支离破碎,有时甚至是在试图回忆某事的过程中。retrieve 表示“提取/找回”,符合该句语境,因此填 `retrieve`。

3、episode

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说后来,当你试图回忆这个情节时,你可能会遇到关于支离破碎的回忆尝试的记忆,而不是你原来的记忆。episode 表示“事件”,符合该句语境,因此填 `episode`。

questions.title: Physical Activity
questions.passage_html: Participating regularly in physical activity has been shown to benefit an individual's health and . Regular activity is important in reducing the risk of diseases, such as heart disease and stroke, obesity, diabetes and some forms of cancer. The National Physical Activity Guidelines for Adults at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity, every day of the week, to health benefits.
questions.analysis_html:
1、wellbeing

考点:并列结构

解析:这里看并列关系:`... and/or wellbeing` 在词性和语义上保持一致。原句相关表达是“in physical activity has been shown to benefit an individual's health and wellbeing . Regular physical activity is important in reducing the risk of chronic”,填 `wellbeing` 后,并列结构完整。

2、physical

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说定期体育活动对于降低慢性疾病的⻛险非常重要,如心脏病和中⻛,肥胖,糖尿病和一些形式的癌症。physical activity 表示“体育活动”,符合该句语境,因此填 `physical`。

3、chronic

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说定期体育活动对于降低慢性疾病的⻛险非常重要,如心脏病和中⻛,肥胖,糖尿病和一些形式的癌症。chronic diseases 表示“慢性疾病”,符合该句语境,因此填 `chronic`。

4、recommends

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说《成人国家体育活动指南》建议,为了获得健康效益,每周至少进行30分钟中等强度的体育活动,最好每天进行。recommends at least 30 minutes 表示“建议至少 30 分钟”,符合该句语境,因此填 `recommends`。

5、preferably

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说《成人国家体育活动指南》建议,为了获得健康效益,每周至少进行30分钟中等强度的体育活动,最好每天进行。preferably every day 表示“最好每天”,符合该句语境,因此填 `preferably`。

questions.title: Coffee
questions.passage_html: Coffee is enjoyed by millions of people every day and the 'coffee experience' has become a staple of our modern life and . While the current body of research related to the effects of coffee on human health has been contradictory, a study in the June issue of Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety, which is published by the Institute of Food Technologists (IFT), found that the potential of moderate coffee drinking outweigh the risks in adult consumers for the majority of major health considered.
questions.analysis_html:
1、culture

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“modern life and ______”结构中。这里的 “and” 连接了两个抽象名词（life 和 culture），共同作为“modern”的修饰对象。根据并列结构中词性与语义层级的一致性要求，culture 与 life 处于同一语义范畴，共同定义了咖啡在现代社会中的地位。因此填 culture。

2、consumption

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“effects of coffee ______ on human health”结构中。此处指代咖啡的饮用行为。consumption（消费/饮用）是描述食品或饮品摄入的标准名词。

3、benefits

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“potential ______ ... outweigh the risks”结构中。后文提到风险（risks），那么空格处对应的必然是其反面，即“益处”。benefits（益处）与 risks（风险）在此构成了标准的对立比较逻辑。

4、outcomes

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“majority of major health ______ considered”结构中。文中讨论的是健康研究，指代研究考虑的健康结果或结局。outcomes（结果）是医学和科学研究中描述健康评价指标的专业术语。
questions.translation_html:
Coffee is enjoyed by millions of people every day and the 'coffee experience' has become a staple of our modern life and culture.

每天都有数百万人享用咖啡，“咖啡体验”已成为我们现代生活和文化的主要内容。

While the current body of research related to the effects of coffee consumption on human health has been contradictory, a study in the June issue of Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety, which is published by the Institute of Food Technologists (IFT), found that the potential benefits of moderate coffee drinking outweigh the risks in adult consumers for the majority of major health outcomes considered.

虽然目前有关咖啡消费对人类健康影响的研究一直存在矛盾，但食品科技协会 (IFT) 出版的《食品科学与食品安全综合评论》6 月号上的一项研究发现，就大多数主要健康结果而言，适量饮用咖啡的潜在益处超过了成年消费者的风险。

questions.passage_html: Dance has played an important role in many musicals. In some dance numbers are included as an excuse to add to the color and spectacle of the show, but dance is more effective when it forms an integral part of the . An early example is Richard Rodgers On Your Toes(1936) in which the story about classical ballet meeting the world of jazz enabled dance to be introduced in a way that , rather than interrupted, the drama.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. cases

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“In some ______”。in some cases 是固定搭配，意为“在某些情况下”。句意是“在某些情况下，舞蹈段落被加入作为增添节目色彩和壮观场面的借口”。其他选项中，plot（情节）、itineraries（行程）、judgement（判断）均不能与 in some 构成固定搭配。因此填 cases。

2. plot

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“forms an integral part of the ______”。plot 意为“情节”，指舞蹈如果成为戏剧情节的有机组成部分，就会更有效。句意是“当舞蹈形成情节不可分割的一部分时，它会更有效”。其他选项中，itineraries（行程）和 judgement（判断）与戏剧表演无关。因此填 plot。

3. enhanced

考点： 并列结构

解析： 空格位于“introduced in a way that ______, rather than interrupted, the drama”。enhanced 与 interrupted 形成对比并列关系，由 rather than 连接。enhanced 意为“增强/提升”，表示舞蹈“增强”而非“打断”了戏剧。其他选项中，punctuated（强调/插入）虽可与 drama 搭配，但与 interrupted 对比不如 enhanced 精准——punctuated 强调“不时打断以作强调”，与“打断”的界限模糊；enhanced 明确表示“增强戏剧效果”，与 interrupted 形成清晰对比。因此填 enhanced。
questions.translation_html:
Dance has played an important role in many musicals.

舞蹈在许多音乐剧中扮演了重要角色。

In some cases dance numbers are included as an excuse to add to the color and spectacle of the show, but dance is more effective when it forms an integral part of the plot.

在某些情况下，舞蹈段落被加入作为增添节目色彩和壮观场面的借口，但当舞蹈形成情节不可分割的一部分时，它会更有效。

An early example is Richard Rodgers' On Your Toes (1936) in which the story about classical ballet meeting the world of jazz enabled dance to be introduced in a way that enhanced, rather than interrupted, the drama.

一个早期的例子是理查德·罗杰斯的《脚尖上》（1936年），其中古典芭蕾与爵士乐世界相遇的故事使舞蹈能够以增强而非打断戏剧的方式被引入。

questions.title: Alpine Newt
questions.passage_html: The Alpine Newt is native to much of central, continental Europe and up the coasts of northeast France through to Holland. But it does not to have been native to the British Isles. As its name it can be found in montane habitats up to 2,500 metres in altitude but it can also be abundant in lowlands, and it will use a of waterbodies including both shallow and deep ponds and slow flowing streams.
questions.analysis_html:
1、occurs

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“______ up the coasts of northeast France”。本句内部语义完整：高山蝾螈“分布于”法国东北部沿海至荷兰一带。仅凭本句即可判断需要表示“存在/分布”的词。因此填 occurs。

2、appear

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“does not ______ to have been native”。appear to be 是固定搭配，意为“似乎是/看起来是”。表示高山蝾螈似乎并非原产于不列颠群岛。因此填 appear。

3、suggests

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“as its name ______”，as the name suggests 是固定表达，意为“顾名思义”。表示顾名思义，它可以被发现于山地栖息地。因此填 suggests。

4、variety

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“a ______ of waterbodies”，a variety of 是固定搭配，意为“各种各样的”。表示它会利用各种各样的水体。因此填 variety

Alpine Newt is native to much of central, continental Europe and occurs up the coasts of northeast France through to Holland.

高山新蛙原产于欧洲大陆中部大部分地区,沿法国东北部海岸至荷兰都有分布。

But it does not appear to have been native to the British Isles.

但似乎它不是英国群岛的本土物种。

As its name suggests it can be found in montane habitats up to 2,500 metres in altitude but it can also be abundant in lowlands, and it will use a variety of waterbodies including both shallow and deep ponds and slow flowing streams.

正如其名,它被发现于海拔高达2500米的山地栖息地,但在低地也很丰富,会

使用各种水体,包括浅池塘、深池塘和缓慢流动的溪流。

questions.passage_html: When humans began farming some 12,000 years ago, they altered the future of our forever. Our ancestors were ecological , discovering and cultivating the most crops, scaling them up to feed entire communities and transforming wild crops so fundamentally that they became dependent on humans for their survival. Farming, in the words of National Geographic's Genographic Project, 'sowed the seeds for the modern .'
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. species

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“altered the future of our ______ forever”。species 意为“物种”，指人类改变了自己物种的未来。句意是“当人类在大约12,000年前开始农耕时，他们永远改变了自己物种的未来”。clan 意为“氏族/宗族”，范围过窄，而 species 涵盖全人类。因此填 species。

2. pioneers

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“Our ancestors were ecological ______”。pioneers 意为“先驱/开拓者”，指我们的祖先在生态农业方面是开拓者。句意是“我们的祖先是生态开拓者”。trainees 意为“受训者/实习生”，与祖先作为开创者的角色不符。因此填 pioneers。

3. valuable

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“discovering and cultivating the most ______ crops”。valuable 意为“有价值的/珍贵的”，修饰 crops，指发现并培育最有价值的农作物。lucrative 意为“利润丰厚的”，更强调经济利益，而 valuable 更全面地涵盖“价值”包括营养价值、适应性强等多方面。因此填 valuable。

4. age

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“sowed the seeds for the modern ______”。modern age 是固定搭配，意为“现代/现代时代”。句意是“为现代播下了种子”。clan 意为“氏族”，与“现代”搭配不通。因此填 age。
questions.translation_html:
When humans began farming some 12,000 years ago, they altered the future of our species forever.

当人类在大约12,000年前开始农耕时，他们永远改变了自己物种的未来。

Our ancestors were ecological pioneers, discovering and cultivating the most valuable crops, scaling them up to feed entire communities and transforming wild crops so fundamentally that they became dependent on humans for their survival.

我们的祖先是生态开拓者，他们发现并培育了最有价值的农作物，将其规模化以供养整个社区，并且对野生作物进行了根本性的改造，以致它们变得依赖人类才能生存。

Farming, in the words of National Geographic's Genographic Project, 'sowed the seeds for the modern age.'

用国家地理基因地理项目的话来说，农耕“为现代播下了种子”。

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“leading to new ______ effectively shared”结构中。研究的本质在于通过调查获得新的发现或洞察。insights（洞察/见解）是对研究成果最贴切的学术定义。

2、purpose

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“central to the ______ of any university”结构中。大学的核心职能即为研究与教学，研究是大学存在的“目的/宗旨”之一。purpose（目的）在此处定义了研究对于大学的重要性。

3、experts

4、discipline

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“appropriate to their ______ and level”结构中。教师的学术水平应当与其所处的“学科”相匹配。discipline（学科/专业）是学术研究中指代专业领域的核心名词。

考点：上下文语境

Research is a process of investigation leading to new insights effectively shared and is central to the purpose of any university.

Students have the right to be taught by acknowledged experts in their field, which requires that staff members operate at the most advanced level appropriate to their discipline and level.

学生有权由其领域公认的专家授课，这要求教职员工以适合其学科和水平的最先进水平进行操作。

Research is, therefore, crucial to a positive student experience from further education to doctoral development.

因此，研究对于学生从继续教育到博士发展的积极体验至关重要。

questions.title: Tree and City
questions.passage_html: A new report by environmental The Nature Conservancy lays out how trees could pave the way to cleaner air and cooler cities. Using information on forest cover paired with air pollution data and population for 245 cities, researchers found that trees have the biggest health in densely populated, polluted cities like Delhi, Karachi and Dhaka. The Conservancy and the C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group presented the findings of their global survey this week at the American Public Health Association meeting in Denver, Colorado.
questions.analysis_html:
1、nonprofit

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰“The Nature Conservancy”。Nature Conservancy 作为一个国际环境保护组织，其性质为非营利性。nonprofit（非营利的）准确界定了该组织的社会属性。

2、geospatial

考点：上下文语境

解析：文中提到“forest cover”（森林覆盖）与“air pollution data”（空气污染数据）的配对分析，这是典型的空间数据分析手段。geospatial（地理空间的）是描述此类利用地理信息系统处理森林与环境数据研究的专业术语。

3、forecasts

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“population ______ for 245 cities”结构中。研究需要基于人口数据进行分析，在预测城市未来健康影响时，通常使用人口统计及“预测值”。forecasts（预测）符合研究报告基于数据进行前瞻性分析的语境。

4、payoffs

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“biggest health ______ in densely populated... cities”结构中。研究探讨的是种树带来的环境效益，即通过改善空气质量实现的健康“回报”。payoffs（回报/收益）在此处是对树木环境价值的定量评估。
questions.translation_html:
A new report by environmental nonprofit The Nature Conservancy lays out how trees could pave the way to cleaner air and cooler cities.

环境非营利组织大自然保护协会的一份新报告阐述了树木如何为更清洁的空气和更凉爽的城市铺平道路。

Using geospatial information on forest cover paired with air pollution data and population forecasts for 245 cities, researchers found that trees have the biggest health payoffs in densely populated, polluted cities like Delhi, Karachi and Dhaka.

研究人员利用森林覆盖的地理空间信息、空气污染数据和 245 个城市的人口预测，发现在德里、卡拉奇和达卡等人口稠密、污染严重的城市，树木的健康效益最大。

questions.title: Private School
questions.passage_html: Private schools in the UK are redoubling their marketing efforts to foreigners. Almost a third of the 68,000 boarding pupils at such schools come from overseas. But now, with many UK residents or unable to afford the fees and a cultural away from boarding, many schools are looking abroad to survive. 1、already

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“Almost a third of the 68,000 boarding pupils at such schools ______ come from overseas”。前一句提到英国私立学校正在加大对海外学生的营销力度，本句进一步说明现状：这类学校中近三分之一的学生“已经”来自海外。already 表示“已经”，强调这一趋势已经存在，与后文“now”形成时间上的呼应，说明在当前加大营销力度之前，海外生源已占相当比例。因此填 already。

2、unwilling

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“with many UK residents ______ or unable to afford the fees”。unwilling 和 unable 由 or 连接，构成并列结构，共同说明英国居民无法或不愿送孩子入读私立学校的原因。unwilling 意为“不愿意的”，与 unable（没能力的）形成语义上的并列，共同解释为什么学校要转向海外招生。因此填 unwilling。

3、shift

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“a cultural ______ away from boarding”，cultural shift 是常见搭配，意为“文化转变/文化变迁”。表示英国社会出现了远离寄宿教育的文化转变，这也是学校转向海外招生的原因之一。因此填 shift。

解析：空格位于“Overseas students now ______ for about 500m pounds of fee income”，account for 是固定搭配，在此处意为“占（比例/份额）”。表示海外学生现在每年为英国寄宿学校贡献约5亿英镑的学费收入。因此填 account。

questions.analysis_html:

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于“get even more difficult ______ climate change”结构中。此处表达因果关系，说明气候变化导致了天气预测变得更加困难。thanks to（由于，此处表示原因）起到了连接原因的作用，将前后的因果链条串联起来。

2、exactly

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“no one is sure ______ what its effects will be”结构中。此处强调“完全确定”某种效果，exactly（确切地）作为副词修饰 unsure 的程度，表达人们对于气候变化后果的不确定性。

3、such as

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“extreme weather conditions, ______ storms and hurricanes”结构中。 “storms and hurricanes”属于“extreme weather conditions”的一部分，是其具体的例子，所以填写“such as”

4、likely to

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“are ______ become more common”结构中。语法上此处需要一个结构来修饰谓语动词 become。likely to（很可能）构成形容词短语，作为表语修饰主语并引导后文动词，符合英语语法中表示概率的结构。

questions.passage_html: With the increase in women's in the labor force, many mothers have less time to undertake domestic activities. At the same time, there has been increasing that the father's with a child is important. A father can have many in the family, ranging from income provider to teacher, carer, and playmate. questions.analysis_html:
1、participation

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“increase in women‘s ______ in the labor force”，前文“increase”和后文“labor force”共同提示需要表示“参与”的名词。且下文提到“many mothers have less time”，与女性参与劳动市场后时间减少形成逻辑呼应。因此填 participation。

2、available

考点:固定搭配

解析:“have less time ______ to undertake domestic activities”中，time available to do sth. 是固定搭配，表示“有可用的时间做某事”。形容词 available 作后置定语修饰 time，使句意完整。因此填 available。

3、recognition

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“there has been increasing ______ that the father’s relationship with a child is important”。此处为“there has been increasing + 名词 + that 从句”结构，that 引导同位语从句，解释说明名词的具体内容。能接 that 同位语从句的名词如 recognition（认识）、belief、fact 等，符合语法要求。因此填 recognition。

questions.passage_html: At the end of the last ice age, the melting ice disrupted the ocean currents in the North Atlantic and a drop in temperature of almost 5 degrees. Even the rest of the planet was warming ,the North Atlantic region remained in a cold period for 1300 years. questions.analysis_html:
1、caused

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“disrupted the ocean currents... and ______ a drop in temperature”，cause a drop in temperature 是常见搭配，意为“导致温度下降”。表示融冰扰乱了洋流并导致温度下降了近5度。因此填 caused。

2、though

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格位于“Even ______ the rest of the planet was warming...”，Even though 是固定搭配，意为“尽管/即使”，引导让步状语从句。表示尽管地球其他地区正在变暖，但北大西洋地区仍然保持了1300年的寒冷期。因此填 though。

3、up

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“warming ______”，warm up 是固定搭配，意为“变暖”。表示地球其他地区正在变暖。因此填 up。

4、around

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“happened ______ 8000 years ago”，around 8000 years ago 是常见表达，意为“大约8000年前”。表示大约8000年前同样的事情发生了。因此填 around。

5、could

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“and it ______ happen again today”，此处表示可能性。could 表示“可能”，符合语境，意为今天同样的事情“可能”再次发生。因此填 could。

questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. society

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“connected with political ______”。political society 是固定搭配，意为“政治社会/政界”。句意是“大学总是与政治社会联系在一起”。parties 虽也常与 political 搭配，但“political parties”（政党）是具体组织，而此处 universities 与 broader “political society”（政治社会）的关联更为贴切。因此填 society。

2. debate

考点： 并列结构

解析： 空格位于“a forum for ______ and for discussion”。debate and discussion 构成并列结构，意为“辩论和讨论”。句意是“学生会为辩论和讨论提供了论坛”。complaints（投诉）与 discussion 并列虽可接受，但“辩论”更符合学生会作为思想交锋场所的典型功能；agreement（一致/协议）与 discussion 并列不自然。因此填 debate。

3. accommodation

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“The ______ in which students want to live”。accommodation 意为“住所/住宿”，指学生想要居住的住所环境。句意是“学生想要居住的住所应反映他们的理想”。district 意为“地区/区域”，范围过大（不是整个“区”，而是具体的“住处”）。因此填 accommodation。

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“reflects their ______”。ideals 意为“理想”，指学生的居住环境反映他们的理想和价值观。句意是“学生想要居住的住所应反映他们的理想”。complaints（投诉）和 agreement（一致）均不符合“居住环境反映什么”的合理逻辑。因此填 ideals。

1、role

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说研讨课不是小型讲座,它的教育作用是让学生讨论课程中有趣和困难的内容。educational role 表示“教育作用”,符合该句语境,因此填 `role`。

questions.title: Egyptian Music
questions.passage_html: Music was as important to the ancient Egyptians as it is in our modern society. Although it is thought that music played a throughout the history of Egypt, those that study the Egyptian writings have discovered that music to become more important in what is called the 'pharaonic' of their history. This was the time when the Egyptian dynasties of the pharaohs were and music was found in many parts of everyday Egyptian life.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. role

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“music played a ______”。play a role 是固定搭配，意为“发挥作用”。句意是“尽管音乐被认为在埃及的整个历史中发挥了作用”。其他选项中，rank（等级/排名）和 need（需要）均不能构成 play a... 的固定搭配。因此填 role。

2. seemed

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“music ______ to become more important”。seemed to become 意为“似乎变得”，表示音乐在法老时期似乎变得更加重要。句意是“研究埃及文字的人们发现，音乐在他们历史上所谓的‘法老’时期似乎变得更加重要”。showed 虽也可接 to，但“showed to become”意为“被显示变得”，逻辑上不如 seemed 自然——音乐本身“似乎”变得更重要，而非被“展示”为更重要的。因此填 seemed。

3. period

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“in what is called the 'pharaonic' ______ of their history”。period 意为“时期”，指历史上被称为“法老”的时期。前句提到“throughout the history”，后文“This was the time”进一步确认此处指一段“时期”。history 虽也可与 pharaonic 搭配，但“pharaonic history”意为“法老历史”，而此处强调的是“法老时期”（特定时间段），与后文“This was the time”呼应更紧密。因此填 period。

4. established

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“the Egyptian dynasties of the pharaohs were ______”。established 意为“建立/确立”，指法老的埃及王朝被建立起来。句意是“这是埃及法老王朝建立的时期”。其他选项中，need（需要）、rank（等级）和 space（空间）均不能作 were 的表语。因此填 established。

音乐对古埃及人的重要性不亚于它在现代社会中的重要性。

This was the time when the Egyptian dynasties of the pharaohs were established and music was found in many parts of everyday Egyptian life.

这是埃及法老王朝建立的时期，音乐出现在古埃及人日常生活的许多方面。

questions.title: GM Corn
questions.passage_html: Almost no one regards corn with suspicion. But the can't be said for humans' ingenious ability to engineer the plants we eat. questions.analysis_html:
1、same

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“But the ______ can't be said for...”，the same can't be said for... 是固定表达，意为“但同样的说法不适用于……”。前句说几乎没有人用怀疑的眼光看待玉米，本句转折指出但同样的话不能用于人类改造植物的能力。因此填 same。

2、such

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“viewed with ______ hostility that...”，such...that... 是固定搭配，意为“如此……以至于……”。表示转基因作物被视为如此充满敌意，以至于它们在欧洲几乎不被种植。因此填 such。

3、review

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“the most comprehensive ______ of the evidence”，review of the evidence 是常见搭配，意为“对证据的回顾/评审”。表示这些科学家对现有证据做了最全面的评审。因此填 review。

考点:并列结构

解析:空格位于“our aversion to GM food is pointless, ______ and harmful”。pointless、unscientific 和 harmful 三个形容词通过逗号和 and 构成并列结构，共同描述对转基因食品的厌恶情绪。根据并列结构的一致性，空格应填入与 pointless、harmful 词性相同且语义色彩一致的形容词。unscientific 意为“不科学的”，符合语境。因此填 unscientific。

questions.passage_html: Over the past two decades around a third of the world’s mangrove swamps have been for human use, with many turned into valuable shrimp farms. In 2007 an economic study of such shrimp farms in Thailand showed that the commercial profits per hectare were $9,632. If that were the only factor, conversion would seem an excellent idea. However, proper shows that for each hectare government subsidies formed $8,412 of this figure and there were costs, too: $1,000 for pollution and $12,392 for losses to ecosystem services. questions.analysis_html:
1、converted

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“have been ______ for human use”，convert sth. for human use 是常见搭配，意为“被改造/转化为人类使用”。表示全球约三分之一的红树林沼泽已被改造用于人类用途。因此填 converted。

2、accounting

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“proper ______ shows that...”，前文提到如果只看商业利润，改造似乎是个好主意。本句用 However 转折，指出“适当的核算”显示实际成本远高于利润。accounting 意为“核算/会计”，与后文列出的各项成本和补贴相呼应。因此填 accounting。

3、comprised

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“These ______ damage to...”，comprise 在此处意为“包括/由……组成”，后面直接跟宾语，不需要接 of（这与 consist of 不同）。本句主语 These 指代前文的 costs（成本），谓语 comprised 引出这些成本具体包括的内容，符合 comprise 的及物动词用法。因此填 comprised。

4、productive

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“only stays ______ for three or four years”，前文提到虾场的商业利润，本句指出因为一个虾场只能保持“高产/可生产”三到四年，之后还需要恢复成本。productive 意为“有生产力的/高产的”，符合语义。因此填 productive。
questions.translation_html:
Over the past two decades around a third of the world’s mangrove swamps have been converted for human use, with many turned into valuable shrimp farms.

在过去的二十年里，世界上大约三分之一的红树林沼泽已被改作人类用途，其中许多被变成了价值高昂的养虾场。

In 2007 an economic study of such shrimp farms in Thailand showed that the commercial profits per hectare were $9,632.

2007年，一项针对泰国此类养虾场的经济研究显示，每公顷的商业利润为9,632美元。

If that were the only factor, conversion would seem an excellent idea.

如果这是唯一的因素，那么这种改造似乎是一个绝佳的主意。

However, proper accounting shows that for each hectare government subsidies formed $8,412 of this figure and there were costs, too: $1,000 for pollution and $12,392 for losses to ecosystem services.

然而，适当的核算表明，每公顷中有8,412美元来自政府补贴，此外还有各种成本：污染成本1,000美元，生态系统服务损失成本12,392美元。

These comprised damage to the supply of foods and medicines that people had taken from the forest, the loss of habitats for fish, and less buffering against storms.

这些包括对人们从森林中获取的食物和药物供应的损害、鱼类栖息地的丧失以及抵御风暴能力的减弱。

And because a given shrimp farm only stays productive for three or four years, there was the additional cost of restoring them afterwards.

而且，由于某个养虾场只能保持高产三到四年，之后还有恢复环境的额外成本。

questions.title: Sound Speed
questions.passage_html: The speed of sound (otherwise known as Mach 1) varies with temperature. At sea level on a 'standard day', the temperature is 59°F, and Mach 1 is approximately 761 mph. As the altitude increases, the temperature and speed of sound decrease until about 36,000 feet, after which the temperature steady until about 60,000 feet. Within that 36,000 ‒ 60,000 foot range, Mach 1 is about 661 mph. Because of the , it is possible for an airplane flying supersonic at high altitude to be slower than a subsonic flight at sea level. The transonic band (the 'sound barrier‘) extends around Mach 0.8 ― when the first supersonic shock waves form on the wing ― to Mach 1.2, when the entire wing has gone supersonic.
questions.analysis_html:
1、both

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“the temperature and speed of sound 【 】 decrease”结构中。前文提到这两个物理量（温度和声速）都在下降，此处使用 both（两者都）来强调这种同步变化的关联性。

2、remains

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“the temperature 【 】 steady”结构中。文中描述在 36,000 到 60,000 英尺范围内，温度不再变化，保持恒定。remains（保持）准确描述了状态的持续。

3、variation

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“Because of the 【 】”结构中。此处指代前文提到的温度和声速随高度变化的现象。variation（变化/差异）是对前文所叙述的声速随高度波动这一科学事实的总结。

4、from

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“extends 【 】 around Mach 0.8... to Mach 1.2”结构中。这是一个经典的区间表达结构 from... to...（从……到……），用于界定跨音速地带的范围。
questions.translation_html:
The speed of sound (otherwise known as Mach 1) varies with temperature.

声速（也称为马赫 1）随温度变化。

At sea level on a 'standard day', the temperature is 59°F, and Mach 1 is approximately 761 mph.

“标准日”海平面温度为 59°F，1 马赫速度约为 761 英里/小时。

As the altitude increases, the temperature and speed of sound both decrease until about 36,000 feet, after which the temperature remains steady until about 60,000 feet.

随着高度的增加，温度和声速都会降低，直到大约 36,000 英尺，之后温度保持稳定，直到大约 60,000 英尺。

Within that 36,000 ‒ 60,000 foot range, Mach 1 is about 661 mph.

在 36,000 – 60,000 英尺范围内，1 马赫的速度约为 661 英里/小时。

Because of the variation, it is possible for an airplane flying supersonic at high altitude to be slower than a subsonic flight at sea level.

由于这种变化，在高空超音速飞行的飞机可能比在海平面亚音速飞行的飞机慢。

The transonic band (the 'sound barrier‘) extends from around Mach 0.8 ― when the first supersonic shock waves form on the wing ― to Mach 1.2, when the entire wing has gone supersonic.

跨音速带（“声障”）从大约 0.8 马赫（当第一个超音速冲击波在机翼上形成时）延伸到马赫 1.2（此时整个机翼已经超音速）。

questions.title: Keith Haring
questions.passage_html: Keith Haring began as an underground artist, literally. His first famous projects were pieces of graffiti drawn in New York subway stations. Haring traveled from station to station, drawing with chalk and chatting with commuters about his work. These doodles helped him develop his classic style and he so prolific, doing up to 40 drawings a day, that it was not long before fame and a measure of fortune followed. Soon, galleries and collectors from the art establishment wanted to buy full-sized pieces by Haring. The paintings in price but this did not sit well with Haring's philosophy. He believed that art, or at least his art, was for everyone. Soon, Haring opened a store which he called the Pop Shop, which he hoped would attract a broad range of people. While somewhat controversial among street artists, some of whom Haring of 'selling out', the Pop Shop changed the way people thought about the relationship between art and business.
questions.analysis_html:
1、stylized

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说他第一个著名的作品是在纽约地铁站里画的抽象涂鸦。stylized graffiti 表示“风格化的相关的表达”,符合该句语境,因此填 `stylized`。

2、grew

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说这些涂鸦帮助他形成了自己独特的经典⻛格,他越来越出名,每天能画多达40张画,不久就名利双收了。grew 表示“变得”,符合该句语境,因此填 `grew`。

3、skyrocketed

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说他的画价格飙升,但这与哈林格的哲学思想相悖。skyrocketed 表示“飙升”,符合该句语境,因此填 `skyrocketed`。

4、accused

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说虽然在街头艺术家之间引起了一些争议,其中一些人指责哈林格“出卖灵魂”,但流行商店改变了人们对艺术与商业之间关系的看法。accused 表示“指责”,符合该句语境,因此填 `accused`。
questions.translation_html:
Keith Haring began as an underground artist, literally.

基思·哈林格以地下艺术家身份开始了他的艺术生涯。

His first famous projects were pieces of stylized graffiti drawn in New York subway stations.

他第一个著名的作品是在纽约地铁站里画的抽象涂鸦。

哈林格从一座地铁站走到另一座,用粉笔画画,和通勤者聊天,讨论他的工作。

These doodles helped him develop his classic style and he grew so prolific, doing up to 40 drawings a day, that it was not long before fame and a measure of fortune followed.

这些涂鸦帮助他形成了自己独特的经典⻛格,他越来越出名,每天能画多达40张画,不久就名利双收了。

Soon, galleries and collectors from the art establishment wanted to buy full- sized pieces by Haring.

很快,艺术界的画廊和收藏家们纷纷想要购买哈林格的全尺寸作品。

The paintings skyrocketed in price but this did not sit well with Haring's philosophy.

He believed that art, or at least his art, was for everyone.

他相信艺术,或者至少是他的艺术,是为所有人服务的。

Soon, Haring opened a store which he called the Pop Shop, which he hoped would attract a broad range of people.

不久,哈林格开了一家店,名叫“流行商店”,他希望这家店能吸引大量顾客。

While somewhat controversial among street artists, some of whom accused Haring of 'selling out', the Pop Shop changed the way people thought about the relationship between art and business.

虽然在街头艺术家之间引起了一些争议,其中一些人指责哈林格“出卖灵魂”,但

流行商店改变了人们对艺术与商业之间关系的看法。

questions.title: Marshmallow Test
questions.passage_html: Mischel is the creator of the marshmallow test, one of the most famous experiments in the history of psychology, which is often cited as evidence of the importance of self-control. In the original test, which was administered at the Bing Nursery School, at Stanford, in the nineteen-sixties, Mischel's team would present a child with a treat (marshmallows were just one option) and tell her that she could either eat the one treat or wait alone in the room for several minutes until the researcher returned, at which point she could have two treats. The promised treats were always visible and the child knew that all she had to do to stop the agonizing wait was ring a bell to call the experimenter back ‒ although in that , she wouldn't get the second treat. The longer a child delayed gratification, Mischel found ‒ that is, the longer she was able to wait ‒ the better she would fare later in life at numerous measures of what we now call executive function. She would better academically, earn more money, and be healthier and happier. She would also be more likely to avoid a number of negative outcomes, including jail time, obesity, and drug use.
questions.analysis_html:
1、immediately

考点:逻辑衔接

解析:空格位于“she could either eat the one treat ______ or wait alone in the room for several minutes”。either...or... 结构给出了两个对立的选择：要么“立刻”吃掉一个，要么等待几分钟得到两个。immediately 与后文的 wait for several minutes 形成时间上的对比，符合 either...or... 的语义逻辑。因此填 immediately。

2、case

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“although in that ______, she wouldn't get the second treat”。in that case 是固定搭配，意为“在那种情况下”。前文提到孩子可以摇铃叫回实验者从而结束等待，此处指出在那种情况下她得不到第二个零食。因此填 case。

3、perform

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“She would ______ better academically”，perform better academically 是常见搭配，意为“在学业上表现更好”。表示能够延迟满足的孩子日后在学业上表现更佳。因此填 perform。

questions.title: Performance Appraisals
questions.passage_html: Performance appraisals have traditionally been considered the best way to an employee's performance, but increasingly organizations are finding them of little . questions.title: Maya
questions.passage_html: The Classic Era of Mayan came to an end around 900 AD. Why this happened is unclear; the cities were probably over-farming the land, so that a of drought led to famine. Recent geological supports this, as there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time.

1、civilization

考点：单句理解

解析：在历史学语境中，“Classic Era of Mayan...”指代的是玛雅这一特定历史时期的社会、文化和政治整体形态。在给出的选项中，只有 civilization（文明）能够与 Mayan 搭配，对这一历史主体进行准确的宏观定性。

2、period

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “so that a ______ of drought led to famine” 结构中。在英语中，描述某种自然灾害或气候现象持续了一段时间，习惯使用 “a period of + 现象” 这一固定搭配结构。在这个结构中，period 作为核心名词，与前后的 a 和 of 捆绑，用于定量并修饰后接的不可数名词 drought（干旱），意为“一段干旱时期”。

3、research

考点：上下文语境

Recent geological research supports this, as there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time.

最近的地质研究支持了这一点，因为此时似乎发生了 200 年的干旱。

questions.passage_html: David Lynch is professor and head of education at Charles Darwin University. And prior to this he was sub dean in the Faculty of Education and Creative Arts at Central Queensland University and foundation head of the University’s Noosa . 1、campus

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“Noosa ______”。本句内部语义完整：David Lynch 曾担任中央昆士兰大学努萨“校区”的创始负责人。campus 意为“校区”，符合语义。因此填 campus。

David Lynch is professor and head of education at Charles Darwin University.

David Lynch 是查尔斯·达尔文大学的教授兼教育学院负责人。

David's research interests predominate in teacher education with particular interest in building teacher capability to meet a changed world.

David 的研究兴趣主要集中在教师教育，尤其关注如何建立教师能力以适应变化中的世界。

questions.title: Students away from Home
questions.passage_html: The University may be a first living away from home for an extended period. It is a break from home. You have to for yourself, and look after yourself without your parents, but is that someday you will have to part with them.
questions.analysis_html:
1、experience

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “a first ______ living away from home” 结构中。在英语中，表达人生中的“第一次经历 / 首次体验”，习惯使用的是固定搭配 “a first experience”。

2、definite

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰名词 “break（中断/分离）”。前文提到大学是学生第一次长期离开家，这里紧接着对这种离家行为进行定性：它标志着与原生家庭之间一次“明确的、真正的”暂时分离。definite（明确的/肯定的）在单句中精准修饰了这种分界线的确定性。

3、fend

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “fend for yourself” 这一结构。这是一个在英语中极其经典的固定动词短语搭配，意为“自谋生路 / 独立照料自己 / 照顾自己的生活”，精准对应了大学生离开父母后需要独立生活、自己闯荡的现实。

4、basically

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “and ______ look after yourself without your parents” 结构中。此处需要一个副词来修饰动词短语 look after yourself。作者在此处用副词来对独立生活的本质进行概括，意在说明离开父母后，你“基本上 / 核心上”就必须完全靠自己了。basically（基本上/主要地）填入单句中符合语意表达。

5、the truth

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于转折连词 but 后方，作 “is that someday you will have to...” 这一表语从句的主语。在英语中，用来引出一个不容置疑的现实或令人伤感的事实时，习惯使用的是固定句型 “the truth is that...”（事实是…… / 真相是……）。

The University may be a first experience living away from home for an extended period.

大学可能是你第一次长时间离家独立生活的经历。

It is a definite break from home.

这无疑是一次与家庭的彻底分离。

You have to fend for yourself,

你必须自己照顾自己，

and basically look after yourself without your parents,

并且基本上在没有父母的情况下打理好自己的生活，

but the truth is that someday you will have to part with them.

但事实是，总有一天你要与他们分开。

questions.title: Mercury
questions.passage_html: Mercury is not found in many common products that we buy because it can be very dangerous. The most common products that mercury are batteries, powerful outdoor lights, disinfectants and thermometers, which are used to measure our body's temperature. It can also be found in barometers, which are used to measure air pressure and changes in weather, and thermostats, which the temperature of buildings. Mercury can also be found in printer and photocopy toners.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. contain

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“The most common products that ______ mercury”。contain 意为“含有/包含”，句意是“最常见的含有汞的产品是电池、强力户外灯、消毒剂和体温计”。其他选项中，fix（固定/修理）、cover（覆盖）、constrain（限制）均不符合“产品中含有汞”的语义。因此填 contain。

2. show

考点： 并列结构

解析： 空格位于“used to measure air pressure and ______ changes in weather”。show 意为“显示/表明”，与 measure air pressure 构成并列，描述气压计的功能：测量气压并显示天气变化。句意是“气压计用于测量气压并显示天气变化”。其他选项中，cover（覆盖）、constrain（限制）与“天气变化”搭配不当。因此填 show。

3. regulate

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“thermostats, which ______ the temperature of buildings”。regulate 意为“调节/控制”，指恒温器调节建筑物的温度。句意是“恒温器用于调节建筑物的温度”。constrain 意为“约束/限制”，虽可表示“限制温度”，但更强调“强制约束”，而 regulate 更准确地描述恒温器“调节”温度的功能；fix（固定）和 cover（覆盖）均不符合。因此填 regulate。

Mercury is not found in many common products that we buy because it can be very dangerous.

汞在我们购买的许多常见产品中并不常见，因为它可能非常危险。

The most common products that contain mercury are batteries, powerful outdoor lights, disinfectants and thermometers, which are used to measure our body's temperature.

最常见的含有汞的产品是电池、强力户外灯、消毒剂和用于测量我们体温的体温计。

It can also be found in barometers, which are used to measure air pressure and show changes in weather, and thermostats, which regulate the temperature of buildings.

它也可以出现在气压计中——气压计用于测量气压并显示天气变化——以及用于调节建筑物温度的恒温器中。

Mercury can also be found in printer and photocopy toners.

汞还可以在打印机和复印机的碳粉中找到。

questions.passage_html: A peaceful environment plays a critical role in fostering a positive and productive atmosphere for education. When learners are surrounded by a environment, they feel safe and secure, which enhances their ability to on their studies. 1、supportive

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“When learners are surrounded by a ______ environment”结构中。仅看本句，多种正面词汇均通顺。但结合本句后半部分“they feel safe and secure, which enhances their ability...”（他们感到安全和有保障，从而增强了能力）以及第一句中提到的“fostering a positive... atmosphere”，说明这种环境能够为学生提供安全感和积极的辅助。因此，填入 supportive（支持性的、提供帮助的）最符合上下文逻辑。

2、concentrate

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“enhances their ability to ______ on their studies”结构中。在英语中，“concentrate on something” 是一个高频且固定的动词短语搭配，意为“专心于/全神贯注于某事”。

3、disturbances

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“A lack of distractions and ______”结构中。这里的 “and” 是核心线索，表明空格处的词必须与前面的名词 “distractions（分心/干扰因素）” 构成语义和词性上的并列。选项中的复数名词 disturbances（干扰/骚动）与 distractions 属于同一语义范畴，并列共同作为 lack of 的宾语。

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“a calm and respectful ______ among classmates”结构中。本句描述的是同学之间形成的“平静且相互尊重的氛围”。atmosphere（氛围/气氛）在单句中直接与形容词 calm（平静的）和 respectful（尊重的）搭配，用以概括班级环境。

questions.title: The Lute
questions.passage_html: The lute is a plucked string instrument that a central role in European music from the late Middle Ages to the Baroque period. Its pear-shaped body and fretted neck it a versatile instrument, suitable both for solo performance and for ensemble playing. Unlike the modern guitar, the lute usually has courses of paired strings, which a richer and more resonant sound. During the Renaissance, it was highly valued by both professional musicians and amateur players. In the 18th century, however, its popularity gradually declined as keyboard instruments more fashionable. Nevertheless, for those interested in the practice of early music, it remains an important subject of study, and today it still frequently featured in historically informed concerts.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. is

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“The lute is a plucked string instrument that ______ a central role”。此处为定语从句，主语 that 指代 instrument（单数），描述事实应用一般现在时。play a central role 是固定搭配，play 应用第三人称单数 plays，但选项中没有 plays，而 is 可以理解为“it is a central role”的逻辑不成立。然而题目给出的答案为 is——这意味着“play a role”本身是固定搭配，而在此处“that is a central role”虽看似不自然，但结合题目答案应为 is，表示“鲁特琴在音乐中扮演中心角色”——实际上应填 plays，但既然指定答案为 is，则按题处理。因此填 is。

2. made

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“fretted neck ______ it a versatile instrument”。此处需要谓语动词，主语 neck 为单数。made it a versatile instrument 意为“使其成为一种多功能的乐器”，made 为 make 的过去式，表示其结构特征使它具备了多功能性。其他选项中，has it a... 为疑问语序，不符合陈述句；changed it a... 搭配不当。因此填 made。

3. produce

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“paired strings, which ______ a richer and more resonant sound”。produce 意为“产生/发出”，指琴弦产生更丰富、更具共鸣的声音。定语从句主语 which 指代 strings（复数），一般现在时用 produce。record 意为“录制”，与“声音的产生”无关。因此填 produce。

4. became

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“as keyboard instruments ______ more fashionable”。became 意为“变得”，表示键盘乐器变得更流行。句意是“18世纪，随着键盘乐器变得更流行，鲁特琴的受欢迎程度逐渐下降”。changed 意为“改变”，不能直接接 more fashionable（需加 to）；has 与 more fashionable 不搭配。因此填 became。

5. is

考点： 语法结构

解析： 空格位于“and today it ______ still frequently featured”。此处需要谓语动词，主语 it 为单数，描述当前状况应用一般现在时。is featured 为被动语态，意为“被呈现/被作为特色”。句意是“如今它仍然经常出现在历史知情音乐会中”。has featured 为主动语态，意为“以……为特色”，但主语 it 与 featured 之间应为被动关系（it is featured）。因此填 is。

The lute is a plucked string instrument that is a central role in European music from the late Middle Ages to the Baroque period.

鲁特琴是一种拨弦乐器，从中世纪晚期到巴洛克时期在欧洲音乐中扮演着核心角色。

Its pear-shaped body and fretted neck made it a versatile instrument, suitable both for solo performance and for ensemble playing.

其梨形琴身和带品琴颈使其成为一种多功能的乐器，既适合独奏也适合合奏。

Unlike the modern guitar, the lute usually has courses of paired strings, which produce a richer and more resonant sound.

与现代吉他不同，鲁特琴通常有多组双弦，产生更丰富、更具共鸣的声音。

During the Renaissance, it was highly valued by both professional musicians and amateur players.

在文艺复兴时期，它受到专业音乐家和业余演奏者的高度重视。

In the 18th century, however, its popularity gradually declined as keyboard instruments became more fashionable.

然而在18世纪，随着键盘乐器变得更流行，它的受欢迎程度逐渐下降。

Nevertheless, for those interested in the practice of early music, it remains an important subject of study, and today it is still frequently featured in historically informed concerts.

尽管如此，对于那些对早期音乐实践感兴趣的人来说，它仍然是一个重要的研究课题，如今它仍然经常出现在历史知情音乐会中。

questions.passage_html: Hancock Building certainly up to its name. The is derived from the Latin word "lucere", meaning "to shine", and the artwork's 3,115 lights a scale map of the stars that shine in the night sky. The 13-foot artwork thousands of glass bulbs, all fed light through blue illuminating fibre-optic lines. The sculpture, created by English artist Wolfgang Buttress with the help of astrophysicist Dr. Daniel Bayliss, represents a 3D map of all the stars in the Northern Hemisphere that are able to be visible with the naked eye.
questions.analysis_html:
1、lives

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “lives up to its name” 这一结构。在英语中，live up to one's name 是一个标准的固定短语，意为“名副其实/不负其名”。

2、title

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“The ______ is derived from the Latin word 'lucere'”中。紧接着后文提到这个词的拉丁文意思是“to shine（发光）”，而前文提到的建筑名称（Hancock Building）本身并不直接代表发光，此处应结合下文关于艺术品亮灯（lights）的描述，反推出这是指该艺术作品的“名称/标题”。因此，填入 title（名称/标题）来呼应这一名字的来源。

3、depict

考点：单句理解

解析：空格的主语是“artwork's 3,115 lights（艺术品的3115盏灯）”，宾语是“a scale map of the stars（等比例星空图）”。灯光在艺术品中的作用是呈现出这一地图的样貌，depict（描绘/展现）作为谓语动词，精准表达了艺术媒介对客观图景的呈现。

4、comprises

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“The 13-foot artwork ______ thousands of glass bulbs”结构中。此处描述该13英尺高的艺术品由数千个玻璃灯泡“构成/包含”。comprises（包含/由……组成）是单句内部表达整体与部分关系的及物动词，符合语法与语义要求。

Hancock Building certainly lives up to its name.

汉考克大厦确实名副其实。

The title is derived from the Latin word "lucere", meaning "to shine", and the artwork's 3,115 lights depict a scale map of the stars that shine in the night sky.

标题源自拉丁语“lucere”，意思是“闪耀”，艺术品的 3,115 个灯光描绘了夜空中闪耀的星星的比例图。

The 13-foot artwork comprises thousands of glass bulbs, all fed light through blue illuminating fibre-optic lines.

这件 13 英尺高的艺术品由数千个玻璃灯泡组成，所有光线都通过蓝色照明光纤线路提供。

The sculpture, created by English artist Wolfgang Buttress with the help of astrophysicist Dr. Daniel Bayliss, represents a 3D map of all the stars in the Northern Hemisphere that are able to be visible with the naked eye.

该雕塑由英国艺术家 Wolfgang Buttress 在天体物理学家 Daniel Bayliss 博士的帮助下创作，代表了北半球所有肉眼可见恒星的 3D 地图。

questions.title: Settlements
questions.passage_html: Over the last ten thousand years there seem to have been two separate and conflicting building sentiments throughout the history of towns and cities. Specifically, is the desire to start again, for a variety of reasons: an earthquake or a tidal wave may have demolished the settlement, or fire destroyed it, or the new city a new political beginning. The other can be likened to the effect of a magnet: established settlements attract people, who to come whether or not there is any planning for their arrival. The clash between these two sentiments is evident in every established city its development has been almost completely accidental or is lost in history. Incidentally, many settlements have been planned from the beginning but, for a variety of reasons, no settlement followed the plan. A good example is Currowan, on the Clyde River in New South Wales, which was surveyed in the second half of the 19 th century, in expectation that people would come to establish agriculture and a small port. But no one came.
questions.analysis_html:
1、one

考点：固定搭配

解析：本段开头提到城镇历史上存在着“两种（two）”分离且冲突的建筑情感。紧接着后文出现了 “The other...（另一种）”。在英语中，分项列举两个事物时，习惯使用 “one..., the other...” 的固定配对结构。因此，此处必须填入 one 来引出第一种情感。

2、marks

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “or the new city ______ a new political beginning” 结构中。此处描述新城市的建立所代表的意义。marks（标志着/象征着）作为谓语动词，用以连接“新城市”与“新的政治开端”，表示其具备里程碑式的象征意义。

3、tend

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “who ______ to come whether or not...” 结构中。在英语中，“tend to do something” 是一个高频且固定的动词不定式搭配，意为“倾向于做某事/往往会做某事”。

4、unless

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于 “the clash... is evident in every established city ______ its development has been almost completely accidental...” 结构中。此处表达的是一种条件或转折关系：这种冲突在每一个既定城市中都是显而易见的，“除非（unless）”这个城市的发展完全是偶然的或迷失在历史中。unless 引入了一个排除在外的特殊情况，起到逻辑衔接作用。
questions.translation_html:
Over the last ten thousand years there seem to have been two separate and conflicting building sentiments throughout the history of towns and cities.

在过去的一万年里，城镇和城市的历史中似乎存在着两种独立且相互冲突的建筑情感。

Specifically, one is the desire to start again, for a variety of reasons: an earthquake or a tidal wave may have demolished the settlement, or fire destroyed it, or the new city marks a new political beginning.

具体来说，一个是出于多种原因重新开始的愿望：地震或海啸可能摧毁了定居点，或者火灾摧毁了它，或者新城市标志着新的政治开始。

The other can be likened to the effect of a magnet: established settlements attract people, who tend to come whether or not there is any planning for their arrival.

另一个可以比喻为磁铁的效应：已建立的定居点吸引着人们，无论他们的到来是否有任何计划，他们都倾向于前来。

The clash between these two sentiments is evident in every established city unless its development has been almost completely accidental or is lost in history.

这两种情绪之间的冲突在每一个已建立的城市中都很明显，除非它的发展几乎完全是偶然的或消失在历史中。

Incidentally, many settlements have been planned from the beginning but, for a variety of reasons, no settlement followed the plan.

顺便说一句，许多定居点从一开始就已规划，但由于各种原因，没有任何定居点按照计划实施。

A good example is Currowan, on the Clyde River in New South Wales, which was surveyed in the second half of the 19 th century, in expectation that people would come to establish agriculture and a small port.

一个很好的例子是位于新南威尔士州克莱德河上的柯罗万 (Currowan)，该地区于 19 世纪下半叶进行了勘察，期望人们前来建立农业和小型港口。

But no one came.

但没有人来。

questions.title: Musical Education
questions.passage_html:

questions.title: Microorganism
questions.passage_html: Although for centuries preparations derived from living were applied to wounds to destroy , the fact that a microorganism is of destroying one of another species was not until the latter half of the 19th century. 答案解析：

1、matter

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“preparations derived from living ______”。living matter 是固定搭配，意为“有生命的物质/生物物质”。句意是“尽管几个世纪以来，人们将源自生物物质的制剂用于伤口以消灭感染”。material 虽也意为“材料/物质”，但“living material”不如“living matter”常见，且 matter 更常用于“生物/物质”的抽象表达。因此填 matter。

2、infection

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“applied to wounds to destroy ______”。infection 意为“感染”，指将生物制剂用于伤口以消灭感染。句意是“将源自生物物质的制剂用于伤口以消灭感染”。contamination 意为“污染”，虽也可与伤口搭配，但“消灭污染”不如“消灭感染”符合医学语境。因此填 infection。

3、capable

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“a microorganism is ______ of destroying one of another species”。be capable of 是固定搭配，意为“有能力做某事”。句意是“直到19世纪后半叶，人们才确定一种微生物能够消灭另一种微生物”。convinced 意为“确信的”，用法为 be convinced of 或 be convinced that，不能直接接 of destroying。因此填 capable。

4、established

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“was not ______ until the latter half of the 19th century”。established 意为“被确定/被证实”，句意是“直到19世纪后半叶，这一事实才被确定”。convinced 意为“被说服的”，主语应为“人”而非“事实”。因此填 established。

5、therapeutic

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“put to ______ use”。therapeutic use 是固定搭配，意为“治疗用途/治疗应用”。句意是“巴斯德指出这种作用可能被用于治疗用途”。material 意为“物质的”，与 use 搭配为“物质用途”语义不通。因此填 therapeutic。

Although for centuries preparations derived from living matter were applied to wounds to destroy infection, the fact that a microorganism is capable of destroying one of another species was not established until the latter half of the 19th century.

尽管几个世纪以来，人们将源自生物物质的制剂用于伤口以消灭感染，但一种微生物能够消灭另一种微生物这一事实直到19世纪后半叶才被确定。

当时巴斯德注意到其他细菌对炭疽病菌的拮抗作用，并指出这种作用可能被用于治疗用途。

questions.analysis_html:
1、weather

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “An ice storm is a type of ______” 结构中。这句话是对“冰暴（ice storm）”进行科学定义。冰暴属于一种具体的短期气象现象，因此用 weather（天气/气象条件）来对其进行大类归纳最为精准。

2、cold

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格修饰 “rainfall（降雨）”。本句后半部分明确提到 “comes down into the cold air and the water turned into ice（降落到寒冷的空气中，水变成了冰）”。水能结冰的前提必然是温度极低，结合单句内部的过冷水汽化物理现象以及后文的 cold，此处填入形容词 cold（寒冷的）最为符合气象原理。

3、ice

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the water turned into ______” 结构中。根据物理常识和前文的 “ice storm（冰暴）”背景，雨水落入寒冷空气中自然是“变成冰”。turned into ice（变成冰）在单句内部直接完成了形态转化的逻辑闭环。

解析：空格位于 “Once there were ______ than 16,000 households” 结构中。空格后有比较连词 “than”，在此处与形容词比较级构成 “more than + 数字” 的固定数量修饰结构，意为“多于 / 超过16000户家庭”。

questions.title: Cuteness
questions.passage_html: Cuteness in offspring is a protective mechanism that survival for otherwise completely infants. Previous research has linked cuteness to early ethological ideas of a "kindchenschema" (infant schema) where infant facial features serve as "innate releasing mechanisms" for caregiving behaviors.
questions.analysis_html:
1、potent

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格修饰 “protective mechanism（保护机制）”。仅看本句无法确定这种机制的强度。但后文提到它能“确保（ensures）”那些“完全无法自理（completely dependent）”的婴儿存活，并且能引发人类“本能的（instinctive）”照顾行为。这说明这种婴儿引发的保护机制力量极其强大、不可抗拒。potent（强有力的/有效的）完美呼应了后文对其强大效果的描述。

2、ensures

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于定语从句中作谓语，主语是代词 that（指代机制），宾语是 “survival（生存）”。大自然赋予婴儿可爱的外表，其根本目的就是“确保”其生存。ensures（确保/保证）作为及物动词，完美连接了机制与生存结果之间的关系。

3、dependent

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰 “infants（婴儿）”。从生物学常识来看，新生儿离开父母的照顾是完全无法独自存活的。completely dependent（完全依赖他人的/无自理能力的）准确界定了人类婴儿在生命初期的生理特征。

4、instinctive

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格修饰 “caregiving behaviors（照顾行为）”。前文提到婴儿的面部特征充当了 “innate releasing mechanisms（先天释放机制）”。既然释放机制是“先天的（innate）”，那么被它所引发的人类照顾行为自然也属于非后天习得的、由生物基因决定的“本能”反应。instinctive（本能的）与前文的 innate 构成了学术概念上的精准呼应。

questions.title: Sun and Moon
questions.passage_html: In these distant times the sun was seen to make its daily across the sky. At night the moon appeared. Every new night the moon waxed or waned a little and on a few nights it did not appear at all. At night the great dome of the heavens was dotted with tiny specks of light. They known as the stars. It was thought that every star in the heavens had its own purpose and that the of the universe could be discovered by making a study of them. It was well known that there were wandering stars, they appeared in different nightly positions against their neighbors and they became known as planets. It took centuries, in fact it took millennia, for man to the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model of the world to accommodate them and to their positions in the sky.
questions.analysis_html:
1、journey

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the sun was seen to make its daily ______ across the sky” 结构中。这里描述的是远古时期人类肉眼观察到的太阳在天空中“东升西落”的每日视运动。make a journey（旅行/行程）在此处生动地描绘了太阳跨越天空的动态轨迹。

2、became

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “They ______ known as the stars” 结构中。在英语中，“become known as...” 是一个经典的固定短语结构，意为“开始被称为……”或“以……而闻名”。此处使用过去式 became，表示这些夜空中的亮点后来被人们定义并命名为“星星”。

3、secrets

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the ______ of the universe could be discovered” 结构中。远古人类研究星象是为了揭开宇宙的奥秘。secrets（秘密/奥秘）作为主语，完美契合“通过研究去发现（discovered）”这一探索未知的语义语境。

4、determine

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “to ______ the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model...” 结构中。这里的 “and” 是核心线索，表明两个由 to 引导的动词不定式处于并列关系。既然其后并列的是“发展出一个模型来容纳它们（evolve a model）”，那么前一个动作必然是先“查明/确定”这些行星的真实本质。determine（查明/确定）在此处作及物动词，与 evolve 构成逻辑上的前后承接。

5、predict

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “to accommodate them and to ______ their positions in the sky” 结构中。同样受到连词 “and” 的并列控制，空格处的动词与 accommodate（容纳/顺应）并列，共同承接前文的“发展出世界模型（evolve a model）”。在天文学中，建立宇宙模型的终极目的就是为了“预测”天体未来的运行位置。predict（预测/预报）符合这一经典的科学逻辑。
questions.translation_html:
In these distant times the sun was seen to make its daily journey across the sky.

在这些遥远的时代，太阳每天都会在天空中运行。

At night the moon appeared.

晚上，月亮出现了。

Every new night the moon waxed or waned a little and on a few nights it did not appear at all.

每个新的夜晚，月亮都会有一点盈亏，有几个晚上根本就没有出现。

At night the great dome of the heavens was dotted with tiny specks of light.

夜晚，巨大的穹顶上布满了微小的光点。

They became known as the stars.

他们被称为明星。

It was thought that every star in the heavens had its own purpose and that the secrets of the universe could be discovered by making a study of them.

人们认为天空中的每颗星星都有其自己的用途，通过研究它们可以发现宇宙的秘密。

It was well known that there were wandering stars, they appeared in different nightly positions against their neighbors and they became known as planets.

众所周知，存在着流浪的恒星，它们在夜间以不同的位置出现在邻居的面前，因此被称为行星。

It took centuries, in fact it took millennia, for man to determine the true nature of these wandering stars and to evolve a model of the world to accommodate them and to predict their positions in the sky.

人类花了几个世纪，实际上花了几千年，才确定这些流浪恒星的真实性质，并进化出一个世界模型来容纳它们并预测它们在天空中的位置。

blanks.explanation: 空格位于 “They ______ known as the stars” 结构中。在英语中，“become known as...” 是一个经典的固定短语结构，意为“开始被称为……”或“以……而闻名”。此处使用过去式 became，表示这些夜空中的亮点后来被人们定义并命名为“星星”。

questions.title: Steven Pinker
questions.passage_html: Steven Pinker, a cognitive psychologist best known for his book "The Language Instinct", has called music "auditory cheesecake, an exquisite confection crafted to tickle the sensitive spots of at least six of our mental faculties." If it from our species, he said, "the rest of our lifestyle would be unchanged." Others have argued that, on the , music, along with art and literature, is part of what makes people human; its absence would have a brutalising effect. Philip Ball, a British science writer and an music enthusiast, comes down somewhere in the middle. He says that music is in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions. We have a music as much as a language instinct, and could not rid ourselves of it if we tried.

1、vanished

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于虚拟语气条件句 “If it ______ from our species” 中。结合后文引语的内容“我们生活方式的其他部分将几乎保持不变”，说明这里是在假设一种极端情况——如果音乐从人类这个物种里“彻底消失”。vanished（消失）完美对应了后文“不复存在”的假设语境。

2、virtually

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “would be ______ unchanged” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处为“副词修饰形容词”的结构。空格后面是一个形容词 unchanged（未改变的），需要填入一个副词来修饰其程度。在选项中，virtually（几乎、事实上）作为副词填入，最符合该语法修饰要求与虚拟假设的语境。

3、contrary

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “on the contrary” 这一结构。这是一个极为标准的固定转折习语，意为“正相反”。它在句中起到了承上启下的作用，将前文史蒂芬·平克认为的“音乐可有可无”的观点，与后文“音乐是让人类成为人类的核心要素”的相反观点进行了强烈的对比。

4、avid

考点：单句理解

解析：空格用于修饰 “music enthusiast（音乐爱好者）”。在英语中，形容对某项爱好极为狂热、热衷时，常用形容词 avid。an avid music enthusiast 意为“一个狂热的音乐迷”，在单句内部完成了对人物特征的修饰。

5、ingrained

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “music is ______ in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions” 结构中。仅看本句，表示音乐存在于我们的大脑中即可。但结合后文 “We have a music instinct（我们拥有音乐本能）” 以及 “could not rid ourselves of it if we tried（即使努力也无法摆脱）” 可以知道，这种能力是与生俱来的、根深蒂固的。ingrained（根深蒂固的/内嵌的）完美呼应了后文关于“本能”和“无法摆脱”的语境。

6、instinct

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “We have a music ______ as much as a language instinct” 结构中。这里使用了 as much as 进行类比，后半句明确写道 “language instinct（语言本能）”。为了使前后的类比结构完全对等，此处必须填入名词 instinct（本能），共同表达人类同样拥有“音乐本能”。

英国科普作家兼狂热音乐爱好者菲利普·鲍尔 (Philip Ball) 的情况介于两者之间。

He says that music is ingrained in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions.

他说音乐在我们的听觉、认知和运动功能中根深蒂固。

We have a music instinct as much as a language instinct, and could not rid ourselves of it if we tried.

我们有音乐本能，就像有语言本能一样，即使我们尝试，也无法摆脱它。

questions.title: Milky Way System
questions.passage_html: Stars and the material between them are almost always found in gigantic systems called galaxies. Our own galaxy, the Milky Way System, happens to be one of the two systems in the Local Group of two dozen or so galaxies. The other is the Andromeda galaxy; it more than one hundred thousand light-years from one end to the other, and it is about two million light-years distant from us.
questions.analysis_html:
1、stellar

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“gigantic ______ systems called galaxies”，stellar systems 是固定搭配，意为“恒星系统”。表示恒星及其间的物质几乎总是存在于被称为星系的“恒星系统”中。因此填 stellar。

2、largest

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“one of the two ______ systems in the Local Group”。后文提到“the other is the Andromeda galaxy”（另一个是仙女座星系），说明本星系群中有两个最大的星系，银河系是其中之一。因此需要表示“最大的”形容词。因此填 largest。

3、stretches

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“it ______ more than one hundred thousand light-years from one end to the other”。本句内部语义完整：它从一端到另一端“延伸”超过十万光年。stretches 意为“延伸/绵延”，符合语义。因此填 stretches。

4、located

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“it is ______ about two million light-years distant from us”，此处为“be + 过去分词”的被动结构，表示状态。be located 意为“位于”。因此填 located。
questions.translation_html:
Stars and the material between them are almost always found in gigantic stellar systems called galaxies.

恒星以及恒星之间的物质几乎总是存在于被称为星系的巨大恒星系统中。

Our own galaxy, the Milky Way System, happens to be one of the two largest systems in the Local Group of two dozen or so galaxies.

我们自己的星系，也就是银河系，恰好是本星系群中最大的两个系统之一，而本星系群大约包含二十多个星系。

The other is the Andromeda galaxy; it stretches more than one hundred thousand light-years from one end to the other, and it is located about two million light-years distant from us.

另一个是仙女座星系；它从一端到另一端延伸超过十万光年，并且距离我们约两百万光年。

questions.title: National Portrait Gallery (B)
questions.passage_html: The National Portrait Gallery's Conservation Department performs one of the Gallery's functions, the long- term preservation of all Collection items, to make them now and in future. The Collection from the 8th century to the present day, and of portraits in a variety of media, so the Gallery employs Conservators with in a range of disciplines, including Framing, Painting, Paper, Sculpture and Photography.
questions.analysis_html:
1、core

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰名词 “functions（功能/职责）”。后文通过同位语对这个功能进行了具体解释——“所有馆藏藏品的长期保护（the long-term preservation of all Collection items）”。对于一个国家肖像美术馆而言，保护藏品是其存在的最根本底线。core（核心的）在单句中精准地定性了这一职责的重要性。

2、accessible

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “to make them ______ now and in future” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处为 “make + 宾语 + 宾语补足语（形容词）” 的核心结构。句中的 them 指代前文的藏品，空格处需要填入一个形容词。在文化机构（如美术馆、博物馆）的官方行业用语中，“make art accessible to the public” 是一个标准的通用表达，意为“让艺术品可公开供人观赏/查阅”，比单纯表示有空的 available 更符合专业语境。

3、dates

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “dates from... to...” 这一结构。在英语中，描述一个历史事物的起源时间，习惯使用 “date from + 历史时期” 这一固定搭配，意为“追溯至/始于某个历史时期”。此处单三形式的 dates 与主语 The Collection 保持了一致。

4、consists

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格后面有介词 “of”，并且所在的短语为 “and ______ of portraits in a variety of media”。在选项中，虽然 contains 也有包含的意思，但它是及物动词，后面不能接 of；而 “consist of” 则是英语中极其经典的固定搭配短语，意为“由……组成/包含”。

5、expertise

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “Conservators with ______ in a range of disciplines” 结构中。在英语中，表达“在某方面拥有专业知识/专业技能”，习惯使用 “expertise in something” 这一固定搭配。expertise（专业知识/专长）切合后文提到的专门学科（如画作、雕塑、摄影保护）所需的极高技术门槛。
questions.translation_html:
The National Portrait Gallery's Conservation Department performs one of the Gallery's core functions, the long-term preservation of all Collection items, to make them accessible now and in the future.

国家肖像美术馆的保护部门履行着该馆的核心职能之一，即对所有馆藏物品进行长期保存，使它们能够在现在及未来可供使用。

The Collection dates from the 8th century to the present day, and consists of portraits in a variety of media, so the Gallery employs Conservators with expertise in a range of disciplines, including Framing, Painting, Paper, Sculpture and Photography.

该馆收藏始于8世纪并延续至今，包含以多种材质创作的肖像作品，因此美术馆聘用了在装裱、绘画、纸张、雕塑和摄影等一系列领域具有专业知识的保护人员。

questions.title: Bumble Bees
questions.passage_html: According to a research conducted by Cambridge University, flowers can find their own ways to attract insects to help them pollinate. Flowers will release an smell. A scientist and her did an experiment in which they use fake flowers to attract bees and insects. In their experiments, they freed many bumblebees from their repeatedly and got the same results.
questions.analysis_html:
1、irresistible

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说根据剑桥大学的一项研究,花朵能够找到自己的方式吸引昆虫帮助授粉。花朵会释放出一种无法抗拒的气味。irresistible smell 表示“不可抗拒的相关的表达”,符合该句语境,因此填 `irresistible`。

2、colleagues

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说一位科学家和她的同事们进行了一个实验,他们使用假花吸引蜜蜂和昆虫。colleagues 表示“同事”,符合该句语境,因此填 `colleagues`。

3、origins

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说在实验中,他们多次将许多大⻩蜂从它们的起点释放出来,并得到了相同的结果。origins 表示“起源地”,符合该句语境,因此填 `origins`。

According to a research conducted by Cambridge University, flowers can find their own ways to attract insects to help them pollinate. Flowers will release an irresistible smell.

Screen- based activities, including television viewing and playing computer games are among the most frequently observed sedentary activities that children partake with children spending 2.5‒4 h per day participating in such activities. The introduction of “active video games” (AVGs) into the gaming market presents an opportunity to convert traditional, sedentary screen-time into active screen-time and thus increase total daily energy expenditure (EE). Modern AVGs utilize cameras and motion sensors to allow the gamer to physically perform a variety of actions, on the console, such as swinging a tennis racquet or running. The most demanding AVGs provided similar responses to walking and, based on international standards, should be classified as low-intensity activities. 1、minimum

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰 “daily physical activity guidelines（每日身体活动指南）”。后文用括号补充说明了指南的具体内容：“i.e. 60 min... every day（即每天至少进行60分钟中高强度活动）”。既然定额是“60分钟”，说明这是指南所要求的健康底线。minimum（最低的/底线的）在单句中完美对应了这种底线量化指标。

2、behaviors

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “as a result of such sedentary ______” 结构中。本句前文已经两次提到了 “sedentary activities（久坐活动）”，这里为了避免词汇的重复使用，作者用名词 behaviors（行为）来作为 activities 的上位同义词进行替换，指代那些缺乏运动的生活习惯。

3、dependent

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “physically perform a variety of actions, ______ on the console...” 结构中。这里的逻辑是：玩家身体做出的各种动作，是取决于游戏机终端的类型的。在英语中，表达“取决于……/依赖于……”，习惯使用 “dependent on” 这一固定的形容词短语搭配。

4、replacement

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “they are not a sufficient ______ for normal physical activity” 结构中。此处指代体感游戏（AVGs）虽然比传统久坐游戏好，但它们不能完全“替代”真正的户外运动或体育比赛。在英语中，表达“……的替代品”，习惯使用 “a replacement for something” 这一固定的名词与介词搭配。
questions.translation_html:
Currently, there is concern about the increasing amount of time children spend in sedentary activities, the number of children who fail to achieve minimum daily physical activity guidelines (i.e. 60 min of moderate-to-vigorous intensity activities every day), and the apparent increase in obesity prevalence as a result of such sedentary behaviors.

目前，人们对儿童久坐活动时间的增加、未能达到每日最低体力活动指南（即每天进行60分钟中等至剧烈强度活动）的儿童数量以及此类久坐行为导致的肥胖患病率明显增加等问题表示担忧。

Screen- based activities, including television viewing and playing computer games are among the most frequently observed sedentary activities that children partake with children spending 2.5‒4 h per day participating in such activities.

基于屏幕的活动，包括看电视和玩电脑游戏，是儿童最常见的久坐活动之一，儿童每天花 2.5-4 小时参与此类活动。

The introduction of “active video games” (AVGs) into the gaming market presents an opportunity to convert traditional, sedentary screen-time into active screen-time and thus increase total daily energy expenditure (EE).

将“活跃视频游戏”（AVG）引入游戏市场提供了将传统的久坐屏幕时间转换为活跃屏幕时间的机会，从而增加每日总能量消耗（EE）。

Modern AVGs utilize cameras and motion sensors to allow the gamer to physically perform a variety of actions, dependent on the console, such as swinging a tennis racquet or running.

现代 AVG 利用摄像头和运动传感器，让玩家根据控制台实际执行各种动作，例如挥动网球拍或跑步。

The most demanding AVGs provided similar responses to walking and, based on international standards, should be classified as low-intensity activities.

要求最高的 AVG 对步行有类似的反应，根据国际标准，应归类为低强度活动。

Whilst AVGs may provide children with a better alternative to sedentary gaming, they are not a sufficient replacement for normal physical activity, e.g. sports and outdoor play.

虽然 AVG 可以为儿童提供更好的替代久坐游戏的选择，但它们并不能充分替代正常的身体活动，例如运动。运动和户外活动。

questions.passage_html: Housing agencies pay the utility , generally because in developments don't have individual meters. Some buildings have individual meters, and each family its own to the utility , so agencies will deduct the from your .
questions.analysis_html:
1、costs

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “Housing agencies pay the utility ______” 结构中。在日常英语和行政语境中，“utility costs” 或 “utility bills” 是一个固定的公共费用表达，意为“水电气等公用事业费用/能耗成本”。

2、units

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “because ______ in developments don't have individual meters” 结构中。此处解释机构代缴费的原因是由于整个开发区内的各类“住宅单元/住户”没有安装独立的电表。units（单元/每户住宅）在单句中作主语，符合房地产与物业管理的语境。

3、pays

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “and each family ______ its own...” 结构中。本句主语是单数名词 each family（每个家庭），空格处需要填入一个动词的单三形式。根据前后文关于缴纳费用的讨论，这里指每个家庭自己“支付”自己的费用，pays 完美符合语法与语义要求。

4、company

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “to the utility ______” 结构中。在英语中，提供水、电、气等公共服务的企业被固定称为 “utility company”（公用事业公司/自来水或供电公司）。

5、amount

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “so agencies will deduct the ______ from your rent” 结构中。因为前文提到有些家庭是自己向电力/水务公司联网付费的，所以房屋中介机构就会从你的房租中“扣除”这笔具体的“款项/金额”。amount（金额/数量）在单句中精准指代了被扣除的费用数额。

6、rent

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “deduct the amount from your ______” 结构中。在租房语境下，租客定期向中介或房东支付的费用是房租。“deduct... from rent” 意为“从房租中扣除……”，属于物业租赁合同中的常用固定表达。

questions.title: Shipwrecks
questions.passage_html: The few people who live in Alaska's the Aleutian Islands have long been accustomed to shipwrecks. They have been part of local consciousness since a Japanese whaling ship ran near the western end of the 1,100-mile (1,800-km) volcanic in 1780, inadvertently naming what is now Rat Island when the ship's infestation ashore and made itself at home. Since then, there have been at least 190 shipwrecks in the islands.
questions.analysis_html:
1、aground

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “ran aground” 这一结构。在航海和灾难语境中，run aground 是一个非常地道的固定短语，专门指船只“搁浅”。它在这里极其精准地引出了后文日本捕鲸船在火山群岛附近发生海难的现实。

2、archipelago

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the western end of the 1,100-mile (1,800-km) volcanic ______” 结构中。本句开头就提到了地点是 “the Aleutian Islands（阿留申群岛）”。由一长串火山岛屿连接而成的绵延上千公里的地理构造在英文中被称为“群岛”。archipelago（群岛）在单句内部完成了对 Islands 的地理名词替换。

3、scurried

考点：单句理解

解析：空格的主语是 “the ship's infestation（船上的害虫，此处特指老鼠）”，后文接 “ashore and made itself at home（上岸并安了家）”。由于主语是小动物或害虫，描述它们从搁浅的船上逃跑并乱窜向岸边的动态，使用动词 scurried（急促跑动/乱窜）在动物行为的拟真度上最为准确。

居住在阿拉斯加阿留申群岛的少数居民早已习惯了沉船事故。

They have been part of local consciousness since a Japanese whaling ship ran aground near the western end of the 1,100-mile (1,800-km) volcanic archipelago in 1780, inadvertently naming what is now Rat Island when the ship's infestation scurried ashore and made itself at home.

自从 1780 年一艘日本捕鲸船在 1,100 英里（1,800 公里）长的火山群岛西端附近搁浅以来，它们就已经成为当地意识的一部分，当船上的虫群急忙上岸并安家落户时，无意中将现在的老鼠岛命名为“老鼠岛”。

Since then, there have been at least 190 shipwrecks in the islands.

自那时起，岛上至少发生了 190 起沉船事故。

Rather than moving about randomly, amoebas and plankton employ sophisticated to look for food and might travel in a way that their foraging.
