questions.title: Investment
questions.passage_html: One city will start to attract the of public or private investment. This could be due to advantage or political decisions. This, in turn, will further investment due to the multiplier effect and rural-to- urban migration. The investment in this city will be at the of other cities.
questions.analysis_html:
1、majority

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “start to attract the ______ of public or private investment” 结构中。在英语中，表达“吸引了绝大多数的……”，习惯使用 “the majority of + 名词” 这一固定数量修饰结构。

2、natural

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “This could be due to ______ advantage or political decisions” 结构中。这里的核心线索是连词 “or”，它将空格处的修饰词与后面的 “political decisions（政治决策）” 进行了对立并列。“政治决策”属于人为主观造成的、后天的制度性优势；而在区域经济学中，与之相对的另一种导致城市最初吸引投资的优势，则是客观存在的、先天的地理或资源优势，即“天然优势/自然优势”。因此，填入形容词 natural 完美地在上下文语境中与 political 形成了“先天自然条件 vs 后天人为政策”的经典逻辑对照。

3、stimulate

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “This, in turn, will ______ further investment” 结构中。前文提到了“乘数效应（multiplier effect）”，即初始投资会像滚雪球一样带来连锁反应，因此这种效应会进一步“刺激/拉动”更多的后续投资。stimulate（刺激/促进）作为谓语动词，准确表达了这种经济效应的动态催化作用。

4、significant

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰名词短语 “rural-to-urban migration（城乡移民潮）”。由于大量的资金和项目集中在某一个城市，必然会引发“重大的/规模巨大的”人口从农村向城市迁移的社会现象。significant（显著的/重大的）在单句内部对这场迁移的规模进行了准确的程度定性。

5、expense

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “at the expense of...” 这一结构。这是一个极其经典的固定短语搭配，意为“以……为代价 / 损害……的利益”。这里生动地说明了某一个核心城市获得投资，是以“牺牲其他城市的投资机会”为代价的，完美揭示了区域经济发展不平衡的规律。
questions.translation_html:
One city will start to attract the majority of public or private investment.

This could be due to natural advantage or political decisions.

这可能是由于自然优势或政治决定。

This, in turn, will stimulate further investment due to the multiplier effect and significant rural-to- urban migration.

反过来，由于乘数效应和大量农村人口向城市的人口迁移，这将刺激进一步的投资。

The investment in this city will be at the expense of other cities.

这个城市的投资将以牺牲其他城市为代价。

2、build in

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “______ a margin of safety” 结构中。在投资学和风险管理语境中，“build in a margin of safety” 是一个高频的专业固定搭配，意为“预留出安全边际 / 预设安全空间”，指通过在评估中留出余地来防御潜在风险。

3、valuation

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “always thinking about the ______” 结构中。本段探讨的是理性的投资策略，除了前文提到的制定计划、预留安全边际，投资人最需要时刻思考和评估的就是资产的“估值”。“think about valuation” 在金融投资领域属于标准的通用行业表达，指对企业资产内在价值的判定。

4、wish

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于条件状语从句 “if you ______” 中。从语法结构来看，此处为 “if you wish/want/like” 的省略结构，意为“如果你愿意的话 / 只要你喜欢”。作者的意思是，在保证主力组合安全的前提下，如果你愿意，完全可以加入一小部分投机性品种。

考点：上下文语境

questions.analysis_html:

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“make observations, have assumptions, and do ______”结构中。这是科学研究的标准步骤（观察、假设、实验）。experiments（实验）作为科学研究的三大支柱之一，逻辑上最为严密。

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“After these have been done, they get their ______”结构中。这里构成了一个严格的逻辑时间序列：先有“observations, assumptions, and experiments”（前文内容），才有之后的产出。根据前文所述的研究步骤，这些动作完成后必然产生“结果”，这是由科学研究的行为逻辑所驱动的上下文语义关联。

3、data

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“a lot of ______ from scientists”结构中。实验产生结果后，紧随其后的是对这些结果的收集与整理，即“数据”。data（数据）在科学界是指代实验产出的核心要素。

解析：空格位于“have a ______ of the world”结构中。科学研究的最终目的在于通过观察和实验，建立起对客观世界完整的认知或描述。picture（图景/认识）精准地概括了科学家通过研究对世界形成的综合性理解。

questions.title: Digital Media
questions.passage_html: Digital media and the internet have made the sharing of texts, music and images easier than ever, and the of copyright restriction harder. This situation has encouraged the growth of IP law, and increased industrial concentration on extending and 'policing' IP protection, while also leading to the growth of an 'open access', or 'creative commons' movement which such control of knowledge and .
questions.analysis_html:
1、enforcement

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于名词短语 “the ______ of copyright restriction” 中。本句在讨论互联网时代背景下，分享变得容易，而版权限制的“执行/实施”却变得更难。在法律和知识产权语境中，表达“法律、法规或限制条款的强制执行”，其标准的固定名词短语搭配为 “law/restriction enforcement”（此处为 enforcement of restriction）。

2、prompted

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格与前面的动词 encouraged（鼓励/促进）由连词 and 连接，共同作为 This situation（这种情况）的谓语动词。这种情况一方面促进了知识产权法的增长，另一方面也“促使/推动了”工业界更加集中力量去延伸和监管知识产权。在单句内部的词义辨析中，及物动词 prompted（促使/推动） 最符合“形势推动行为”的因果逻辑。

3、challenges

考点：时态语态

解析： 空格位于 which 引导的定语从句中作谓语动词，修饰先行词 'open access', or 'creative commons' movement（开放获取或创意共享运动）。根据常识与文意，这种运动设立的初衷，就是为了去“质疑/挑战”工业界对知识和创意的垄断控制。因为该运动（movement）为单数概念，且全篇在陈述客观的当代社会现状，必须使用一般现在时的单三形式。故选用 challenges（挑战/质疑） 满足时态语态要求。

4、creativity

考点：并列结构

解析： 空格由连词 and 与前面的名词 knowledge（知识）构成正向的并列，共同作介词 of 的宾语（such control of knowledge and ______）。整个互联网运动的核心冲突点在于“对知识的控制”以及“对【创造力/创意】的控制”。在选项中，只有名词 creativity（创造力/创造性） 能够与 knowledge 形成词性对称、语意色彩一致的完美并列。
questions.translation_html:
Digital media and the internet have made the sharing of texts, music and images easier than ever, and the enforcement of copyright restriction harder.

数字媒体和互联网使文本、音乐和图像的分享变得比以往任何时候都更加容易，同时也使得版权限制的执行变得更加困难。

This situation has encouraged the growth of IP law, and prompted increased industrial concentration on extending and 'policing' IP protection, while also leading to the growth of an 'open access', or 'creative commons' movement which challenges such control of knowledge and creativity.

这种情况促进了知识产权法的发展，并促使行业更加集中于扩展和“监管”知识产权保护，同时也导致了“开放获取”或“知识共享”运动的兴起，该运动挑战这种对知识和创造力的控制。

questions.title: Jury
questions.passage_html: Serving on a jury is normally compulsory for individuals who are for jury service. A jury is to be an impartial panel capable of reaching a verdict. There are often and requirements, including a fluent understanding of the language and the opportunity to test juror's neutrality or otherwise exclude jurors who are perceived as likely to be less than or partial to one side.
questions.analysis_html:
1、qualified

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “individuals who are ______ for jury service” 结构中。在法律语境中，表达“有资格/符合条件去从事某项公职或服务”，习惯使用 “be qualified for something” 这一固定形容词短语搭配。

2、intended

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “A jury is ______ to be an impartial panel” 结构中。在英语中，“be intended to be/do something” 是一个极其经典的固定搭配结构，意为“旨在成为…… / 被要求应当是……”。这里指陪审团在法律设计之初，其根本宗旨和设立目的就是为了成为一个公正的裁决小组。

3、procedures

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “There are often ______ and requirements” 结构中。这里的 “and” 是核心线索，表明空格处的名词必须与后面的 “requirements（要求/条件）” 构成词性和语义上的并列。在法律诉讼和陪审团筛选流程中，既有成文的硬性要求，也有标准的“程序/流程”。选项中的复数名词 procedures（程序/手续）与 requirements 属于同一法学语义范畴，完美并列。

4、neutral

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “less than ______ or partial to one side” 结构中。这里的 “or” 是核心线索，表明空格处的形容词与后面的 “partial（偏袒的/不公正的）” 构成反义并列对照。结合前文提到的 “test juror's neutrality（测试陪审员的中立性）”，如果一个人无法做到“中立”，那他就会偏袒某一方。因此，neutral（中立的）在此处与 partial 完美呼应，符合法律对陪审员身份中立性的严苛考量。

questions.passage_html: Trees may have a lot to teach us about being part of a and how co-operation is better for a society than . Scientists are only just beginning to understand how it all works, but we now know that trees growing together all of the available resources with each other. 1、community

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “being part of a ______” 结构中。结合前文的“树木可以教会我们”以及后文的“社会（society）”，这里是在将树木生态类比为人类社会。在英语中，表达“成为集体 / 社区 / 社会的一员”，习惯使用的是固定搭配 “be part of a community”。

2、competition

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “how co-operation is better for a society than ______” 结构中。

逻辑线索： 核心线索是连词 “than（比……）”，它引导了一个直接的对比。

语义筛选： 前文提到了“合作（co-operation）”，在探讨社会运行和生态关系时，“合作”最经典的反义对照概念就是“竞争”。因此，填入名词 competition（竞争），完美完成了单句内部关于“合作比竞争对社会更好”的反义逻辑对照。

3、share

考点：语法结构

解析：空格在主谓宾结构中作谓语动词：“trees growing together ______ all of the available resources”。

主语判定： 本句的主语核心词是复数名词 “trees”（growing together 为后置定语）。

语法筛选： 既然主语是复数，且整段话在阐述一个客观科学事实，因此空格处必须填入一个动词的复数原形。选项中只有 share 复合“复数主语 + 动词原形”的语法主谓搭配规律，意为树木们共同“分享”现有的资源。

4、strong

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “So, ______ trees in a very good position will supply food and water to weaker trees” 结构中。

逻辑线索： 核心线索是后半句的 “weaker trees（更弱小的树木）”。

语义筛选： 文本在此处展示了一幅强者帮助弱者的生态画面。既然是去给“更弱小（weaker）”的树木提供食物和水，那么发出施舍动作的、处于绝佳位置的必然是那些“强壮的”树木。形容词 strong 与后文的 weaker 构成了精准的语境反义呼应。

5、through

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “They do this ______ their roots, the soil and also the networks...” 结构中。句中的“根部（roots）”、“土壤（soil）”以及“真菌网络（networks of fungi）”是树木之间输送食物和水分的具体媒介和渠道。介词 through 在单句内部精准表达了“通过……媒介 / 经由……渠道”的逻辑。

questions.title: UN
questions.passage_html: Founded after World War II by 51 "peace-loving states" combined to oppose future aggression, the United Nations now counts 192 member nations, its newest members, Nauru, Kiribati, and Tonga in 1999, Tuvalu and Yugoslavia in 2000, Switzerland and East Timor in 2002, and Montenegro in 2006. United Nations Day has been on October 24 since 1948 and celebrates the objectives and accomplishments of the organization, which was established on October 24, 1945. The UN in peacekeeping and humanitarian missions across the globe. Though some say its has declined in recent decades, the United Nations still plays a tremendous role in world politics. In 2001 the United Nations and Kofi Annan, then Secretary-General of the UN, won the Nobel Peace Prize "for their work for a better organized and more peaceful world." Since 1948 there have been 63 UN peacekeeping operations, 16 are currently underway. Thus far, close to 130 nations have contributed personnel at various times; 119 are currently providing peacekeepers. As of August 31, 2008, there were 16 peacekeeping operations underway with a total of 88,230 personnel. The small island nation of Fiji has taken part in virtually every UN peacekeeping operation, as has Canada.
questions.analysis_html:
1、including

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the United Nations now counts 192 member nations, ______ its newest members, Nauru...” 结构中。前文提到联合国目前有192个成员国，后文则具体罗列了瑙鲁、基里巴斯、汤加等一系列国家和它们加入的年份。这些具体的国家包含在192个成员国的大数之中，因此使用介词 including（包括/包含）来引出具体成员的举例。

2、observed

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “United Nations Day has been ______ on October 24” 结构中。在英语中，表达“庆祝 / 纪念（节日、特定日子）”，除了 celebrate 之外，官方和正式语境中极其习惯使用被动结构 “be observed + 具体日期”。observed（被纪念/被庆祝）在此处符合联合国的官方行文风格。

3、engages

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “engages in” 这一结构。在英语中，表达“参与到……之中 / 投身于某项活动”，习惯使用 “engage in something” 这一固定动词短语搭配。这里极其准确地引出了联合国长期致力于维和（peacekeeping）和人道主义救援（humanitarian missions）的职责现实。

4、influence

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “Though some say its ______ has declined in recent decades” 结构中。由让步连词 “Though（尽管）” 引导，后半句提到联合国在世界政治中依然发挥着巨大的作用（plays a tremendous role）。为了构成前后的对立转折，前半句被让步的内容必须是“尽管有人认为它的‘影响力 / 威望’在近几十年有所下降”。influence（影响力）在单句内部完美完成了这一逻辑对抗。
questions.translation_html:
Founded after World War II by 51 "peace-loving states" combined to oppose future aggression, the United Nations now counts 192 member nations, including its newest members, Nauru, Kiribati, and Tonga in 1999, Tuvalu and Yugoslavia in 2000, Switzerland and East Timor in 2002, and Montenegro in 2006.

联合国是二战后由 51 个“爱好和平国家”联合成立的，旨在反对未来的侵略，目前有 192 个成员国，其中包括 1999 年的最新成员国瑙鲁、基里巴斯和汤加，2000 年的图瓦卢和南斯拉夫，2002 年的瑞士和东帝汶，以及 2006 年的黑山。

United Nations Day has been observed on October 24 since 1948 and celebrates the objectives and accomplishments of the organization, which was established on October 24, 1945.

自 1948 年以来，每年 10 月 24 日都是联合国日，庆祝该组织于 1945 年 10 月 24 日成立的目标和成就。

The UN engages in peacekeeping and humanitarian missions across the globe.

联合国在全球范围内执行维和和人道主义任务。

Though some say its influence has declined in recent decades, the United Nations still plays a tremendous role in world politics.

尽管有人说近几十年来联合国的影响力有所下降，但联合国在世界政治中仍然发挥着巨大作用。

In 2001 the United Nations and Kofi Annan, then Secretary-General of the UN, won the Nobel Peace Prize "for their work for a better organized and more peaceful world." Since 1948 there have been 63 UN peacekeeping operations, 16 are currently underway.

2001年，联合国和时任联合国秘书长科菲·安南因“为建设一个更有组织、更和平的世界所做的贡献”而荣获诺贝尔和平奖。自 1948 年以来，联合国已开展了 63 项维和行动，其中 16 项正在进行中。

Thus far, close to 130 nations have contributed personnel at various times; 119 are currently providing peacekeepers.

迄今为止，已有近130个国家在不同时期派遣了人员；目前有119名维和人员在派遣。

As of August 31, 2008, there were 16 peacekeeping operations underway with a total of 88,230 personnel.

截至2008年8月31日，共有16项维和行动正在进行，共有人员88 230人。

The small island nation of Fiji has taken part in virtually every UN peacekeeping operation, as has Canada.

小岛国斐济几乎参加了所有联合国维和行动，加拿大也是如此。

questions.title: Textile Industry
questions.passage_html: The environmental impact of the global textile industry is hard to overstate. One-third of the water used worldwide is spent fashioning fabrics. For every ton of cloth , 200 tons of water is polluted with chemicals and heavy metals. An estimated 1 trillion kilowatt-hours of electricity powers the factories that card and comb, spin and weave, and cut and stitch materials into everything from T-shirts to towels, behind mountains of solid waste and a massive carbon footprint. "Where the industry is today is not really sustainable for the long term," says Shreyaskar Chaudhary, chief executive of Pratibha Syntex, a textile manufacturer based outside Indore, India. With something of an "if you build it, they will come" attitude, Mr. Chaudhary has steered Pratibha the leading edge of eco-friendly textile production. Under his direction, Pratibha began making clothes with organic cotton in 1999. Initially, the company couldn't find enough organic farms growing cotton in central India to its factories. To meet production demands, Chaudhary's team had to convince conventional cotton farmers to change their growing methods. Pratibha provided seeds, cultivation instruction, and a guarantee of fairtrade prices for their crops. Today, Pratibha has a network of 28,000 organic cotton growers across the central states of Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Orissa.

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“For every ton of cloth ______”，此处为“名词 + 后置定语”结构，cloth 与 produce（生产）之间为被动关系，应用过去分词作后置定语，相当于“that is produced”。因此填 produced。

A continent once bordered with Britain has sunk, but not many people that Britain is a relatively recent . Scientists have been able to this ancient continent with the help of modern technologies. questions.analysis_html:
1、realize

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“not many people ______ that...”，realize that... 是常见搭配，意为“意识到……”。表示没有多少人意识到英国是一个相对较新的实体。因此填 realize。

2、entity

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“a relatively recent ______”，entity 意为“实体”。前文提到大陆与英国曾经相连，后文说科学家能够重建这片古老的大陆，说明英国作为一个独立的地理“实体”是相对较新的。因此填 entity。

3、reconstruct

考点:单句理解

解析:空格位于“able to ______ this ancient continent”。本句内部信息完整：科学家借助现代技术，能够对这片古老的大陆进行“重建”。reconstruct 意为“重建”，符合单句内部的语义逻辑，无需依赖前后文线索进行判断。因此填 reconstruct。

questions.passage_html: With the popularity of the gender equality campaign and the cultural change, the roles of men as the , and of women in which they stay at home, are today.
questions.analysis_html:
1、traditional

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格修饰 “roles of men... and of women...”。单独看这一句无法直接确定角色的属性，但紧接着后文给出了具体的线索：“男主人外赚钱，女主人内留守家中（men as the breadwinner, and of women in which they stay at home）”。这种男主外女主内的分工属于人类社会跨越数百年的典型“传统”观念，因此通过后文的这种分工描述，可以直接反推出这指的是 traditional（传统的）角色。

2、earner

考点：上下文语境与固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “roles of men as the ______” 结构中。前文提到了“性别平等运动（gender equality campaign）”，这里在描述传统社会的分工。在英语中，负责养家糊口、挣钱维持家庭生计的人被称为 “earner”（尤其是固定搭配 breadwinner / wage earner）。选项中的名词 earner 精准地指代了男性在传统家庭中所扮演的“经济支柱/挣钱者”角色。

questions.title: Law and Order
questions.passage_html: The narrative of law and order is located fundamentally at the level of individual and responsibility. Criminal acts are seen as individual issues of personal responsibility and culpability, to which the state responds by way of policing, prosecution, and punishment. This is but one level at which crime and criminal can be analyzed. The problem is that so often analysis ends there, at the level of individual action, characterized in terms of responsibility, guilt, evil. In few other areas of social life does individualism have this hold? To take but one instance, it would be to restrict analysis of obesity, to individual greed. It should similarly be widely seen as absurd to restrict analysis of criminal justice issues to the culpability of individuals.
questions.analysis_html:
1、guilt

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于第一句。紧接着的后方文本中直接给出了核心线索：“...at the level of individual action, characterized in terms of responsibility, guilt, evil.” 后文直接出现了 guilt 这个词，根据前后呼应的语境，此处直接照抄即可。

2、adjudication

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于法律流程的排比列举中：“by way of policing（警务）, prosecution（起诉）, ______ and punishment（惩罚）”。这描述的是一个罪犯从被捕到判刑的完整司法流水线，夹在起诉与惩罚之间的，只能是 adjudication（法庭审判/裁决）。

3、justice

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “crime and criminal ______” 结构中。在法学和社会学领域中，探讨犯罪现象与司法体制的学科名词被固定称为 “criminal justice”（刑事司法）。

4、absurd

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “it would be ______ to restrict... to individual greed” 结构中。紧接着的后一句进行了完全对等的句式排比：“It should similarly be widely seen as absurd to restrict...” 后文直接给出了形容词 absurd。根据上下文语境中 “It would be [A]... It should similarly be seen as [A]” 的镜像呼应结构，此处直接填入 absurd。
questions.translation_html:
The narrative of law and order is located fundamentally at the level of individual guilt and responsibility.

对法律和秩序的叙述从根本上来说是位于个人罪恶和责任的层面上的。

Criminal acts are seen as individual issues of personal responsibility and culpability, to which the state responds by way of policing, prosecution, adjudication and punishment.

犯罪行为被视为个人责任和罪责的个人问题，国家通过治安、起诉、审判和惩罚的方式予以回应。

This is but one level at which crime and criminal justice can be analyzed.

这只是分析犯罪和刑事司法的一个层面。

The problem is that so often analysis ends there, at the level of individual action, characterized in terms of responsibility, guilt, evil.

问题在于，分析往往就止步于个人行为的层面，以责任、内疚和邪恶为特征。

In few other areas of social life does individualism have this hold?

在社会生活的其他领域中，个人主义很少有这种地位吗？

To take but one instance, it would be absurd to restrict analysis of obesity, to individual greed.

仅举一个例子，将肥胖分析局限于个人贪婪是荒谬的。

It should similarly be widely seen as absurd to restrict analysis of criminal justice issues to the culpability of individuals.

同样，将刑事司法问题的分析仅限于个人罪责也应该被广泛认为是荒谬的。

questions.title: Color Preference
questions.passage_html: Many tests have shown that, in a very broad way, peoples in most parts of the world have similar color preferences. Blue is the most preferred and popular hue, followed in order by red, green, purple, yellow and orange. Overlying this basic order of color preference, , are the responses of individuals, which of course vary and may also be very powerful. Children are likely to have strong preferences for some colors and aversions to others, but sometimes will not admit to them, since outside may be influential in determining both color preferences and the way that they are expressed or suppressed. Current fashions in clothes and accessories, gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure may all play a significant part. Boys in particular may be reluctant to admit to any strong preferences for colors those of favorite football teams, because color awareness may be regarded by their peer-group as feminine.
questions.analysis_html:
1、however

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格前后都有逗号，位于句中。前文提到世界各地的人颜色偏好“高度相似”，本句则讨论“个体的反应千差万别”，前后构成转折。在英语中，放在句中作为双逗号插入语、且表示上下文逻辑转折的，只有固定副词 “, however, ”。

2、widely

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “which of course vary ______” 结构中。由于 vary 是一个不及物动词，在语法规则中，能够站在不及物动词后方对其进行程度修饰的，只能是副词。选项中的副词 widely（广泛地/极大地）填入，符合“副词修饰动词”的语法修饰规律。

3、factors

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “since outside ______ may be influential” 中。后文用了一整句话列举了这些具体事物：“Current fashions..., gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure...”。由于后面的服装时尚、刻板印象、同伴压力等在宏观上都属于外部“因素”，因此 factors 完美完成了对下文具体举例的归纳。

4、other than

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “preferences for colors ______ those of favorite football teams” 结构中。小男生为了表现得阳刚，除了自己支持的足球队的颜色外，不愿承认喜欢其他颜色。在英语中，表达“除了……之外”，习惯使用的是固定习语 “other than”。
questions.translation_html:
Many tests have shown that, in a very broad way, peoples in most parts of the world have similar color preferences.

许多测试表明，世界上大部分地区的人们在很大程度上都有相似的颜色偏好。

Blue is the most preferred and popular hue, followed in order by red, green, purple, yellow and orange.

蓝色是最受欢迎和最受欢迎的色调，其次是红色、绿色、紫色、黄色和橙色。

Overlying this basic order of color preference, however, are the responses of individuals, which of course vary widely and may also be very powerful.

然而，覆盖这种颜色偏好的基本顺序的是个人的反应，这些反应当然差异很大，而且也可能非常强大。

Children are likely to have strong preferences for some colors and aversions to others, but sometimes will not admit to them, since outside factors may be influential in determining both color preferences and the way that they are expressed or suppressed.

儿童可能对某些颜色有强烈的偏好，而对另一些颜色有强烈的厌恶，但有时不会承认，因为外部因素可能会影响颜色偏好及其表达或抑制的方式。

Current fashions in clothes and accessories, gender-stereotyping and peer-group pressure may all play a significant part.

当前的服装和配饰时尚、性别刻板印象和同侪群体压力都可能发挥重要作用。

Boys in particular may be reluctant to admit to any strong preferences for colors other than those of favorite football teams, because color awareness may be regarded by their peer-group as feminine.

尤其是男孩，他们可能不愿意承认自己对除了最喜欢的足球队以外的颜色有任何强烈的偏好，因为颜色意识可能被他们的同龄人视为女性化的。

questions.title: Higher Education Shift
questions.passage_html: After centuries of inequality in UK higher education benefiting men, there has been a over the past three decades. A lower proportion of entrants to UK higher education institutions are male than ever before and they up less than one-half of the total. Other developed countries have a similar shift. Male is not seen only in the figures for entry but also in non-continuation (drop- out) rates and degree performance statistics.
questions.analysis_html:
1、reversal

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“there has been a 【 】 over the past three decades”结构中。前文提到过去几个世纪高等教育中存在性别不平等（偏向男性），而近三十年发生了变化，说明趋势发生了“逆转”。reversal（逆转）准确描述了这一结构性变化。

2、make

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“they 【 】 up less than one-half”结构中。此处需要一个动词构成短语 make up（构成/占据），指男性入学人数比例低于总数的一半。

3、undergone

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“Other developed countries have 【 】 a similar shift”结构中。这种现象不仅在英国发生，其他国家也经历了同样的趋势。undergone（经历）常用于描述国家或社会层面的变迁过程。

4、underachievement

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“Male 【 】 is not seen only in the figures...”结构中。后文提到了“drop-out”（退学率）和“degree performance”（学位表现），这些数据指标均指向男性在高等教育表现上的不足。underachievement（表现不佳/成绩低下）是对这些负面统计数据的专业总结。

After centuries of inequality in UK higher education benefiting men, there has been a reversal over the past three decades.

英国高等教育中的不平等现象持续了几个世纪，男性受益匪浅，但过去三十年出现了逆转。

英国高等教育机构的男性入学人数比以往任何时候都低，占总数的不到一半。

Other developed countries have undergone a similar shift.

其他发达国家也经历了类似的转变。

Male underachievement is not seen only in the figures for entry but also in non-continuation (drop- out) rates and degree performance statistics.

男性成绩不佳不仅体现在入学数据中，还体现在不继续（退学）率和学位表现统计数据中。

questions.title: MBA
questions.passage_html: Deciding to go to business school is perhaps the simplest part of what can be a complicated process. With nearly 600 accredited MBA programs on around the world, the choice of where to study can be overwhelming. Here we explain how to the right school and course for you and unravel the application and funding process. "Probably the of people applying to business school are at a point in their careers where they know they to shake things up, but they don't know exactly what they want to do with their professional lives," says Stacy Blackman, an MBA admissions consultant based in Los Angeles. "If that's the case with you, look at other : culture, teaching method, location, and then pick a place that’s a good fit for you with a strong general management program. Super- defined career goals don’t have to be a part of this process."
questions.analysis_html:
1、offer

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “programs on ______ around the world” 结构中。在英语中，表达“可供选择 / 在售 / 供应中”，习惯使用的是固定介词短语搭配 “on offer”。

2、choose

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “how to ______ the right school and course” 结构中。由不定式符号 to 引导，后面接了并列的两个宾语“学校和课程”。根据单句内部的逻辑，面对前面提到的600多个令人眼花缭乱的项目，申请者需要知道如何去“挑选”最适合自己的那一个。choose（选择/挑选）作为动词最为符合句意。

3、majority

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “Probably the ______ of people applying to business school...” 结构中。在英语中，表达“绝大多数的……”，习惯使用的是固定数量修饰结构 “the majority of...”。

4、want

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “where they know they ______ to shake things up” 结构中。在语法和词汇习惯中，表达“想要做某事”且后接动词不定式 to do 时，使用的是固定动词短语 “want to do something”。

5、criteria

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “look at other ______: culture, teaching method, location” 结构中。核心线索是空格后方的冒号 “:”，它引出了具体的列举内容：校园文化、教学方法、地理位置。这些在宏观上都属于选择学校时所参考的“标准 / 条件”。因此，复数名词 criteria（标准/准则）在上下文语境中完美完成了对后文具体举例的归纳概括。

questions.title: Evolution
questions.passage_html: In The Origin of Species, Darwin provided abundant evidence that life on Earth has evolved over time, and he proposed natural selection as the primary mechanism for that change. He observed that individuals in their inherited traits and that selection acts on such differences, leading to change. Although Darwin realized that variation in heritable traits is a prerequisite for , he did not know precisely how organisms pass heritable traits to their offspring. Just a few years after Darwin published The Origin of Species, Gregor Mendel wrote a groundbreaking paper on inheritance in pea plants. In that paper, Mendel proposed a model of inheritance in which organisms transmit discrete heritable units (now called genes) to their offspring. Although Darwin did not know about genes, Mendel’s paper set the stage understanding the genetic differences on which evolution is based.
questions.analysis_html:
1、differ

考点:固定搭配

解析:`differ in` 构成固定搭配,意思是“在......方面不同”。句子说明个体在遗传性状上存在差异。因此填 `differ`。

2、evolutionary

考点:单句理解

解析:句子说达尔文观察到个体在遗传性状上存在差异,自然选择作用于这些差异,从而导致进化变化。evolutionary change 表示“进化变化”,符合该句语境,因此填 `evolutionary`。

3、evolution

考点:上下文语境

解析:`prerequisite for evolution`意思是“进化的先决条件”。句子说明可遗传性状的变异是进化发生的前提。因此填 `evolution`。

4、for

考点:固定搭配

解析:`set the stage for` 构成固定搭配,意思是“为......奠定基础”。句子说明孟德尔的论文为理解进化所依据的遗传差异奠定了基础。因此填 `for`。
questions.translation_html:
In The Origin of Species, Darwin provided abundant evidence that life on Earth has evolved over time, and he proposed natural selection as the primary mechanism for that change.

在《物种起源》一书中，达尔文提供了大量证据表明地球上的生命是随时间进化的，并提出自然选择是这一变化的主要机制。

He observed that individuals differ in their inherited traits and that selection acts on such differences, leading to evolutionary change.

他观察到，个体在遗传性状上存在差异，而自然选择作用于这些差异，从而导致进化性的变化。

Although Darwin realized that variation in heritable traits is a prerequisite for evolution, he did not know precisely how organisms pass heritable traits to their offspring.

尽管达尔文意识到可遗传性状的变异是进化的先决条件，但他并不确切知道生物体是如何将可遗传性状传递给后代的。

Just a few years after Darwin published The Origin of Species, Gregor Mendel wrote a groundbreaking paper on inheritance in pea plants.

就在达尔文发表《物种起源》几年后，格雷戈尔·孟德尔撰写了一篇关于豌豆遗传的开创性论文。

In that paper, Mendel proposed a model of inheritance in which organisms transmit discrete heritable units (now called genes) to their offspring.

在那篇论文中，孟德尔提出了一个遗传模型，认为生物体将离散的可遗传单位（现在称为基因）传递给后代。

Although Darwin did not know about genes, Mendel's paper set the stage for understanding the genetic differences on which evolution is based.

尽管达尔文不知道基因的存在，但孟德尔的论文为理解进化所依据的遗传差异奠定了基础。

blanks.explanation: 句子说达尔文观察到个体在遗传性状上存在差异,自然选择作用于这些差异,从而导致进化变化。evolutionary change 表示“进化变化”,符合该句语境,因此填 `evolutionary`。

blanks.explanation: `prerequisite for evolution`意思是“进化的先决条件”。句子说明可遗传性状的变异是进化发生的前提。因此填 `evolution`。

questions.title: Tomato
questions.passage_html: The tomato is probably the most widely grown by the home gardener because of its value, many uses, and relative ease of . Originating in Central and South America, the tomato was domesticated in Mexico. There are many related species in South America. “Tomati” was the name by Native Americans.
questions.analysis_html:
1、vegetable

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “The tomato is probably the most widely grown ______ by the home gardener” 结构中。虽然在植物学上西红柿属于水果，但在日常烹饪、园艺种植以及本题的选项语境中，它被普遍当作一种“蔬菜”来种植和消费。vegetable（蔬菜）最符合家庭园艺种植的日常分类。

2、food

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “because of its ______ value” 结构中。在营养学和食品科学语境中，表达某种作物的“营养价值 / 食用价值”，习惯使用的是固定搭配 “food value”（或 nutritional value）。

3、culture

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “and relative ease of ______” 结构中。在农业和园艺学中，culture 除了“文化”之外，还有一个核心专业含义是“栽培 / 养殖 / 种植”。这里是指西红柿对于家庭园艺者来说“相对容易栽培”。culture（栽培）填入单句中，完美呼应了句首的 grown（种植）。

4、wild

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “There are many related ______ species in South America” 结构中。

核心线索是前一句的动词 “domesticated（驯化/家养化）”。前文提到西红柿在墨西哥被人类“驯化”了，紧接着本句指出在南美洲还存在着许多相关的品种。

在生物学和农业语境中，“家养/驯化（domesticated）”与“野生（wild）”是一对最经典的反义概念。既然前句说了墨西哥的是人工驯化版，为了形成对比，后句指的必然是大自然中存在的原始“野生物种”。因此，填入形容词 wild 完美完成了与前句的语境逻辑对照。

5、used

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “‘Tomati’ was the name ______ by Native Americans” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处为“过去分词短语作后置定语”。used 作为过去分词放在名词 name 后面，相当于一个省略了关系代词的定语从句（which was used），用来修饰这个名字是被美洲原住民所“使用”的。

Originating in Central and South America, the tomato was domesticated in Mexico.

番茄原产于中美洲和南美洲，在墨西哥驯化。

There are many related wild species in South America.

南美洲有许多相关的野生物种。

“Tomati” was the name used by Native Americans.

“Tomati”是美洲原住民使用的名字。

questions.title: Herbal
questions.passage_html: A herbal is a book of plants, describing their appearance, their properties and how they may be used for preparing ointments and medicines. The medical use of plants is on fragments of papyrus and clay tablets from ancient Egypt, Samaria and China that date back 5,000 years but document traditions far older still. Over 700 herbal remedies were detailed in the Papyrus Ebers, an Egyptian text written in 1500 BC. Around 65 BC, a Greek physician called Dioscorides wrote a herbal that was into Latin and Arabic. Known as ‘De materia medica’, it became the most influential work on medicinal plants in both Christian and Islamic worlds until the late 17th century. An illustrated manuscript copy of the text made in Constantinople (modern- day Istanbul) from the sixth century. The first printed herbals date from the dawn of European printing in the 1480s. They provided valuable information for apothecaries, whose job was to make the pills and potions by physicians. In the next century, landmark herbals were produced in England by William Turner, considered to be the father of British botany, and John Gerard, whose illustrations would inspire the floral fabric, wallpaper and tile designs of William Morris four centuries later.
questions.analysis_html:
1、recorded

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“is ______ on fragments of papyrus”，主语 The medical use of plants 与 record（记录）之间为被动关系，is recorded 为一般现在时的被动语态。表示植物的医疗用途被记录在莎草纸和泥板碎片上。因此填 recorded。

2、translated

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“a herbal that was ______ into Latin and Arabic”，that 指代 a herbal，与 translate（翻译）之间为被动关系，was translated 为一般过去时的被动语态。表示这本草药书被翻译成拉丁语和阿拉伯语。因此填 translated。

3、survives

考点:单句理解

解析:空格位于“An illustrated manuscript copy... ______ from the sixth century”。本句内部语义完整：一份带插图的抄本“幸存/保存下来”自6世纪。survives 意为“幸存/保存至今”，符合语义。因此填 survives。

4、prescribed

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“pills and potions ______ by physicians”，pills and potions 与 prescribe（开处方）之间为被动关系，过去分词 prescribed 作后置定语，相当于“that were prescribed by physicians”。表示药剂师制作医生开出的药丸和药水。因此填 prescribed。

A herbal is a book of plants, describing their appearance, their properties and how they may be used for preparing ointments and medicines.

草药是一种植物书籍,描述它们的外观、它们的特性和它们如何被用来准备药膏

Over 700 herbal remedies were detailed in the Papyrus Ebers, an Egyptian text written in 1500 BC.

多种草药疗法。

Around 65 BC, a Greek physician called Dioscorides wrote a herbal that was translated into Latin and Arabic.

大约公元前65年,一位名叫迪奥斯科里德斯的希腊医生写了一本关于草药的书,

Known as ‘De materia medica’, it became the most influential work on medicinal plants in both Christian and Islamic worlds until the late 17th century.这本书被称为《德物医》,直到17世纪末,它一直是基督教和伊斯兰世界最有影响力的药用植物著作。

An illustrated manuscript copy of the text made in Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) survives from the sixth century.

一份六世纪的文本抄本,其中配有插图,该抄本是在君士坦丁堡(现伊斯坦布

尔)制作的。

The first printed herbals date from the dawn of European printing in the 1480s.

最早的印刷草药书籍可追溯到15世纪80年代欧洲印刷业刚刚兴起之时。

They provided valuable information for apothecaries, whose job was to make the pills and potions prescribed by physicians.

这些书籍为药剂师提供了宝贵的信息,他们的工作是按照医生的处方制作药片和

药水。

In the next century, landmark herbals were produced in England by William Turner, considered to be the father of British botany, and John Gerard, whose illustrations would inspire the floral fabric, wallpaper and tile designs of William Morris four centuries later.

在下一个世纪,英国出现了里程碑式的草药书籍,这些书籍由威廉·特纳和约翰·

杰拉德编写,特纳被认为是英国植物学的奠基人,而杰拉德的插图四个世纪后仍将启发威廉·莫里斯的花卉织物、壁纸和瓷砖设计。

questions.title: Cuypers Library
questions.passage_html: The Cuypers Library is a research library in Amsterdam's famous Rijks museum. It is the oldest and largest of its kind in the country and aesthetically astounding. However, despite the streams of tourists that flow through the museum, far too seem to trickle into its remarkable reading room. The 19th-century library, which has recently been , has been collecting content since 1885. Its are stocked with manuscripts bound to entice any art history lover. While browsing its extensive collection, you'll come across books, journals, and periodicals, as well as catalogues about art auctions, exhibitions, trades, and collections. Following its renovations, the museum opened the library's reading room to visitors. Tourists, students, and art historians alike are welcome to delve into its rich collection. Tables on the ground floor allow people to hunker down with their research materials, surrounded by the library’s aesthetically astounding walls of books.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. few

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“far too ______ seem to trickle into its remarkable reading room”。前句说“尽管有大量游客涌入博物馆”，后句说“进入阅览室的人______”。far too few 意为“太少了”，表示与大量游客相比，进入阅览室的人极少。many 与 despite 的逻辑矛盾（尽管游客多，但进入阅览室的人也多，无法构成对比）。因此填 few。

2. restored

考点： 单句理解

解析： 空格位于“which has recently been ______”。restored 意为“修复/翻新”，句意是“这座19世纪的图书馆最近得到了修复”。后文提到“Following its renovations”（在翻新之后），进一步印证了“修复”的含义。renovated 也意为“翻新”，与 restored 高度近义，但 restored 更侧重于“修复恢复原貌”，而 renovated 侧重于“翻新改造”；考虑到图书馆作为历史建筑，restored（修复）更贴切。因此填 restored。

3. shelves

考点： 上下文语境

解析： 空格位于“Its ______ are stocked with manuscripts”。shelves 意为“书架”，句意是“它的书架上堆满了手稿”。collections 意为“收藏品”，若填 collections 则意为“它的收藏品中堆满了手稿”——收藏品本身包含手稿，逻辑上应为“书架/架子上”存放着手稿。因此填 shelves。

questions.title: Ancient Paintings
questions.passage_html: Ancient paintings offer a fascinating glimpse into the lives, beliefs, and artistic skills of early civilizations. Many of these paintings were created on cave walls or pottery and have survived for thousands of years due to their . The subjects of ancient paintings often include animals, humans, and scenes from daily life. These artworks were not only meant for decoration but also had significance. For instance, some cave paintings are believed to have been created for ritualistic purposes or to convey stories and . The use of natural pigments and techniques highlights the resourcefulness and creativity of ancient artists. Despite the passage of time, the beauty and intricacy of ancient paintings continue to captivate and inspire modern audiences.
questions.analysis_html:
1、preservation

考点：单句理解

解析：句子前面提到这些画作“have survived for thousands of years”（已经存活了数千年），后面接“due to their ______”（由于它们的……）。根据因果逻辑，文物能跨越漫长历史存留至今，必然是由于它们得到了良好的保存或具备不易腐烂的保存条件。因此，填入名词 preservation（保存/留存状态）完全是由单句内部的因果链条决定的。

2、religious

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于“had ______ significance”中，单独看这一句无法确定古代绘画具有什么具体的意义。但紧接着后文给出了具体的线索：“For instance, some cave paintings are believed to have been created for ritualistic purposes”（例如，某些洞穴壁画被认为是为了仪式目的而创作的）。在早期人类社会中，“仪式（ritualistic）”与图腾、神明、信仰密不可分，因此必须通过后文的举例，才能反推出前文所说的意义是指 religious（宗教的/信仰的）意义。

3、folklore

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “to convey stories and ______” 结构中。这里的 “and” 是核心线索，表明空格处的词必须与前面的名词 “stories” 构成并列关系。选项中的 folklore（民间传说/民俗故事）作为一种特定的故事载体，与 stories 词性相同、语义范畴对等，完美并列共同作为 convey 的宾语。

4、traditional

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰“techniques”（技法）。本句前文提到“The use of natural pigments（使用天然颜料）”，利用大自然现有的矿石、植物油脂进行作画，是远古画家在科技不发达时世代相传、因陋就简的创作手段。traditional（传统的）在此处修饰技术，极为准确地描绘了这种古老技艺的传承特征。
questions.translation_html:
Ancient paintings offer a fascinating glimpse into the lives, beliefs, and artistic skills of early civilizations.

古代绘画让我们得以一睹早期文明的生活、信仰和艺术技巧。

Many of these paintings were created on cave walls or pottery and have survived for thousands of years due to their preservation.

其中许多绘画是在洞穴墙壁或陶器上创作的，由于保存完好，已经保存了数千年。

The subjects of ancient paintings often include animals, humans, and scenes from daily life.

古代绘画的题材往往包括动物、人物和日常生活场景。

These artworks were not only meant for decoration but also had religious significance.

这些艺术品不仅具有装饰作用，还具有宗教意义。

For instance, some cave paintings are believed to have been created for ritualistic purposes or to convey stories and folklore.

例如，一些洞穴壁画被认为是出于仪式目的或传达故事和民间传说而创作的。

The use of natural pigments and traditional techniques highlights the resourcefulness and creativity of ancient artists.

天然颜料和传统技法的运用，凸显了古代艺术家的足智多谋和创造力。

Despite the passage of time, the beauty and intricacy of ancient paintings continue to captivate and inspire modern audiences.

尽管时间流逝，古代绘画的美丽和复杂仍然吸引和启发着现代观众。

questions.title: Great Engineers
questions.passage_html: Great engineers have a passion to improve life; a burning conviction that they can make life better for everyone. Engineers need to have a talent for invention and innovation, but what them is the conviction that they can find a better way to do things; a cheaper and more efficient solution to the problems of human existence on this planet of resources that we call Earth. Many of us a lot of time complaining about the difficulties and problems of life. It is easy to find fault with things that make daily life arduous. For an engineer, these difficulties can be opportunities. How can this be made to work better? How can that process be made more efficient? How can be made more cheaply, more accurately and more fit-for-purpose? Great engineers are convinced that everything can be . Instead of complaining, they think of ways to make things better.
questions.analysis_html:
1、drives

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “but what ______ them is the conviction...” 结构中。前文提到伟大工程师拥有“热烈的信念（a burning conviction）”，本句开头又用 “but” 进行了语意承接。这种内心的信念是促使他们去寻找更好解决方法的动力。在选项中，drives（驱动/激励）最能与“信念”呼应，表达这种内在力量对工程师行为的推动作用。

2、limited

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰地球的 “resources（资源）”。根据常识与科学事实，地球的资源是稀缺、有限的，这也正是工程师需要寻找“更便宜、更高效（a cheaper and more efficient solution）”解决办法的原因。limited（有限的）在单句中直接说明了资源的属性。

3、spend

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “Many of us ______ a lot of time complaining...” 结构中。在英语中，“spend + 时间/金钱 + doing something” 是一个极其经典的固定搭配结构，意为“花费时间/金钱做某事”。

4、components

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “How can ______ be made more cheaply, more accurately...” 结构中。前文讨论的是提高过程效率和制造物品，此处指代工业生产中被制造出来的具体物件。components（零部件/组件）作为主语，符合工程制造与组装的单句语境。

5、improved

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “Great engineers are convinced that everything can be ______” 结构中。文章首句就指出工程师有“改善生活的激情（a passion to improve life）”，尾句再次呼应 “think of ways to make things better”。因此，中间这句表明他们坚信“一切都可以被改进”，improved（改进/完善）与前后文的 improve 和 make things better 构成了完美的语义呼应。

伟大的工程师有改善生活的热情；坚信他们可以让每个人的生活变得更美好。

Engineers need to have a talent for invention and innovation, but what drives them is the conviction that they can find a better way to do things; a cheaper and more efficient solution to the problems of human existence on this planet of limited resources that we call Earth.

工程师需要具备发明和创新的天赋，但驱动他们的是坚信自己能够找到更好的做事方式；一种更便宜、更有效的解决方案，解决人类在这个资源有限的星球（我们称之为地球）上的生存问题。

Many of us spend a lot of time complaining about the difficulties and problems of life.

我们中的许多人花了很多时间抱怨生活中的困难和问题。

It is easy to find fault with things that make daily life arduous.

人们很容易对那些让日常生活变得艰难的事情挑剔。

For an engineer, these difficulties can be opportunities.

对于工程师来说，这些困难也可能是机遇。

How can this be made to work better?

如何才能使其发挥更好的作用？

How can that process be made more efficient?

如何才能使这个过程更加高效？

How can components be made more cheaply, more accurately and more fit-for-purpose?

如何才能更便宜、更准确、更适合用途？

Great engineers are convinced that everything can be improved.

伟大的工程师相信一切都可以改进。

Instead of complaining, they think of ways to make things better.

他们不会抱怨，而是想办法让事情变得更好。

questions.title: Emotional Intelligence
questions.passage_html: The to control emotions is crucial to success. In 1990, two scholars the term “emotional intelligence”. Years later, Daniel Goleman, in the Harvard Business was why leaders must cultivate this ability. Since then, the concept has influenced the community’s emphasis on integrity and cooperation.
questions.analysis_html:
1、ability

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “The ______ to control emotions” 结构中。在英语语法与日常表达中，由名词引导动词不定式作后置定语，用来表达“做某事的能力”时，习惯使用的是固定搭配 “the ability to do something”。

2、coined

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格在句中作谓语动词：“two scholars ______ the term ‘emotional intelligence’”。在学术界和语言学中，表达“发明/创造一个新词汇、新术语”，习惯使用的是固定动词短语搭配 “coin a term”。

3、Review

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “Harvard Business ______.” 结构中，且位于句尾。

第一步看标点： 空格后方紧跟一个句号，说明这里需要填入一个名词。

第二步看大写（核心线索）： 前面的 Harvard 和 Business 首字母都是大写的，这暗示空格处有极大可能也需要填入一个首字母大写的名词，共同构成一个专有名词（如机构、杂志、书籍或地名）。

第三步选项筛选： 观察选项，首字母大写的词只有 Review 和 Recycle。在考场上，根据最基本的常识逻辑进行二选一：哈佛商业【评论/回顾】（Review）显然比哈佛商业【回收/循环】（Recycle）通顺且符合学术文章的逻辑。因此，通过大写锁定和语义筛选即可秒杀。

4、telling

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “was ______ why leaders must cultivate this ability” 结构中，在过去进行时态（was + doing）中作现在分词。根据句意，丹尼尔·戈尔曼在文章中正在“告诉 / 阐述”读者为什么领导者必须培养这种能力。telling（讲述/告诉）填入单句中，最符合作者向公众传播观点、解释原因的动作逻辑。

Since then, the concept has influenced the community’s emphasis on integrity and cooperation.

questions.title: Answering Questions
questions.passage_html: You have about 30 minutes to answer each question. You must take account of how many marks are for each part when you answer it. Even if you think you can write more, don't spend 15 minutes a part worth only 5 marks. Leave space at the end of your answer and come back to it if you have to spare later. questions.analysis_html:
1、available

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “how many marks are ______ for each part” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处为 “marks are available” 这一固定的“名词 + 形容词定语”结构。在考试和授课语境中，表达某道题“可获得的 / 分配给该题的”分数，必须使用形容词 available 作后置修饰。

2、answering

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “don't spend 15 minutes ______ a part...” 结构中。在英语语法中，表达“花费多少时间做某事”，使用的是固定句型结构 “spend time doing something”。因此，此处必须填入现在分词 answering（回答）。

3、time

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “if you have ______ to spare later” 结构中。在英语中，表达“有充裕的时间 / 有剩余的时间可供支配”，使用的是固定搭配 “have time to spare”。

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰名词 “time（时间）”。句中提到，在考试时如果不知道正确答案而瞎写一些不相关的东西，纯粹是在浪费你（和阅卷老师）的“宝贵”时间。valuable（宝贵的）在单句中精准地修饰了考试时分秒必争的时间属性。

questions.title: Stress
questions.passage_html: Stress is what you feel when you have to handle more than you are used to. When you are stressed, your body as though you are in danger. It makes that speed up your heart, make you breathe faster, and give you a burst of energy. This is called the fight-or-flight stress . Some stress is normal and even useful. Stress can help if you need to work hard or react quickly. For example, it can help you win a race or an important job on time. But if stress happens too often or lasts too long, it can have bad effects. It can weaken your system, making it harder to fight off .
questions.analysis_html:
1、responds

考点：语法结构

解析：空格在句中作谓语动词。因为主语 your body 是单数第三人称，且全文都在阐述一个客观事实，所以此处必须填入动词的单三形式 responds，在语法上构成主谓一致。

2、hormones

考点：单句理解

解析：空格后面由 that 引导的定语从句明确指出，这些物质的功能是“加速心跳、让你呼吸加快并获得爆发力”。在人体处于高压状态时，能在体内迅速分泌并产生这种强烈生理调节作用的物质只能是复数名词 hormones（激素）。

3、response

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格与前文的 fight-or-flight 构成了心理学和生物学中极其著名的固定的专用术语，即 “fight-or-flight response”（战斗或逃跑反应）。

4、finish

考点：语法结构

解析：空格处于由连词 or 连接的并列结构中。or 的前方是动词原形 win，根据语法的并列对称原则，后方也必须使用动词原形，结合后文的提示语 on time（按时），此处填入 finish 构成“按时完成工作”。

5、immune

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格与后面的名词 system 构成了医学和生理学上雷打不动的固定标准搭配，即 “immune system”（免疫系统）。

6、disease

考点：单句理解

questions.title: Concept of Culture
questions.passage_html: Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe during the 18th and early 19th centuries. This of culture reflected inequalities within European societies and their colonies around the world. This understanding of culture equates culture with civilization and contrasts both with nature or non-civilization. According to this understanding of culture, some countries are more civilized than others, and some people are more cultured than others. Anything that doesn’t fit into this category is labeled as chaos or anarchy. From this perspective, culture is closely tied to cultivation, which is the progressive refinement of human . In practice, culture referred to elite goods and activities such as haute cuisine, high fashion or haute couture, museum-caliber art and classical music. The word cultured referred to people who knew about and took part in these activities. For example, someone who used culture in this sense might that classical music is more refined than music by working-class people, such as jazz or the indigenous music traditions of aboriginal peoples.
questions.analysis_html:
1、concept

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “This ______ of culture reflected...” 结构中。核心线索是紧随其后的下一句：“This understanding of culture equates...”。在前后句式高度对等的学术文本中，后文的 understanding（理解/观念）与前文空格处的名词构成了直接的同义近义词呼应。选项中的 concept（概念/观念）填入其中，完美实现了上下文语境的词汇衔接。

2、behavior

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “the progressive refinement of human ______” 结构中。在社会学和人类学语境中，表达“人类行为的逐步完善 / 人类行为的开化”，习惯使用的是固定搭配 “human behavior”（人类行为）。

3、argue

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “might ______ that classical music is more refined...” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处位于情态动词 might 的后方，必须填入一个动词原形来作谓语，且该动词后面直接顶着一个由 that 引导的宾语从句。选项中只有动词原形 argue（主张/认为）符合“情态动词 + 动词原形 + that从句”的语法规则。

今天，许多人对文化的理解方式，与18世纪及19世纪早期欧洲人对文化的理解方式相同。

This concept of culture reflected inequalities within European societies and their colonies around the world.

这种文化概念反映了欧洲社会及其在世界各地殖民地内部的不平等。

This understanding of culture equates culture with civilization and contrasts both with nature or non-civilization.

这种对文化的理解将文化与文明等同起来，并将二者与自然或非文明相对立。

According to this understanding of culture, some countries are more civilized than others, and some people are more cultured than others.

根据这种对文化的理解，一些国家比其他国家更文明，一些人比其他人更有文化修养。

Anything that doesn’t fit into this category is labeled as chaos or anarchy.

任何不符合这一类别的事物都会被贴上混乱或无政府状态的标签。

从这个角度看，文化与“教化”紧密相连，而“教化”是人类行为的逐步完善。

questions.title: Coral Reefs
questions.passage_html: Coral reefs support more marine life than any other ocean ecosystem and are, not , a favorite pursuit for many divers. But as well as being physically and biologically spectacular, coral reefs also the livelihoods of over half a billion . What is more, this number is expected to in coming decades while the area of high-quality reef is expected to halve. In combination with the very real threat of climate change, which could lead to increased seawater temperatures and ocean , we start to arrive at some quite frightening scenarios.
questions.analysis_html:
1、surprisingly

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “not surprisingly” 这一结构。在英语中，这是一个极其常用的固定插入语，意为“不出所料地 / 毫无疑问地”。作者在此处用其来修饰整句话，说明珊瑚礁作为生物最丰富的生态系统，自然而然会成为潜水者的最爱。

2、support

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “coral reefs also ______ the livelihoods of over half a billion...” 结构中。本篇首句就提到 “Coral reefs support more marine life...（珊瑚礁支持/养活了更多的海洋生物）”，此处使用副词 “also（也）”进行语义递进，表明珊瑚礁不仅养活了海洋生物，还“养活/维系着”超过五亿人口的生计。support 在此处构成了前后文的词汇精准呼应。

3、people

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于数量词 “half a billion（五亿）” 后面。此处用于指代依赖珊瑚礁维持生计的人口数量。虽然选项中的 human 也表示人类，但它通常用作形容词或总称名词，在表达具体数量的“多少人”时，习惯使用名词复数 people。

4、double

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “this number is expected to ______ in coming decades” 结构中。前文提到这个数字目前是五亿，后面用 “while（然而）”引导的内容进行了反差对比——“高质量珊瑚礁的面积预计将减半（halve）”。为了对应“面积减半”所带来的生存危机和后文“令人恐惧的场景（frightening scenarios）”，依赖它的人口数量在未来几十年必然是急剧增加。double（翻倍）在单句内部与 halve（减半）构成了完美的数量对应逻辑。

5、acidification

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “increased seawater temperatures and ocean ______” 结构中。由连词 “and” 连接，空格处需要填入一个与“海水温度升高”并列的全球气候变暖带来的海洋生态灾难。在环境科学语境中，“ocean acidification” 是一个标准的固定专业术语，意为“海洋酸化”。

珊瑚礁不仅在物理和生物上令人惊叹，还支撑着超过 5 亿人的生计。

What is more, this number is expected to double in coming decades while the area of high-quality reef is expected to halve.

更重要的是，这个数字预计在未来几十年内将增加一倍，而优质珊瑚礁的面积预计将减少一半。

In combination with the very real threat of climate change, which could lead to increased seawater temperatures and ocean acidification, we start to arrive at some quite frightening scenarios.

再加上气候变化的现实威胁（可能导致海水温度升高和海洋酸化），我们开始看到一些相当可怕的情景。

questions.title: Country Definition
questions.passage_html: What is a country, and how is a country defined? When people ask how many countries there are in the world, they expect a simple answer. After , we've explored the whole planet, we have international travel, satellite navigation and plenty of global organizations like the United Nations, so we really know how many countries there are! However, the answer to the question varies according to whom you ask. Most people say there are 192 countries, but others point out that there could be more like 260 of them. So why isn't there a straightforward answer? The problem because there isn't a universally agreed definition of 'country' and because, for political reasons, some countries it convenient to recognize or not recognize countries.
questions.analysis_html:
1、all

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“After ______”，after all 是固定搭配，意为“毕竟”。前文提到人们期望一个简单的答案，本句进一步说明原因：毕竟我们已经探索了整个星球，拥有国际旅行、卫星导航和许多像联合国这样的全球性组织。after all 在这里起到补充说明的作用，使逻辑更完整。因此填 all。

2、should

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“so we ______ really know how many countries there are”，should 在此处作情态动词，表示根据常理做出的推断或预期，意为“应当”。前文列举了我们拥有全球探索、国际旅行、卫星导航和联合国等条件，因此按照常理我们“应当”知道有多少个国家。这种“条件 + so + should”的结构表达了一种合理的预期。因此填 should。

3、arises

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“The problem ______ because there isn't a universally agreed definition”。本句内部语义完整：问题“产生”是因为没有一个普遍认同的“国家”定义。arises 意为“出现/产生”，与主语 problem 构成主谓关系，表示问题的来源。仅凭本句即可判断需要表示“出现”的动词。因此填 arises。

4、find

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“some countries ______ it convenient to recognize or not recognize other countries”。此处为“find + it + 形容词 + to do”的语法结构，其中 it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的 to recognize or not recognize other countries。find 意为“发现/认为”，find it convenient 表示“认为这样很方便”。这种结构在英语中非常常见，属于重要的语法考点。因此填 find。

5、other

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“recognize or not recognize ______ countries”。本句内部语义完整：一些国家出于政治原因，发现承认或不承认“其他”国家很方便。other countries 意为“其他国家”，与主语 some countries 形成对应关系。仅凭本句即可判断需要表示“其他的”形容词。因此填 other。
questions.translation_html:
What is a country, and how is a country defined?

什么是国家？国家又是如何界定的？

When people ask how many countries there are in the world, they expect a simple answer.

当人们问世界上有多少个国家时，他们期待一个简单的答案。

After all, we've explored the whole planet, we have international travel, satellite navigation and plenty of global organizations like the United Nations, so we should really know how many countries there are!

毕竟，我们已经探索了整个星球，我们有国际旅行、卫星导航以及像联合国这样的大量全球性组织，所以我们应该确实知道有多少个国家！

However, the answer to the question varies according to whom you ask.

然而，这个问题的答案因你问的对象而异。

Most people say there are 192 countries, but others point out that there could be more like 260 of them.

大多数人认为有192个国家，但也有人指出可能多达260个左右。

So why isn't there a straightforward answer?

那么为什么没有一个直截了当的答案呢？

The problem arises because there isn't a universally agreed definition of 'country' and because, for political reasons, some countries find it convenient to recognize or not recognize other countries.

questions.title: Dictionary
questions.passage_html: Samuel Johnson's Dictionary of the English Language is one of the most famous dictionaries in . First published in 1755, the dictionary took just over eight years to compile, six helpers and listed 40,000 words. Each word was defined in , the definitions illustrated with quotations every branch of learning. It was a huge scholarly , a more extensive and complex dictionary than any of its predecessors ‒ the comparable French Dictionnaire had taken 55 years to compile and required the dedication of 40 scholars.
questions.analysis_html:
1、history

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “one of the most famous dictionaries in ______” 结构中。在英语中，表达“历史上最著名的……”，习惯使用的是固定介词短语搭配 “in history”。

2、required

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “the dictionary took just over eight years to compile, ______ six helpers and listed 40,000 words” 这一并列的分句结构中。该句描述了编纂这部词典所付出的代价与规模：耗时八年、列出四万单词，中间自然是“需要/雇佣了”六位助手。required（需要）作为过去时态的动词，在单句内部精准说明了人力成本的投入。

3、detail

考点：固定搭配

questions.title: Lens
questions.passage_html: The lens in the human eye works much like the lens in a camera. Just as a camera its focus, the lens changes its shape to bend and focus the light a second time, ensuring that you have a clear and image of whatever you are looking at. Whether the object is close or away, the lens adapts accordingly. questions.analysis_html:
1、adjusts

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “Just as a camera ______ its focus” 结构中。本句利用类比（Just as...）来解释人眼晶状体的工作原理，后半句提到晶状体改变形状来聚焦，那么前半句对应的大自然中的相机自然也是“调整”其焦距。adjusts（调整/调节）在单句内部完美对应了相机调焦的机械动作。

2、precise

考点：单句理解

解析：空格修饰名词 “image（图像/物像）”。由连词 “and” 与形容词 clear（清晰的）并列，共同修饰眼睛看物体时视网膜上所呈现的图像品质。为了确保视觉质量，图像除了清晰之外，还必须是“精准的 / 准确的”。precise（精确的）填入单句中，符合人眼光学聚焦的生理结果。

3、far

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “Whether the object is close or ______ away” 结构中。在英语中，表达距离上的“遥远的 / 距离远的”，习惯使用的是固定短语搭配 “far away”。它与前文的 close 构成了完美的远近对照。

Whether the object is close or far away, the lens adapts accordingly.

无论物体是近还是远，镜头都会相应地进行调整。

Structurally, the lens is made up of water and protein, which together allow it to remain transparent and flexible throughout much of life.

从结构上讲，晶状体由水和蛋白质组成，它们共同使其在生命的大部分时间里保持透明和柔韧。

questions.title: Electrons
questions.passage_html: The electrons that orbit closest to the nucleus are strongly . They are called bound electrons. The electrons that are farther away from the pull of nucleus can be out of their . These are called free electrons. Free electrons can move from one atom to another. This is known as electron flow. Electricity is the movement or flow of electrons from one atom to another.
questions.analysis_html:
1、attracted

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“strongly ______”。本句内部语义完整：最靠近原子核的电子受到强烈的“吸引”。attracted 意为“被吸引”，符合语义。因此填 attracted。

2、forced

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“can be ______ out of their orbits”。此处为被动语态结构（can be + 过去分词），表示电子可以被“强制”离开轨道。force out of 是一个常见的动词 + 介词短语结构。因此填 forced。

3、orbits

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“out of their ______”。本句内部语义完整：离原子核较远的电子可以被强制离开它们的“轨道”。orbits 意为“轨道”，符合语义。因此填 orbits。

4、phenomenon

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“This ______ is known as electron flow”。本句内部语义完整：这种“现象”被称为电子流。phenomenon 意为“现象”，符合语义。因此填 phenomenon。

距离原子核吸引力更远的电子可能会被迫离开它们的轨道。

这些电子被称为自由电子。

自由电子可以从一个原子移动到另一个原子。

This phenomenon is known as electron flow.

这种现象被称为电子流。

Electricity is the movement or flow of electrons from one atom to another.

电就是电子从一个原子到另一个原子的运动或流动。

questions.title: English Language
questions.passage_html: With about one and a half billion non-native speakers, English has become the world's own language. Such has its downside, of course. There are now about 6,800 languages left in the world, compared with perhaps that number back at the dawn of agriculture. Thanks in to the rise of über-languages, most importantly English, the remaining languages are now dying at the of about one a fortnight. Want to learn Busuu, anyone? Then you'd better head to Cameroon fast, before one of the language's last eight speakers kicks the bucket (as the Busuu-nese presumably doesn't say).
questions.analysis_html:
1、dominance

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格位于 “Such ______ has its downside” 结构中。核心线索是限定词 “Such（这种）”，它表明空格处的名词必须是对前一句话的高度概括。前文提到“英语拥有15亿非母语使用者，已经成为了世界性语言”，这直接反映了英语在全球的“统治地位 / 绝对优势”。因此，填入名词 dominance（统治地位）完成了精准的语境呼应。

2、twice

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “compared with perhaps ______ that number” 结构中。此处在将现存的6800种语言与农业文明初期时的语言数量进行对比。根据后文“语言正在以每两周消失一种的速度消亡（dying）”这一事实，可以反推出过去的语言数量应当远高于现在。twice（两倍）填入单句中，符合历史发展中语言数量从多到少的消亡逻辑。

3、part

考点：固定搭配

解析：句中出现了 “thanks in part to...” 这一结构。在英语中，这是一个极其常用的固定搭配短语，意为“在很大程度上由于…… / 部分归功于……”，用于引出导致事情发生的其中一个核心原因。

4、rate

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于 “dying at the ______ of about one a fortnight” 结构中。在英语中，表达“以……的速度 / 以……的速率”，使用的是由介词 at 引导的固定短语搭配 “at the rate of...”。

当然，这种主导地位也有其缺点。

现在世界上大约还剩下 6,800 种语言，而这一数字可能是农业初期的两倍。

部分由于超级语言（最重要的是英语）的兴起，其余语言现在正以大约每两周一种的速度消亡。

Want to learn Busuu, anyone?

有人想学习博树吗？

Then you'd better head to Cameroon fast, before one of the language's last eight speakers kicks the bucket (as the Busuu-nese presumably doesn't say).

然后，您最好快速前往喀麦隆，以免该语言的最后八位使用者之一去世（博树人大概不会这么说）。

questions.passage_html: The theme of contrast evident in Blue Skies is typical of Ms Vu's work. She explores organic structures using the newest technologies. questions.title: Chimpanzee Behavior
questions.passage_html: In studies of chimpanzee behavior, researchers seek to how they learn to use tools, with findings to understanding primate cognition. In an experiment, signals were to test communication skills, and responses occurred prior training.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析

1. answer

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“researchers seek to ______ how they learn to use tools”。answer 在此意为“解答/探究”，answer how... 表示“探究如何……”。句意是“在黑猩猩行为研究中，研究人员试图探究它们如何学习使用工具”。plan 虽可接 how，但“plan how”意为“计划如何”，与“研究/探究”的语境不符。因此填 answer。

2. applied

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“with findings ______ to understanding primate cognition”。applied to 是固定搭配，意为“应用于”，指研究发现被应用于理解灵长类认知。句意是“这些发现被应用于理解灵长类认知”。其他选项 due（由于）、despite（尽管）均为介词，不能与 to 构成“被应用于”的含义。因此填 applied。

3. sent

考点： 固定搭配

解析： 空格位于“signals were ______ to test communication skills”。send signals 是固定搭配，意为“发送信号”。句意是“在实验中，信号被发送以测试沟通能力”。其他选项中，happened（发生）和 planned（计划）均不能与 signals 构成“发送信号”的搭配。因此填 sent。

4. without

考点： 逻辑衔接

解析： 空格位于“responses occurred ______ prior training”。without 意为“没有”，表示反应是在没有事先训练的情况下发生的。句意是“反应在没有事先训练的情况下发生”。despite 意为“尽管”，表示“尽管有事先训练但仍发生”，与“without”逻辑相反——此处强调的是“无需训练即可产生反应”。因此填 without。

questions.title: Bhutan
questions.passage_html: Bhutan is the last standing Buddhist Kingdom in the World and, until recently, has much of their culture since the 17th century by avoiding globalization and staying isolated from the world. Internet, television, and western dress were from the country up until ten years ago. But over the past ten years globalization has begun to change in Bhutan, but things remain balanced. Bhutan is the only country in the world that has a 'GNH.' You may think GNH is just another based term with no real-life application, but it refers to "Gross National Happiness." The process of measuring GNH began when Bhutan opened to globalization. It measures people's quality of life, and makes sure that "material and spiritual development happen together." Bhutan has done an amazing Job of finding this balance. Bhutan has continually been (ranked) as the happiest country in all of Asia, and the eighth Happiest Country in the world according to Business Week. In 2007 Bhutan had the second fastest growing GDP in the world, at the same time as their environment and cultural identity. Bhutan is the only Buddhist Kingdom in the world; Mahayana Buddhism is the official religion of Bhutan. Over two thirds of the people are Buddhist, and Buddhism is supported by the government both politically and economically. The government gives to Buddhist monasteries, shrines, monks and other Buddhist programs.
questions.analysis_html:
1、preserved

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “has ______ much of their culture” 结构中。后文提到不丹通过“避免全球化和保持与世隔绝（avoiding globalization and staying isolated）”的方法来实现对文化的某种动作。闭关锁国的直接结果就是使自身文化免受外界冲击。preserved（保护/保存）在单句内部符合因果逻辑。

2、banned

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “Internet, television, and western dress were ______ from the country” 结构中。前文提到不丹一直保持与世隔绝，直到十年前，互联网、电视和西方服饰这些代表外界全球化的事物在不丹都是被“禁止”的。banned（禁止）准确描述了该国曾经严格控制外来文化的历史政策。

3、perfectly

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于 “things remain ______ balanced” 结构中。从语法结构来看，此处为“副词修饰形容词”的结构。空格后面是一个形容词 balanced（平衡的），需要填入一个副词来修饰其程度。结合选项与上下文语境，不丹在传统与现代之间保持着一种极其精妙的状态，perfectly（完美地）在此处最准确地修饰了这种平衡程度。

4、statistically

考点：上下文语境

解析：空格修饰 “based term（基于……的术语）”。后文立刻提到 “but it refers to 'Gross National Happiness.' The process of measuring GNH began...（但它指的是‘国民幸福总值’，其测量过程始于……）”。既然这个概念涉及到了具体的“测量（measuring）”以及后文提到的“排名（ranked）”，说明它不是一个虚无缥缈的空洞词汇，而是一个可以通过数据进行统计分析的术语。statistically（统计学上地）与后文的 measuring 构成了精准的语境呼应。

5、maintaining

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “at the same time as ______ their environment and cultural identity” 结构中。这里的 “at the same time as” 引导一个伴随或并列的结构，要求前后动作在逻辑和形式上保持一致。前文提到不丹拥有“全球第二快的GDP增长速度”，这里说明它在发展经济的同时，“也保持了”环境与文化特征。maintaining（保持/维护）的现在分词形式符合该结构的语法要求，并与前文的发展构成良性并列。

6、subsidies

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “The government gives ______ to Buddhist monasteries...” 结构中。前一句提到政府“在政治和经济上都支持佛教（supported... both politically and economically）”，本句则是对“经济支持”进行具体的单句解释。政府给寺庙、僧侣提供的经济支持在行政 and 财政语境中被称为“补贴/资助”。subsidies（补贴/资助金）作为 gives 的宾语，完美完成了这一经济行为的落地。
questions.translation_html:
Bhutan is the last standing Buddhist Kingdom in the World and, until recently, has preserved much of their culture since the 17th century by avoiding globalization and staying isolated from the world.

不丹是世界上最后一个存在的佛教王国，直到最近，通过避免全球化和与世界隔绝，还保留了自 17 世纪以来的大部分文化。

Internet, television, and western dress were banned from the country up until ten years ago.

直到十年前，该国还禁止互联网、电视和西式服装。

But over the past ten years globalization has begun to change in Bhutan, but things remain perfectly balanced.

但过去十年来，全球化在不丹开始发生变化，但一切仍然保持完美平衡。

Bhutan is the only country in the world that has a 'GNH.' You may think GNH is just another statistically based term with no real-life application, but it refers to "Gross National Happiness." The process of measuring GNH began when Bhutan opened to globalization.

不丹是世界上唯一拥有“国民幸福指数”的国家。您可能认为 GNH 只是另一个基于统计的术语，没有实际应用，但它指的是“国民幸福总值”。当不丹向全球化开放时，测量国民幸福指数的过程就开始了。

It measures people's quality of life, and makes sure that "material and spiritual development happen together." Bhutan has done an amazing Job of finding this balance.

它衡量人们的生活质量，确保“物质发展和精神发展同步发展”。不丹在寻找这种平衡方面做得非常出色。

Bhutan has continually been (ranked) as the happiest country in all of Asia, and the eighth Happiest Country in the world according to Business Week.

据《商业周刊》报道，不丹连续被评为亚洲最幸福的国家和世界第八幸福的国家。

In 2007 Bhutan had the second fastest growing GDP in the world, at the same time as maintaining their environment and cultural identity.

2007年，不丹的国内生产总值增长速度位居世界第二，同时保持了其环境和文化特征。

Bhutan is the only Buddhist Kingdom in the world; Mahayana Buddhism is the official religion of Bhutan.

不丹是世界上唯一的佛教王国；大乘佛教是不丹的官方宗教。

Over two thirds of the people are Buddhist, and Buddhism is supported by the government both politically and economically.

三分之二以上的人口信奉佛教，佛教在政治和经济上都得到政府的支持。

The government gives subsidies to Buddhist monasteries, shrines, monks and other Buddhist programs.

政府对佛教寺院、神社、僧侣和其他佛教项目给予补贴。

questions.title: Pewter
questions.passage_html: Pewter is an attractive metal which has been used for the of household and other items in Britain since Roman times. It is an alloy mostly of tin which has been with small amounts of other metals such as copper, lead or antimony to it and make it more durable.
questions.analysis_html:
1、production

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“the ______ of household and other items”。本句内部语义完整：白镴自古以来被用于家居用品和其他物品的“生产”。production 意为“生产”，符合语义。因此填 production。

2、consisting

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“an alloy ______ mostly of tin”，consist of 是固定搭配，意为“由……组成”。表示它是一种主要由锡组成的合金。因此填 consisting。

3、mixed

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“which has been ______ with small amounts of other metals”，此处为现在完成时的被动语态（has been + 过去分词），表示锡与少量的其他金属被混合在一起。因此填 mixed。

questions.analysis_html:
1、profits

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“driven by ______, cost control, and maintaining market share”。profits、cost control 和 maintaining market share 由逗号和 and 连接，构成并列结构，共同说明第一种领导力的驱动因素。根据并列结构的一致性，空格应填入与 cost control、market share 语义范畴相近的名词。profits 意为“利润/盈利”，符合语境。因此填 profits。

2、leadership

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于“versus ______ driven more by...”。本句中，第一种领导力（driven by profits...）与第二种领导力（______ driven more by...）形成对比关系，versus 前后的结构应保持一致。前文已出现 leadership，此处需要填入相同的词以构成平行结构。因此填 leadership。

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“customer or client ______”。本句内部语义完整：第二种领导力受客户或顾客的“需求”等因素驱动。仅凭本句即可判断需要表示“需求”的名词。因此填 needs。

questions.title: Australian Dwellings
questions.passage_html: The stock of Australia's dwellings is with current homes having more bedrooms on average than homes ten years ago. At the same time, households are getting smaller on average with decreasing of couple families with children and couple-only and lone-person households. This examines the changes in household size and number of bedrooms from 1994_95 to 2003_04. It also looks at the types of households with spare bedrooms and the size of recently purchased new homes compared with existing stock.
questions.analysis_html:
1、evolving

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “The stock of Australia's dwellings is ______” 结构中。后文用 “with current homes having more bedrooms on average than homes ten years ago（现在的住房平均比十年前拥有更多卧室）” 这一具体变化作为补充说明。这表明澳大利亚的住房总量结构并不是静止的，而是处于一种动态的演变、发展过程中。evolving（演变/逐步发展）在单句中精准地概括了这种跨越十年的动态变化。

2、proportions

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “with decreasing ______ of couple families with children” 结构中。此处的 decreasing 为形容词修饰空格。本句在讨论人口普查或家庭结构调查中的数据变动，“有孩子的夫妇家庭”在总家庭数中所占的“比例”在下降。proportions（比例/份额）作为名词，完美符合人口统计学语境中对家庭结构构成比例的客观描述。

3、increasing

考点：并列结构

解析：空格位于 “and ______ couple-only and lone-person households” 结构中。这里的 “and” 是核心线索，表明该短语与前面的 “decreasing proportions of couple families...” 构成了逻辑上的反义并列对照。既然前面是“有孩子的夫妇家庭比例在下降（decreasing）”，那么根据全段关于家庭正在变小（households are getting smaller）的论述，仅有夫妇的家庭和独居家庭的数量必然在上升。因此，填入分词形容词 increasing（增加的）在并列结构中完成了逻辑的完美闭环。

4、article

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于 “This ______ examines the changes...” 结构中。此处指代读者正在阅读的这篇文本本身。examines（探讨/审查） 和 looks at（关注） 是学术论文、调查报告或文章中极其经典的陈述研究目的的谓语动词。article（文章/报道）作为主语，完全符合单句的文本定性。

This article examines the changes in household size and number of bedrooms from 1994_95 to 2003_04.

It also looks at the types of households with spare bedrooms and the size of recently purchased new homes compared with existing stock.

questions.title: Fish Dispersal
questions.passage_html: Small lakes with a surface area of less than 100 m2 represent the majority of global freshwater ecosystems. Many of these lakes are found in , often mountainous areas with no inflow and outflow. Yet in most of these lakes, there are fish. So how do fish reach lakes and ponds that are not connected to other bodies of water? This question was already addressed by some of the leading natural scientists of the 19th century such as Charles Darwin, Alfred Russel Wallace and Charles Lyell, who all came to the same conclusion ‒ water birds must be responsible for fish . And they had a plausible explanation for this: fish eggs of some species are sticky and can survive for some time out of water. The theory is thus that the fish eggs stick to water birds’ or feet; the birds then fly from one body of water to the next, where the fish from their eggs.
questions.analysis_html:
答案解析：

questions.title: First Impression
questions.passage_html: First impressions based on facial appearance predict many important social outcomes. We investigated such impressions also influence the communication of scientific findings to lay audiences, a process that public beliefs, opinion, and policy. First, we investigated the traits that interest in a scientist's work, and those that create the impression of a "good scientist" who does high-quality research. Apparent competence and morality were positively related to both interest and quality judgments, attractiveness boosted interest but decreased perceived quality. Next, we had members of the public choose real science news stories to read or watch and found that people were more likely to choose items that were paired with "interesting-looking" scientists, especially when selecting video-based communications. Finally, we had people read real science news items and found that the research was judged to be of higher quality when paired with researchers who look like "good scientists." Our findings offer insights into the social psychology of science, and indicate a source of bias in the dissemination of scientific findings to broader society.

1、whether

考点：语法结构

解析：空格位于“We investigated ______ such impressions also influence...”，investigated 后接 whether 引导的宾语从句，表示“是否”。表示我们研究这些印象是否也会影响科学发现向非专业受众的传播。因此填 whether。

2、shapes

考点：单句理解

解析：空格位于“a process that ______ public beliefs, opinion, and policy”。本句内部语义完整：这一过程“塑造”公众的信念、观点和政策。shapes 意为“塑造/形成”，符合语义。因此填 shapes。

3、engender

考点：固定搭配

解析：空格位于“the traits that ______ interest in a scientist‘s work”，engender interest 是常见搭配，意为“产生兴趣/引起兴趣”。表示我们研究了哪些特质会引起人们对科学家工作的兴趣。因此填 engender。

4、whereas

考点：逻辑衔接

解析：空格位于“attractiveness boosted interest but decreased perceived quality, ______ competence and morality were positively related...”，whereas 表示对比，意为“然而”。前句说吸引力提高了兴趣但降低了感知质量，然而能力和道德与两者都呈正相关。因此填 whereas。
questions.translation_html:
First impressions based on facial appearance predict many important social outcomes.

基于外貌的第一印象可以预测许多重要的社会结果。

We investigated whether such impressions also influence the communication of scientific findings to lay audiences, a process that shapes public beliefs, opinion, and policy.

我们调查了这种印象是否也会影响科学研究成果向普通大众的传播,这个过程塑造了公众的信仰、意⻅和政策。

First, we investigated the traits that engender interest in a scientist's work, and those that create the impression of a "good scientist" who does high-quality research.

首先,我们调查了激发人们对科学家工作兴趣的特征,以及那些给人留下“好科学家”印象的特征,这些科学家进行着高质量的研究。

Apparent competence and morality were positively related to both interest and quality judgments, whereas attractiveness boosted interest but decreased perceived quality.

明显的胜任力和道德感与兴趣和质量的判断都呈正相关,而吸引力虽然增加了兴趣,但降低了感知的质量。

Next, we had members of the public choose real science news stories to read or watch and found that people were more likely to choose items that were paired with "interesting-looking" scientists, especially when selecting video- based communications.

接下来,我们让公众选择真实的科学新闻故事来阅读或观看,结果发现人们更倾向于选择那些与“看起来有趣”的科学家配对的项目,尤其是在选择视频通信的时候。

Finally, we had people read real science news items and found that the research was judged to be of higher quality when paired with researchers who look like "good scientists.

"

最后,我们让人们阅读真实的科学新闻条目,结果发现当与看起来像“好科学家”的研究者配对时,这项研究会被判定为质量更高。

Unlike conventional homes, they can be built on surfaces and can maximize space in small areas by going below the surface. They are also wind, fire, and earthquake resistant, providing a secure and safe environment in extreme weather. One of the greatest benefits of underground living is energy . questions.title: Holy Grail
questions.passage_html: It's interesting that in our minds, we keep thinking of the discovery like it's the Holy Grail. But there are a couple of shortcuts here that I'd like to unpack. I'm not a doctor, I'm just a . My clients focus on health care ― biopharma companies, providers, global health — and they've educated me. We need to find the tools to fight COVID, and we need to make them to all.

1、vaccine

- 考点：单句理解

- 解析：空格位于“the ______ discovery like it's the Holy Grail”。本句内部语义完整：我们在脑海中一直认为“疫苗”的发现就像圣杯一样。vaccine 意为“疫苗”，符合上下文关于 COVID 的讨论。因此填 vaccine。

2、consultant

- 考点：单句理解

- 解析：空格位于“I'm just a ______”。本句内部语义完整：我不是医生，我只是一个“顾问”。consultant 意为“顾问”，与后文“my clients focus on health care”呼应。因此填 consultant。

3、institutions

- 考点：并列结构

- 解析：空格位于“biopharma companies, providers, global health ______”。companies、providers 和 institutions 由逗号和 and 连接，构成并列结构，共同列举我的客户类型。institutions 意为“机构”，与 biopharma companies、providers 并列。因此填 institutions。

4、accessible

- 考点：固定搭配

- 解析：空格位于“make them ______ to all”，make sth. accessible to sb. 是固定搭配，意为“使某事物对某人可及/可获得”。表示我们需要让这些工具对所有人都可获得。因此填 accessible。

我的客户专注于医疗保健，包括生物制药公司、医疗服务提供者和全球卫生机构，是他们让我了解了这些内容。

questions.title: Statistical Theory
questions.passage_html: Social reforms are normally as a result of statistical analyses of factors such as crime rates and poverty levels etc. Large-scale population can result from projections devised by statisticians. Manufacturers can provide better products at lower costs by statistical control tools, as control charts. Diseases are controlled through analyses designed to anticipate epidemics. Endangered species of fish and other wildlife are protected through regulations and laws that react to statistical estimates of changing population sizes. And, statistical analysis of fatality rates, legislators can better justify laws, such as those governing air pollution, auto inspections, seat belt and airbag use, and drunk driving.
questions.analysis_html:
1、initiated

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“Social reforms are normally ______ as a result of...”，主语 Social reforms 与 initiate（发起/启动）之间为被动关系，are initiated 为一般现在时的被动语态。表示社会改革通常是在对犯罪率、贫困水平等因素进行统计分析之后才发起的。因此填 initiated。

2、using

考点:语法结构

解析:空格位于“by ______ statistical control tools”，by 是介词，后接动名词作宾语，表示“通过……方式”。using 意为“使用”，表示制造商通过使用统计控制工具来提供更好的产品。因此填 using。

3、such

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“______ as control charts”，such as 是固定搭配，意为“例如”，用于列举示例。表示统计控制工具例如控制图。因此填 such。

4、through

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“______ statistical analysis of fatality rates”，through statistical analysis 意为“通过统计分析”，表示通过死亡率统计分析，立法者可以更好地为法律提供依据。through 在此表示“通过某种方式/手段”。因此填 through。

Social reforms are normally initiated as a result of statistical analyses of factors such as crime rates and poverty levels etc.

社会改革通常是在对犯罪率、贫困水平等因素进行统计分析之后发起的。

Large-scale population can result from projections devised by statisticians.

大规模的人口（变化/迁移）可以通过统计学家设计的预测得出。

Manufacturers can provide better products at lower costs by using statistical control tools, such as control charts.

制造商可以利用统计控制工具（例如控制图），以更低的成本提供更好的产品。

Diseases are controlled through analyses designed to anticipate epidemics.

疾病通过旨在预测流行病的分析得到控制。

Endangered species of fish and other wildlife are protected through regulations and laws that react to statistical estimates of changing population sizes.

濒危鱼类和其他野生动物通过针对种群数量变化的统计估计而制定的法规和法律得到保护。

And, through statistical analysis of fatality rates, legislators can better justify laws, such as those governing air pollution, auto inspections, seat belt and airbag use, and drunk driving.

并且，通过对死亡率进行统计分析，立法者可以更好地为各项法律提供依据，例如那些关于空气污染、汽车检查、安全带与安全气囊使用以及酒驾的法律。

questions.title: Effective Leaders
questions.passage_html: In search of lessons to in our own careers, we often try to what effective leaders do. Roger Martin says this focus is misplaced, because moves that work in one context may make little sense in another. A more productive, though more difficult, approach is to look at how such leaders . After extensive interviews with more than 50 of them, the author discovered that most are thinkers -that is, they can hold in their heads two opposing ideas at once and then come up with a new idea that contains elements of but is superior to both.
questions.analysis_html:
1、apply

考点:固定搭配

解析:空格位于“lessons to ______ in our own careers”，apply lessons to/in... 是常见搭配，意为“将经验/教训应用于……”。表示我们寻找可应用于自己职业生涯的经验。因此填 apply。

2、emulate

考点:单句理解

解析:空格位于“try to ______ what effective leaders do”，emulate what sb. does 意为“效仿某人的做法”。表示我们常常试图效仿有效领导者的做法。因此填 emulate。

3、think

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“look at how such leaders ______”，前文指出关注领导者的具体做法是错的，因为一种情境下的做法在另一种情境下可能不适用。因此更有效的方法是关注这些领导者如何“思考”。think 意为“思考”，与后文提到的“整合思维”形成呼应。因此填 think。

4、integrative

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“most are ______ thinkers”，后文破折号解释了这种思维方式的特征：能够同时 hold two opposing ideas 并提出包含两者元素且更优的新想法。integrative thinkers 意为“整合思维者”，与后文解释一致。因此填 integrative。

5、each

考点:上下文语境

解析:空格位于“elements of ______ but superior to both”，elements of each 意为“每一个（对立观点）中的元素”。each 指代前文的 two opposing ideas，表示新想法包含两个对立观点中每一个的元素。因此填 each。

为了寻找适用于我们职业生涯的教训,我们通常会尝试效仿有效的领导者。

Roger Martin says this focus is misplaced, because moves that work in one context may make little sense in another.

罗杰·⻢丁认为,这种关注是错位的,因为在一种情况下有效的方法在另一种情

况下可能毫无意义。

A more productive, though more difficult, approach is to look at how such leaders think.

虽然更难,但更有效的方法是看看这些领导者是如何思考的。

After extensive interviews with more than 50 of them, the author discovered

that most are integrative thinkers -that is, they can hold in their heads two opposing ideas at once and then come up with a new idea that contains elements of each but is superior to both.

在与其中50多位进行广泛采访后,作者发现大多数都是整合性思考者,也就是

说,他们可以同时脑海中持有两个对立的想法,然后提出一个新的想法,其中包含两者的元素,但优于两者。

questions.title: Fingerprints
questions.passage_html: Fingerprints, referred to as 'fingermarks' in forensics, are formed when residue from the ridged skin of the fingers or palms is onto a surface, leaving behind an impression. Fingermarks are often made of sweat and colorless materials such as soap, moisturizer and grease. These fingermarks are described as 'latent' as they are generally invisible to the naked eye, which means that them at a crime scene can be challenging.
questions.analysis_html:
1、transferred

- 考点：语法结构

- 解析：空格位于“residue... is ______ onto a surface”，主语 residue 与 transfer（转移）之间为被动关系，is transferred 为被动语态。表示手指或手掌凸起皮肤上的残留物被转移到表面上。因此填 transferred。

2、contaminating

- 考点：单句理解

- 解析：空格位于“colorless ______ materials such as soap, moisturizer and grease”。本句内部语义完整：指纹通常由汗液和无色的“污染性”物质（如肥皂、润肤霜和油脂）构成。contaminating 意为“污染的”，符合语义。因此填 contaminating。

3、locating

- 考点：单句理解

- 解析：空格位于“______ them at a crime scene can be challenging”。本句内部语义完整：在犯罪现场“定位”它们可能具有挑战性。locating 意为“定位/找到”，符合语义。因此填 locating。
questions.translation_html:
Fingerprints, referred to as 'fingermarks' in forensics, are formed when residue from the ridged skin of the fingers or palms is transferred onto a surface, leaving behind an impression.

Fingermarks are often made of sweat and colorless contaminating materials such as soap, moisturizer and grease.

指印通常由汗液和肥皂、润肤霜、油脂等无色污染物构成。

These fingermarks are described as 'latent' as they are generally invisible to the naked eye, which means that locating them at a crime scene can be challenging.

这类指印被称为“潜指印”，因为它们通常肉眼不可见，这意味着在犯罪现场定位它们可能具有挑战性。

questions.title: Fossil Fuel
questions.passage_html: But look beyond fossil fuels for the most intriguing trends. One is that the energy intensity of the world economy -- the amount of energy it takes to produce one dollar's of income -- keeps falling, at a rate of about 2 percent. What this means is that even without any change in the shares of fossil-based and fossil-free sources in the world's energy mix, we could have 2 percent annual economic growth without increasing carbon emissions from energy use. Of course that is not enough to climate change and we need more economic growth than that. It is a stunning number, which refutes the claim by some environmentalists that permanent economic growth is fundamentally incompatible finite physical resources.
questions.analysis_html:
1、worth

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格位于名词短语 “one dollar's ______ of income” 中。这里是在给“能源强度（energy intensity）”下定义，即生产出“价值”一美元的收入所需要消耗的能源量。在单句内部的日常计量与经济学语义下，表达“价值……的东西”，直接选用名词 worth（价值/等值物）。

2、relative

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作定语修饰后面的名词 shares（份额）。文章指出，即使世界能源组合中化石能源与非化石能源的“【相对】份额”不发生任何改变，只要能源强度下降，我们也能实现无碳排的经济增长。在单句内部逻辑下，用来形容两部分份额彼此之间对比关系的，形容词 relative（相对的） 最为精准。

3、address

考点：单句理解

解析： 空格作动词原形，紧跟在 is not enough to 后面，宾语是 climate change（气候变化）。面对全球变暖这一重大环境灾难，人类的核心核心行动是去解决它、应对它。在单句内部的词义辨析中，address（解决/处理/应对） 是应对气候变化这一社会议题时的标准高频动词。

4、nonetheless

考点：逻辑衔接

解析： 空格位于句中作状语。前文提到“当然，仅仅做到这一点对于应对气候变化来说还远远【不够】（属于负面事实）”；本句紧接着指出“这【依然】是一个令人震惊的数字，它驳斥了……（属于正面价值）”。前后两句在逻辑上存在着清晰的让步转折关系，因此选用副词 nonetheless（尽管如此/然而） 满足分句间的逻辑衔接。

5、with

考点：固定搭配

解析： 空格位于 “permanent economic growth is fundamentally incompatible ______ finite physical resources” 结构中。此处是在讨论“持续的经济增长”与“有限的地球物理资源”之间的关系。在英语中，表达“与……不兼容 / 与……格格不入”，习惯使用的是由形容词构成的固定介词搭配 “be incompatible with...”。
questions.translation_html:
But look beyond fossil fuels for the most intriguing trends.

不过，最引人关注的趋势存在于化石燃料之外。

One is that the energy intensity of the world economy -- the amount of energy it takes to produce one dollar's worth of income -- keeps falling, at a rate of about 2 percent.

其中之一是全球经济的能源强度——即产生一美元价值的收入所需的能源量——持续下降，降幅约为2%。

What this means is that even without any change in the relative shares of fossil-based and fossil-free sources in the world's energy mix, we could have 2 percent annual economic growth without increasing carbon emissions from energy use.

这意味着，即使世界能源结构中化石能源与非化石能源的相对比例没有任何变化，我们也能够在实现2%的年经济增长的同时，不增加能源使用产生的碳排放。

Of course that is not enough to address climate change and we need more economic growth than that.

当然，这还不足以应对气候变化，而且我们需要比这更高的经济增长。

It is nonetheless a stunning number, which refutes the claim by some environmentalists that permanent economic growth is fundamentally incompatible with finite physical resources.

尽管如此，这个数字依然惊人，它驳斥了一些环保主义者的说法，即永久的经济增长从根本上与有限的物理资源是不相容的。

questions.title: Experiments
questions.passage_html: Experiments are designed to hypotheses under controlled conditions, where it is relatively easy to measure variables while keeping other factors . By ensuring that all other conditions remain stable, researchers can reliably cause-and-effect relationships.
questions.analysis_html:
1、test

考点：单句理解

Experiments are designed to test hypotheses under controlled conditions, where it is relatively easy to measure variables while keeping other factors constant .

实验旨在在受控条件下检验假设，在这种条件下，研究人员比较容易测量变量，同时保持其他因素不变。
